Saya akan susun sebagai peta praktis untuk onboarding: bukan teori Kafka umum, tapi area skill yang langsung kepakai di microservice Jersey/JAX-RS—producer/consumer, admin, Streams, ksqlDB, EDA patterns, operasional, dan failure model.

## Introduction

Decomposition map ini memetakan **skill praktis Java Kafka Client + EDA** untuk microservice berbasis **Jersey/JAX-RS**. Fokusnya bukan hanya “cara produce/consume message”, tapi bagaimana Kafka masuk ke lifecycle aplikasi: REST request masuk, validasi domain, transaksi database, publish event, consume event, retry, observability, deployment, dan recovery.

Baseline teknis yang relevan: Apache Kafka menyediakan API utama seperti **Producer API, Consumer API, Streams API, Connect API, Admin API**, dan Java client adalah client resmi yang dikelola langsung dalam proyek Kafka utama. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/42/apis/)) Kafka juga digunakan sebagai event streaming platform untuk data pipeline, streaming analytics, integrasi data, dan aplikasi mission-critical. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)) Untuk stream processing, **Kafka Streams** menyediakan pemrosesan dari input topic ke output topic, sedangkan **ksqlDB** menyediakan pendekatan SQL-like untuk membangun streaming app, query, transform, dan enrichment di atas Kafka. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/42/apis/))

## Tabular Decomposition Map

| Area | Skill / Domain | Yang perlu dikuasai | Relevansi di Jersey/JAX-RS microservice |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kafka core model | Topic, partition, offset | Memahami bahwa Kafka adalah append-only distributed log; ordering hanya kuat dalam partition, bukan seluruh topic. | Menentukan event key, ordering guarantee, dan strategi scaling consumer. |
| Kafka core model | Consumer group | Consumer dalam group membagi partition; rebalance terjadi saat membership atau assignment berubah. | Menentukan jumlah instance service, partition count, dan efek rolling deployment. |
| Kafka core model | Retention vs compaction | Retention menyimpan event berdasarkan waktu/ukuran; compaction menyimpan latest value per key. | Cocok untuk audit stream, replay, cache invalidation, lookup state, atau read model. |
| Producer | KafkaProducer lifecycle | Producer sebaiknya dikelola sebagai long-lived singleton/resource, bukan dibuat per request. | Di Jersey biasanya diinisialisasi saat application startup dan ditutup saat shutdown. |
| Producer | Key selection | Key menentukan partition dan ordering per aggregate/entity. | Misalnya `orderId`, `customerId`, `caseId`, atau `tenantId` agar event satu aggregate tetap berurutan. |
| Producer | Async send callback | Publish Kafka bersifat asynchronous; callback menangani success/failure metadata. | REST endpoint perlu memutuskan apakah response menunggu broker ack atau cukup setelah event disimpan di outbox. |
| Producer | Acks, retry, delivery timeout | Konfigurasi reliability producer: broker acknowledgement, retry, timeout, batching. | Salah konfigurasi bisa membuat REST API terlihat sukses padahal event gagal dipublish. |
| Producer | Idempotent producer | Mengurangi duplicate write akibat retry producer. | Penting untuk command/event yang tidak boleh menghasilkan duplikasi teknis. |
| Producer | Transactional producer | Atomic write ke beberapa partition/topic dengan transaction id. | Berguna untuk Kafka-to-Kafka pipeline; tidak otomatis menyelesaikan atomicity DB + Kafka tanpa pattern tambahan. |
| Consumer | Poll loop | Consumer harus rutin `poll`, memproses record, dan menjaga heartbeat. | Biasanya berjalan di worker thread/container-managed lifecycle, bukan di request thread JAX-RS. |
| Consumer | Offset commit | Offset commit menentukan kapan message dianggap selesai diproses. | Commit terlalu awal berisiko message loss; commit terlalu akhir berisiko duplicate processing. |
| Consumer | Manual commit | Commit setelah transaksi domain/database selesai. | Umum untuk at-least-once processing yang aman. |
| Consumer | Rebalance listener | Menangani partition revoked/assigned agar offset dan state lokal aman. | Penting saat deployment Kubernetes, autoscaling, atau crash recovery. |
| Consumer | Idempotent consumer | Consumer harus tahan duplicate message. | Gunakan event id, business id, dedup table, unique constraint, atau processed-event ledger. |
| Consumer | Retry strategy | Retry bisa blocking, delayed topic, retry topic, atau DLQ. | Hindari infinite retry yang menahan partition dan menyebabkan lag sistemik. |
| Consumer | Dead Letter Queue | Tempatkan poison message setelah retry habis. | DLQ harus punya metadata error, stack category, original topic, partition, offset, correlation id. |
| Admin | AdminClient | API untuk inspect/manage topic, broker, ACL, consumer group, config. Kafka Admin API memang mendukung manajemen topic, broker, ACL, dan object Kafka lain. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/42/apis/)) | Dipakai untuk tooling internal, startup validation, smoke test, dan operational automation. |
| Admin | Topic provisioning | Membuat topic secara deklaratif, bukan ad-hoc manual. | Cocok dimasukkan ke Terraform/Helm/GitOps, bukan dibiarkan dibuat otomatis sembarangan. |
| Admin | Consumer group inspection | Melihat group, assignment, lag, committed offset. | Berguna untuk health endpoint administratif dan troubleshooting production. |
| Admin | Config validation | Validasi bootstrap server, security config, topic existence, schema compatibility. | Fail-fast saat startup lebih baik daripada gagal saat traffic production. |
| Contract | Event envelope | Metadata standar: `eventId`, `eventType`, `eventVersion`, `occurredAt`, `correlationId`, `causationId`, `producer`, `tenantId`. | Membuat event mudah diaudit, dilacak, dan direplay. |
| Contract | CloudEvents | CloudEvents adalah spesifikasi untuk mendeskripsikan event data secara umum agar interoperable lintas service/platform. ([CloudEvents](https://cloudevents.io/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)) | Bisa dijadikan format envelope untuk event lintas microservice. |
| Contract | Serialization | JSON mudah debug; Avro/Protobuf lebih kuat untuk schema governance dan evolusi kontrak. | Pilih berdasarkan maturity tim, kebutuhan compatibility, dan tooling. |
| Contract | Schema Registry | Confluent Schema Registry mendukung Avro, JSON Schema, dan Protobuf serde, serta membantu mapping message ke bytes. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/schema-registry/index.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)) | Mencegah producer merilis schema breaking yang merusak consumer. |
| Contract | Compatibility mode | Default compatibility Confluent Schema Registry adalah `BACKWARD`; compatibility rules berbeda untuk Avro, Protobuf, dan JSON Schema. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/schema-registry/fundamentals/schema-evolution.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)) | Penting saat event versioning dan parallel deployment antar service. |
| EDA model | Command vs event | Command meminta aksi; event menyatakan fakta yang sudah terjadi. | REST endpoint biasanya menerima command, lalu menghasilkan state change dan event. |
| EDA model | Domain event vs integration event | Domain event internal bounded context; integration event kontrak publik antar service. | Jangan bocorkan object internal database sebagai event publik. |
| Pattern | Transactional outbox | Service menyimpan message/event ke tabel outbox dalam transaksi yang sama dengan update business entity; proses terpisah mengirimnya ke broker. ([microservices.io](https://microservices.io/patterns/data/transactional-outbox.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)) | Pattern utama untuk atomicity PostgreSQL + Kafka dalam JAX-RS service. |
| Pattern | CDC outbox | Debezium/Kafka Connect membaca outbox table dari WAL database dan mempublish ke Kafka. | Mengurangi custom publisher worker, tapi menambah dependency platform CDC. |
| Pattern | Idempotent consumer | Menjamin repeated delivery tidak menghasilkan efek bisnis ganda. | Wajib karena Kafka consumer umumnya perlu diasumsikan at-least-once di boundary aplikasi. |
| Pattern | Saga choreography | Saga choreography menjaga integritas transaksi terdistribusi melalui event subscriptions. ([AWS Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/cloud-design-patterns/saga-choreography.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)) | Cocok bila alur antar service sederhana dan tidak perlu coordinator pusat. |
| Pattern | Saga orchestration | Saga orchestration memakai coordinator/orchestrator pusat untuk menjaga integritas transaksi lintas service. ([AWS Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/cloud-design-patterns/saga-orchestration.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)) | Cocok jika alur bisnis kompleks, butuh visibility, compensation, atau state machine eksplisit. |
| Pattern | Event sourcing | State entity disimpan sebagai sequence event; current state dibentuk dari replay event. ([microservices.io](https://microservices.io/patterns/data/event-sourcing.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)) | Cocok untuk auditability tinggi, tapi lebih kompleks daripada CRUD + outbox. |
| Pattern | CQRS / read model | Write model menghasilkan event; read model dibangun async dari stream. | Cocok untuk query berat, dashboard, projection, cache, atau search index. |
| Pattern | Event replay | Memproses ulang event lama untuk rebuild projection atau memperbaiki bug logic. | Consumer harus deterministic, version-aware, dan idempotent. |
| Kafka Streams | KStream / KTable | `KStream` untuk event stream; `KTable` untuk changelog/current state. | Dipakai untuk enrichment, aggregation, join, read model, dan stream-table relation. |
| Kafka Streams | DSL vs Processor API | DSL lebih sederhana; Processor API lebih fleksibel untuk low-level topology/state handling. | Gunakan DSL dulu, Processor API hanya jika butuh kontrol detail. |
| Kafka Streams | Stateful processing | Aggregation, join, windowing, sessionization, state store. | Untuk real-time computation tanpa membuat service consumer manual terlalu kompleks. |
| Kafka Streams | State store | Local state untuk query/aggregation; dipulihkan dari changelog topic. | Perlu disk, readiness, restore time, dan observability khusus di Kubernetes. |
| Kafka Streams | Interactive queries | Kafka Streams memungkinkan state aplikasi di-query dari luar; state biasanya tersebar di banyak instance dan state store. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/42/streams/developer-guide/interactive-queries/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)) | Bisa expose JAX-RS endpoint untuk membaca materialized state lokal/remote. |
| Kafka Streams | Exactly-once processing | ksqlDB dan Streams mendukung model exactly-once processing pada pipeline tertentu, tetapi tetap perlu desain idempotency di external side effects. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/ksqldb/overview.html)) | Jangan klaim “exactly-once end-to-end” jika ada database/API eksternal tanpa kontrol transaksi. |
| ksqlDB | Streams & tables | ksqlDB memakai SQL-like language untuk streaming app, query, transform, dan enrichment di atas Kafka. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/ksqldb/overview.html)) | Cocok untuk transformasi cepat tanpa deploy Java service baru. |
| ksqlDB | Persistent query | Query terus berjalan dan menulis hasil ke stream/table baru. | Berguna untuk derived topic, enrichment, denormalisasi, dan near-real-time view. |
| ksqlDB | Push / pull query | Push untuk continuous stream result; pull untuk lookup terhadap materialized table. | Bisa dipakai oleh service, tetapi hati-hati coupling runtime ke ksqlDB availability. |
| ksqlDB | Java client / REST API | ksqlDB menyediakan REST API dan Java client untuk request dari kode. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/ksqldb/developer-guide/overview.html)) | JAX-RS service bisa mengelola query atau membaca hasil, tapi jangan jadikan ksqlDB sebagai transactional source of truth. |
| Kafka Connect | Source connector | Membawa data dari source system ke Kafka. | CDC dari PostgreSQL, ingest file, database, SaaS, legacy system. |
| Kafka Connect | Sink connector | Membawa data dari Kafka ke sink system. | Index ke Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, write ke object storage, warehouse, atau cache. |
| Jersey integration | REST-to-event boundary | Endpoint menerima request, validasi, jalankan use case, lalu publish event. | Pilihan aman: DB transaction + outbox, bukan langsung producer send di tengah transaksi. |
| Jersey integration | Producer injection | Producer di-bind via HK2/CDI sebagai singleton service. | Hindari producer dibuat per request karena mahal dan sulit dikontrol lifecycle-nya. |
| Jersey integration | Consumer bootstrap | Consumer worker dimulai saat app startup, shutdown graceful saat container stop. | Perlu koordinasi dengan Kubernetes termination grace period. |
| Jersey integration | Health endpoint | Pisahkan liveness, readiness, dan dependency health. | Kafka down tidak selalu berarti liveness mati; readiness bisa fail jika service tidak boleh menerima traffic. |
| Jersey integration | Correlation & tracing | Propagasi trace id dari HTTP header ke Kafka header. | Memudahkan tracing REST → Kafka → consumer → database. |
| Reliability | At-most-once | Commit sebelum proses; risiko loss. | Jarang cocok untuk domain bisnis penting. |
| Reliability | At-least-once | Proses dulu, commit setelah sukses; risiko duplicate. | Default practical choice untuk microservice bisnis. |
| Reliability | Effectively-once | Kombinasi idempotent producer, transactional outbox, idempotent consumer, unique constraints. | Lebih realistis daripada menjanjikan exactly-once absolut lintas DB/API/Kafka. |
| Reliability | Poison message | Message valid secara Kafka tapi gagal secara aplikasi. | Harus ada classification: transient, permanent, schema, authorization, business rule. |
| Reliability | Backpressure | Consumer lag naik saat downstream lambat. | Perlu rate limit, pause/resume partition, retry topic, autoscaling, atau load shedding. |
| Security | TLS / SASL / ACL | Kafka authorization memakai ACL untuk resource; ACL dapat diterapkan pada resource seperti topic/group. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/security/authorization-and-acls/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)) | Service identity harus punya permission minimal: read/write topic, read group, describe cluster sesuai kebutuhan. |
| Security | Secret management | JAAS, truststore, keystore, SASL credential, OAuth token. | Di Kubernetes gunakan Secret, mounted file, atau external secret manager. |
| Governance | Topic naming | Format topic: domain.entity.event atau domain.capability.stream. | Hindari nama teknis random yang tidak menunjukkan ownership dan semantic. |
| Governance | Ownership | Setiap topic/event harus punya owner, schema, retention policy, SLA, dan deprecation policy. | Tanpa ownership, Kafka berubah menjadi distributed data swamp. |
| Observability | Producer metrics | Record send rate, error rate, retry rate, request latency, batch size. | Deteksi broker issue atau network issue dari sisi aplikasi. |
| Observability | Consumer metrics | Lag, poll interval, processing latency, commit latency, rebalance count. | Lag tinggi belum tentu buruk; lihat latency bisnis dan backlog growth. |
| Observability | Stream metrics | State restore time, task assignment, processing rate, punctuator, RocksDB metrics. | Penting untuk Kafka Streams di Kubernetes. |
| Deployment | Docker | Inject config via env/file; jangan bake secret ke image. | Sama seperti JAX-RS service lain, tapi Kafka client config lebih sensitif. |
| Deployment | Kubernetes | Readiness harus mempertimbangkan producer/consumer/stream state. | Rolling update dapat memicu rebalance; gunakan graceful shutdown. |
| Deployment | Cloud/on-prem | MSK/Confluent/Azure/Event Hubs-compatible Kafka/on-prem punya detail security dan limit berbeda. | Abstraksi client sama, tapi operasional, quota, auth, dan networking berbeda. |

## Practical Skill Grouping untuk Senior Engineer

### 1. Application-level Kafka usage

Ini skill yang langsung muncul di kode Jersey/JAX-RS:

```text
Resource/Controller
  → Application Service
    → DB transaction
      → Domain state change
      → Outbox insert
  → HTTP response

Outbox Publisher / CDC
  → Kafka topic

Kafka Consumer
  → Deserialize
  → Validate event version
  → Idempotency check
  → Application Service
  → DB transaction
  → Commit offset
```

Yang harus jelas sebagai invariant:

| Invariant | Kenapa penting |
|---|---|
| Jangan publish event bisnis sebelum state bisnis committed | Mencegah event mereferensikan state yang tidak pernah terjadi. |
| Jangan commit offset sebelum side effect sukses | Mencegah message loss. |
| Consumer harus idempotent | Duplicate delivery bisa terjadi saat retry, crash, rebalance, atau commit failure. |
| Event schema harus backward/forward-aware | Service tidak deploy bersamaan. |
| Event key harus sesuai aggregate ordering | Salah key bisa merusak urutan event domain. |

---

### 2. Decision map: Producer langsung vs Outbox

| Pilihan | Cocok untuk | Risiko |
|---|---|---|
| Direct producer dari REST request | Event non-critical, telemetry, audit tambahan, fire-and-forget yang boleh hilang/diulang | DB commit sukses tapi Kafka publish gagal, atau sebaliknya |
| DB transaction + polling outbox | Domain event penting, butuh consistency DB + Kafka | Perlu worker tambahan dan cleanup outbox |
| DB transaction + CDC outbox | Maturity platform tinggi, ada Kafka Connect/Debezium | Operasional CDC lebih kompleks |
| Kafka transaction only | Kafka-to-Kafka pipeline | Tidak menyelesaikan transaksi dengan PostgreSQL biasa |

Rekomendasi untuk microservice bisnis: **pakai transactional outbox untuk event yang merepresentasikan perubahan state domain penting**.

---

### 3. Decision map: Consumer retry

| Strategi | Cocok untuk | Hindari jika |
|---|---|---|
| Immediate retry in-memory | Error transient sangat singkat | Bisa menahan partition terlalu lama |
| Fixed/exponential backoff | Error downstream sementara | Backoff terlalu panjang di poll loop bisa memicu rebalance |
| Retry topic | Error transient menengah/panjang | Butuh ordering ketat per key tanpa desain khusus |
| DLQ | Poison message, schema invalid, business-invalid, retry exhausted | DLQ tidak dimonitor; itu hanya memindahkan masalah |
| Manual intervention + replay | Data penting dan perlu koreksi | Tidak ada tooling offset/replay/audit |

---

### 4. Decision map: Kafka Streams vs ksqlDB vs plain Consumer

| Use case | Plain Consumer | Kafka Streams | ksqlDB |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Consume event lalu update DB | Sangat cocok | Bisa, tapi sering overkill | Kurang cocok |
| Simple transform topic A → topic B | Bisa | Cocok | Sangat cocok |
| Stateful aggregation | Manual sulit | Sangat cocok | Cocok |
| Windowing | Manual sulit | Sangat cocok | Cocok |
| Join stream-table | Manual kompleks | Sangat cocok | Cocok |
| SQL-first data team workflow | Kurang cocok | Kurang cocok | Sangat cocok |
| Complex domain side effect | Sangat cocok | Bisa | Kurang cocok |
| Low-level custom processing | Cocok | Processor API cocok | Kurang cocok |
| Operational transparency via code | Cocok | Cocok | Tergantung governance query |

---

## Roadmap Alur Belajar Singkat

### Phase 1 - Kafka client survival skill

1. Topic, partition, offset, consumer group, rebalance.
2. Java `KafkaProducer` dan `KafkaConsumer`.
3. Producer config: `acks`, retry, timeout, batching, compression, keying.
4. Consumer config: `group.id`, `auto.offset.reset`, `enable.auto.commit`, commit manual.
5. Header propagation: correlation id, trace id, causation id.

Target output: bisa membaca service existing dan tahu “message ini masuk topic mana, key-nya apa, siapa consumer-nya, offset commit kapan”.

---

### Phase 2 - Reliable microservice integration

1. Transactional outbox.
2. Idempotent consumer.
3. Retry topic dan DLQ.
4. Schema Registry dan schema compatibility.
5. Health check, graceful shutdown, lag monitoring.

Target output: bisa mendesain REST → DB → Kafka dan Kafka → DB tanpa message loss diam-diam.

---

### Phase 3 - EDA pattern & domain modelling

1. Command vs event.
2. Domain event vs integration event.
3. Event notification vs event-carried state transfer.
4. Saga choreography vs orchestration.
5. CQRS/read model.
6. Event sourcing, hanya setelah paham trade-off.

Target output: bisa menentukan apakah sebuah kebutuhan cocok pakai REST sync, Kafka async, saga, outbox, atau read model.

---

### Phase 4 - Stream processing

1. Kafka Streams: KStream, KTable, GlobalKTable.
2. Stateless transform.
3. Stateful aggregation.
4. Windowing.
5. Joins.
6. State store dan interactive queries.
7. Exactly-once processing boundary.

Target output: bisa membuat topology stream processing yang production-ready, bukan sekadar demo word-count.

---

### Phase 5 - ksqlDB & platform-level operation

1. ksqlDB stream/table.
2. Persistent query.
3. Push/pull query.
4. Materialized view.
5. Deployment dan governance ksqlDB.
6. Kafka AdminClient.
7. Topic/ACL/config automation.
8. Kubernetes deployment behavior dan consumer rebalancing.

Target output: bisa membedakan mana yang harus jadi Java service, mana yang cukup ksqlDB, dan mana yang harus diurus platform team.

# Cheatsheet - Java Kafka Producer dalam Jersey/JAX-RS Microservice

## 1. Core Mental Model

Kafka Producer di service JAX-RS bertugas mengubah **hasil aksi aplikasi** menjadi **event/message** yang dikirim ke Kafka topic.

```text
HTTP Request
   ↓
JAX-RS Resource
   ↓
Application Service / Use Case
   ↓
Domain State Change
   ↓
PostgreSQL Transaction
   ↓
Event Publication Boundary
   ↓
Kafka Producer
   ↓
Kafka Topic / Partition
```

Kafka menyediakan **Producer API** untuk mengirim stream data ke topic, dan Java client resmi berada dalam proyek utama Apache Kafka. Versi dokumentasi terbaru Kafka 4.3.1 mencantumkan dependency Maven `org.apache.kafka:kafka-clients:4.3.1`. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/apis/))

---

## 2. Prinsip Utama Producer di Microservice

| Prinsip | Penjelasan praktis |
|---|---|
| Producer adalah infrastructure boundary | Jangan campur logic Kafka langsung di JAX-RS resource. Bungkus dalam `EventPublisher`. |
| Producer sebaiknya long-lived singleton | `KafkaProducer` thread-safe; sharing satu instance lintas thread umumnya lebih cepat daripada membuat banyak instance. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/producer/KafkaProducer.html)) |
| `send()` bersifat asynchronous | `send()` menaruh record ke buffer pending dan langsung return; batching terjadi di background I/O thread. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/producer/KafkaProducer.html)) |
| Harus ditutup saat shutdown | Producer punya buffer dan background I/O thread; tidak menutup producer bisa menyebabkan resource leak. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/producer/KafkaProducer.html)) |
| Jangan jadikan Kafka sebagai “afterthought” | Event key, schema, ordering, retry, dan observability harus didesain sejak awal. |
| Untuk event bisnis penting, gunakan outbox | Direct publish dari REST transaction sering gagal menjaga atomicity DB + Kafka. |

---

## 3. Dependency Maven

```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.kafka</groupId>
    <artifactId>kafka-clients</artifactId>
    <version>4.3.1</version>
</dependency>
```

Gunakan versi yang align dengan platform perusahaan. Kafka client biasanya backward-compatible dalam banyak skenario, tapi fitur tertentu seperti transaction tetap bergantung pada versi broker yang mendukungnya; Kafka transactional API membutuhkan broker Kafka 0.11.0 atau lebih baru. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/producer/KafkaProducer.html))

---

## 4. Producer Lifecycle dalam Jersey/JAX-RS

### Recommended lifecycle

```text
Application startup
   ↓
Load config from env/properties/secret
   ↓
Create KafkaProducer singleton
   ↓
Inject EventPublisher into service layer
   ↓
Handle REST traffic
   ↓
Send event asynchronously
   ↓
Application shutdown
   ↓
Flush/close producer with timeout
```

### Anti-pattern lifecycle

```text
HTTP request
   ↓
new KafkaProducer()
   ↓
send()
   ↓
close()
```

Ini buruk karena producer membuat buffer, metadata, koneksi network, dan I/O thread. Membuat producer per request akan mahal, memperburuk latency, dan menyulitkan batching.

---

## 5. Producer Configuration Map

| Config | Fungsi | Rekomendasi praktis |
|---|---|---|
| `bootstrap.servers` | Initial broker list untuk bootstrap koneksi. Kafka menyarankan lebih dari satu server agar resilient jika ada server down. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/generated/producer_config.html)) | Isi minimal 2-3 broker / endpoint bootstrap. |
| `client.id` | Logical application name untuk tracking request dari client. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/generated/producer_config.html)) | Gunakan nama service + environment, misalnya `order-service-prod`. |
| `key.serializer` | Serializer untuk key. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/generated/producer_config.html)) | Umumnya `StringSerializer` untuk aggregate id. |
| `value.serializer` | Serializer untuk value. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/generated/producer_config.html)) | JSON/Avro/Protobuf serializer sesuai standard perusahaan. |
| `acks` | Menentukan acknowledgement sebelum send dianggap sukses. `acks=all` adalah guarantee terkuat dan default-nya `all`. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/generated/producer_config.html)) | Untuk event bisnis penting: `all`. |
| `enable.idempotence` | Jika true, producer memastikan satu copy untuk setiap message dalam stream; default true jika tidak ada config konflik. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/generated/producer_config.html)) | Biarkan true untuk production. |
| `retries` | Retry transient error sampai sukses, non-transient error, atau `delivery.timeout.ms` habis. Default `Integer.MAX_VALUE`; Kafka menyarankan mengontrol retry via `delivery.timeout.ms`. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/generated/producer_config.html)) | Jangan set kecil tanpa alasan kuat. |
| `delivery.timeout.ms` | Upper bound waktu dari `send()` sampai success/failure dilaporkan. Default 120 detik. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/generated/producer_config.html)) | Sesuaikan dengan SLA publish dan retry tolerance. |
| `request.timeout.ms` | Timeout menunggu response request broker. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/generated/producer_config.html)) | Harus lebih kecil/sesuai dengan `delivery.timeout.ms`. |
| `linger.ms` | Delay kecil untuk batching; default 5 ms sejak Kafka 4.0. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/generated/producer_config.html)) | 5-20 ms sering masuk akal untuk throughput. |
| `batch.size` | Upper bound batch per partition. Batching meningkatkan performa client dan broker. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/generated/producer_config.html)) | Naikkan jika throughput tinggi dan memory cukup. |
| `compression.type` | Compression batch: `none`, `gzip`, `snappy`, `lz4`, `zstd`. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/generated/producer_config.html)) | Umumnya `lz4` atau `zstd`, sesuai standard platform. |
| `buffer.memory` | Total memory producer untuk record yang menunggu dikirim; jika penuh, `send()` block sampai `max.block.ms`, lalu gagal. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/generated/producer_config.html)) | Monitor buffer exhaustion. |
| `max.block.ms` | Batas blocking untuk `send()`, metadata fetch, buffer allocation, dan beberapa transactional method. Default 60 detik. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/generated/producer_config.html)) | Jangan biarkan request thread HTTP menggantung terlalu lama. |
| `max.request.size` | Batas ukuran request producer. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/generated/producer_config.html)) | Validasi payload agar event tidak terlalu besar. |
| `max.in.flight.requests.per.connection` | Jumlah request unacknowledged per connection; default 5. Dengan idempotence true, ordering tetap dijaga untuk nilai yang diizinkan. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/generated/producer_config.html)) | Biarkan default kecuali ada kebutuhan ordering/throughput khusus. |
| `security.protocol` | Protocol broker: `PLAINTEXT`, `SSL`, `SASL_PLAINTEXT`, `SASL_SSL`. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/generated/producer_config.html)) | Production biasanya `SASL_SSL` atau `SSL`. |

---

## 6. Baseline Config Production

```java
Properties props = new Properties();

props.put(ProducerConfig.BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS_CONFIG,
        System.getenv("KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS"));

props.put(ProducerConfig.CLIENT_ID_CONFIG,
        "order-service-prod");

props.put(ProducerConfig.KEY_SERIALIZER_CLASS_CONFIG,
        StringSerializer.class.getName());

props.put(ProducerConfig.VALUE_SERIALIZER_CLASS_CONFIG,
        StringSerializer.class.getName());

// Durability
props.put(ProducerConfig.ACKS_CONFIG, "all");
props.put(ProducerConfig.ENABLE_IDEMPOTENCE_CONFIG, "true");

// Retry budget
props.put(ProducerConfig.DELIVERY_TIMEOUT_MS_CONFIG, "120000");
props.put(ProducerConfig.REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS_CONFIG, "30000");

// Throughput / latency tuning
props.put(ProducerConfig.LINGER_MS_CONFIG, "5");
props.put(ProducerConfig.BATCH_SIZE_CONFIG, "16384");
props.put(ProducerConfig.COMPRESSION_TYPE_CONFIG, "lz4");

// Backpressure control
props.put(ProducerConfig.BUFFER_MEMORY_CONFIG, "33554432");
props.put(ProducerConfig.MAX_BLOCK_MS_CONFIG, "5000");

// Security example only; use real company standard
props.put("security.protocol", "SASL_SSL");
props.put("sasl.mechanism", "SCRAM-SHA-512");
props.put("sasl.jaas.config", System.getenv("KAFKA_SASL_JAAS_CONFIG"));
```

Catatan penting: `enable.idempotence=true` membutuhkan `acks=all`, `retries > 0`, dan `max.in.flight.requests.per.connection <= 5`; jika config konflik dan idempotence eksplisit diaktifkan, Kafka akan melempar `ConfigException`. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/generated/producer_config.html))

---

## 7. ProducerRecord Anatomy

```java
ProducerRecord<String, String> record = new ProducerRecord<>(
        "order.events.v1",     // topic
        orderId,               // key
        jsonPayload            // value
);
```

`ProducerRecord` adalah pasangan key/value yang dikirim ke topic Kafka. Key memengaruhi partitioning jika partition tidak ditentukan; konfigurasi default memilih partition berdasarkan hash key ketika key tersedia. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/40/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/producer/package-summary.html))

### Struktur praktis record

| Bagian | Contoh | Fungsi |
|---|---|---|
| Topic | `order.events.v1` | Channel event. |
| Key | `order-123` | Partitioning dan ordering per aggregate. |
| Value | JSON/Avro/Protobuf event | Business payload. |
| Headers | `correlation-id`, `traceparent`, `event-type` | Metadata tracing, routing, debugging. |
| Timestamp | `occurredAt` | Waktu event domain atau waktu publish. |

---

## 8. Event Keying Strategy

Event key adalah salah satu keputusan terpenting.

| Key | Cocok untuk | Konsekuensi |
|---|---|---|
| `orderId` | Semua event order harus ordered per order | Baik untuk aggregate consistency |
| `customerId` | Semua event customer harus satu partition | Bisa hot partition jika customer besar |
| `tenantId` | Multi-tenant routing | Risiko hot tenant |
| Random UUID | Distribusi merata | Tidak ada ordering per entity |
| Null key | Sticky/default partitioning | Tidak cocok jika butuh ordering domain |
| Composite key | `tenantId:orderId` | Baik untuk multi-tenant + aggregate ordering |

Rule of thumb:

```text
Butuh ordering per aggregate?
  → key = aggregateId

Butuh distribusi throughput tinggi dan ordering tidak penting?
  → random / generated key

Ada tenant besar?
  → jangan key hanya tenantId

Ada event lifecycle entity?
  → key harus stabil sepanjang lifecycle entity
```

---

## 9. Event Envelope Standard

Contoh envelope JSON:

```json
{
  "eventId": "01JZABCDEF123456789",
  "eventType": "OrderCreated",
  "eventVersion": 1,
  "occurredAt": "2026-07-13T10:15:30Z",
  "producer": "order-service",
  "correlationId": "req-abc-123",
  "causationId": "cmd-xyz-456",
  "tenantId": "tenant-a",
  "aggregateType": "Order",
  "aggregateId": "order-123",
  "payload": {
    "orderId": "order-123",
    "customerId": "customer-456",
    "status": "CREATED"
  }
}
```

| Field | Wajib? | Fungsi |
|---|---:|---|
| `eventId` | Ya | Deduplication dan audit. |
| `eventType` | Ya | Routing consumer. |
| `eventVersion` | Ya | Schema evolution. |
| `occurredAt` | Ya | Waktu fakta domain terjadi. |
| `producer` | Ya | Ownership/debugging. |
| `correlationId` | Ya | Trace HTTP → Kafka → consumer. |
| `causationId` | Opsional | Menghubungkan event dengan command/event sebelumnya. |
| `tenantId` | Jika multi-tenant | Authorization, partitioning, audit. |
| `aggregateId` | Ya untuk domain event | Ordering dan replay per entity. |
| `payload` | Ya | Data bisnis. |

---

## 10. Async Send dengan Callback

```java
public final class KafkaEventPublisher implements EventPublisher, AutoCloseable {
    private final KafkaProducer<String, String> producer;
    private final String topic;

    public KafkaEventPublisher(KafkaProducer<String, String> producer, String topic) {
        this.producer = producer;
        this.topic = topic;
    }

    @Override
    public void publish(DomainEvent event) {
        String key = event.aggregateId();
        String value = serialize(event);

        ProducerRecord<String, String> record =
                new ProducerRecord<>(topic, key, value);

        record.headers()
                .add("event-type", event.eventType().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
                .add("event-id", event.eventId().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
                .add("correlation-id", event.correlationId().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));

        producer.send(record, (metadata, exception) -> {
            if (exception != null) {
                // Do not swallow this.
                // Send to metrics/logging/alerting or mark outbox row failed.
                log.error("Kafka publish failed topic={} key={} eventId={}",
                        topic, key, event.eventId(), exception);
                return;
            }

            log.info("Kafka published topic={} partition={} offset={} key={} eventId={}",
                    metadata.topic(),
                    metadata.partition(),
                    metadata.offset(),
                    key,
                    event.eventId());
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        producer.close(Duration.ofSeconds(10));
    }

    private String serialize(DomainEvent event) {
        // Replace with JSON-B/Jackson/Avro/Protobuf serializer standard.
        return Json.encode(event);
    }
}
```

`send(record, callback)` mengirim record secara asynchronous dan memanggil callback saat send sudah di-acknowledge. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/producer/KafkaProducer.html))

---

## 11. Synchronous Send: Kapan Boleh?

```java
RecordMetadata metadata = producer
        .send(record)
        .get(3, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
```

Gunakan synchronous send hanya untuk:

| Use case | Boleh? |
|---|---:|
| Startup smoke test | Ya |
| Admin/internal command volume kecil | Ya |
| Unit/integration test | Ya |
| REST endpoint high-throughput | Tidak disarankan |
| Dalam DB transaction | Sangat tidak disarankan |
| Publish critical event tanpa outbox | Tetap problematik |

Masalah utama sync send di request thread: latency REST menjadi tergantung broker, metadata lookup, buffer availability, retry, dan network.

---

## 12. REST Boundary: Direct Publish vs Outbox

### A. Direct publish

```text
POST /orders
   ↓
Insert order into DB
   ↓
producer.send(OrderCreated)
   ↓
Return 201
```

Problem:

| Failure | Dampak |
|---|---|
| DB commit sukses, Kafka publish gagal | State berubah tapi event hilang. |
| Kafka publish sukses, DB rollback | Event menyatakan fakta yang tidak pernah committed. |
| Service crash setelah DB commit sebelum send | Event tidak pernah dikirim. |
| Callback gagal tapi REST sudah 201 | Client melihat sukses, downstream tidak menerima event. |

### B. Transactional outbox

```text
POST /orders
   ↓
DB transaction:
   - insert order
   - insert outbox_event
   ↓
commit
   ↓
Return 201
   ↓
Outbox relay publishes to Kafka
   ↓
Mark outbox as published
```

Transactional outbox menyimpan event/message di database dalam transaksi yang sama dengan update entity, lalu proses terpisah mengirimkannya ke broker; pattern ini menghindari 2PC dan memastikan message dikirim jika dan hanya jika transaksi database commit. ([microservices.io](https://microservices.io/patterns/data/transactional-outbox.html))

---

## 13. PostgreSQL Outbox Table Example

```sql
CREATE TABLE outbox_event (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    aggregate_type  TEXT NOT NULL,
    aggregate_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_type      TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_version   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    topic           TEXT NOT NULL,
    partition_key   TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload         JSONB NOT NULL,
    headers         JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    status          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
    retry_count     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    next_attempt_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    published_at    TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE INDEX idx_outbox_pending
ON outbox_event (status, next_attempt_at, created_at)
WHERE status = 'PENDING';
```

### Outbox relay flow

```text
Loop
  ↓
SELECT pending rows FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  ↓
publish to Kafka
  ↓
on success: mark PUBLISHED
  ↓
on failure: increment retry_count, set next_attempt_at
```

```sql
SELECT *
FROM outbox_event
WHERE status = 'PENDING'
  AND next_attempt_at <= now()
ORDER BY created_at
LIMIT 100
FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;
```

`SKIP LOCKED` berguna saat beberapa worker relay berjalan paralel agar row yang sedang dikunci worker lain tidak memblokir worker berikutnya.

---

## 14. Outbox Relay Pseudocode

```java
public final class OutboxPublisherJob {
    private final OutboxRepository outboxRepository;
    private final EventPublisher publisher;

    public void runOnce() {
        List<OutboxEvent> batch = outboxRepository.lockPendingBatch(100);

        for (OutboxEvent event : batch) {
            try {
                publisher.publish(event.toDomainEvent());

                // Safer variant: wait for future result or use callback to mark success.
                outboxRepository.markPublished(event.id());
            } catch (RetriablePublishException e) {
                outboxRepository.reschedule(event.id(), backoff(event.retryCount()));
            } catch (NonRetriablePublishException e) {
                outboxRepository.markFailed(event.id(), e.getMessage());
            }
        }
    }
}
```

Untuk relay yang benar-benar kuat, jangan mark `PUBLISHED` sebelum Kafka acknowledgement diterima. Jika relay crash setelah Kafka publish sukses tapi sebelum mark published, event bisa terkirim ulang; karena itu consumer tetap harus idempotent. Microservices.io juga menekankan bahwa message relay dapat publish lebih dari sekali, sehingga consumer perlu idempotent. ([microservices.io](https://microservices.io/patterns/data/transactional-outbox.html))

---

## 15. Idempotent Producer

Idempotent producer mencegah duplicate yang disebabkan oleh retry producer pada satu producer session. Sejak Kafka 3.0, `enable.idempotence` default true, dan saat aktif `retries` default ke `Integer.MAX_VALUE` serta `acks` default ke `all`. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/producer/KafkaProducer.html))

Yang sering disalahpahami:

| Mitos | Realita |
|---|---|
| Idempotent producer berarti end-to-end exactly once | Tidak. Ini hanya sisi producer write ke Kafka dalam constraint tertentu. |
| Aman melakukan application-level resend manual | Tidak selalu. Kafka docs menyarankan menghindari application-level resend karena tidak bisa dideduplicate oleh idempotent producer. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/producer/KafkaProducer.html)) |
| Idempotence menyelesaikan DB + Kafka atomicity | Tidak. Untuk itu gunakan outbox/CDC. |
| Idempotence menghilangkan kebutuhan idempotent consumer | Tidak. Consumer tetap harus tahan duplicate dari replay, relay, atau proses lain. |

---

## 16. Transactional Producer

Transactional producer memungkinkan satu producer mengirim message ke beberapa topic/partition secara atomic dalam satu transaksi Kafka. Kafka docs menyatakan transactional producer memungkinkan aplikasi mengirim message ke banyak partition dan topic secara atomik. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/producer/KafkaProducer.html))

```java
props.put(ProducerConfig.TRANSACTIONAL_ID_CONFIG, "order-service-publisher-0");

KafkaProducer<String, String> producer = new KafkaProducer<>(props);
producer.initTransactions();

try {
    producer.beginTransaction();

    producer.send(new ProducerRecord<>("order.events.v1", orderId, eventJson));
    producer.send(new ProducerRecord<>("audit.events.v1", orderId, auditJson));

    producer.commitTransaction();
} catch (ProducerFencedException |
         OutOfOrderSequenceException |
         AuthorizationException fatal) {
    producer.close();
    throw fatal;
} catch (KafkaException retriableOrAbortable) {
    producer.abortTransaction();
    throw retriableOrAbortable;
}
```

Important boundary:

| Hal | Penjelasan |
|---|---|
| `transactional.id` wajib | Untuk transactional producer, config `transactional.id` harus diset; jika diset, idempotence otomatis implied. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/generated/producer_config.html)) |
| Satu open transaction per producer | Semua message antara `beginTransaction()` dan `commitTransaction()` adalah bagian dari satu transaksi. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/producer/KafkaProducer.html)) |
| `initTransactions()` wajib | Harus dipanggil sebelum `beginTransaction()` pertama. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/producer/KafkaProducer.html)) |
| Bukan solusi otomatis DB + Kafka | Kafka transaction tidak otomatis atomic dengan PostgreSQL transaction biasa. |
| Cocok untuk Kafka-to-Kafka | Terutama consume-transform-produce pipeline. |
| Consumer harus baca committed | Untuk end-to-end transactional guarantee di Kafka, consumer harus dikonfigurasi membaca committed messages. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/producer/KafkaProducer.html)) |

---

## 17. Failure Handling Matrix

| Failure | Tanda | Handling |
|---|---|---|
| Broker unavailable | Timeout, metadata unavailable, send failure | Retry via producer sampai `delivery.timeout.ms`; outbox reschedule. |
| Buffer full | `send()` block lalu gagal setelah `max.block.ms` | Rate limit, tune `buffer.memory`, reduce request pressure. |
| Serialization error | Exception sebelum/ketika send | Treat as non-retriable; fix schema/payload. |
| Authorization error | `AuthorizationException` | Fatal config/security issue; alert platform/security team. |
| Message too large | Record/request size exception | Jangan kirim payload besar; simpan object besar di storage, event hanya reference. |
| Invalid topic | Unknown topic / authorization / metadata issue | Startup validation via AdminClient atau fail fast. |
| Callback exception ignored | Log kosong, event hilang secara operasional | Callback wajib emit metric/log/error state. |
| REST returned 201 but Kafka failed | Data inconsistency | Gunakan outbox untuk event penting. |
| Producer fenced | Producer lain pakai `transactional.id` sama | Fatal untuk producer instance; close dan investigasi deployment identity. |
| Duplicate publish outbox | Consumer menerima event sama dua kali | Consumer idempotency by `eventId`. |

---

## 18. Error Classification

```text
Kafka publish error
│
├── Serialization / schema error
│   └── Non-retriable; fix producer payload/schema
│
├── Authorization / authentication error
│   └── Non-retriable until config/ACL fixed
│
├── Invalid topic / config error
│   └── Non-retriable until deployment/platform fixed
│
├── Timeout / broker unavailable
│   └── Retriable within retry budget
│
├── Buffer exhaustion
│   └── Backpressure problem; tune or shed load
│
└── Unknown KafkaException
    └── Classify conservatively; retry limited, alert if repeated
```

---

## 19. Jersey/HK2 Integration Sketch

### Binder

```java
public final class KafkaBinder extends AbstractBinder {
    @Override
    protected void configure() {
        bindFactory(KafkaProducerFactory.class)
                .to(new TypeLiteral<KafkaProducer<String, String>>() {})
                .in(Singleton.class);

        bind(KafkaEventPublisher.class)
                .to(EventPublisher.class)
                .in(Singleton.class);
    }
}
```

### Factory

```java
public final class KafkaProducerFactory
        implements Factory<KafkaProducer<String, String>> {

    private KafkaProducer<String, String> producer;

    @Override
    public KafkaProducer<String, String> provide() {
        if (producer == null) {
            producer = new KafkaProducer<>(producerProperties());
        }
        return producer;
    }

    @Override
    public void dispose(KafkaProducer<String, String> producer) {
        if (producer != null) {
            producer.close(Duration.ofSeconds(10));
        }
    }

    private Properties producerProperties() {
        Properties props = new Properties();
        props.put(ProducerConfig.BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS_CONFIG,
                requireEnv("KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS"));
        props.put(ProducerConfig.CLIENT_ID_CONFIG,
                requireEnvOrDefault("KAFKA_CLIENT_ID", "order-service-local"));
        props.put(ProducerConfig.KEY_SERIALIZER_CLASS_CONFIG,
                StringSerializer.class.getName());
        props.put(ProducerConfig.VALUE_SERIALIZER_CLASS_CONFIG,
                StringSerializer.class.getName());
        props.put(ProducerConfig.ACKS_CONFIG, "all");
        props.put(ProducerConfig.ENABLE_IDEMPOTENCE_CONFIG, "true");
        props.put(ProducerConfig.LINGER_MS_CONFIG, "5");
        props.put(ProducerConfig.COMPRESSION_TYPE_CONFIG, "lz4");
        props.put(ProducerConfig.MAX_BLOCK_MS_CONFIG, "5000");
        return props;
    }
}
```

### Resource → service → publisher

```java
@Path("/orders")
@Consumes(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
@Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
public final class OrderResource {
    private final OrderApplicationService service;

    @Inject
    public OrderResource(OrderApplicationService service) {
        this.service = service;
    }

    @POST
    public Response createOrder(CreateOrderRequest request,
                                @Context HttpHeaders headers) {
        String correlationId = headers.getHeaderString("X-Correlation-Id");

        OrderId orderId = service.createOrder(request, correlationId);

        return Response
                .status(Response.Status.CREATED)
                .entity(Map.of("orderId", orderId.value()))
                .build();
    }
}
```

```java
public final class OrderApplicationService {
    private final OrderRepository orderRepository;
    private final OutboxRepository outboxRepository;

    public OrderId createOrder(CreateOrderRequest request, String correlationId) {
        return transaction.inTransaction(() -> {
            Order order = Order.create(request);
            orderRepository.save(order);

            DomainEvent event = OrderCreated.from(order, correlationId);
            outboxRepository.save(event);

            return order.id();
        });
    }
}
```

Untuk business-critical event, service layer sebaiknya menyimpan outbox event dalam transaksi yang sama dengan domain state, bukan memanggil `producer.send()` langsung.

## 20. Callback Observability Checklist

Callback producer minimal harus emit:

| Signal | Contoh |
|---|---|
| Success count | `kafka_producer_publish_success_total` |
| Failure count | `kafka_producer_publish_failure_total` |
| Publish latency | `kafka_producer_publish_latency_ms` |
| Topic | label: `topic` |
| Event type | label: `event_type` |
| Error class | label: `exception` |
| Partition/offset | log field |
| Correlation id | log field |
| Event id | log field |

Contoh structured log:

```json
{
  "level": "INFO",
  "message": "Kafka event published",
  "service": "order-service",
  "topic": "order.events.v1",
  "partition": 4,
  "offset": 987654,
  "eventType": "OrderCreated",
  "eventId": "01JZABCDEF123456789",
  "aggregateId": "order-123",
  "correlationId": "req-abc-123"
}
```

---

## 21. Backpressure Strategy

Producer punya buffer memory; jika record dikirim lebih cepat daripada dapat dikirim ke broker, producer akan block sampai `max.block.ms`, lalu fail dengan exception. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/generated/producer_config.html))

| Level | Strategy |
|---|---|
| Application | Batasi payload size, rate limit endpoint, reject request saat overload. |
| Producer | Tune `buffer.memory`, `batch.size`, `linger.ms`, `compression.type`. |
| Outbox | Batasi batch size, retry dengan backoff, pisahkan status `FAILED`. |
| Platform | Monitor broker latency, disk, ISR, network, controller health. |
| Product/SLA | Tentukan apakah event boleh delayed atau harus fail-fast. |

---

## 22. Topic & Event Naming

Gunakan naming yang menunjukkan ownership dan semantic.

```text
<domain>.<entity-or-capability>.<event-stream>.v<major>
```

Contoh:

```text
order.order.events.v1
order.payment.events.v1
customer.profile.events.v1
case.enforcement.events.v1
```

Hindari:

```text
events
order-topic
kafka-test
service-a-output
new-topic-final-v2
```

## 23. Producer Testing Strategy

| Test | Tujuan |
|---|---|
| Unit test dengan `MockProducer` | Validasi topic, key, header, payload tanpa Kafka broker. Kafka Java client menyediakan `MockProducer` untuk testing code yang menggunakan Kafka. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/40/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/producer/package-summary.html)) |
| Contract test | Validasi schema event kompatibel. |
| Integration test dengan Testcontainers Kafka | Validasi producer benar-benar publish ke broker. |
| Failure test | Simulasikan broker down, auth error, serialization error. |
| Load test | Validasi batching, throughput, latency, buffer behavior. |
| Replay test | Pastikan duplicate event tidak merusak downstream. |

Contoh unit test dengan `MockProducer`:

```java
MockProducer<String, String> mockProducer = new MockProducer<>(
        true,
        new StringSerializer(),
        new StringSerializer()
);

KafkaEventPublisher publisher =
        new KafkaEventPublisher(mockProducer, "order.events.v1");

publisher.publish(OrderCreated.sample());

ProducerRecord<String, String> sent = mockProducer.history().get(0);

assertEquals("order.events.v1", sent.topic());
assertEquals("order-123", sent.key());
assertNotNull(sent.headers().lastHeader("correlation-id"));
```

## 24. Production Readiness Checklist

| Area | Checklist |
|---|---|
| Lifecycle | Producer singleton, close on shutdown, no per-request producer. |
| Config | `acks=all`, idempotence enabled, sane timeout, compression chosen. |
| Keying | Key sesuai aggregate ordering, tidak menyebabkan hot partition ekstrem. |
| Payload | Event kecil, schema versioned, tidak expose internal DB model mentah. |
| Header | `event-id`, `event-type`, `correlation-id`, tracing headers. |
| Error handling | Callback tidak swallow exception. |
| Outbox | Business-critical event memakai outbox/CDC. |
| Retry | Retry budget jelas; outbox retry punya backoff. |
| Idempotency | Consumer downstream bisa deduplicate `eventId`. |
| Observability | Metrics/log/tracing tersedia. |
| Security | TLS/SASL/ACL/secret management siap. |
| Deployment | Readiness/liveness tidak salah interpretasi Kafka temporary issue. |
| Testing | Unit, contract, integration, failure, load test. |

---

## 25. Common Anti-Patterns

| Anti-pattern | Kenapa berbahaya |
|---|---|
| Membuat `KafkaProducer` per HTTP request | Mahal, latency tinggi, resource leak risk. |
| Publish event sebelum DB commit | Event bisa menyatakan state yang rollback. |
| Publish event setelah DB commit tanpa outbox | Crash window menyebabkan event hilang. |
| Key random untuk lifecycle aggregate | Event per aggregate bisa out-of-order. |
| Key `tenantId` untuk semua event multi-tenant | Hot partition untuk tenant besar. |
| Callback hanya log debug | Publish failure tidak terdeteksi operasional. |
| `acks=0` untuk event bisnis | Tidak ada guarantee broker menerima record. |
| Payload event terlalu besar | Mengganggu broker, network, consumer, retention. |
| Event schema mengikuti table schema | Coupling database internal ke consumer eksternal. |
| Menganggap idempotent producer cukup | Tidak menyelesaikan consumer duplicate, outbox duplicate, replay, atau DB atomicity. |
| Menggunakan transaction Kafka untuk DB + Kafka atomicity | Kafka transaction tidak otomatis mengikat PostgreSQL transaction. |

---

## 26. Ringkasan Praktis

Untuk Jersey/JAX-RS microservice production:

```text
Gunakan KafkaProducer singleton
Gunakan event key = aggregateId
Gunakan acks=all + idempotence
Gunakan callback dengan metrics/logging
Gunakan outbox untuk event bisnis penting
Jangan publish langsung di tengah DB transaction
Jangan commit state tanpa rencana publish yang durable
Pastikan consumer downstream idempotent
```

Model paling aman:

```text
REST command
  → validate
  → DB transaction
      → update aggregate
      → insert outbox event
  → commit
  → return response
  → outbox relay / CDC publishes to Kafka
  → consumer deduplicates by eventId
```

Kita lanjut ke **Java Kafka Consumer dalam Jersey/JAX-RS microservice**. Fokusnya: poll loop yang benar, offset commit, rebalance, idempotency, retry/DLQ, backpressure, dan shutdown yang aman saat running di Kubernetes.

# Cheatsheet - Java Kafka Consumer dalam Jersey/JAX-RS Microservice

## 1. Core Mental Model

Kafka Consumer di microservice bertugas mengambil record dari topic, memetakan event menjadi aksi aplikasi, menjalankan side effect dengan aman, lalu meng-commit offset setelah pemrosesan selesai.

```text id="u17pg8"
Kafka Topic / Partition
   ↓
KafkaConsumer.poll()
   ↓
Deserialize + validate event
   ↓
Idempotency check
   ↓
Application Service / Use Case
   ↓
Database transaction / external side effect
   ↓
Commit offset
```

Consumer API Kafka memberi fleksibilitas untuk berbagai pola konsumsi, termasuk automatic offset commit dan manual offset control. Untuk pemrosesan yang terhubung dengan database atau business logic, Kafka sendiri mencontohkan manual commit setelah insert database agar record tidak dianggap selesai sebelum proses benar-benar selesai. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/KafkaConsumer.html))

---

## 2. Prinsip Utama Consumer di Microservice

| Prinsip | Penjelasan praktis |
|---|---|
| Consumer bukan request handler | Jangan jalankan consumer di JAX-RS resource method. Consumer adalah background worker. |
| `KafkaConsumer` tidak thread-safe | Akses consumer dari satu thread saja; `wakeup()` adalah pengecualian yang aman dipanggil dari thread lain untuk shutdown. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/KafkaConsumer.html)) |
| Offset commit adalah business boundary | Commit offset berarti “event ini selesai diproses”. |
| Disable auto commit untuk event bisnis | `enable.auto.commit=true` membuat offset commit otomatis berdasarkan interval; untuk logic bisnis, commit manual lebih aman. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/KafkaConsumer.html)) |
| Consumer harus idempotent | At-least-once delivery dapat mengulang record saat crash setelah DB write tapi sebelum commit offset. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/KafkaConsumer.html)) |
| Rebalance harus diperlakukan sebagai failure mode normal | Rebalance terjadi saat membership group berubah, topic berubah, atau partition assignment berubah. |
| Poll loop harus cepat kembali ke `poll()` | Jika melebihi `max.poll.interval.ms`, consumer dianggap gagal dan group akan rebalance. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/42/configuration/consumer-configs/)) |

---

## 3. Consumer Lifecycle di Jersey/JAX-RS

```text id="5f7t7k"
Application startup
   ↓
Load Kafka consumer config
   ↓
Create background worker thread / managed executor
   ↓
Create KafkaConsumer inside worker thread
   ↓
Subscribe to topic
   ↓
poll → process → commit loop
   ↓
Shutdown signal
   ↓
consumer.wakeup()
   ↓
finish/abort safely
   ↓
commit final safe offsets
   ↓
close consumer
```

Yang penting: buat `KafkaConsumer` di thread yang sama dengan poll loop, karena consumer tidak thread-safe. Untuk shutdown dari lifecycle hook Jersey/container, panggil `consumer.wakeup()` dari thread lain; Kafka mendokumentasikan `wakeup()` sebagai mekanisme thread-safe untuk menginterupsi long poll. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/KafkaConsumer.html))

---

Gunakan `kafka-clients` yang selaras dengan platform Kafka perusahaan. Dokumentasi Kafka terbaru yang terindeks saat ini mencantumkan `org.apache.kafka:kafka-clients:4.3.1`. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/KafkaConsumer.html))

```xml id="gg6qkt"
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.kafka</groupId>
    <artifactId>kafka-clients</artifactId>

</dependency>
```
