## 5. Baseline Consumer Configuration

```java id="46ge16"
Properties props = new Properties();

props.put(ConsumerConfig.BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS_CONFIG,
        System.getenv("KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS"));

props.put(ConsumerConfig.GROUP_ID_CONFIG,
        "order-projection-service");

props.put(ConsumerConfig.CLIENT_ID_CONFIG,
        "order-projection-service-" + System.getenv("HOSTNAME"));

props.put(ConsumerConfig.KEY_DESERIALIZER_CLASS_CONFIG,
        StringDeserializer.class.getName());

props.put(ConsumerConfig.VALUE_DESERIALIZER_CLASS_CONFIG,
        StringDeserializer.class.getName());

// Business processing: prefer manual commit
props.put(ConsumerConfig.ENABLE_AUTO_COMMIT_CONFIG, "false");

// Start behavior when there is no committed offset
props.put(ConsumerConfig.AUTO_OFFSET_RESET_CONFIG, "earliest");

// Batch and poll control
props.put(ConsumerConfig.MAX_POLL_RECORDS_CONFIG, "100");
props.put(ConsumerConfig.MAX_POLL_INTERVAL_MS_CONFIG, "300000");

// Transactional Kafka producer compatibility
props.put(ConsumerConfig.ISOLATION_LEVEL_CONFIG, "read_committed");

// Security example only
props.put("security.protocol", "SASL_SSL");
props.put("sasl.mechanism", "SCRAM-SHA-512");
props.put("sasl.jaas.config", System.getenv("KAFKA_SASL_JAAS_CONFIG"));
```

`group.id` diperlukan saat consumer memakai group management melalui `subscribe(topic)` atau Kafka-based offset management. `max.poll.records` membatasi jumlah record yang dikembalikan per `poll()`, sedangkan `max.poll.interval.ms` membatasi jeda maksimum antar pemanggilan `poll()` sebelum consumer dianggap gagal. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/42/configuration/consumer-configs/))

---

## 6. Config Map Praktis

| Config | Fungsi | Rekomendasi praktis |
|---|---|---|
| `bootstrap.servers` | Broker awal untuk menemukan cluster | Isi beberapa endpoint, bukan satu broker saja. |
| `group.id` | Identitas consumer group | Satu logical processor = satu group id. |
| `client.id` | Identitas instance client | Masukkan service name + pod/host id. |
| `enable.auto.commit` | Commit offset otomatis berdasarkan interval | Untuk event bisnis: `false`. |
| `auto.commit.interval.ms` | Interval auto commit jika auto commit aktif | Tidak relevan jika manual commit. |
| `auto.offset.reset` | Posisi awal saat tidak ada committed offset | `earliest` untuk rebuild projection; `latest` untuk event baru saja. |
| `max.poll.records` | Maksimum record per poll | Turunkan jika processing berat; naikkan jika ringan. |
| `max.poll.interval.ms` | Batas waktu antar poll | Harus lebih besar dari worst-case batch processing time. |
| `session.timeout.ms` | Timeout liveness consumer ke broker | Jika heartbeat hilang sampai timeout, broker mengeluarkan consumer dari group. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/42/configuration/consumer-configs/)) |
| `heartbeat.interval.ms` | Interval heartbeat untuk classic group protocol | Biasanya lebih kecil dari `session.timeout.ms`, sering tidak lebih dari sepertiganya. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/42/configuration/consumer-configs/)) |
| `partition.assignment.strategy` | Strategi pembagian partition ke consumer | Default mencakup `RangeAssignor` dan `CooperativeStickyAssignor`; cooperative bisa mengurangi disruption saat rebalance. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/42/configuration/consumer-configs/)) |
| `group.instance.id` | Static membership id | Berguna untuk mengurangi rebalance akibat restart singkat. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/42/configuration/consumer-configs/)) |
| `isolation.level` | Baca transactional messages | Gunakan `read_committed` jika producer memakai Kafka transactions. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/42/configuration/consumer-configs/)) |

---

## 7. Poll Loop Dasar

```java id="m1glgx"
public final class OrderEventConsumerWorker implements Runnable, AutoCloseable {
    private final AtomicBoolean closed = new AtomicBoolean(false);
    private final KafkaConsumer<String, String> consumer;
    private final OrderEventHandler handler;

    public OrderEventConsumerWorker(
            KafkaConsumer<String, String> consumer,
            OrderEventHandler handler
    ) {
        this.consumer = consumer;
        this.handler = handler;
    }

    @Override
    public void run() {
        try {
            consumer.subscribe(List.of("order.events.v1"));

            while (!closed.get()) {
                ConsumerRecords<String, String> records =
                        consumer.poll(Duration.ofMillis(1000));

                for (ConsumerRecord<String, String> record : records) {
                    handler.handle(record);
                }

                consumer.commitSync(Duration.ofSeconds(5));
            }
        } catch (WakeupException e) {
            if (!closed.get()) {
                throw e;
            }
        } finally {
            consumer.close(Duration.ofSeconds(10));
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        closed.set(true);
        consumer.wakeup();
    }
}
```

Kafka menyediakan `poll(Duration)`, `commitSync`, `commitAsync`, `seek`, `pause`, `resume`, `committed`, dan API lain di interface `Consumer`. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/Consumer.html))

---

## 8. Offset Commit Mental Model

Offset yang di-commit harus menunjuk ke **record berikutnya** yang akan diproses, bukan offset record terakhir yang sudah diproses. Kafka Javadoc menjelaskan bahwa committed offset untuk map commit seharusnya adalah offset message berikutnya yang akan dikonsumsi aplikasi. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/KafkaConsumer.html))

```text id="dw5vgh"
Record offset processed successfully: 100
Committed offset should be:       101
```

### Commit timing

| Timing | Guarantee | Risiko |
|---|---|---|
| Commit sebelum process | At-most-once | Event bisa hilang jika proses gagal. |
| Process lalu commit | At-least-once | Event bisa diproses ulang jika crash sebelum commit. |
| Process + dedup + commit | Effectively-once di boundary aplikasi | Butuh idempotency store/constraint. |
| Auto commit | Tergantung disiplin poll/process | Bisa offset maju sebelum record benar-benar selesai. |

Untuk business processing, model paling aman biasanya: **process transactionally → commit offset setelah sukses → consumer idempotent untuk duplicate**.

---

## 9. Manual Commit Pattern: Per Batch

```java id="ewl00r"
while (!closed.get()) {
    ConsumerRecords<String, String> records =
            consumer.poll(Duration.ofMillis(1000));

    if (records.isEmpty()) {
        continue;
    }

    try {
        for (ConsumerRecord<String, String> record : records) {
            handler.handle(record);
        }

        consumer.commitSync(Duration.ofSeconds(5));
    } catch (Exception e) {
        log.error("Batch failed; offset not committed", e);
        // No commit. Records will be retried after restart/rebalance.
        // Be careful: continuing immediately can hot-loop poison messages.
    }
}
```

Kelebihan:

| Kelebihan | Kekurangan |
|---|---|
| Simple | Jika record ke-99 gagal, record 1-98 bisa diproses ulang. |
| Throughput baik | Perlu idempotency karena duplicate batch. |
| Commit overhead rendah | Sulit menangani poison message granular. |

---

## 10. Manual Commit Pattern: Per Partition

Lebih aman untuk batch berisi banyak partition.

```java id="e1va39"
ConsumerRecords<String, String> records =
        consumer.poll(Duration.ofMillis(1000));

Map<TopicPartition, OffsetAndMetadata> offsetsToCommit = new HashMap<>();

for (TopicPartition partition : records.partitions()) {
    List<ConsumerRecord<String, String>> partitionRecords =
            records.records(partition);

    for (ConsumerRecord<String, String> record : partitionRecords) {
        handler.handle(record);

        offsetsToCommit.put(
                partition,
                new OffsetAndMetadata(record.offset() + 1)
        );
    }
}

if (!offsetsToCommit.isEmpty()) {
    consumer.commitSync(offsetsToCommit, Duration.ofSeconds(5));
}
```

Pattern ini menjaga commit per partition dan sesuai dengan model Kafka bahwa offset adalah posisi per topic-partition, bukan global position.

---

## 11. Consumer Handler Boundary

Handler sebaiknya tidak menerima `ConsumerRecord` mentah sampai ke domain layer. Pisahkan infrastructure concern dari application concern.

```text id="6bx5f2"
ConsumerRecord
   ↓
Event deserialization
   ↓
Envelope validation
   ↓
Idempotency check
   ↓
Application command
   ↓
Domain service
```

```java id="09a7kv"
public final class OrderEventHandler {
    private final EventDeserializer deserializer;
    private final ProcessedEventRepository processedEvents;
    private final OrderProjectionService projectionService;

    public void handle(ConsumerRecord<String, String> record) {
        IntegrationEvent<OrderCreatedPayload> event =
                deserializer.deserialize(record.value());

        validateEnvelope(event, record);

        transaction.inTransaction(() -> {
            if (processedEvents.exists(event.eventId())) {
                return null;
            }

            projectionService.apply(event.payload());

            processedEvents.insert(event.eventId(), event.eventType());
            return null;
        });
    }
}
```

---

## 12. Idempotent Consumer Pattern

At-least-once berarti duplicate bukan bug aneh, tapi konsekuensi normal dari failure window. Kafka sendiri menjelaskan bahwa jika proses gagal setelah insert database tetapi sebelum commit offset, record dapat diproses ulang oleh proses berikutnya. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/KafkaConsumer.html))

### Dedup table

```sql id="o80lcc"
CREATE TABLE processed_event (
    event_id      UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    event_type    TEXT NOT NULL,
    aggregate_id  TEXT,
    processed_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
```

### Handler transaction

```sql id="89qzoo"
-- pseudo flow inside one DB transaction

INSERT INTO processed_event(event_id, event_type, aggregate_id)
VALUES (:event_id, :event_type, :aggregate_id)
ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING;

-- if inserted row count = 0:
--   duplicate event, skip business mutation

-- else:
--   apply business/projection update
```

### Idempotency alternatives

| Strategy | Cocok untuk |
|---|---|
| `processed_event(event_id)` | Event punya global unique id. |
| Unique business constraint | Contoh: payment reference, order transition id. |
| Version check | Aggregate event version harus meningkat satu per satu. |
| Upsert projection | Read model bisa ditulis ulang deterministically. |
| Natural idempotency | Operation memang sama hasilnya jika diulang. |

---

## 13. Rebalance Handling

Rebalance terjadi saat consumer group membership berubah, topic matching berubah, atau partition assignment berubah. Kafka Javadoc menyebut rebalances terjadi saat group membership berubah dan hanya berlangsung saat active call ke `poll(Duration)`. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/KafkaConsumer.html))

Gunakan `ConsumerRebalanceListener` jika perlu commit offset sebelum partition dilepas.

```java id="48rn92"
consumer.subscribe(List.of("order.events.v1"), new ConsumerRebalanceListener() {
    @Override
    public void onPartitionsRevoked(Collection<TopicPartition> partitions) {
        log.info("Partitions revoked: {}", partitions);

        // Commit only offsets known to be safely processed.
        consumer.commitSync(currentOffsets, Duration.ofSeconds(5));
    }

    @Override
    public void onPartitionsAssigned(Collection<TopicPartition> partitions) {
        log.info("Partitions assigned: {}", partitions);

        // Optionally initialize partition-local state here.
    }
});
```

Kafka Javadoc menyarankan listener jika aplikasi mengelola offset sendiri karena listener memberi kesempatan commit offset sebelum rebalance selesai. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/KafkaConsumer.html))

---

## 14. Retry Strategy

Jangan asal `catch Exception` lalu lanjut commit. Itu sama saja membuang event bermasalah.

```text id="at9rd7"
Processing error
│
├── Deserialization/schema error
│   └── DLQ / quarantine, do not retry forever
│
├── Business validation permanent
│   └── DLQ / rejected-event topic
│
├── Database transient error
│   └── Retry with backoff
│
├── Downstream service timeout
│   └── Retry topic / delayed retry
│
└── Unknown bug
    └── Stop / DLQ after limited attempts + alert
```

### Retry options

| Strategy | Cara kerja | Cocok untuk | Risiko |
|---|---|---|---|
| Inline retry | Retry langsung di poll loop | Error sangat singkat | Bisa melewati `max.poll.interval.ms`. |
| Stop no commit | Biarkan event diproses ulang | Error sementara cepat | Poison message bisa mengunci partition. |
| Retry topic | Publish ke topic retry dengan attempt count | Error transient menengah | Ordering bisa berubah. |
| DLQ | Publish event gagal ke dead-letter topic | Error permanen/retry exhausted | DLQ harus dimonitor. |
| Quarantine table | Simpan error ke DB untuk investigasi | Domain/regulatory audit | Perlu tooling replay. |

---

## 15. Retry Topic Pattern

```text id="k31dtg"
main topic
  → consumer
    → processing fails
      → retry topic with attempt=1, nextAttemptAt
        → retry consumer
          → processing fails
            → retry topic with attempt=2
              → exhausted
                → DLQ
```

Contoh headers retry:

```text id="n1iqhv"
x-original-topic: order.events.v1
x-original-partition: 3
x-original-offset: 98123
x-retry-attempt: 2
x-error-class: java.sql.SQLTransientConnectionException
x-error-message: connection timeout
x-correlation-id: req-abc-123
```

### Retry decision

| Error | Retry? | Aksi |
|---|---:|---|
| JSON malformed | Tidak | DLQ/quarantine. |
| Unknown event version | Tidak langsung | DLQ atau compatibility handler. |
| DB connection timeout | Ya | Retry dengan backoff. |
| Unique constraint duplicate | Tidak sebagai error | Treat as idempotent success. |
| Downstream 503 | Ya | Retry topic/backoff. |
| Authorization denied | Tidak | Alert/config fix. |

---

## 16. DLQ Design

DLQ bukan tempat sampah; DLQ adalah **audit queue untuk event yang gagal diproses secara normal**.

```json id="c7k7mi"
{
  "errorId": "01JZDLQ123456789",
  "failedAt": "2026-07-13T10:15:30Z",
  "consumerGroup": "order-projection-service",
  "originalTopic": "order.events.v1",
  "originalPartition": 3,
  "originalOffset": 98123,
  "originalKey": "order-123",
  "eventId": "01JZEVENT123456789",
  "eventType": "OrderCreated",
  "eventVersion": 1,
  "correlationId": "req-abc-123",
  "errorClass": "JsonMappingException",
  "errorMessage": "missing required field customerId",
  "payload": "{...}"
}
```

| DLQ field | Fungsi |
|---|---|
| Original topic/partition/offset | Bisa trace sumber record. |
| Consumer group | Tahu processor mana yang gagal. |
| Event id/type/version | Analisis compatibility dan dedup. |
| Error class/message | Klasifikasi root cause. |
| Correlation id | Hubungkan ke request/log/tracing. |
| Payload | Investigasi dan replay. |
| Attempt count | Bedakan first failure vs exhausted. |

---

## 17. Backpressure dengan `pause()` / `resume()`

Kafka Consumer mendukung `pause(Collection)` dan `resume(Collection)` untuk menghentikan sementara fetch dari partition tertentu tanpa mengubah subscription; pause tidak menyebabkan group rebalance, tetapi state pause/resume tidak dipertahankan setelah rebalance. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/KafkaConsumer.html))

```java id="k6s8ou"
Set<TopicPartition> slowPartitions = Set.of(partition);

consumer.pause(slowPartitions);

try {
    drainInternalQueue();
} finally {
    consumer.resume(slowPartitions);
}
```

Gunakan pause/resume saat:

| Kondisi | Tujuan |
|---|---|
| Internal work queue penuh | Hindari memory blow-up. |
| Downstream lambat | Kurangi tekanan ke DB/API. |
| Partition tertentu hot | Isolasi partition yang bermasalah. |
| Retry lokal pendek | Jangan fetch record baru dulu. |

Tetap panggil `poll()` walaupun paused agar heartbeat dan group membership tetap hidup.

---

## 18. Multi-threaded Processing Model

Karena `KafkaConsumer` tidak thread-safe, jangan memanggil `poll`, `commit`, `pause`, `resume`, atau `seek` dari banyak thread tanpa kontrol ketat. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/KafkaConsumer.html))

### Model A - Single-thread consumer + processing inline

```text id="il243v"
consumer thread:
  poll
  process record
  commit
```

| Cocok untuk | Tidak cocok untuk |
|---|---|
| Logic ringan/sedang | Processing lama/blocking |
| Ordering per partition ketat | Throughput tinggi |
| Simplicity | Banyak I/O downstream |

### Model B - Consumer thread + worker pool

```text id="k901gz"
consumer thread:
  poll
  dispatch to worker pool
  track completed offsets
  commit safe offsets

worker threads:
  process records
```

Lebih kompleks karena commit offset harus tetap preserve ordering per partition. Jangan commit offset 105 jika offset 104 di partition yang sama belum sukses.

### Model C - Scale dengan lebih banyak consumer instances

```text id="muw9c7"
N partitions
  ↓
up to N active consumers in same group
```

Ini sering lebih bersih daripada worker pool internal. Batas paralelisme consumer group efektif ditentukan oleh jumlah partition.

---

## 19. Safe Offset Tracking untuk Worker Pool

Jika memproses parallel per partition, offset tracking harus hati-hati.

```text id="u06xer"
Partition 0:
  offset 100 done
  offset 101 processing
  offset 102 done

Safe commit offset = 101
Bukan 103, karena 101 belum selesai.
```

Pattern:

| Rule | Penjelasan |
|---|---|
| Track completion per partition | Offset adalah per topic-partition. |
| Commit contiguous completed offset | Hanya commit sampai sebelum gap pertama. |
| Pause partition saat backlog tinggi | Hindari worker queue tak terbatas. |
| Jangan reorder side effect jika ordering penting | Proses partition secara serial jika domain butuh ordering. |

---

## 20. Deserialization & Schema Failure

Pisahkan error sebelum dan sesudah event dianggap valid.

```text id="luz57b"
Raw ConsumerRecord
   ↓
Deserialize
   ├── fail → DLQ/quarantine raw payload
   ↓
Validate envelope
   ├── fail → DLQ/quarantine structured error
   ↓
Validate event version
   ├── unsupported → DLQ / compatibility handler
   ↓
Business handler
```

| Error | Commit offset? | Kenapa |
|---|---:|---|
| Malformed JSON permanen | Ya, setelah masuk DLQ | Retry tidak akan memperbaiki payload. |
| Unknown schema version | Tergantung policy | Bisa butuh deploy consumer baru. |
| DB transient error | Tidak / retry topic | Retry mungkin sukses. |
| Duplicate event | Ya | Treat as success. |
| Business rule invalid permanen | Ya, setelah audit/DLQ | Jangan blokir partition selamanya. |

---

## 21. Consumer Worker untuk Jersey/HK2

### Worker manager

```java id="doc6wq"
public final class KafkaConsumerManager implements AutoCloseable {
    private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
    private final OrderEventConsumerWorker worker;
    private Future<?> future;

    @Inject
    public KafkaConsumerManager(OrderEventConsumerWorker worker) {
        this.worker = worker;
    }

    public void start() {
        future = executor.submit(worker);
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        worker.close();
        executor.shutdown();

        try {
            if (!executor.awaitTermination(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
                executor.shutdownNow();
            }
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            executor.shutdownNow();
        }
    }
}
```

### Jersey application hook sketch

```java id="81uo62"
public final class AppLifecycle implements ApplicationEventListener {
    private final KafkaConsumerManager consumerManager;

    @Inject
    public AppLifecycle(KafkaConsumerManager consumerManager) {
        this.consumerManager = consumerManager;
    }

    @Override
    public void onEvent(ApplicationEvent event) {
        if (event.getType() == ApplicationEvent.Type.INITIALIZATION_FINISHED) {
            consumerManager.start();
        }

        if (event.getType() == ApplicationEvent.Type.DESTROY_FINISHED) {
            consumerManager.close();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public RequestEventListener onRequest(RequestEvent requestEvent) {
        return null;
    }
}
```

---

## 22. Graceful Shutdown di Kubernetes

```text id="akxg29"
SIGTERM
   ↓
Jersey/container shutdown hook
   ↓
consumer.wakeup()
   ↓
poll loop exits
   ↓
finish currently safe processing
   ↓
commit processed offsets
   ↓
consumer.close(timeout)
   ↓
pod exits
```

Consumer close dengan timeout memberi kesempatan pending operation selesai secara graceful; Kafka Javadoc menyediakan `close(Duration)` dengan timeout. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/KafkaConsumer.html))

Checklist Kubernetes:

| Item | Rekomendasi |
|---|---|
| `terminationGracePeriodSeconds` | Harus lebih besar dari worst-case shutdown + commit time. |
| Readiness | Set not-ready saat shutdown mulai agar traffic HTTP berhenti. |
| Consumer shutdown | Gunakan `wakeup()`, bukan interrupt mentah. |
| Final commit | Commit hanya offset yang sudah aman. |
| Long processing | Hindari batch terlalu besar sehingga shutdown tidak selesai. |
| Static membership | Pertimbangkan `group.instance.id` untuk mengurangi rebalance akibat restart singkat. |

---

## 23. Health Check

Pisahkan **liveness** dan **readiness**.

| Health | Makna | Kafka consumer impact |
|---|---|---|
| Liveness | Process masih hidup | Jangan fail hanya karena Kafka sementara lambat. |
| Readiness | Service siap menerima traffic | Untuk service consumer-only, readiness bisa bergantung worker running dan subscription sehat. |
| Dependency health | Kafka reachable? DB reachable? | Bisa tampil di `/health/dependencies`. |
| Lag health | Backlog naik? | Jangan selalu jadikan readiness fail; bedakan warning vs outage. |

Contoh status:

```json id="f80c6i"
{
  "status": "UP",
  "consumer": {
    "running": true,
    "groupId": "order-projection-service",
    "topics": ["order.events.v1"],
    "lastPollAt": "2026-07-13T10:15:30Z",
    "lastRecordAt": "2026-07-13T10:15:29Z",
    "lastCommitAt": "2026-07-13T10:15:31Z"
  }
}
```

---

## 24. Observability Metrics

| Metric | Kenapa penting |
|---|---|
| `records_consumed_total` | Throughput konsumsi. |
| `records_processed_total` | Throughput sukses aplikasi. |
| `records_failed_total` | Error rate handler. |
| `consumer_lag` | Backlog per partition. |
| `processing_latency_ms` | Waktu business handler. |
| `poll_latency_ms` | Waktu poll. |
| `commit_latency_ms` | Waktu commit offset. |
| `rebalance_total` | Stabilitas consumer group. |
| `dlq_published_total` | Poison/permanent failure volume. |
| `duplicate_event_total` | Efektivitas idempotency. |
| `last_successful_poll_age` | Deteksi worker macet. |
| `partition_pause_duration_ms` | Backpressure signal. |

Structured log minimal:

```json id="aa5u39"
{
  "level": "INFO",
  "message": "Kafka event processed",
  "service": "order-projection-service",
  "topic": "order.events.v1",
  "partition": 3,
  "offset": 98123,
  "key": "order-123",
  "eventId": "01JZEVENT123456789",
  "eventType": "OrderCreated",
  "correlationId": "req-abc-123",
  "durationMs": 42
}
```

## 25. Ordering Model

Kafka ordering berlaku di dalam partition. Karena consumer group membagi partition ke consumer instances, ordering global lintas partition tidak boleh diasumsikan.

```text id="7dr8v2"
Topic: order.events.v1

Partition 0: order-1 event-1 → order-1 event-2
Partition 1: order-2 event-1 → order-2 event-2

Ordering aman per order jika key = orderId.
Ordering global semua order tidak dijamin.
```

| Kebutuhan | Strategy |
|---|---|
| Ordering per aggregate | Key = aggregate id. |
| Ordering per tenant | Key = tenant id, tapi hati-hati hot partition. |
| Throughput tinggi | Tambah partition dan scale consumer. |
| Global ordering | Hindari jika bisa; gunakan single partition hanya jika throughput kecil. |
| Per-entity lifecycle | Pastikan semua event entity memakai key yang sama. |

---

## 26. Seek & Replay

Kafka Consumer menyediakan API `seek`, `seekToBeginning`, dan `seekToEnd`. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/Consumer.html))

Use case replay:

| Use case | Strategy |
|---|---|
| Rebuild projection | Consumer group baru + `auto.offset.reset=earliest`. |
| Reprocess subset | Admin tool dengan `assign` + `seek`. |
| Recover bad deployment | Reset offset ke posisi sebelum bug. |
| Audit investigation | Read specific partition/offset. |
| Backfill data | Dedicated replay job, bukan production consumer group utama. |

Rule penting: replay hanya aman jika handler idempotent dan schema lama masih bisa dibaca.

---

## 27. Security

Consumer biasanya butuh permission minimal:

| Resource | Permission |
|---|---|
| Topic input | `READ`, `DESCRIBE` |
| Consumer group | `READ` |
| Retry/DLQ topic | `WRITE`, `DESCRIBE` |
| Transactional/idempotent use case tertentu | Sesuai producer/retry publisher config |
| Schema Registry | Read schema subject |

Jangan pakai satu credential superuser untuk semua service. Service identity harus dipetakan ke topic dan group yang benar.

---

## 28. Testing Strategy

| Test | Tujuan |
|---|---|
| Unit test handler | Validasi event → application service tanpa Kafka. |
| Unit test consumer wrapper | Gunakan `MockConsumer` untuk simulasi poll/offset. |
| Contract test | Pastikan schema event kompatibel. |
| Integration test | Jalankan Kafka test container dan validasi consume/commit. |
| Duplicate test | Kirim event sama dua kali; hasil harus idempotent. |
| Rebalance test | Matikan instance saat processing. |
| Poison message test | Pastikan masuk DLQ dan partition tidak stuck. |
| Replay test | Reset offset dan rebuild projection. |
| Shutdown test | SIGTERM saat batch processing. |

Kafka interface `Consumer` memiliki implementasi `KafkaConsumer` dan `MockConsumer`, sehingga wrapper consumer dapat dites tanpa broker nyata untuk beberapa skenario. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/Consumer.html))

---

## 29. Common Anti-Patterns

| Anti-pattern | Dampak |
|---|---|
| `enable.auto.commit=true` untuk business handler berat | Offset bisa maju sebelum side effect selesai. |
| Commit offset sebelum DB commit | Message loss secara bisnis. |
| Tidak punya idempotency | Duplicate event menghasilkan side effect ganda. |
| Consumer dipakai lintas banyak thread | Race condition / `ConcurrentModificationException`. |
| Processing batch terlalu lama | Melewati `max.poll.interval.ms`, rebalance. |
| Poison message di-retry selamanya | Partition stuck dan lag naik. |
| Tidak ada DLQ | Error permanent tidak bisa diaudit. |
| DLQ ada tapi tidak dimonitor | Masalah hanya dipindahkan, bukan diselesaikan. |
| Commit offset tertinggi walau ada gap | Message loss dalam partition. |
| Consumer worker hidup di request thread | REST latency dan lifecycle kacau. |
| Tidak handle rebalance | Offset/state lokal bisa tidak konsisten. |
| Tidak close consumer | TCP connection/resource leak; Kafka Javadoc memperingatkan failure to close consumer akan leak connection. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/KafkaConsumer.html)) |

---

## 30. Production Readiness Checklist

| Area | Checklist |
|---|---|
| Lifecycle | Consumer dibuat dan dipakai di satu worker thread. |
| Shutdown | `wakeup()` dipakai untuk stop long poll. |
| Commit | Manual commit setelah processing sukses. |
| Idempotency | Dedup by `eventId` atau business unique key. |
| Retry | Error transient punya retry/backoff strategy. |
| DLQ | Error permanent masuk DLQ dengan metadata lengkap. |
| Rebalance | Ada listener jika mengelola offset/state sendiri. |
| Backpressure | `max.poll.records`, pause/resume, worker queue limit. |
| Ordering | Event key sesuai aggregate ordering. |
| Observability | Lag, processing latency, commit latency, rebalance count, DLQ count. |
| Security | Topic/group ACL minimal. |
| Replay | Handler aman untuk reprocessing. |
| Kubernetes | Graceful shutdown dan readiness behavior jelas. |

---

## 31. Ringkasan Praktis

Model consumer yang aman untuk microservice bisnis:

```text id="g3s14l"
poll records
  → deserialize
  → validate envelope
  → begin DB transaction
      → check processed_event(eventId)
      → if duplicate: skip as success
      → apply domain/projection mutation
      → insert processed_event
  → commit DB transaction
  → commit Kafka offset
```

Failure model-nya:

```text id="n7k5fk"
DB commit sukses, Kafka commit gagal
  → event akan dibaca ulang
  → idempotency mencegah side effect ganda

Kafka commit sukses, DB commit gagal
  → ini harus dihindari
  → commit Kafka hanya setelah DB sukses

Poison message
  → jangan retry selamanya
  → DLQ/quarantine + commit offset setelah aman diaudit
```

Untuk Jersey/JAX-RS: consumer adalah **background application component**, bukan bagian dari request lifecycle. Resource menerima HTTP; consumer memproses stream secara mandiri; keduanya bertemu di application service, repository, observability, dan transaction boundary.

## Response:
7/13/2026, 1:43:21 AM

Kita lanjut ke **Kafka Consumer Retry, DLQ, dan Backpressure Pattern**. Saya akan pisahkan antara error transient, poison message, replay, offset handling, dan operational runbook supaya tidak tercampur antara desain aplikasi dan tindakan operasional.

# Cheatsheet - Kafka Consumer Retry, DLQ, Backpressure & Replay Pattern

## 1. Core Mental Model

Consumer failure handling bukan sekadar `try-catch`. Di Kafka, keputusan retry, commit offset, DLQ, pause/resume, dan replay menentukan apakah sistem akan:

```text id="17jj8w"
Aman
  → duplicate bisa ditoleransi
  → poison message tidak menahan partition
  → transient error bisa pulih
  → offset tidak maju sebelum proses aman
  → replay bisa dilakukan tanpa merusak state

Tidak aman
  → message hilang diam-diam
  → event diproses dua kali dengan side effect ganda
  → satu poison message membuat seluruh partition stuck
  → DLQ penuh tapi tidak ada yang melihat
  → offset reset dilakukan sembarangan
```

Kafka Consumer menyediakan API penting seperti `poll`, `commitSync`, `commitAsync`, `seek`, `seekToBeginning`, dan `seekToEnd`, sehingga failure handling sepenuhnya berada di desain aplikasi consumer, bukan otomatis diselesaikan Kafka. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/Consumer.html))

---

## 2. Prinsip Utama

| Prinsip | Makna praktis |
|---|---|
| Retry bukan satu mekanisme tunggal | Bedakan retry cepat, retry terjadwal, retry topic, DLQ, dan replay manual. |
| Jangan commit offset sebelum event aman | Commit offset berarti consumer tidak akan membaca ulang record itu secara normal. |
| Duplicate adalah normal | Crash setelah DB commit tapi sebelum offset commit akan menyebabkan reprocessing. |
| Poison message harus diisolasi | Jangan biarkan satu message invalid menahan partition selamanya. |
| DLQ harus observable | DLQ tanpa alert, dashboard, owner, dan replay tooling hanya memindahkan masalah. |
| Backpressure harus eksplisit | Jika downstream lambat, consumer harus menahan laju konsumsi secara terkendali. |
| Replay harus dirancang sejak awal | Event handler harus idempotent, version-aware, dan deterministic. |

---

## 3. Failure Classification

Langkah pertama adalah mengklasifikasi error. Jangan semua error diperlakukan sebagai retryable.

```text id="o8z2w7"
Consumer processing failure
│
├── 1. Data/contract failure
│   ├── malformed JSON
│   ├── unknown schema version
│   ├── missing required field
│   └── invalid enum/value
│
├── 2. Business permanent failure
│   ├── invalid state transition
│   ├── referenced entity intentionally absent
│   ├── authorization/domain rule violation
│   └── event no longer applicable
│
├── 3. Transient infrastructure failure
│   ├── DB connection timeout
│   ├── downstream HTTP 503
│   ├── temporary network issue
│   └── Kafka producer timeout while writing retry/DLQ
│
├── 4. Capacity/backpressure failure
│   ├── DB pool exhausted
│   ├── worker queue full
│   ├── consumer lag growing
│   └── processing slower than ingestion
│
└── 5. Code bug / unknown failure
    ├── NullPointerException
    ├── mapping bug
    ├── unexpected invariant violation
    └── incompatible deployment
```

| Failure type | Retry? | Commit main offset? | Typical action |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Malformed payload | Tidak | Ya, setelah masuk DLQ/quarantine | DLQ + alert contract owner |
| Unknown schema version | Tidak langsung | Tergantung policy | DLQ atau stop consumer sampai compatible |
| Missing required field | Tidak | Ya, setelah DLQ | DLQ + schema validation alert |
| Invalid business transition | Biasanya tidak | Ya, setelah audit | Rejected-event topic / DLQ |
| DB timeout | Ya | Tidak, atau commit setelah retry-topic publish sukses | Retry/backoff |
| Downstream 503 | Ya | Tidak, atau retry topic | Retry topic dengan delay |
| Duplicate event | Tidak perlu | Ya | Treat as success |
| Code bug | Tidak infinite retry | Biasanya tidak dulu | Stop, alert, fix, replay |
| Worker queue full | Bukan retry record | Tidak | Pause partition / scale consumer |

---

## 4. Retry Strategy Map

```text id="g4jrrq"
Record processing failed
│
├── Retriable and short-lived?
│   └── Inline retry with small bounded attempt
│
├── Retriable but may take seconds/minutes?
│   └── Retry topic / delayed retry
│
├── Non-retriable data or schema issue?
│   └── DLQ / quarantine topic
│
├── Business rejected but valid event?
│   └── Rejected event stream / audit table
│
├── Code bug in current deployment?
│   └── Stop consumer, alert, fix, replay
│
└── Downstream overloaded?
    └── Pause/resume, reduce max.poll.records, scale, shed load
```

---

## 5. Inline Retry

Inline retry berarti record yang gagal dicoba ulang langsung dalam poll loop.

```java id="0ubtmz"
public void handleWithInlineRetry(ConsumerRecord<String, String> record) {
    int maxAttempts = 3;

    for (int attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {
        try {
            handler.handle(record);
            return;
        } catch (TransientException e) {
            if (attempt == maxAttempts) {
                throw e;
            }

            sleep(backoff(attempt));
        }
    }
}
```

| Cocok untuk | Tidak cocok untuk |
|---|---|
| DB timeout sangat singkat | Downstream outage panjang |
| Network glitch pendek | Poison message |
| Optimistic lock retry | Processing lama |
| Retry < beberapa detik | Backoff menit/jam |

Risiko utama inline retry adalah poll loop tertahan terlalu lama. `max.poll.interval.ms` membatasi jeda maksimum antar pemanggilan `poll()`, dan jika processing batch melewati batas ini, consumer dapat dianggap gagal oleh group coordinator. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/41/configuration/consumer-configs/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 6. Stop-and-Retry by Not Committing Offset

Pattern ini sederhana: jika gagal, jangan commit offset. Record akan dibaca ulang setelah restart/rebalance.

```java id="zyzplh"
try {
    handler.handle(record);
    commitOffset(record);
} catch (TransientException e) {
    log.warn("Processing failed; offset not committed", e);
    throw e; // or stop consumer loop
}
```

| Kelebihan | Kekurangan |
|---|---|
| Simple | Poison message bisa menahan partition selamanya |
| Tidak butuh retry topic | Tidak ada delay natural selain restart/backoff loop |
| Menjaga ordering partition | Throughput partition berhenti |
| Aman untuk transient singkat | Buruk untuk outage panjang |

Gunakan pattern ini hanya jika failure memang jarang dan cepat pulih, atau jika domain mewajibkan strict ordering sehingga record berikutnya tidak boleh lewat sebelum record ini selesai.

---

## 7. Retry Topic Pattern

Retry topic memindahkan record gagal ke topic lain agar main partition bisa terus bergerak.

```text id="49ah4c"
main topic:
  order.events.v1
      ↓
main consumer
      ↓ fails transient
      ↓ publish to retry topic
      ↓ commit original offset

retry topic:
  order.events.retry.1m.v1
      ↓
retry consumer after delay
      ↓ success → done
      ↓ fail again → retry.5m / retry.30m / DLQ
```

Confluent menjelaskan bahwa DLQ biasanya diimplementasikan sebagai dedicated Kafka topic dan beberapa sistem melakukan retry sebelum akhirnya mengirim message ke DLQ. Kafka sendiri tidak menyediakan DLQ native di Java consumer; DLQ umumnya diimplementasikan dalam logic aplikasi consumer atau framework/platform di atas Kafka. ([Confluent](https://www.confluent.io/learn/kafka-dead-letter-queue/))

---

## 8. Retry Topic Design

### Naming

```text id="3j9vf8"
<domain>.<stream>.retry.<delay>.v<major>
<domain>.<stream>.dlq.v<major>
```

Contoh:

```text id="6aeydy"
order.order-events.retry.10s.v1
order.order-events.retry.1m.v1
order.order-events.retry.10m.v1
order.order-events.dlq.v1
```

### Header retry

```text id="zf2mog"
x-original-topic: order.events.v1
x-original-partition: 3
x-original-offset: 98123
x-original-timestamp: 2026-07-13T10:15:30Z
x-retry-attempt: 2
x-next-attempt-at: 2026-07-13T10:25:30Z
x-error-class: java.sql.SQLTransientConnectionException
x-error-message-hash: 7af92c
x-correlation-id: req-abc-123
```

### Payload DLQ/retry envelope

```json id="ufkxx3"
{
  "failureId": "01JZFAIL123456789",
  "failedAt": "2026-07-13T10:15:30Z",
  "consumerGroup": "order-projection-service",
  "original": {
    "topic": "order.events.v1",
    "partition": 3,
    "offset": 98123,
    "key": "order-123"
  },
  "event": {
    "eventId": "01JZEVENT123456789",
    "eventType": "OrderCreated",
    "eventVersion": 1,
    "payload": {
      "orderId": "order-123"
    }
  },
  "failure": {
    "attempt": 2,
    "classification": "TRANSIENT_INFRASTRUCTURE",
    "errorClass": "SQLTransientConnectionException",
    "errorMessage": "Connection timeout"
  }
}
```

---

## 9. Commit Rule untuk Retry Topic

Jika main consumer gagal memproses record lalu berhasil menulis record itu ke retry topic, main consumer boleh commit original offset.

```text id="ak25ka"
Process original record
  ↓ fails transient
Publish retry record
  ↓ Kafka ack success
Commit original offset
```

Jangan commit original offset kalau publish ke retry topic gagal.

```text id="1awklm"
Process original record
  ↓ fails transient
Publish retry record
  ↓ fails
Do not commit original offset
```

Jika offset di-commit tetapi retry publish gagal, message hilang secara operasional. Jika retry publish sukses tetapi offset commit gagal, record bisa muncul lagi dari main topic; karena itu retry publisher dan downstream handler tetap harus idempotent.

---

## 10. Delayed Retry Options

Kafka topic tidak memiliki per-message delay queue bawaan seperti beberapa broker lain. Jadi delay harus dibuat dengan desain aplikasi.

| Option | Cara kerja | Cocok untuk | Trade-off |
|---|---|---|---|
| Retry topic per delay | `retry.10s`, `retry.1m`, `retry.10m` | Sederhana dan mudah dioperasikan | Banyak topic |
| Scheduled retry timestamp | Consumer membaca retry topic, jika belum waktunya pause/sleep/seek | Delay fleksibel | Implementasi lebih sulit |
| DB retry table | Gagal disimpan ke DB, scheduler publish ulang | Butuh audit kuat | Menambah DB dependency |
| External scheduler | Job scheduler memindahkan event ke topic utama | Delay panjang | Menambah komponen |
| Kafka Streams punctuator | Stream app mengatur retry berdasarkan state store | Pipeline stream | Lebih kompleks |

---

## 11. Multi-level Retry Flow

```text id="5mv3p6"
main topic
  ↓
attempt 0 fails transient
  ↓
retry.10s
  ↓
attempt 1 fails transient
  ↓
retry.1m
  ↓
attempt 2 fails transient
  ↓
retry.10m
  ↓
attempt 3 fails transient
  ↓
DLQ
```

| Attempt | Delay | Action |
|---:|---:|---|
| 0 | immediate | Main processing |
| 1 | 10 seconds | Retry topic |
| 2 | 1 minute | Retry topic |
| 3 | 10 minutes | Retry topic |
| 4 | exhausted | DLQ |

Batas retry harus eksplisit. Confluent juga menekankan best practice DLQ: gunakan retry limit agar tidak terjadi infinite loop, lalu monitor DLQ health. ([Confluent](https://www.confluent.io/learn/kafka-dead-letter-queue/))

---

## 12. Ordering Trade-off

Retry topic bisa merusak ordering per key.

```text id="n5536m"
main topic partition 0:
  offset 100: OrderCreated(order-1) → fails, sent to retry
  offset 101: OrderConfirmed(order-1) → processed successfully

Result:
  OrderConfirmed diproses sebelum OrderCreated retry sukses
```

| Kebutuhan ordering | Strategy |
|---|---|
| Strict ordering per aggregate wajib | Jangan commit offset dan jangan lanjut record berikutnya untuk key/partition itu. |
| Ordering tidak kritikal | Retry topic aman. |
| Ordering per key tapi throughput tetap mau jalan | Per-key blocking/in-flight tracker, kompleks. |
| Projection bisa upsert deterministic | Retry topic lebih aman. |
| Event lifecycle stateful | Gunakan aggregate version check dan hold-back jika version gap. |

Rule praktis: **retry topic meningkatkan availability, tetapi mengorbankan strict ordering**. Untuk domain lifecycle yang sensitif, gunakan versioning dan idempotent state transition.

---

## 13. DLQ Pattern

DLQ adalah dedicated topic untuk message yang tidak bisa diproses normal. DLQ menyimpan message gagal agar pipeline utama tetap berjalan dan operator bisa inspect/reprocess. ([Confluent](https://www.confluent.io/learn/kafka-dead-letter-queue/))

```text id="qv7raa"
consumer
  ↓ processing failure
error classifier
  ↓ non-retriable or retry exhausted
DLQ publisher
  ↓ Kafka ack
commit original offset
```

### DLQ topic naming

```text id="xngzvr"
<domain>.<source-stream>.dlq.v<major>
```

Contoh:

```text id="d70vim"
order.order-events.dlq.v1
billing.invoice-events.dlq.v1
case.enforcement-events.dlq.v1
```

### DLQ record key

| Option | Kapan dipakai |
|---|---|
| Original key | Menjaga grouping investigasi per aggregate |
| `eventId` | Dedup dan lookup mudah |
| `failureId` | Setiap failure menjadi record unik |
| Composite `eventId:attempt` | Menjaga trace retry attempt |

Rekomendasi umum: pakai **original key** sebagai Kafka key, dan simpan `failureId`, `eventId`, `originalTopic`, `partition`, `offset` dalam payload/header.

---

## 14. DLQ Payload Minimal

```json id="jtd0ki"
{
  "failureId": "01JZDLQ123456789",
  "failedAt": "2026-07-13T10:15:30Z",
  "service": "order-projection-service",
  "consumerGroup": "order-projection-service",
  "environment": "prod",
  "originalRecord": {
    "topic": "order.events.v1",
    "partition": 3,
    "offset": 98123,
    "key": "order-123",
    "timestamp": "2026-07-13T10:15:20Z"
  },
  "eventMetadata": {
    "eventId": "01JZEVENT123456789",
    "eventType": "OrderCreated",
    "eventVersion": 1,
    "correlationId": "req-abc-123"
  },
  "failure": {
    "classification": "SCHEMA_VALIDATION",
    "errorClass": "JsonMappingException",
    "errorMessage": "Missing required field customerId",
    "stackTraceHash": "a81f4c"
  },
  "payload": "{... original payload ...}"
}
```

### DLQ field checklist

| Field | Wajib? | Fungsi |
|---|---:|---|
| `failureId` | Ya | Identifier failure record |
| `failedAt` | Ya | Audit timeline |
| `service` | Ya | Service yang gagal |
| `consumerGroup` | Ya | Group pemroses |
| `environment` | Ya | Prod/staging/dev |
| `original.topic` | Ya | Source stream |
| `original.partition` | Ya | Trace offset |
| `original.offset` | Ya | Replay/investigasi |
| `original.key` | Ya | Aggregate lookup |
| `eventId` | Jika tersedia | Dedup/replay |
| `eventType` | Jika tersedia | Routing |
| `correlationId` | Jika tersedia | Trace end-to-end |
| `classification` | Ya | Triage |
| `errorClass` | Ya | Root cause grouping |
| `payload` | Ya, jika aman | Investigasi/replay |

---

## 15. DLQ Security & Privacy

DLQ sering berisi payload mentah yang gagal, sehingga risikonya tinggi.

| Risiko | Mitigasi |
|---|---|
| PII ikut masuk DLQ | Masking/redaction sebelum publish DLQ |
| Secret/token masuk payload | Reject dan sanitize log/DLQ |
| DLQ retention terlalu lama | Retention sesuai data classification |
| Banyak tim punya akses DLQ | ACL ketat per domain |
| Payload tidak terenkripsi | TLS in transit, encryption at rest sesuai platform |
| Replay sembarangan | Replay tool harus punya approval/audit |

Untuk domain regulated, DLQ harus dianggap sebagai **data store operasional**, bukan sekadar topic teknis.

---

## 16. DLQ Handling Lifecycle

```text id="ird8xd"
DLQ record created
  ↓
Alert / dashboard
  ↓
Triage classification
  ↓
Decide:
  ├── fix producer data
  ├── fix consumer code
  ├── patch schema compatibility
  ├── manually reject as invalid
  └── replay after correction
  ↓
Record resolution
  ↓
Audit trail
```

| Status | Makna |
|---|---|
| `NEW` | Baru masuk DLQ |
| `TRIAGED` | Sudah diklasifikasi |
| `WAITING_FIX` | Butuh fix producer/consumer/schema |
| `READY_TO_REPLAY` | Aman diproses ulang |
| `REPLAYED` | Sudah dikirim ulang |
| `REJECTED` | Tidak akan diproses |
| `CLOSED` | Selesai secara operasional |

Kafka topic sendiri tidak punya status resolution per record. Jika butuh workflow seperti ini, gunakan DB/table/tooling tambahan yang mereferensikan DLQ topic/partition/offset.

---

## 17. Backpressure Mental Model

Backpressure terjadi saat consumer mengambil data lebih cepat daripada kemampuan memproses.

```text id="z6x01k"
Producer rate > Consumer processing rate
  ↓
Consumer lag grows
  ↓
Batch processing takes longer
  ↓
DB/API pressure increases
  ↓
Retry volume grows
  ↓
System may enter retry storm
```

Backpressure yang baik menahan laju konsumsi sebelum downstream collapse.

---

## 18. Backpressure Levers

| Lever | Level | Fungsi |
|---|---|---|
| `max.poll.records` | Consumer config | Membatasi batch size per poll |
| `max.poll.interval.ms` | Consumer config | Memberi batas waktu proses antar poll |
| `pause()` / `resume()` | Runtime API | Stop/resume fetch partition tertentu |
| Worker queue limit | Application | Mencegah memory blow-up |
| DB pool limit | Infrastructure | Membatasi concurrent DB work |
| Rate limiter | Application | Menahan processing downstream |
| Consumer instance count | Deployment | Menambah paralelisme sampai jumlah partition |
| Partition count | Kafka topology | Meningkatkan paralelisme maksimum |
| Circuit breaker | Application | Fail-fast saat downstream rusak |
| Retry budget | Reliability | Mencegah retry storm |

Kafka Consumer API menyediakan `pause` dan `resume`; pause menghentikan konsumsi dari partition tertentu pada poll berikutnya tanpa menyebabkan rebalance, sedangkan resume melanjutkan partition yang dipause. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/10/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/KafkaConsumer.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 19. Pause/Resume Pattern

```java id="8nfzg7"
public void pollLoop() {
    while (running.get()) {
        ConsumerRecords<String, String> records =
                consumer.poll(Duration.ofMillis(500));

        if (workQueue.remainingCapacity() < LOW_WATERMARK) {
            consumer.pause(consumer.assignment());
            paused = true;
        }

        dispatch(records);

        if (paused && workQueue.remainingCapacity() > HIGH_WATERMARK) {
            consumer.resume(consumer.paused());
            paused = false;
        }

        commitCompletedOffsets();
    }
}
```

Important: tetap panggil `poll()` secara periodik walau partition sedang paused agar heartbeat/group membership tetap sehat. Consumer group bergantung pada heartbeat; jika heartbeat hilang sampai `session.timeout.ms`, coordinator akan mengeluarkan member dan melakukan reassignment. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/clients/consumer.html))

---

## 20. Backpressure Decision Table

| Kondisi | Sinyal | Aksi |
|---|---|---|
| DB lambat tapi masih sehat | Processing latency naik | Kurangi `max.poll.records`, tambah worker/instance |
| DB pool penuh | Connection wait tinggi | Pause consumer, kurangi concurrency |
| Downstream outage | Error 503/timeouts | Circuit breaker + retry topic |
| Lag naik tapi processing sehat | Producer rate > consumer rate | Scale consumer hingga batas partition |
| Lag naik di satu partition | Hot key/hot partition | Investigasi key distribution |
| Retry topic tumbuh cepat | Transient outage/retry storm | Stop retry consumer sementara, perpanjang delay |
| DLQ tumbuh | Data/schema/bug | Alert owner, triage |
| Rebalance sering | Deployment/group instability | Static membership/cooperative assignor/tune lifecycle |

---

## 21. Retry Storm

Retry storm terjadi ketika failure transient besar memicu retry massal yang justru memperparah downstream.

```text id="j7cyfb"
Downstream DB slow
  ↓
Consumer failures increase
  ↓
Retry records created
  ↓
Retry consumers add more load
  ↓
DB becomes slower
  ↓
More failures
```

### Mitigasi

| Mitigasi | Penjelasan |
|---|---|
| Exponential backoff | Delay meningkat per attempt |
| Jitter | Hindari semua retry bangun bersamaan |
| Retry budget | Batasi jumlah retry per event/window |
| Circuit breaker | Jangan panggil downstream saat diketahui rusak |
| Pause retry consumers | Hentikan sementara retry stream |
| Bulkhead | Pisahkan pool main processing dan retry processing |
| DLQ after limit | Hindari infinite retry |
| Alert early | Jangan tunggu DLQ membengkak |

---

## 22. Offset Reset & Replay

Replay berarti membaca ulang record lama. Kafka consumer offset menentukan posisi consumer pada partition. Jika consumer gagal, instance lain dalam group melanjutkan dari offset terakhir yang di-commit. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/control-center/current/clients/manage-offsets.html))

### Replay approaches

| Approach | Cocok untuk | Risiko |
|---|---|---|
| Consumer group baru | Rebuild projection dari awal | Load besar ke Kafka/downstream |
| Reset offset existing group | Recovery production bug | Harus stop consumer group dulu |
| `assign + seek` tool | Replay specific partition/offset | Perlu tooling hati-hati |
| DLQ replay topic | Reprocess failed record | Harus sanitize/correct payload |
| Backfill job | Rebuild subset data | Perlu dedup dan rate limit |

Confluent Control Center menjelaskan offset reset dapat digunakan untuk troubleshooting, testing, dan disaster recovery, dan consumer group perlu dikosongkan/dihentikan sebelum reset offset dilakukan melalui Control Center. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/control-center/current/clients/manage-offsets.html))

---

## 23. Offset Reset Modes

`auto.offset.reset` menentukan posisi awal saat tidak ada committed offset atau offset sudah tidak ada di server. Nilai umum mencakup `earliest`, `latest`, `none`, dan pada dokumentasi Confluent terbaru juga ada `by_duration:<duration>` dengan format ISO-8601 duration. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/installation/configuration/consumer-configs.html))

| Mode | Arti | Cocok untuk |
|---|---|---|
| `earliest` | Mulai dari offset paling awal yang masih tersedia | Rebuild projection, bootstrap service baru |
| `latest` | Mulai dari record baru setelah consumer start | Notification-only consumer |
| `none` | Throw error jika offset tidak ada | Production strict mode |
| `by_duration:PnDTnHnMn.nS` | Mulai dari durasi tertentu dari waktu sekarang | Replay window terbatas, jika platform mendukung |

Catatan penting: `auto.offset.reset` hanya dipakai saat tidak ada committed offset atau offset out of range, bukan setiap consumer restart normal.

---

## 24. Replay Safety Checklist

Sebelum replay, pastikan:

| Checklist | Pertanyaan |
|---|---|
| Idempotency | Apakah event lama aman diproses ulang? |
| Schema compatibility | Apakah consumer bisa membaca event versi lama? |
| Side effect isolation | Apakah replay akan mengirim email/payment/API call ulang? |
| Rate limit | Apakah DB/downstream sanggup menerima replay volume? |
| Ordering | Apakah replay subset merusak urutan aggregate? |
| Dedup ledger | Apakah `processed_event` perlu dibersihkan atau dipertahankan? |
| Target state | Apakah replay rebuild projection atau re-execute business command? |
| Audit | Siapa approve replay dan record mana saja? |
| Stop condition | Bagaimana tahu replay selesai dan benar? |

---

## 25. Replay Tooling Pattern

```text id="xsorh1"
Replay request
  ↓
Validate authorization
  ↓
Resolve source:
  ├── topic + partition + offset range
  ├── timestamp range
  ├── DLQ failure ids
  └── event ids
  ↓
Dry run
  ↓
Rate-limited replay
  ↓
Metrics + audit log
  ↓
Result report
```

### Replay command model

```json id="ll5f2u"
{
  "source": {
    "topic": "order.events.v1",
    "partition": 3,
    "fromOffset": 98100,
    "toOffset": 98200
  },
  "target": {
    "mode": "REPROCESS_HANDLER",
    "consumerGroup": "order-projection-replay"
  },
  "safety": {
    "dryRun": false,
    "maxRecordsPerSecond": 50,
    "requireIdempotency": true
  },
  "reason": "Rebuild order projection after bug fix INC-1234"
}
```

## 26. Main Consumer + Retry/DLQ Pseudocode

```java id="k4slc8"
public void processRecord(ConsumerRecord<String, String> record) {
    try {
        EventEnvelope event = deserializer.deserialize(record.value());

        handler.handle(event);

        offsets.markProcessed(record);
    } catch (Exception e) {
        FailureClassification classification = classifier.classify(e);

        switch (classification.action()) {
            case RETRY_INLINE -> {
                retryInline(record);
                offsets.markProcessed(record);
            }

            case SEND_TO_RETRY_TOPIC -> {
                retryPublisher.publish(record, e, classification);
                offsets.markProcessed(record);
            }

            case SEND_TO_DLQ -> {
                dlqPublisher.publish(record, e, classification);
                offsets.markProcessed(record);
            }

            case STOP_CONSUMER -> {
                throw new FatalConsumerException(e);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

Rule: `offsets.markProcessed(record)` hanya boleh dilakukan jika salah satu ini benar:

```text id="hza7nu"
1. Business processing sukses
2. Duplicate event terdeteksi dan aman dianggap sukses
3. Record berhasil dipublish ke retry topic
4. Record berhasil dipublish ke DLQ/quarantine
5. Record memang intentionally skipped dengan audit
```

---

## 27. Commit Offset Setelah DLQ

```java id="r81w9e"
try {
    dlqPublisher.publish(record, exception, classification);

    // Only after DLQ publish is acknowledged
    commitOffset(record);
} catch (Exception dlqFailure) {
    // Do not commit original offset.
    // Otherwise record disappears from main processing path.
    throw dlqFailure;
}
```

Commit setelah DLQ publish sukses adalah pattern penting. Jika DLQ gagal dan offset sudah di-commit, record bisa hilang dari pipeline utama dan juga tidak ada di DLQ.

---

## 28. DLQ Publisher Harus Kuat

DLQ publisher adalah producer juga, jadi ia punya failure mode sendiri.

| Failure DLQ publisher | Aksi |
|---|---|
| Serialization DLQ gagal | Fallback ke minimal raw DLQ payload |
| DLQ topic unavailable | Jangan commit original offset |
| Authorization gagal | Stop consumer + alert |
| Buffer full | Backpressure/pause consumer |
| Message too large | Truncate payload atau simpan payload di object storage dan kirim reference |
| DLQ publish timeout | Treat as failure; jangan commit offset |

---

## 29. Quarantine Table Alternative

Selain DLQ Kafka topic, bisa juga menyimpan failure ke PostgreSQL quarantine table.

```sql id="k203w1"
CREATE TABLE kafka_quarantine_event (
    id                  UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    consumer_group      TEXT NOT NULL,
    original_topic      TEXT NOT NULL,
    original_partition  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    original_offset     BIGINT NOT NULL,
    original_key        TEXT,
    event_id            UUID,
    event_type          TEXT,
    classification      TEXT NOT NULL,
    error_class         TEXT NOT NULL,
    error_message       TEXT,
    payload             JSONB,
    status              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NEW',
    created_at          TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    resolved_at         TIMESTAMPTZ,
    UNIQUE (consumer_group, original_topic, original_partition, original_offset)
);
```

| Kafka DLQ topic | Quarantine table |
|---|---|
| Natural Kafka pipeline | Lebih mudah buat workflow triage |
| Cocok untuk replay via Kafka | Cocok untuk operational UI |
| Bisa high throughput | Lebih kuat untuk status/resolution |
| Perlu consumer/tooling tambahan | Menambah beban DB |
| Retention topic-based | Retention bisa row/status-based |

Untuk sistem regulated, sering masuk akal memakai keduanya: **DLQ topic untuk pipeline**, **quarantine table untuk workflow investigasi**.

---

## 30. Commit Strategy Matrix

| Scenario | Commit original offset? | Alasan |
|---|---:|---|
| Processing sukses | Ya | Event selesai |
| Duplicate event | Ya | Idempotent success |
| Inline retry sukses | Ya | Event selesai |
| Inline retry exhausted, belum DLQ/retry topic | Tidak | Belum aman |
| Retry topic publish sukses | Ya | Ownership pindah ke retry stream |
| Retry topic publish gagal | Tidak | Agar original tidak hilang |
| DLQ publish sukses | Ya | Sudah diaudit/diisolasi |
| DLQ publish gagal | Tidak | Agar original tidak hilang |
| Fatal code bug | Tidak | Stop, fix, replay |
| Business rejected dan dicatat di audit | Ya | Selesai secara domain |
| Consumer shutdown saat processing | Hanya commit offset yang selesai | Hindari message loss |

---

## 31. Backpressure with Worker Queue

```text id="h4zk20"
consumer poll thread
  ↓
bounded queue
  ↓
worker pool
  ↓
offset completion tracker
  ↓
commit contiguous offsets
```

### Bounded queue rule

```java id="dku27d"
if (!workQueue.offer(task)) {
    consumer.pause(Set.of(recordTopicPartition));
    // Do not fetch more from overloaded partition.
}
```

| Komponen | Rule |
|---|---|
| Consumer thread | Hanya poll, dispatch, pause/resume, commit |
| Worker thread | Proses business logic |
| Queue | Bounded, tidak boleh unbounded |
| Offset tracker | Commit hanya contiguous completed offset |
| Partition ordering | Jika wajib, satu worker lane per partition/key |

---

## 32. Poison Message Detection

Poison message adalah record yang terus gagal walau di-retry.

```text id="72q727"
same eventId / topic-partition-offset
  ↓
same error classification
  ↓
same error repeated across attempts
  ↓
no sign of transient recovery
  ↓
route to DLQ
```

| Signal | Interpretasi |
|---|---|
| Same payload, same schema error | Permanent data issue |
| Same event id, same NPE | Code bug |
| Same aggregate, invalid version gap | Ordering/replay issue |
| Many different events, same DB timeout | Infrastructure issue |
| Many schema failures after deploy | Producer/consumer contract mismatch |
| Retry topic grows but main normal | Downstream retry dependency failing |

---

## 33. Operational Runbook: DLQ Spike

```text id="us0n06"
DLQ spike detected
  ↓
Check top errorClass / eventType / producer
  ↓
Was there a deploy?
  ↓
Is failure schema/data/business/infrastructure?
  ↓
Stop or throttle affected consumer if needed
  ↓
Assign owner:
    producer team / consumer team / platform team / data team
  ↓
Fix root cause
  ↓
Replay or reject DLQ records
  ↓
Close incident with prevention item
```

| Check | Query/Signal |
|---|---|
| Error class distribution | `count by errorClass` |
| Event type distribution | `count by eventType` |
| Producer version | header/build metadata |
| First failure time | compare deployment timeline |
| Partition/key concentration | hot aggregate? |
| Schema version | compatibility issue? |
| DLQ publish rate | active incident severity |
| Retry exhausted count | outage duration estimate |

---

## 34. Operational Runbook: Lag Spike

```text id="kntmzx"
Consumer lag spike
  ↓
Is processing rate below normal?
  ├── yes → app/downstream problem
  └── no → producer surge or partition skew
  ↓
Check rebalance count
  ↓
Check DB/API latency
  ↓
Check error/retry rate
  ↓
Check hot partition
  ↓
Scale or throttle
```

| Cause | Evidence | Action |
|---|---|---|
| Producer surge | Input rate increased | Scale consumers up to partition count |
| Hot partition | One partition lag much higher | Investigate key distribution |
| DB slow | Processing latency high | Pause/reduce concurrency |
| Retry storm | Retry count high | Increase backoff, circuit breaker |
| Rebalance loop | Rebalance count high | Fix lifecycle/config/deployment |
| Consumer stuck | Last poll age high | Restart/inspect thread dump |
| DLQ blocked | DLQ publisher errors | Fix DLQ topic/ACL/producer |

---

## 35. Operational Runbook: Replay DLQ

```text id="nqcz7h"
Replay DLQ
  ↓
Identify failure ids / offset range
  ↓
Confirm root cause fixed
  ↓
Dry run deserialize + validate
  ↓
Confirm idempotency behavior
  ↓
Choose replay target:
    main topic / dedicated replay topic / handler direct
  ↓
Rate limit
  ↓
Monitor success/failure
  ↓
Mark DLQ resolved
```

| Replay target | Cocok untuk |
|---|---|
| Original main topic | Ingin melewati pipeline normal dari awal |
| Dedicated replay topic | Ingin isolasi dari live traffic |
| Direct handler tool | Ingin reprocess ke projection tertentu |
| DB correction script | Jika event sudah tidak valid untuk replay |
| Reject/close | Jika event memang invalid dan tidak boleh diproses |

---

## 36. Production Metrics

| Metric | Level | Tujuan |
|---|---|---|
| `consumer_records_polled_total` | Consumer | Input volume |
| `consumer_records_processed_total` | Handler | Success volume |
| `consumer_records_failed_total` | Handler | Failure volume |
| `consumer_retry_published_total` | Retry | Retry volume |
| `consumer_dlq_published_total` | DLQ | DLQ volume |
| `consumer_duplicate_events_total` | Idempotency | Duplicate rate |
| `consumer_processing_latency_ms` | Handler | Bottleneck detection |
| `consumer_commit_latency_ms` | Offset | Commit issue |
| `consumer_lag` | Kafka | Backlog |
| `consumer_rebalance_total` | Kafka | Group stability |
| `consumer_partition_paused` | Backpressure | Flow control |
| `retry_topic_depth` | Retry | Retry backlog |
| `dlq_unresolved_count` | Ops | Operational debt |
| `last_successful_poll_age_seconds` | Health | Stuck worker detection |

---

## 37. Alert Rules

| Alert | Severity | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| DLQ count > 0 for critical event | Warning/Critical | Critical event gagal |
| DLQ spike > baseline | Critical | Breaking change atau outage |
| Retry exhausted > threshold | Critical | Transient failure tidak pulih |
| Lag growing continuously | Warning/Critical | Consumer tidak mengejar input |
| One partition lag dominates | Warning | Hot key/skew |
| Last successful poll too old | Critical | Consumer stuck |
| Rebalance loop | Warning/Critical | Deployment/lifecycle instability |
| DLQ publisher failure | Critical | Failure isolation rusak |
| Retry topic age too old | Warning | Retry backlog tidak terkuras |
| Duplicate event spike | Warning | Producer/outbox/replay issue |

---

## 38. Design Pattern: Strict Ordering Consumer

Untuk domain yang tidak boleh memproses event berikutnya sebelum event sebelumnya sukses.

```text id="bq8fxj"
partition record fails
  ↓
do not commit offset
  ↓
pause partition or stop consumer
  ↓
retry bounded
  ↓
if still fails:
    operator decision
    ├── fix and retry
    ├── DLQ and accept ordering break
    └── stop pipeline
```

| Cocok untuk | Contoh |
|---|---|
| State machine lifecycle | `CaseOpened → CaseAssigned → CaseClosed` |
| Financial ledger | Debit/credit sequence |
| Aggregate version strict | Event version must be `current + 1` |
| Regulatory audit chain | Enforcement timeline |

Trade-off: satu poison event bisa menahan seluruh partition. Untuk domain seperti ini, desain keying, schema validation, dan producer correctness jauh lebih penting.

---

## 39. Design Pattern: High Availability Consumer

Untuk domain yang lebih mementingkan pipeline tetap jalan.

```text id="oyjp5z"
record fails
  ↓
classify
  ↓
retry topic or DLQ
  ↓
commit original offset
  ↓
continue next record
```

| Cocok untuk | Contoh |
|---|---|
| Analytics projection | Dashboard/read model |
| Notification enrichment | Email/push non-critical |
| Search indexing | Eventually consistent index |
| Cache rebuild | Redis/materialized cache |

Trade-off: ordering bisa berubah, tapi throughput dan availability lebih baik.

---

## 40. Design Pattern: Hybrid per Error Class

```text id="n9m6fr"
Error class:
  schema invalid
    → DLQ + commit

  transient DB
    → retry topic + commit

  aggregate version gap
    → stop/pause partition, do not commit

  duplicate
    → commit as success

  code bug
    → stop consumer, alert
```

Ini biasanya pattern paling realistis untuk microservice bisnis.

---

## 41. Jersey/JAX-RS Integration Notes

Di Jersey/JAX-RS, retry/DLQ/backpressure bukan bagian dari `Resource`, tapi bagian dari background worker.

```text id="bkj5n4"
JAX-RS Resource
  → handles HTTP

Kafka Consumer Worker
  → handles Kafka records
  → uses same Application Service
  → uses same Repository
  → uses same Observability
  → has independent lifecycle
```

| Area | Praktik |
|---|---|
| Dependency injection | Inject handler, repository, publisher retry/DLQ |
| Lifecycle | Start worker at app startup, stop with `wakeup()` |
| Health | Expose consumer status, lag, last poll, DLQ failure |
| Config | Retry thresholds via env/config |
| Shutdown | Commit only completed offsets |
| Tracing | Propagate `traceparent` / correlation id from Kafka headers |

---

## 42. Common Anti-Patterns

| Anti-pattern | Dampak |
|---|---|
| Retry semua exception tanpa klasifikasi | Infinite retry / partition stuck |
| Commit offset walau retry/DLQ publish gagal | Message hilang |
| Tidak punya retry limit | Retry storm |
| DLQ tanpa metadata original offset | Sulit replay/investigasi |
| DLQ tanpa monitoring | Masalah tidak terlihat |
| Retry topic tanpa idempotency | Duplicate side effect |
| Retry topic untuk strict ordering domain | Event lifecycle bisa out-of-order |
| Worker queue unbounded | Memory blow-up |
| Pause partition tapi tidak poll | Heartbeat hilang, rebalance |
| Reset offset production tanpa stop group | Race dan hasil tidak terprediksi |
| Replay tanpa rate limit | Menjatuhkan downstream |
| Replay tanpa idempotency | Side effect ganda |
| Menjadikan DLQ sebagai “normal flow” | Data quality buruk disembunyikan |
| Menyimpan PII mentah di DLQ sembarangan | Compliance/security risk |

---

## 43. Production Readiness Checklist

| Area | Checklist |
|---|---|
| Error classification | Ada mapping retriable/non-retriable/fatal |
| Retry policy | Ada max attempt, backoff, jitter |
| Retry topic | Naming, retention, owner, ACL jelas |
| DLQ | Payload metadata lengkap dan termonitor |
| Offset safety | Commit hanya setelah success/retry-publish/DLQ-publish |
| Idempotency | Consumer dedup by event id/business key |
| Ordering | Ada keputusan explicit: strict vs availability |
| Backpressure | `pause/resume`, queue limit, rate limit |
| Replay | Ada dry-run, approval, rate limit, audit |
| Observability | Lag, DLQ, retry, failure class, processing latency |
| Security | DLQ redaction, ACL, retention |
| Kubernetes | Graceful shutdown dan readiness behavior |
| Runbook | DLQ spike, lag spike, replay, rollback tersedia |

---

## 44. Ringkasan Praktis

Model yang aman:

```text id="gcfztl"
poll record
  ↓
deserialize
  ↓
classify/process
  ↓
if success:
      commit offset
  ↓
if duplicate:
      commit offset
  ↓
if transient:
      publish retry topic
      if publish success: commit offset
      else: do not commit
  ↓
if permanent:
      publish DLQ/quarantine
      if publish success: commit offset
      else: do not commit
  ↓
if fatal/code bug:
      stop consumer
      do not commit unsafe offset
```

Decision rule paling penting:

```text id="oky17f"
Offset boleh maju hanya jika ownership record sudah jelas:
  - selesai diproses, atau
  - aman dianggap duplicate, atau
  - sudah dipindahkan ke retry topic, atau
  - sudah dipindahkan ke DLQ/quarantine, atau
  - sudah direject dengan audit yang sah.
```
