## Response:
7/13/2026, 1:46:14 AM

Kita lanjut ke **Kafka AdminClient & operational automation**. Fokusnya bukan membuat “admin panel besar”, tapi skill praktis untuk startup validation, topic/config inspection, consumer group visibility, lag calculation, dan automation yang aman dari service Java/Jersey.

# Cheatsheet - Kafka AdminClient & Operational Automation dalam Java/Jersey Microservice

## 1. Core Mental Model

**Kafka AdminClient / Admin API** adalah client programmatic untuk melakukan operasi administratif terhadap Kafka cluster: inspect topic, broker, config, ACL, consumer group, offset, dan beberapa operasi perubahan seperti create topic atau alter config.

Dalam Java modern, gunakan interface **`org.apache.kafka.clients.admin.Admin`** sebagai tipe utama. Dokumentasi Kafka menyebut `Admin` sebagai administrative client untuk mengelola dan menginspeksi **topics, brokers, configurations, dan ACLs**, dan instance yang dibuat dari `Admin.create(...)` dijamin thread-safe. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/40/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/admin/Admin.html))

```text id="kafka-admin-mental-model"
Jersey/JAX-RS Microservice
│
├── Runtime path
│   ├── Producer
│   ├── Consumer
│   └── Kafka Streams
│
└── Admin/Operational path
    ├── Startup validation
    ├── Topic inspection
    ├── Config validation
    ├── Consumer group inspection
    ├── Lag calculation
    ├── ACL visibility
    ├── Health/dependency checks
    └── Internal admin tooling
```

Jangan perlakukan AdminClient sebagai pengganti platform tooling seperti Terraform, Helm, Confluent Control Center, MSK tooling, Azure tooling, atau GitOps. Dalam microservice, Admin API paling aman dipakai untuk **read-mostly inspection** dan **fail-fast validation**. Operasi mutasi seperti create/delete/alter harus dikunci ketat.

---

## 2. Kapan Admin API Dipakai?

| Use case | Cocok? | Catatan |
|---|---:|---|
| Startup check apakah topic wajib ada | Ya | Fail-fast jika service tidak bisa jalan tanpa topic. |
| Validate partition count topic | Ya | Penting untuk parallelism dan ordering. |
| Validate cleanup policy / retention | Ya | Deteksi mismatch environment. |
| Inspect consumer group offset | Ya | Untuk diagnostics/internal endpoint. |
| Hitung consumer lag | Ya | Butuh committed offset + log end offset. |
| Create topic otomatis saat startup | Hati-hati | Lebih baik via IaC/GitOps; boleh untuk local/dev/test. |
| Delete topic dari service | Tidak disarankan | Risiko destructive tinggi. |
| Alter config runtime | Sangat hati-hati | Butuh approval dan audit. |
| ACL management dari business service | Tidak disarankan | Biasanya tanggung jawab platform/security. |
| Reset offset production | Jangan dari endpoint biasa | Harus lewat admin tool dengan approval, dry-run, audit. |

---

## 3. Dependency Maven

Sesuaikan versi `kafka-clients` dengan standard platform perusahaan. Jika mengikuti dokumentasi Kafka terbaru yang sedang tersedia, Kafka 4.3.x mendokumentasikan konfigurasi Admin client secara terpisah di halaman **Admin Configs**. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/configuration/admin-configs/))

```xml id="maven-kafka-clients"
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.kafka</groupId>
    <artifactId>kafka-clients</artifactId>
    <version>4.3.1</version>
</dependency>
```

Gunakan `Admin`, bukan mengikat kode ke implementasi `KafkaAdminClient`. Dokumentasi `AdminClient` lama juga menyatakan client code sebaiknya memakai interface `Admin` yang lebih baru dibanding base class `AdminClient`. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/39/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/admin/AdminClient.html))

---

## 4. AdminClient Configuration

```java id="admin-config"
Properties props = new Properties();

props.put(AdminClientConfig.BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS_CONFIG,
        System.getenv("KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS"));

props.put(AdminClientConfig.CLIENT_ID_CONFIG,
        "order-service-admin-" + System.getenv().getOrDefault("HOSTNAME", "local"));

props.put(AdminClientConfig.REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS_CONFIG, "30000");
props.put(AdminClientConfig.DEFAULT_API_TIMEOUT_MS_CONFIG, "60000");

// Security example only; follow company platform standard
props.put("security.protocol", "SASL_SSL");
props.put("sasl.mechanism", "SCRAM-SHA-512");
props.put("sasl.jaas.config", System.getenv("KAFKA_SASL_JAAS_CONFIG"));

Admin admin = Admin.create(props);
```

Kafka Admin config `default.api.timeout.ms` adalah timeout default untuk client APIs yang tidak menentukan timeout eksplisit, default-nya 60 detik; `request.timeout.ms` mengontrol waktu tunggu response request sebelum retry/fail, default-nya 30 detik di dokumentasi Kafka 4.3. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/configuration/admin-configs/))

| Config | Fungsi | Rekomendasi praktis |
|---|---|---|
| `bootstrap.servers` | Initial broker list untuk menemukan cluster | Isi lebih dari satu endpoint jika tersedia. |
| `client.id` | Identitas admin client | Gunakan `<service>-admin-<pod/host>`. |
| `default.api.timeout.ms` | Timeout default operasi API | Jangan biarkan terlalu panjang untuk health check. |
| `request.timeout.ms` | Timeout request ke broker | Sesuaikan dengan network/platform SLA. |
| `security.protocol` | Transport/auth mode | Production umumnya `SSL` atau `SASL_SSL`. |
| `sasl.*` / `ssl.*` | Auth material | Ambil dari secret manager/Kubernetes Secret. |
| `metadata.max.age.ms` | Refresh metadata berkala | Default cukup untuk kebanyakan service. |

---

## 5. Lifecycle di Jersey/JAX-RS

Admin client bisa dibuat sebagai singleton infrastructure component dan ditutup saat aplikasi shutdown.

```text id="admin-lifecycle"
Application startup
  ↓
Load Kafka admin config
  ↓
Create Admin singleton
  ↓
Run startup validations
  ↓
Expose internal diagnostics endpoints
  ↓
Application shutdown
  ↓
admin.close()
```

```java id="admin-provider"
public final class KafkaAdminProvider implements AutoCloseable {
    private final Admin admin;

    public KafkaAdminProvider(Properties props) {
        this.admin = Admin.create(props);
    }

    public Admin admin() {
        return admin;
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        admin.close(Duration.ofSeconds(10));
    }
}
```

Walaupun `Admin` instance thread-safe, hasil operasi Admin API berbasis future; dokumentasi Kafka mengingatkan callback/future completion berjalan pada single thread internal sehingga jangan menjalankan blocking work yang lama di callback tersebut. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/40/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/admin/Admin.html))

---

## 6. Admin API Capability Map

| Capability | API | Use case praktis |
|---|---|---|
| Cluster info | `describeCluster()` | Cek broker nodes, controller, cluster id. |
| Topic listing | `listTopics()` | Validasi topic ada / discovery internal. |
| Topic metadata | `describeTopics()` | Partition count, replicas, ISR, leader. |
| Topic creation | `createTopics()` | Provision dev/test atau controlled bootstrap. |
| Config inspection | `describeConfigs()` | Retention, cleanup policy, min ISR. |
| Config mutation | `incrementalAlterConfigs()` | Controlled operation; jarang dari app service. |
| Consumer group description | `describeConsumerGroups()` | Member, assignment, state. |
| Group offset listing | `listConsumerGroupOffsets()` | Ambil committed offset. |
| Log end offset listing | `listOffsets()` | Ambil latest/earliest/timestamp offset. |
| ACL inspection | `describeAcls()` | Diagnose permission issue. |
| ACL mutation | `createAcls()` / `deleteAcls()` | Biasanya platform/security only. |
| Delete topic | `deleteTopics()` | Destructive; jangan dari service biasa. |

Kafka Admin interface menyediakan operasi seperti `listTopics`, `describeTopics`, `describeCluster`, `describeConfigs`, `describeConsumerGroups`, `listConsumerGroupOffsets`, dan `listOffsets`. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/40/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/admin/Admin.html))

---

## 7. Startup Validation Pattern

Startup validation berguna agar service gagal cepat jika Kafka topology tidak sesuai.

```text id="startup-validation-flow"
Service startup
  ↓
Validate Kafka reachable
  ↓
Validate required topics exist
  ↓
Validate partition count
  ↓
Validate critical topic configs
  ↓
Validate optional ACL/read-write capability
  ↓
Mark service ready
```

### Contoh topic requirement

```java id="topic-requirement"
public record TopicRequirement(
        String name,
        int minPartitions,
        Map<String, String> requiredConfigs
) {}
```

```java id="startup-validator"
public final class KafkaStartupValidator {
    private final Admin admin;

    public KafkaStartupValidator(Admin admin) {
        this.admin = admin;
    }

    public void validateTopics(List<TopicRequirement> requirements) throws Exception {
        Set<String> topicNames = requirements.stream()
                .map(TopicRequirement::name)
                .collect(Collectors.toSet());

        Map<String, TopicDescription> descriptions =
                admin.describeTopics(topicNames)
                        .allTopicNames()
                        .get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);

        for (TopicRequirement requirement : requirements) {
            TopicDescription description = descriptions.get(requirement.name());

            if (description.partitions().size() < requirement.minPartitions()) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Topic %s has %d partitions, expected at least %d"
                                .formatted(
                                        requirement.name(),
                                        description.partitions().size(),
                                        requirement.minPartitions()
                                )
                );
            }
        }
    }
}
```

Prinsip penting: validasi startup boleh membuat service **not ready**, tetapi jangan otomatis membuat topic production tanpa governance. Create topic tidak bersifat transactional; Kafka Javadoc menyatakan create batch bisa sukses untuk sebagian topic dan gagal untuk topic lain, serta metadata topic baru bisa butuh beberapa detik sebelum terlihat konsisten oleh `listTopics` / `describeTopics`. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/40/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/admin/Admin.html))

---

## 8. Topic Inspection

```java id="describe-topics"
public Map<String, TopicDescription> describeTopics(Set<String> topics) {
    try {
        return admin.describeTopics(topics)
                .allTopicNames()
                .get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
    } catch (ExecutionException e) {
        throw new KafkaAdminOperationException("Failed to describe topics", e.getCause());
    } catch (InterruptedException e) {
        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
        throw new KafkaAdminOperationException("Interrupted while describing topics", e);
    } catch (TimeoutException e) {
        throw new KafkaAdminOperationException("Timed out describing topics", e);
    }
}
```

Yang dicek dari `TopicDescription`:

| Field | Arti | Kenapa penting |
|---|---|---|
| Topic name | Nama stream | Cocok dengan contract service. |
| Partition count | Jumlah partition | Menentukan parallelism maksimum consumer group. |
| Leader | Broker leader partition | Troubleshooting leader unavailable. |
| Replicas | Replica assignment | Melihat redundancy. |
| ISR | In-sync replicas | Health durability replication. |
| Internal flag | Topic internal/tidak | Hindari memakai internal topic sembarangan. |

---

## 9. Topic Config Inspection

Gunakan `describeConfigs()` untuk membaca konfigurasi resource seperti topic. Kafka Javadoc menyatakan `describeConfigs` mengembalikan default values juga, dan nilai config yang sensitive selalu `null` agar tidak membocorkan informasi sensitif. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/40/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/admin/Admin.html))

```java id="describe-topic-config"
public Config describeTopicConfig(String topic) throws Exception {
    ConfigResource resource =
            new ConfigResource(ConfigResource.Type.TOPIC, topic);

    return admin.describeConfigs(List.of(resource))
            .all()
            .get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            .get(resource);
}
```

### Config penting untuk topic

| Config | Kenapa dicek |
|---|---|
| `cleanup.policy` | `delete`, `compact`, atau keduanya; menentukan semantic retention. |
| `retention.ms` | Event tersedia berapa lama untuk replay. |
| `retention.bytes` | Batas ukuran retention. |
| `min.insync.replicas` | Durability saat producer pakai `acks=all`. |
| `segment.ms` / `segment.bytes` | Segment lifecycle; biasanya platform concern. |
| `max.message.bytes` | Batas ukuran message topic. |
| `compression.type` | Topic-level compression default/override. |

### Validator config sederhana

```java id="topic-config-validator"
public void requireTopicConfig(String topic, String key, String expected) throws Exception {
    Config config = describeTopicConfig(topic);
    ConfigEntry entry = config.get(key);

    if (entry == null) {
        throw new IllegalStateException("Topic config missing: " + key);
    }

    String actual = entry.value();

    if (!Objects.equals(expected, actual)) {
        throw new IllegalStateException(
                "Topic %s config %s=%s, expected %s"
                        .formatted(topic, key, actual, expected)
        );
    }
}
```

---

## 10. Topic Provisioning: Kapan Boleh?

```java id="create-topic"
public void createTopicIfMissing(
        String name,
        int partitions,
        short replicationFactor,
        Map<String, String> configs
) throws Exception {
    NewTopic topic = new NewTopic(name, partitions, replicationFactor)
            .configs(configs);

    try {
        admin.createTopics(List.of(topic))
                .all()
                .get(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
    } catch (ExecutionException e) {
        if (e.getCause() instanceof TopicExistsException) {
            return;
        }
        throw e;
    }
}
```

| Environment | Auto-create by service? | Rekomendasi |
|---|---:|---|
| Local dev | Boleh | Mempercepat developer onboarding. |
| Integration test | Boleh | Test isolation. |
| Staging | Hati-hati | Lebih baik lewat IaC agar mirip production. |
| Production | Umumnya tidak | Gunakan Terraform/Helm/GitOps/platform request. |

Kafka `createTopics()` membuat batch topic, tetapi operasi itu tidak transactional dan bisa berhasil sebagian. Setelah sukses, metadata juga bisa belum langsung terlihat di semua broker. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/40/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/admin/Admin.html))

---

## 11. Consumer Group Inspection

Admin API dapat mendeskripsikan consumer group dan membaca offset yang sudah di-commit oleh group. Kafka 4.1 Javadoc juga menunjukkan `listConsumerGroups()` sudah deprecated since 4.1 dan menyarankan `listGroups(...)` sebagai pengganti; namun `listConsumerGroupOffsets(...)` tetap tersedia untuk membaca offset consumer group. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/41/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/admin/Admin.html))

```java id="describe-consumer-group"
public ConsumerGroupDescription describeGroup(String groupId) throws Exception {
    return admin.describeConsumerGroups(List.of(groupId))
            .all()
            .get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            .get(groupId);
}
```

Yang dicek:

| Data | Makna |
|---|---|
| Group id | Logical consumer group. |
| State | Stable, Empty, Dead, PreparingRebalance, CompletingRebalance, dll. |
| Members | Instance aktif di group. |
| Assignment | Partition yang dipegang member. |
| Coordinator | Broker coordinator group. |

Use case praktis:

```text id="group-inspection-use"
Internal diagnostics endpoint:
  GET /internal/kafka/groups/{groupId}

Return:
  - state
  - member count
  - assigned partitions
  - lag summary
  - last checked time
```

---

## 12. Consumer Lag Calculation

Lag dasar:

```text id="lag-formula"
lag = logEndOffset - committedOffset
```

Untuk menghitungnya:

```text id="lag-calculation-flow"
1. Ambil committed offsets:
   admin.listConsumerGroupOffsets(groupId)

2. Ambil log-end offsets topic-partition:
   admin.listOffsets(partition -> OffsetSpec.latest())

3. Hitung:
   latestOffset - committedOffset
```

Kafka Admin API menyediakan `listConsumerGroupOffsets(...)` untuk membaca offset group, dan `listOffsets(...)` untuk membaca offset tertentu pada partition. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/41/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/admin/Admin.html))

```java id="lag-calculator"
public Map<TopicPartition, Long> calculateLag(String groupId) throws Exception {
    Map<TopicPartition, OffsetAndMetadata> committed =
            admin.listConsumerGroupOffsets(groupId)
                    .partitionsToOffsetAndMetadata()
                    .get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);

    Map<TopicPartition, OffsetSpec> latestRequests = committed.keySet().stream()
            .collect(Collectors.toMap(
                    Function.identity(),
                    tp -> OffsetSpec.latest()
            ));

    Map<TopicPartition, ListOffsetsResult.ListOffsetsResultInfo> latest =
            admin.listOffsets(latestRequests)
                    .all()
                    .get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);

    Map<TopicPartition, Long> lag = new TreeMap<>(
            Comparator.comparing(TopicPartition::topic)
                    .thenComparingInt(TopicPartition::partition)
    );

    for (Map.Entry<TopicPartition, OffsetAndMetadata> entry : committed.entrySet()) {
        TopicPartition tp = entry.getKey();
        long committedOffset = entry.getValue().offset();
        long endOffset = latest.get(tp).offset();

        lag.put(tp, Math.max(0, endOffset - committedOffset));
    }

    return lag;
}
```

### Interpretasi lag

| Kondisi | Interpretasi |
|---|---|
| Lag 0 | Consumer sudah catch up. |
| Lag naik terus | Consumer processing rate < producer rate. |
| Lag tinggi tapi turun | Backlog sedang dikuras. |
| Satu partition lag dominan | Hot key / partition skew. |
| Semua partition lag naik | Downstream lambat, consumer stuck, atau producer surge. |
| Lag ada tapi group empty | Consumer tidak berjalan. |
| Committed offset tidak ada | Group belum pernah commit atau offset expired. |

---

## 13. Internal Diagnostics Endpoint

Contoh endpoint internal, bukan public API:

```java id="admin-resource"
@Path("/internal/kafka")
@Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
public final class KafkaAdminResource {
    private final KafkaDiagnosticsService diagnostics;

    @Inject
    public KafkaAdminResource(KafkaDiagnosticsService diagnostics) {
        this.diagnostics = diagnostics;
    }

    @GET
    @Path("/topics/{topic}")
    public Response topic(@PathParam("topic") String topic) {
        return Response.ok(diagnostics.describeTopic(topic)).build();
    }

    @GET
    @Path("/groups/{groupId}/lag")
    public Response lag(@PathParam("groupId") String groupId) {
        return Response.ok(diagnostics.groupLag(groupId)).build();
    }
}
```

Output contoh:

```json id="diagnostics-output"
{
  "groupId": "order-projection-service",
  "state": "Stable",
  "memberCount": 3,
  "totalLag": 1284,
  "partitions": [
    {
      "topic": "order.events.v1",
      "partition": 0,
      "committedOffset": 99100,

    },
    {
      "topic": "order.events.v1",

    }
```

Endpoint seperti ini harus diberi proteksi network/auth yang kuat. Jangan expose ke internet.

## 14. Health Check vs Diagnostics

Jangan jadikan semua Admin API failure sebagai liveness failure.

| Check | Endpoint | Efek |
|---|---|---|
| Liveness | `/health/live` | Apakah process hidup. Jangan fail hanya karena Kafka lambat sesaat. |
| Readiness | `/health/ready` | Apakah service siap menerima traffic. Bisa fail jika topic wajib tidak tersedia. |
| Dependency | `/health/dependencies` | Kafka reachable, DB reachable, schema registry reachable. |
| Diagnostics | `/internal/kafka/...` | Detail topic/group/lag/config untuk operator. |

Pattern:

```text id="health-vs-diagnostics"
Kafka Admin timeout
│
├── During startup validation
│   └── readiness = DOWN
│
├── During diagnostics call
│   └── return 503 diagnostics unavailable
│
└── During liveness
    └── do not kill process automatically
```

---

## 15. ACL Awareness

Admin API bisa digunakan untuk describe ACL dengan filter. Kafka `Admin` memiliki `describeAcls(...)` dan dokumentasinya mencatat perubahan ACL bisa butuh waktu sebelum terlihat di output describe. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/40/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/admin/Admin.html))

```java id="describe-acls"
public Collection<AclBinding> describeTopicAcls(String topic) throws Exception {
    ResourcePatternFilter resourceFilter = new ResourcePatternFilter(
            ResourceType.TOPIC,
            topic,
            PatternType.LITERAL
    );

    AccessControlEntryFilter entryFilter = AccessControlEntryFilter.ANY;

    AclBindingFilter filter =
            new AclBindingFilter(resourceFilter, entryFilter);

    return admin.describeAcls(filter)
            .values()
            .get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
}
```

| Praktik | Penjelasan |
|---|---|
| Service boleh inspect ACL untuk diagnostics | Berguna saat publish/consume gagal karena authorization. |
| Jangan auto-create ACL dari business service | ACL adalah security/platform concern. |
| Jangan log secret/security material | Config sensitive biasanya `null`, tapi tetap hati-hati. |
| Permission minimal | Service hanya butuh permission topic/group yang relevan. |

---

## 16. Admin API Error Classification

| Error | Kemungkinan sebab | Action |
|---|---|---|
| `TimeoutException` | Broker unreachable, network issue, controller busy | Retry terbatas, mark dependency degraded. |
| `UnknownTopicOrPartitionException` | Topic belum ada / typo / metadata belum update | Fail startup atau trigger platform provisioning. |
| `TopicExistsException` | Create topic idempotency case | Treat as success jika config cocok. |
| `ClusterAuthorizationException` | Principal tidak punya cluster permission | Alert platform/security. |
| `TopicAuthorizationException` | Tidak punya akses topic | Alert platform/security. |
| `GroupAuthorizationException` | Tidak punya akses group | Alert platform/security. |
| `InvalidReplicationFactorException` | RF > broker tersedia / config salah | Fix IaC/platform config. |
| `InvalidPartitionsException` | Partition count invalid | Fix topology requirement. |
| `ExecutionException` wrapper | Future failure | Unwrap cause. |
| `InterruptedException` | Thread interrupted | Restore interrupt flag. |

---

## 17. Safe Future Handling

Admin API banyak mengembalikan result object yang di dalamnya memiliki `KafkaFuture`. Jangan biarkan future tanpa timeout di request path.

```java id="future-helper"
public final class KafkaFutureSupport {
    public static <T> T getOrThrow(KafkaFuture<T> future, Duration timeout) {
        try {
            return future.get(timeout.toMillis(), TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            throw new KafkaAdminOperationException("Interrupted", e);
        } catch (TimeoutException e) {
            throw new KafkaAdminOperationException("Kafka admin operation timed out", e);
        } catch (ExecutionException e) {
            throw new KafkaAdminOperationException("Kafka admin operation failed", e.getCause());
        }
    }
}
```

Rule:

```text id="admin-future-rules"
Always:
  - set timeout
  - unwrap ExecutionException
  - restore interrupt flag
  - classify Kafka exception
  - emit metric
  - avoid blocking inside future callbacks
```

---

## 18. AdminClient Metrics

`Admin` juga menyediakan `metrics()` untuk mengambil metrics client. Kafka Admin interface mencantumkan `metrics()` sebagai operasi untuk mendapatkan metrics yang disimpan oleh admin client. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/41/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/admin/Admin.html))

```java id="admin-metrics"
Map<MetricName, ? extends Metric> metrics = admin.metrics();

for (Map.Entry<MetricName, ? extends Metric> entry : metrics.entrySet()) {
    MetricName name = entry.getKey();
    Object value = entry.getValue().metricValue();

    log.debug("admin metric {}={} tags={}",
            name.name(),
            value,
            name.tags());
}
```

Metric yang berguna:

| Metric family | Kenapa berguna |
|---|---|
| Request latency | Broker/controller lambat. |
| Request rate | Admin endpoint terlalu sering dipanggil. |
| Connection count | Koneksi bocor / lifecycle salah. |
| Failed request rate | Security/network/topology issue. |
| Metadata age | Metadata stale. |

---

## 19. Jangan Poll Admin API Terlalu Sering

Admin API bukan replacement untuk metrics pipeline. Untuk monitoring reguler, pakai JMX/exporter/platform metrics. Admin API cocok untuk **diagnostic query** dan **validation**, bukan polling berat tiap detik.

| Anti-pattern | Dampak |
|---|---|
| Internal endpoint hit `describeTopics` ratusan kali per detik | Beban broker/controller. |
| Liveness check selalu call Admin API | Pod restart karena transient Kafka issue. |
| Setiap request bisnis cek topic via Admin API | Latency tinggi dan coupling tidak perlu. |
| Create topic di setiap startup semua instance | Race/noise dan partial failure. |
| Lag dihitung per request dashboard tanpa cache | Admin load tinggi. |

Gunakan caching pendek untuk diagnostics:

```java id="diagnostics-cache"
public final class CachedKafkaDiagnostics {
    private volatile LagSnapshot lastSnapshot;
    private volatile Instant lastRefresh = Instant.EPOCH;

    public LagSnapshot groupLagCached(String groupId) {
        Instant now = Instant.now();

        if (lastSnapshot != null &&
            Duration.between(lastRefresh, now).compareTo(Duration.ofSeconds(15)) < 0) {
            return lastSnapshot;
        }

        synchronized (this) {
            if (Duration.between(lastRefresh, now).compareTo(Duration.ofSeconds(15)) >= 0) {
                lastSnapshot = loadLag(groupId);
                lastRefresh = now;
            }
            return lastSnapshot;
        }
    }
}
```

---

## 20. Topic Governance Validation

Representasikan Kafka topology sebagai deklarasi, bukan hardcode tersebar.

```yaml id="topic-contract-yaml"
topics:
  - name: order.events.v1
    owner: order-platform
    partitions:
      min: 12
    configs:
      cleanup.policy: delete
      retention.ms: "604800000"
      min.insync.replicas: "2"

  - name: order.projection-retry.1m.v1
    owner: order-platform
    partitions:
      min: 12
    configs:
      cleanup.policy: delete
      retention.ms: "86400000"

  - name: order.projection-dlq.v1
    owner: order-platform
    partitions:
      min: 3
    configs:
      cleanup.policy: delete
      retention.ms: "2592000000"
```

Validation matrix:

| Contract item | Validasi |
|---|---|
| Topic exists | `describeTopics` tidak gagal. |
| Partition count | `actual >= min`. |
| Retention | `describeConfigs`. |
| Cleanup policy | `describeConfigs`. |
| Min ISR | `describeConfigs`. |
| DLQ exists | Required untuk consumer production. |
| Retry topic exists | Required jika retry-topic pattern dipakai. |
| Owner metadata | Biasanya di registry/internal catalog, bukan Kafka native. |

## 21. Internal Admin Command Safety

Untuk command mutasi, gunakan prinsip **dry-run → approve → execute → audit**.

```text id="admin-command-safety"
Request admin action
  ↓
Authorize operator
  ↓
Validate scope
  ↓
Dry-run
  ↓
Require approval for destructive/mutating action
  ↓
Execute with timeout
  ↓
Record audit log
  ↓
Emit metric/event
```

| Action | Butuh approval? | Catatan |
|---|---:|---|
| Describe topic | Tidak, jika internal authorized | Read-only. |
| Describe group lag | Tidak, jika internal authorized | Read-only. |
| Create topic dev/test | Mungkin tidak | Guard by environment. |
| Create topic prod | Ya | Lebih baik via IaC. |
| Alter config | Ya | Perubahan runtime berdampak cluster. |
| Delete topic | Ya, plus break-glass | Destructive. |
| Reset offset | Ya | Bisa reprocess/drop data. |
| Create/delete ACL | Ya | Security-sensitive. |

---

## 22. Example: Startup Validation Service

```java id="startup-validation-service"
public final class KafkaTopologyStartupCheck {
    private final Admin admin;
    private final List<TopicRequirement> requirements;

    public KafkaTopologyStartupCheck(Admin admin, List<TopicRequirement> requirements) {
        this.admin = admin;
        this.requirements = requirements;
    }

    public void run() {
        try {
            validateClusterReachable();
            validateTopics();
            validateConfigs();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Kafka topology validation failed", e);
        }
    }

    private void validateClusterReachable() throws Exception {
        DescribeClusterResult result = admin.describeCluster();

        Collection<Node> nodes = result.nodes()
                .get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);

        if (nodes.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Kafka cluster has no visible broker nodes");
        }
    }

    private void validateTopics() throws Exception {
        Set<String> names = requirements.stream()
                .map(TopicRequirement::name)
                .collect(Collectors.toSet());

        Map<String, TopicDescription> descriptions =
                admin.describeTopics(names)
                        .allTopicNames()
                        .get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);

        for (TopicRequirement requirement : requirements) {
            TopicDescription description = descriptions.get(requirement.name());
            int partitions = description.partitions().size();

            if (partitions < requirement.minPartitions()) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                        "Topic %s partition count %d < required %d"
                                .formatted(requirement.name(), partitions, requirement.minPartitions())
                );
            }
        }
    }

    private void validateConfigs() throws Exception {
        for (TopicRequirement requirement : requirements) {
            ConfigResource resource =
                    new ConfigResource(ConfigResource.Type.TOPIC, requirement.name());

            Config config = admin.describeConfigs(List.of(resource))
                    .all()
                    .get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                    .get(resource);

            for (Map.Entry<String, String> expected : requirement.requiredConfigs().entrySet()) {
                ConfigEntry actual = config.get(expected.getKey());

                if (actual == null || !Objects.equals(actual.value(), expected.getValue())) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException(
                            "Topic %s config %s expected %s actual %s"
                                    .formatted(
                                            requirement.name(),
                                            expected.getKey(),
                                            expected.getValue(),
                                            actual == null ? null : actual.value()
                                    )
                    );
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`describeCluster()` mengambil informasi node cluster, sementara `describeTopics()` mengambil deskripsi topic. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/40/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/admin/Admin.html))

## 23. Example: Lag Snapshot DTO

```java id="lag-dto"
public record ConsumerGroupLagSnapshot(
        String groupId,
        Instant checkedAt,
        long totalLag,
        List<PartitionLag> partitions
) {}

public record PartitionLag(
        String topic,
        int partition,
        long committedOffset,
        long endOffset,
        long lag
) {}
```

```java id="lag-snapshot-service"
public ConsumerGroupLagSnapshot lagSnapshot(String groupId) throws Exception {
    Map<TopicPartition, OffsetAndMetadata> committed =
            admin.listConsumerGroupOffsets(groupId)
                    .partitionsToOffsetAndMetadata()
                    .get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);

    Map<TopicPartition, OffsetSpec> latestRequest = committed.keySet().stream()
            .collect(Collectors.toMap(Function.identity(), tp -> OffsetSpec.latest()));

    Map<TopicPartition, ListOffsetsResult.ListOffsetsResultInfo> latest =
            admin.listOffsets(latestRequest)
                    .all()
                    .get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);

    List<PartitionLag> partitions = new ArrayList<>();

    for (TopicPartition tp : committed.keySet()) {
        long committedOffset = committed.get(tp).offset();
        long endOffset = latest.get(tp).offset();
        long lag = Math.max(0, endOffset - committedOffset);

        partitions.add(new PartitionLag(
                tp.topic(),
                tp.partition(),
                committedOffset,
                endOffset,
                lag
        ));
    }

    long totalLag = partitions.stream()
            .mapToLong(PartitionLag::lag)
            .sum();

    return new ConsumerGroupLagSnapshot(
            groupId,
            Instant.now(),
            totalLag,
            partitions
    );
}
```

Caveat: lag snapshot adalah titik waktu tertentu, bukan fakta stabil. Offset bisa berubah saat snapshot sedang dihitung.

## 24. Admin API dalam Kubernetes

```text id="admin-k8s"
Pod startup
  ↓
Run Kafka topology check
  ↓
If required Kafka resources invalid:
      readiness = DOWN
      app may fail startup depending policy
  ↓
If valid:
      readiness = UP
  ↓
Diagnostics endpoint cached
```

| Concern | Praktik |
|---|---|
| Startup storm | Jangan semua pod create/alter topic bersamaan. |
| Readiness | Validasi dependency kritikal, bukan semua diagnostics detail. |
| Secrets | Mount JAAS/truststore dari Secret/ExternalSecret. |
| NetworkPolicy | Izinkan egress ke Kafka brokers/controller endpoint. |
| RBAC app | Beda service beda principal/ACL. |
| Multi-cluster | Jangan salah bootstrap server environment. |
| Timeout | Admin API timeout pendek untuk readiness. |
| Caching | Cache diagnostics agar tidak membebani broker. |

---

## 25. Multi-Environment Concerns

| Environment | Risiko | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|
| Local | Topic belum ada | Auto-create boleh. |
| Dev shared | Topic bentrok antar developer | Prefix namespace atau ephemeral topic. |
| Test CI | Kafka lambat start | Retry startup check terbatas. |
| Staging | Config drift dari prod | Topology contract validation. |
| Production | Mutasi tidak terkontrol | Read-only Admin API di service; mutasi via IaC. |
| DR cluster | Offset/topology berbeda | Explicit environment binding dan validation report. |

---

## 26. Security Model

Admin API permission harus minimum.

| Kebutuhan | Permission konseptual |
|---|---|
| Describe cluster | Cluster describe |
| Describe topic | Topic describe |
| Read group offset | Group describe/read sesuai platform ACL |
| List offsets | Topic describe/read tergantung platform policy |
| Create topic | Cluster/topic create |
| Alter config | Alter configs |
| Describe ACL | Describe ACL/cluster-level permission |
| Create/delete ACL | Security admin only |

Jangan gunakan credential producer/consumer biasa untuk semua admin operation jika prinsip least privilege perusahaan membedakannya.

---

## 27. Admin API vs CLI vs Platform API

| Tool | Cocok untuk |
|---|---|
| Java Admin API | Service startup validation, internal diagnostics, controlled automation. |
| `kafka-topics.sh` / `kafka-consumer-groups.sh` | Manual ops/debug di environment yang mengizinkan. |
| Terraform/Helm/GitOps | Provisioning production topology. |
| Confluent/MSK/Azure UI/API | Platform-level governance, cluster management. |
| JMX/Prometheus | Continuous monitoring metrics. |
| Schema Registry API | Schema compatibility, subject/version validation. |

Admin API tidak menggantikan Schema Registry. Untuk event contract validation, gunakan Schema Registry API/tooling, bukan hanya topic metadata.

---

## 28. Operational Automation Patterns

### Pattern A - Fail-fast topology validator

```text id="pattern-topology-validator"
Startup:
  describeCluster
  describeTopics(required)
  describeConfigs(required)
  if mismatch → fail readiness/startup
```

Cocok untuk service yang tidak boleh berjalan jika Kafka topology salah.

### Pattern B - Internal diagnostics endpoint

```text id="pattern-diagnostics"
GET /internal/kafka/topics/{topic}
GET /internal/kafka/groups/{group}/lag
GET /internal/kafka/cluster
```

Cocok untuk on-call troubleshooting.

### Pattern C - Drift detector job

```text id="pattern-drift"
Scheduled job:
  expected topology contract
  actual Kafka topic/config
  diff
  report/alert
```

Lebih cocok sebagai platform job daripada setiap app instance.

### Pattern D - Controlled topic bootstrapper

```text id="pattern-bootstrapper"
Dev/test only:
  if topic missing:
      create topic
  validate config
```

Jangan dipakai bebas di production.

### Pattern E - Lag reporter

```text id="pattern-lag-reporter"
Every N seconds:
  listConsumerGroupOffsets
  listOffsets latest
  publish metric:
      total lag
      max partition lag
      lag by topic-partition
```

Untuk monitoring terus-menerus, lebih baik integrasikan ke metrics system agar tidak semua request menghitung ulang lag.

---

## 29. Failure Model: Startup Validation

```text id="startup-failure-model"
Startup validation fails
│
├── Kafka unreachable
│   ├── network/security/bootstrap issue
│   └── readiness down / fail startup
│
├── Topic missing
│   ├── provisioning drift
│   └── fail startup or trigger dev auto-create
│
├── Partition count too low
│   ├── scaling mismatch
│   └── fail startup; do not auto-increase silently in prod
│
├── Config mismatch
│   ├── retention/cleanup/minISR drift
│   └── fail startup or warn based criticality
│
└── Authorization failure
    ├── wrong principal/ACL
    └── fail startup + platform alert
```

---

## 30. Failure Model: Diagnostics Endpoint

```text id="diagnostics-failure-model"
Diagnostics request fails
│
├── Timeout
│   └── return 503 diagnostics_unavailable
│
├── Authorization
│   └── return 403/500 internal diagnostic, alert platform
│
├── Unknown topic/group
│   └── return 404 diagnostic result
│
├── Partial result
│   └── return degraded snapshot with errors
│
└── Admin client closed
    └── lifecycle bug
```

Jangan membuat diagnostics endpoint menyebabkan service crash.

---

## 31. Common Anti-Patterns

| Anti-pattern | Dampak |
|---|---|
| Membuat `Admin` client per HTTP request | Koneksi berlebih, latency tinggi, resource leak. |
| Liveness check memanggil Kafka Admin API | Pod restart karena transient Kafka issue. |
| Auto-create topic production dari setiap pod | Race, drift, partial creation, governance bypass. |
| Delete topic dari endpoint internal biasa | Risiko kehilangan data besar. |
| Menghitung lag tanpa cache di dashboard traffic tinggi | Membebani broker/controller. |
| Tidak memakai timeout pada future | Request thread bisa menggantung. |
| Blocking lama di KafkaFuture callback | Mengganggu thread internal Admin client. |
| Mengabaikan partial failure create topic | Topology setengah jadi. |
| Tidak unwrap `ExecutionException` | Error classification buruk. |
| Menampilkan sensitive config/log | Security leak. |
| Menganggap lag = error | Lag perlu konteks: input surge, catch-up, atau stuck. |
| Reset offset tanpa dry-run dan audit | Data loss/reprocessing tidak terkendali. |

---

## 32. Production Readiness Checklist

| Area | Checklist |
|---|---|
| Lifecycle | `Admin` singleton, closed saat shutdown. |
| Config | `bootstrap.servers`, timeout, security config benar. |
| Timeout | Semua future `.get()` punya timeout. |
| Startup validation | Required topic/config/partition dicek. |
| Topic creation | Disabled di production kecuali controlled bootstrapper. |
| Diagnostics | Internal-only, auth protected, cached. |
| Lag calculation | `listConsumerGroupOffsets` + `listOffsets`, dengan cache. |
| Error handling | Exception di-classify dan di-log structured. |
| Security | Least privilege principal; jangan expose secrets. |
| Observability | Admin operation latency, failure count, timeout count. |
| Governance | Expected topology dideklarasikan sebagai contract. |
| Audit | Semua mutating operation tercatat. |
| Kubernetes | Readiness bukan liveness; hindari startup storm. |

---

## 33. Ringkasan Praktis

Model penggunaan yang aman:

```text id="admin-safe-summary"
Use Admin API for:
  - startup validation
  - topic metadata inspection
  - config drift detection
  - consumer group diagnostics
  - lag calculation
  - internal tools

Avoid using Admin API from service for:
  - uncontrolled production topic creation
  - topic deletion
  - ACL mutation
  - offset reset without approval
  - high-frequency monitoring loop
```

Invariant yang perlu dipegang:

```text id="admin-invariants"
Admin operations must be:
  - bounded by timeout
  - read-mostly by default
  - protected by authorization
  - cached when used for diagnostics
  - audited when mutating
  - separated from public API path
```

## Response:
7/13/2026, 1:48:43 AM

Kita lanjut ke **Kafka Event Contract & Serialization**. Fokusnya: desain envelope, header, pilihan JSON/Avro/Protobuf, Schema Registry, compatibility, versioning, CloudEvents, dan contract testing yang cocok untuk Java/Jersey microservice.

# Cheatsheet - Kafka Event Contract & Serialization dalam Java/Jersey Microservice

## 1. Core Mental Model

Di Kafka, producer mengirim **record** ke topic. Record membawa **topic, optional partition, key, value, timestamp, dan headers**. Jika partition tidak ditentukan tetapi key ada, Kafka producer memilih partition berdasarkan hash key; jika key dan partition tidak ada, partition dipilih otomatis. Ini berarti desain **event key** dan **event contract** langsung memengaruhi ordering, routing, replay, dan consumer compatibility. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/0110/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/producer/ProducerRecord.html))

```text id="event-contract-model"
Business fact
  ↓
Domain event
  ↓
Integration event contract
  ↓
Envelope + headers + payload
  ↓
Serializer
  ↓
Kafka record:
    topic
    key
    value
    headers
    timestamp
  ↓
Consumer deserializer
  ↓
Contract validation
  ↓
Application handler
```

Prinsip utamanya: **event adalah kontrak publik antar service**, bukan dump object internal Java atau snapshot table mentah.

---

## 2. Event Contract Layer

```text id="event-contract-layers"
Kafka Event Contract
│
├── Transport metadata
│   ├── topic
│   ├── partition
│   ├── offset
│   ├── timestamp
│   └── headers
│
├── Routing metadata
│   ├── key
│   ├── eventType
│   ├── eventVersion
│   ├── tenantId
│   └── aggregateId
│
├── Observability metadata
│   ├── eventId
│   ├── correlationId
│   ├── causationId
│   ├── traceparent
│   └── producer
│
├── Schema metadata
│   ├── schema id
│   ├── schema subject
│   ├── compatibility mode
│   └── serialization format
│
└── Business payload
    ├── domain facts
    ├── immutable event data
    ├── no internal entity leakage
    └── version-aware structure
```

---

## 3. Event Envelope Standard

Envelope adalah struktur standar yang membungkus payload bisnis.

```json id="event-envelope-json"
{
  "eventId": "01JZ7Y9Y6J9X2V3K6Q7R8S9T0A",
  "eventType": "OrderCreated",
  "eventVersion": 1,
  "occurredAt": "2026-07-13T10:15:30Z",
  "producer": "order-service",
  "correlationId": "req-9f8a7b6c",
  "causationId": "cmd-1a2b3c4d",
  "tenantId": "tenant-a",
  "aggregateType": "Order",
  "aggregateId": "order-123",
  "payload": {
    "orderId": "order-123",
    "customerId": "customer-456",
    "status": "CREATED",
    "createdBy": "user-789"
  }
}
```

| Field | Wajib? | Fungsi |
|---|---:|---|
| `eventId` | Ya | Deduplication, audit, replay tracking. |
| `eventType` | Ya | Routing logic consumer. |
| `eventVersion` | Ya | Evolusi schema dan compatibility handling. |
| `occurredAt` | Ya | Waktu fakta domain terjadi. |
| `producer` | Ya | Ownership dan troubleshooting. |
| `correlationId` | Ya | Trace HTTP request → Kafka → consumer. |
| `causationId` | Opsional | Menghubungkan event dengan command/event penyebab. |
| `tenantId` | Jika multi-tenant | Isolation, authorization, audit. |
| `aggregateType` | Ya untuk domain event | Membantu replay dan audit. |
| `aggregateId` | Ya untuk domain event | Ordering dan idempotency. |
| `payload` | Ya | Data bisnis yang dikontrakkan. |

---

## 4. Kafka Headers vs Payload

Kafka `ProducerRecord` mendukung headers sebagai bagian dari record; headers cocok untuk metadata transport/routing, sedangkan payload cocok untuk data bisnis. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/0110/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/producer/ProducerRecord.html))

| Simpan di | Cocok untuk | Hindari |
|---|---|---|
| Kafka key | Aggregate id / routing key / partition key | Metadata besar atau berubah-ubah |
| Kafka headers | Correlation id, trace id, event type, schema hint, retry metadata | Payload bisnis besar |
| Kafka value / payload | Business event data | Secret, token, internal entity object |
| Topic name | Stream semantic dan ownership | Event type terlalu granular tanpa governance |

### Header standard

```text id="kafka-header-standard"
event-id: 01JZ7Y9Y6J9X2V3K6Q7R8S9T0A
event-type: OrderCreated
event-version: 1
correlation-id: req-9f8a7b6c
causation-id: cmd-1a2b3c4d
traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-00
tenant-id: tenant-a
producer: order-service
content-type: application/json
```

Rule praktis:

```text id="headers-rule"
Headers:
  - metadata kecil
  - routing
  - tracing
  - retry/DLQ metadata

Payload:
  - business facts
  - event-specific data
  - schema-controlled content
```

---

## 5. Event Type Naming

Gunakan nama event sebagai **fakta yang sudah terjadi**, bukan command.

| Baik | Buruk |
|---|---|
| `OrderCreated` | `CreateOrder` |
| `PaymentAuthorized` | `AuthorizePayment` |
| `CaseEscalated` | `EscalateCase` |
| `CustomerAddressChanged` | `UpdateCustomerAddress` |
| `InvoiceIssued` | `IssueInvoice` |

Pattern naming:

```text id="event-type-naming"
<Noun><PastTenseVerb>

OrderCreated
OrderCancelled
PaymentCaptured
CaseAssigned
EnforcementActionApproved
```

Untuk topic:

```text id="topic-naming"
<domain>.<capability-or-entity>.events.v<major>

order.order.events.v1
billing.payment.events.v1
case.enforcement.events.v1
customer.profile.events.v1
```

---

## 6. Event Contract vs Java Class

Jangan samakan event contract dengan Java class internal.

```text id="contract-vs-class"
Internal Java object:
  - boleh berubah karena refactor
  - punya field teknis
  - bisa expose ORM/database shape
  - lifecycle mengikuti codebase producer

Integration event:
  - kontrak lintas service
  - versioned
  - backward/forward aware
  - punya owner
  - punya compatibility policy
```

| Internal DTO / Entity | Integration Event |
|---|---|
| Untuk boundary internal service | Untuk boundary antar service |
| Bisa berubah cepat | Harus evolvable |
| Tidak perlu compatibility lintas consumer | Wajib compatibility |
| Bisa mengikuti table/domain model | Harus mengikuti semantic contract |
| Tidak selalu diaudit | Harus traceable dan replay-safe |

---

## 7. Serialization Options

Kafka serializer bertugas mengubah object menjadi byte array; Kafka `Serializer` didefinisikan sebagai interface untuk mengonversi object menjadi bytes. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/21/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/common/serialization/Serializer.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

| Format | Kelebihan | Kekurangan | Cocok untuk |
|---|---|---|---|
| Plain JSON | Human-readable, mudah debug, mudah dipakai di Jersey/Jackson/JSON-B | Schema governance lemah jika tanpa registry | Early-stage, low-throughput, internal events |
| JSON Schema | Tetap JSON, bisa divalidasi, cocok dengan ekosistem REST | Lebih verbose dari binary | Tim yang ingin readability + schema registry |
| Avro | Compact, schema evolution kuat, umum di Kafka ecosystem | Kurang human-readable, butuh schema tooling | High-throughput event streaming |
| Protobuf | Compact, strongly typed, bagus untuk polyglot/gRPC ecosystem | Evolution rules perlu disiplin tag/field | Sistem polyglot dan kontrak strict |
| String | Sangat sederhana | Tidak cukup untuk event bisnis kompleks | Demo, local test |
| Byte array | Full control | Semua governance ditanggung sendiri | Custom protocol/encryption/compression |

Confluent Schema Registry mendukung Avro, Protobuf, dan JSON Schema, serta menyediakan serializer/deserializer Kafka untuk ketiga format tersebut. Serializer Schema Registry juga dapat otomatis mendaftarkan schema secara default. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/schema-registry/fundamentals/serdes-develop/index.html))

---

## 8. JSON vs Avro vs Protobuf - Decision Table

| Kriteria | JSON | JSON Schema | Avro | Protobuf |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Human-readable | Tinggi | Tinggi | Rendah | Rendah |
| Payload size | Besar | Besar | Kecil | Kecil |
| Schema governance | Lemah tanpa tooling | Baik | Sangat baik | Sangat baik |
| Java ergonomics | Mudah | Sedang | Sedang | Baik |
| Polyglot support | Baik | Baik | Baik | Sangat baik |
| Kafka ecosystem maturity | Baik | Baik | Sangat matang | Matang |
| Debugging via CLI | Mudah | Mudah | Butuh deserializer | Butuh deserializer |
| Evolution complexity | Manual | Medium | Medium | Medium-high |
| Cocok untuk regulated audit | Baik jika readable | Baik | Baik dengan tooling | Baik dengan tooling |

Rule praktis:

```text id="serialization-decision"
Butuh cepat debug dan tim masih awal?
  → JSON + strict envelope + contract test

Butuh JSON tapi governance kuat?
  → JSON Schema + Schema Registry

Butuh throughput tinggi dan Kafka-native schema evolution?
  → Avro + Schema Registry

Sudah pakai gRPC/Protobuf di platform?
  → Protobuf + Schema Registry
```

---

## 9. Schema Registry Mental Model

Schema Registry menyimpan schema berdasarkan **subject** dan melakukan compatibility check saat schema baru didaftarkan. Confluent mendukung beberapa subject naming strategy; untuk `RecordNameStrategy`, subject untuk Avro memakai record fullname, Protobuf memakai message name, dan JSON Schema memakai title. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/schema-registry/fundamentals/serdes-develop/index.html))

```text id="schema-registry-model"
Producer
  ↓
Serialize event
  ↓
Register / lookup schema
  ↓
Encode schema id + payload
  ↓
Kafka topic
  ↓
Consumer
  ↓
Read schema id
  ↓
Fetch schema
  ↓
Deserialize payload
```

### Subject naming strategies

| Strategy | Bentuk subject | Cocok untuk |
|---|---|---|
| Topic name strategy | `<topic>-value` | Satu schema utama per topic |
| Record name strategy | `<namespace>.<record>` | Banyak event type reuse lintas topic |
| Topic record name strategy | `<topic>-<record>` | Banyak event type per topic tapi tetap topic-scoped |

Untuk microservice business event, pilihan umum:

```text id="subject-strategy"
Jika 1 topic = 1 event family:
  TopicNameStrategy

Jika 1 topic berisi banyak event type:
  TopicRecordNameStrategy

Jika event type dipakai lintas topic:
  RecordNameStrategy
```

---

## 10. Compatibility Rules

Default compatibility Confluent Schema Registry adalah `BACKWARD`. Compatibility rules berbeda untuk Avro, Protobuf, dan JSON Schema; Confluent juga menekankan bahwa detail compatibility tiap format tidak identik. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/schema-registry/fundamentals/schema-evolution.html))

| Compatibility | Makna praktis | Cocok untuk |
|---|---|---|
| Backward | Consumer baru bisa membaca data lama | Rolling upgrade consumer |
| Forward | Consumer lama bisa membaca data baru | Rolling upgrade producer lebih dulu |
| Full | Backward + forward | Event publik banyak consumer |
| Transitive | Kompatibel terhadap semua versi sebelumnya, bukan hanya versi terakhir | Long-lived event stream dan replay lama |
| None | Tidak ada check | Hanya dev/test atau disposable topic |

Praktik aman untuk event lintas service:

```text id="compatibility-policy"
Internal low-risk event:
  BACKWARD

Public integration event:
  FULL atau BACKWARD_TRANSITIVE

Long-retention/replay-heavy stream:
  FULL_TRANSITIVE atau BACKWARD_TRANSITIVE

Dev/test:
  bisa NONE, tapi jangan dibawa ke production
```

---

## 11. Schema Evolution Rules

### Safe-ish changes

| Perubahan | Aman? | Catatan |
|---|---:|---|
| Tambah optional field | Umumnya aman | Consumer lama mengabaikan field baru. |
| Tambah field dengan default | Umumnya aman | Terutama penting untuk Avro. |
| Remove optional field | Bisa aman | Tergantung compatibility mode dan format. |
| Tambah enum value | Hati-hati | Consumer lama mungkin tidak mengenal value baru. |
| Widen numeric type | Hati-hati | Harus sesuai aturan format. |
| Tambah event type baru | Aman jika consumer bisa ignore unknown type | Butuh routing defensif. |

### Dangerous changes

| Perubahan | Risiko |
|---|---|
| Rename field | Consumer lama melihat field hilang. |
| Change meaning field | Paling berbahaya karena schema bisa tetap valid tapi semantic rusak. |
| Change type field | Bisa breaking. |
| Remove required field | Consumer lama bisa gagal. |
| Reuse Protobuf field number untuk makna baru | Breaking secara semantic. |
| Mengubah unit field | Misalnya cents → rupiah tanpa nama baru. |
| Mengubah timezone/temporal meaning | Replay dan audit bisa rusak. |

Rule utama: **schema compatibility tidak menjamin semantic compatibility**.

---

## 12. Versioning Strategy

Ada dua level versioning:

```text id="versioning-levels"
Event contract version
  → eventVersion, schema version, subject version

Topic major version
  → topic name v1, v2, dst.
```

| Perubahan | Gunakan |
|---|---|
| Tambah optional field | Same topic, schema version naik |
| Tambah field dengan default | Same topic, schema version naik |
| Tambah event type baru | Same topic jika consumer toleran |
| Rename besar-besaran | Pertimbangkan event v2 |
| Ubah semantic field | Event type baru atau topic v2 |
| Ubah partition key | Topic v2 sangat disarankan |
| Ubah serialization format | Topic v2 atau migrasi terkontrol |
| Ubah dari event notification ke state transfer | Event type/topic baru |

Contoh:

```text id="topic-versioning-example"
order.order.events.v1
  - OrderCreated v1
  - OrderCancelled v1

order.order.events.v2
  - OrderCreated v2 dengan semantic baru
```

---

## 13. CloudEvents

CloudEvents adalah spesifikasi CNCF untuk mendeskripsikan event data secara common/interoperable lintas service, platform, dan sistem. ([CloudEvents](https://cloudevents.io/))

CloudEvents berguna jika perusahaan ingin standard metadata lintas transport seperti HTTP, Kafka, serverless, dan event routers.

### CloudEvents-style envelope

```json id="cloudevents-envelope"
{
  "specversion": "1.0",
  "id": "01JZ7Y9Y6J9X2V3K6Q7R8S9T0A",
  "source": "/services/order-service",
  "type": "com.company.order.OrderCreated",
  "subject": "orders/order-123",
  "time": "2026-07-13T10:15:30Z",
  "datacontenttype": "application/json",
  "dataschema": "https://schema.company.local/order/OrderCreated/1",
  "data": {
    "orderId": "order-123",
    "customerId": "customer-456",
    "status": "CREATED"
  }
}
```

CloudEvents Kafka binding mendefinisikan bagaimana attributes dan data CloudEvent dipetakan ke value dan headers Kafka record. ([GitHub](https://github.com/cloudevents/spec/blob/main/cloudevents/bindings/kafka-protocol-binding.md?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

| CloudEvents attribute | Equivalent internal field |
|---|---|
| `id` | `eventId` |
| `type` | `eventType` |
| `source` | `producer` / service source |
| `subject` | aggregate path/id |
| `time` | `occurredAt` |
| `datacontenttype` | payload content type |
| `dataschema` | schema URI / schema subject |

### Structured vs binary mode

| Mode | Cara kerja | Cocok untuk |
|---|---|---|
| Structured | Seluruh CloudEvent, termasuk metadata dan data, berada dalam value | Simpel, mudah dilihat sebagai satu document |
| Binary | CloudEvents attributes masuk headers, data masuk value | Lebih natural untuk Kafka routing/tracing |

Untuk Kafka microservice internal, **binary-style mapping** sering praktis: headers untuk metadata, value untuk payload.

---

## 14. Event Payload Design

### Event notification

Payload minimal; consumer harus fetch detail sendiri.

```json id="event-notification"
{
  "eventId": "01JZ...",
  "eventType": "OrderCreated",
  "aggregateId": "order-123",
  "payload": {
    "orderId": "order-123"
  }
}
```

| Kelebihan | Kekurangan |
|---|---|
| Payload kecil | Consumer coupling ke API producer |
| Tidak expose banyak data | Perlu synchronous call tambahan |
| Mudah evolve | Bisa meningkatkan latency/downstream dependency |

### Event-carried state transfer

Payload membawa data cukup untuk consumer bekerja.

```json id="event-carried-state"
{
  "eventId": "01JZ...",
  "eventType": "OrderCreated",
  "aggregateId": "order-123",
  "payload": {
    "orderId": "order-123",
    "customerId": "customer-456",
    "status": "CREATED",
    "totalAmount": {
      "currency": "IDR",
      "minorUnits": 15000000
    }
  }
}
```

| Kelebihan | Kekurangan |
|---|---|
| Consumer lebih autonomous | Payload lebih besar |
| Cocok untuk read model/projection | Schema evolution lebih serius |
| Lebih baik untuk replay | Risiko data privacy lebih tinggi |

Rule praktis: untuk projection/read model, gunakan **event-carried state transfer**. Untuk trigger sederhana, event notification cukup.

---

## 15. Java Producer - JSON Example

```java id="json-producer-example"
public final class OrderCreatedEvent {
    public String eventId;
    public String eventType;
    public int eventVersion;
    public Instant occurredAt;
    public String producer;
    public String correlationId;
    public String aggregateId;
    public OrderCreatedPayload payload;
}

public final class JsonKafkaEventPublisher {
    private final KafkaProducer<String, String> producer;
    private final ObjectMapper objectMapper;
    private final String topic;

    public void publish(OrderCreatedEvent event) {
        try {
            String key = event.aggregateId;
            String value = objectMapper.writeValueAsString(event);

            ProducerRecord<String, String> record =
                    new ProducerRecord<>(topic, key, value);

            record.headers()
                    .add("event-id", bytes(event.eventId))
                    .add("event-type", bytes(event.eventType))
                    .add("event-version", bytes(String.valueOf(event.eventVersion)))
                    .add("correlation-id", bytes(event.correlationId))
                    .add("content-type", bytes("application/json"));

            producer.send(record, this::onCompletion);
        } catch (JsonProcessingException e) {
            throw new NonRetriableSerializationException(e);
        }
    }

    private byte[] bytes(String value) {
        return value == null ? new byte[0] : value.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    private void onCompletion(RecordMetadata metadata, Exception exception) {
        if (exception != null) {
            // log + metric + outbox retry handling
        }
    }
}
```

---

## 16. Java Consumer - Contract Validation Example

```java id="json-consumer-validation"
public final class EventEnvelopeValidator {
    public void validate(OrderCreatedEvent event) {
        requireNonBlank(event.eventId, "eventId");
        requireEquals(event.eventType, "OrderCreated", "eventType");
        requireEquals(event.eventVersion, 1, "eventVersion");
        requireNonNull(event.occurredAt, "occurredAt");
        requireNonBlank(event.aggregateId, "aggregateId");
        requireNonNull(event.payload, "payload");
        requireNonBlank(event.payload.orderId, "payload.orderId");

        if (!event.aggregateId.equals(event.payload.orderId)) {
            throw new ContractViolationException(
                    "aggregateId must match payload.orderId"
            );
        }
    }
}
```

Contract validation harus terjadi **sebelum** business handler.

```text id="consumer-contract-flow"
ConsumerRecord
  ↓
Deserialize
  ↓
Envelope validation
  ↓
Schema/eventVersion validation
  ↓
Idempotency check
  ↓
Business handler
  ↓
Commit offset
```

---

## 17. Schema Registry SerDes - Conceptual Config

Confluent menyediakan serializer/deserializer untuk Avro, Protobuf, dan JSON Schema, misalnya `KafkaAvroSerializer`, `KafkaProtobufSerializer`, dan `KafkaJsonSchemaSerializer`. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/schema-registry/fundamentals/serdes-develop/index.html))

### JSON Schema style

```java id="json-schema-serde-config"
props.put(ProducerConfig.KEY_SERIALIZER_CLASS_CONFIG,
        StringSerializer.class.getName());

props.put(ProducerConfig.VALUE_SERIALIZER_CLASS_CONFIG,
        "io.confluent.kafka.serializers.json.KafkaJsonSchemaSerializer");

props.put("schema.registry.url",
        System.getenv("SCHEMA_REGISTRY_URL"));

props.put("auto.register.schemas", "false");
props.put("use.latest.version", "false");
```

### Avro style

```java id="avro-serde-config"
props.put(ProducerConfig.KEY_SERIALIZER_CLASS_CONFIG,
        StringSerializer.class.getName());

props.put(ProducerConfig.VALUE_SERIALIZER_CLASS_CONFIG,
        "io.confluent.kafka.serializers.KafkaAvroSerializer");

props.put("schema.registry.url",
        System.getenv("SCHEMA_REGISTRY_URL"));

props.put("auto.register.schemas", "false");
```

Production recommendation:

```text id="schema-registry-prod-config"
Production:
  auto.register.schemas=false
  schema registered via CI/CD
  compatibility checked before deploy
  subject naming strategy explicit
  schema registry auth configured
```

---

## 18. Contract Testing

Contract testing mencegah producer merilis event yang merusak consumer.

```text id="contract-testing-flow"
Producer change
  ↓
Generate/update schema
  ↓
Run schema compatibility check
  ↓
Run sample event validation
  ↓
Run consumer contract tests
  ↓
Register schema in CI/CD
  ↓
Deploy producer
```

| Test | Tujuan |
|---|---|
| Schema compatibility test | Pastikan schema baru kompatibel dengan policy. |
| Golden event test | Sample event valid dan stabil. |
| Consumer deserialization test | Consumer bisa baca event versi lama dan baru. |
| Unknown field test | Consumer tidak gagal karena field baru. |
| Missing optional field test | Consumer tahan event lama. |
| Unknown event type test | Consumer skip/DLQ sesuai policy. |
| Semantic contract test | Field meaning tidak berubah diam-diam. |
| Replay test | Event lama masih bisa diproses ulang. |

Example golden event:

```json id="golden-event"
{
  "eventId": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
  "eventType": "OrderCreated",
  "eventVersion": 1,
  "occurredAt": "2026-07-13T10:15:30Z",
  "producer": "order-service",
  "correlationId": "test-correlation-id",
  "aggregateType": "Order",
  "aggregateId": "order-123",
  "payload": {
    "orderId": "order-123",
    "customerId": "customer-456",
    "status": "CREATED"
  }
}
```

---

## 19. Consumer Compatibility Pattern

Consumer jangan brittle terhadap event baru.

```java id="event-router-example"
public final class EventRouter {
    private final Map<String, EventHandler<?>> handlers;

    public void route(EventEnvelope envelope) {
        EventHandler<?> handler = handlers.get(envelope.eventType());

        if (handler == null) {
            // Policy decision:
            // 1. ignore unknown event type
            // 2. send to DLQ
            // 3. stop consumer if strict stream
            throw new UnknownEventTypeException(envelope.eventType());
        }

        handler.handle(envelope);
    }
}
```

| Scenario | Recommended handling |
|---|---|
| Unknown event type di shared topic | Ignore atau DLQ sesuai policy |
| Unknown event version lebih tinggi | DLQ atau compatibility fallback |
| Missing optional field | Gunakan default |
| Missing required field | DLQ / contract violation |
| Extra field | Ignore |
| Unknown enum | Map ke `UNKNOWN` jika domain memungkinkan |
| Deprecated field masih ada | Jangan langsung gagal |

---

## 20. Schema Evolution Example

### V1

```json id="schema-v1"
{
  "eventType": "OrderCreated",
  "eventVersion": 1,
  "payload": {
    "orderId": "order-123",
    "customerId": "customer-456"
  }
}
```

### V2 safe addition

```json id="schema-v2-safe"
{
  "eventType": "OrderCreated",
  "eventVersion": 2,
  "payload": {
    "orderId": "order-123",
    "customerId": "customer-456",
    "salesChannel": "WEB"
  }
}
```

Safe jika `salesChannel` optional atau punya default.

### Breaking semantic change

```json id="schema-breaking"
{
  "eventType": "OrderCreated",
  "eventVersion": 3,
  "payload": {
    "orderId": "order-123",
    "customerId": "customer-456",
    "amount": 150000
  }
}
```

Jika sebelumnya `amount` berarti rupiah lalu sekarang berarti cents/minor units, schema mungkin tetap valid, tapi semantic contract rusak. Gunakan nama eksplisit:

```json id="schema-better-money"
{
  "totalAmount": {
    "currency": "IDR",
    "minorUnits": 15000000
  }
}
```

---

## 21. Data Type Design Rules

| Domain concept | Hindari | Gunakan |
|---|---|---|
| Money | `double amount` | `{ "currency": "IDR", "minorUnits": 15000000 }` |
| Time | Local time ambigu | ISO-8601 instant + timezone/offset jika perlu |
| Enum | Free text tanpa kontrol | Enum version-aware + `UNKNOWN` fallback |
| ID | Numeric DB id internal | Stable business id / UUID / ULID |
| Boolean state | Banyak boolean saling konflik | Explicit status enum |
| Address | Satu string bebas | Structured address jika dipakai downstream |
| Quantity | Angka tanpa unit | `{ "value": 10, "unit": "KG" }` |
| Optional field | `null` ambigu | Optional/default jelas |
| Large document | Payload besar | Object storage reference + checksum |

---

## 22. Event ID, Correlation ID, Causation ID

```text id="id-relationship"
HTTP request id / correlationId
  ↓
Command id / causationId
  ↓
Event id
  ↓
Downstream event causationId
```

| ID | Scope | Fungsi |
|---|---|---|
| `eventId` | Satu event unik | Dedup, replay, audit |
| `correlationId` | Satu request/business flow | Trace end-to-end |
| `causationId` | Penyebab langsung event | Event chain/debugging |
| `aggregateId` | Entity lifecycle | Ordering dan state transition |
| `traceparent` | Distributed trace | Observability toolchain |

Example:

```text id="causation-example"
POST /orders
  correlationId = req-001
  commandId = cmd-001

OrderCreated
  eventId = evt-001
  correlationId = req-001
  causationId = cmd-001

PaymentRequested
  eventId = evt-002
  correlationId = req-001
  causationId = evt-001
```

---

## 23. Privacy & Security Contract

Event contract harus memasukkan data seminimal mungkin. Kafka retention dan replay membuat data sensitif bertahan lebih lama daripada request/response biasa.

| Risiko | Mitigasi |
|---|---|
| PII tersebar ke banyak consumer | Data minimization, masking, topic ACL |
| Secret/token masuk event | Blocklist validation sebelum publish |
| Payload besar berisi dokumen | Simpan di secure storage, event hanya reference |
| DLQ menyimpan raw sensitive payload | Redaction/tokenization |
| Multi-tenant data bocor | `tenantId`, ACL, consumer authorization |
| Retention terlalu lama | Retention policy sesuai classification |
| Schema expose internal data | Review contract sebelum publish |

Rule praktis: **jangan publish field hanya karena tersedia di database**.

---

## 24. Contract Ownership

Setiap event harus punya owner dan lifecycle.

| Metadata | Contoh |
|---|---|
| Owner team | `order-platform` |
| Producer service | `order-service` |
| Topic | `order.order.events.v1` |
| Event type | `OrderCreated` |
| Schema subject | `order.order.events.v1-OrderCreated` |
| Compatibility | `BACKWARD_TRANSITIVE` |
| Retention | `7 days` |
| Data classification | `internal`, `restricted`, `pii` |
| Deprecation policy | `support v1 until 2027-01-01` |
| Consumers | `billing-service`, `search-indexer`, `case-service` |

Tanpa ownership, Kafka mudah berubah menjadi “distributed data swamp”.

---

## 25. Jersey/JAX-RS Integration Pattern

```text id="jersey-event-contract-flow"
JAX-RS Resource
  ↓
Application Service
  ↓
Domain Event
  ↓
Integration Event Mapper
  ↓
Contract Validator
  ↓
Outbox Event
  ↓
Kafka Publisher
```

### Mapper boundary

```java id="integration-event-mapper"
public final class OrderEventMapper {
    public OrderCreatedIntegrationEvent toIntegrationEvent(
            Order order,
            RequestContext context
    ) {
        return new OrderCreatedIntegrationEvent(
                EventId.newId(),
                "OrderCreated",
                1,
                Instant.now(),
                "order-service",
                context.correlationId(),
                context.commandId(),
                context.tenantId(),
                "Order",
                order.id().value(),
                new OrderCreatedPayload(
                        order.id().value(),
                        order.customerId().value(),
                        order.status().name()
                )
        );
    }
}
```

### Jangan lakukan ini

```java id="bad-event-publish"
producer.send(new ProducerRecord<>(
        "order.events.v1",
        order.getId(),
        objectMapper.writeValueAsString(orderEntity)
));
```

Masalahnya: `orderEntity` biasanya berisi field internal, relasi ORM, field audit database, dan shape yang bisa berubah karena refactor.

---

## 26. Outbox + Contract

Outbox row sebaiknya menyimpan event yang sudah berbentuk integration contract, bukan domain object mentah.

```sql id="outbox-contract-table"
CREATE TABLE outbox_event (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    topic           TEXT NOT NULL,
    partition_key   TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_type      TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_version   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    schema_subject  TEXT,
    payload         JSONB NOT NULL,
    headers         JSONB NOT NULL,
    status          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
```

| Column | Fungsi |
|---|---|
| `topic` | Target Kafka topic |
| `partition_key` | Kafka key |
| `event_type` | Routing |
| `event_version` | Version handling |
| `schema_subject` | Registry/schema reference |
| `payload` | Serialized event/envelope |
| `headers` | Metadata Kafka headers |
| `status` | Relay state |

---

## 27. Contract Failure Handling

| Failure | Stage | Action |
|---|---|---|
| Producer cannot serialize | Producer/outbox relay | Non-retriable; fix mapper/schema |
| Schema Registry unavailable | Producer | Retry if transient; outbox preserves event |
| Schema incompatible | CI/CD or producer startup | Block deploy |
| Consumer unknown field | Consumer | Ignore if allowed |
| Consumer missing required field | Consumer | DLQ/contract violation |
| Consumer unknown event type | Consumer router | Ignore/DLQ/stop depending policy |
| Consumer unsupported version | Consumer | DLQ or compatibility fallback |
| Semantic mismatch | Runtime/business | Incident; schema may not catch it |

---

## 28. Observability for Event Contract

| Signal | Kenapa penting |
|---|---|
| `event_type` | Grouping success/failure |
| `event_version` | Detect bad rollout |
| `schema_subject` | Debug compatibility |
| `schema_id` | Trace exact schema |
| `producer` | Ownership |
| `correlation_id` | Request trace |
| `causation_id` | Event chain |
| `payload_size_bytes` | Detect bloated events |
| `serialization_error_total` | Producer contract issue |
| `deserialization_error_total` | Consumer contract issue |
| `unknown_event_type_total` | Version/routing mismatch |
| `dlq_contract_violation_total` | Breaking change signal |

Structured log:

```json id="contract-log"
{
  "level": "INFO",
  "message": "Kafka event published",
  "topic": "order.order.events.v1",
  "key": "order-123",
  "eventId": "01JZ7Y9Y6J9X2V3K6Q7R8S9T0A",
  "eventType": "OrderCreated",
  "eventVersion": 1,
  "schemaSubject": "order.order.events.v1-OrderCreated",
  "producer": "order-service",
  "correlationId": "req-9f8a7b6c",
  "payloadSizeBytes": 512
}
```

---

## 29. Practical Checklist

| Area | Checklist |
|---|---|
| Envelope | `eventId`, `eventType`, `eventVersion`, `occurredAt`, `producer`, `correlationId`, `aggregateId`. |
| Key | Stable aggregate/business key, bukan random jika butuh ordering. |
| Headers | Trace/correlation/retry metadata kecil. |
| Payload | Business facts, bukan entity/table dump. |
| Schema | JSON Schema/Avro/Protobuf jika production contract penting. |
| Compatibility | Set policy explicit, jangan default tanpa sadar. |
| Versioning | Minor evolution via schema; major semantic change via event/topic v2. |
| Consumer | Toleran field baru, strict pada invariant penting. |
| Testing | Golden event, compatibility test, consumer deserialization test. |
| Privacy | PII/secret review, DLQ redaction, retention policy. |
| Ownership | Owner, consumers, retention, deprecation documented. |
| Observability | Log/metric event type, version, schema id, payload size. |

---

## 30. Common Anti-Patterns

| Anti-pattern | Dampak |
|---|---|
| Publish Java entity langsung | Consumer coupling ke database/internal model. |
| Tidak punya `eventId` | Dedup/replay sulit. |
| Tidak punya `eventVersion` | Consumer tidak bisa handle evolution. |
| Payload berisi semua field table | Privacy risk, bloated event, coupling tinggi. |
| Rename field tanpa versioning | Consumer rusak diam-diam. |
| Ubah semantic field tanpa ganti nama/version | Schema valid tapi business salah. |
| Key random untuk aggregate lifecycle | Ordering per aggregate hilang. |
| Semua metadata dimasukkan payload | Routing/tracing lebih sulit. |
| Semua metadata dimasukkan headers | Payload kehilangan self-describing audit value. |
| Auto-register schema di production tanpa review | Breaking contract bisa masuk runtime. |
| Compatibility `NONE` di production | Consumer bisa rusak saat deploy producer. |
| DLQ tanpa raw contract metadata | Investigasi/replay sulit. |
| Event type terlalu teknis | Consumer memahami implementation detail, bukan fakta domain. |

---

## 31. Ringkasan Praktis

Model aman untuk Java/Jersey microservice:

```text id="safe-contract-summary"
Domain object
  → map to integration event
  → validate envelope
  → validate schema
  → store in outbox
  → publish with stable key
  → include tracing headers
  → serialize with governed format
  → consumer validates + handles idempotently
```

Invariant utama:

```text id="contract-invariants"
Event contract must be:
  - stable
  - versioned
  - owned
  - schema-governed
  - traceable
  - replay-safe
  - privacy-reviewed
  - independent from internal Java/database model
```

Untuk awal onboarding production, pilihan paling pragmatis biasanya:

```text id="pragmatic-choice"
Jika perusahaan belum matang Schema Registry:
  JSON + strict envelope + golden event tests + compatibility discipline

Jika sudah ada Schema Registry:
  Avro/Protobuf/JSON Schema + CI compatibility check + explicit subject strategy

Jika butuh interoperability lintas platform:
  CloudEvents-style metadata + Kafka binary mapping
```

## Response:
7/13/2026, 1:51:22 AM

Kita lanjut ke **Kafka Streams dalam Java microservice**. Fokusnya: kapan memakai Kafka Streams dibanding consumer biasa, mental model KStream/KTable, state store, join/windowing, processing guarantee, dan cara expose materialized state lewat Jersey/JAX-RS.

# Cheatsheet - Kafka Streams dalam Java Microservice berbasis Jersey/JAX-RS

## 1. Core Mental Model

**Kafka Streams** adalah library Java untuk membangun stream processing app di atas Kafka. Berbeda dari plain `KafkaConsumer`, Kafka Streams menyediakan model deklaratif untuk transformasi, join, aggregation, windowing, materialized state, fault tolerance, dan query terhadap state lokal. Dokumentasi Kafka Streams terbaru 4.3 menjelaskan bahwa Kafka Streams menyediakan **state stores** yang bisa dipakai aplikasi untuk menyimpan dan meng-query data saat stateful processing. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/streams/core-concepts/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```text
Kafka topic(s)
   ↓
Kafka Streams topology
   ↓
KStream / KTable / GlobalKTable
   ↓
Transform / filter / map / join / aggregate / window
   ↓
State store, jika stateful
   ↓
Output topic(s)
   ↓
Optional: Jersey endpoint queries materialized state
```

Kafka Streams cocok jika service tidak hanya “consume event lalu update DB”, tetapi perlu membangun **continuous computation**: projection, enrichment, aggregation, stream-table join, rolling metrics, fraud/rule detection, denormalized read model, atau materialized lookup.

---

## 2. Kafka Consumer vs Kafka Streams vs ksqlDB

| Kebutuhan | Plain Kafka Consumer | Kafka Streams | ksqlDB |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Consume event lalu update PostgreSQL | Sangat cocok | Bisa, tapi sering overkill | Kurang cocok |
| Transform topic A ke topic B | Bisa | Sangat cocok | Sangat cocok |
| Stateless filtering/mapping | Bisa | Sangat cocok | Sangat cocok |
| Stateful aggregation | Manual kompleks | Sangat cocok | Cocok |
| Windowing | Manual sulit | Sangat cocok | Cocok |
| Join stream-table | Manual kompleks | Sangat cocok | Cocok |
| Local materialized state | Manual | Sangat cocok | Via ksqlDB state |
| Expose state via JAX-RS endpoint | Manual DB/cache | Cocok dengan Interactive Queries | Biasanya lewat ksqlDB query |
| Fine-grained Java control | Tinggi | Tinggi | Rendah-sedang |
| SQL-first stream processing | Rendah | Rendah | Tinggi |
| Domain side effect kompleks | Cocok | Hati-hati | Kurang cocok |

Rule praktis:

```text
Gunakan plain Consumer jika:
  event → business handler → DB/API side effect

Gunakan Kafka Streams jika:
  event stream → transform/join/aggregate/window/materialize → output topic/state

Gunakan ksqlDB jika:
  logic stream processing cukup nyaman ditulis SQL dan dikelola platform
```

---
