## 4. Core Abstractions

| Abstraction | Mental model | Use case |
|---|---|---|
| `KStream<K,V>` | Infinite stream of independent records | Events: `OrderCreated`, `PaymentCaptured`, `CaseEscalated` |
| `KTable<K,V>` | Changelog stream interpreted as latest value per key | Current customer profile, account balance, order status |
| `GlobalKTable<K,V>` | Fully replicated table on every instance | Small reference data: country code, product catalog subset, risk rule |
| `StreamsBuilder` | Builder untuk topology | Mendefinisikan stream/table/source/sink |
| `Topology` | Graph processing final | Debugging, testing, deployment |
| State store | Local materialized state | Aggregation result, dedup cache, lookup table |
| Changelog topic | Kafka-backed recovery log for state store | Restore state after crash/rebalance |
| Task | Unit processing partition/subtopology | Parallelism dan state ownership |

Kafka Streams DSL menyediakan abstraksi `KStream`, `KTable`, dan `GlobalKTable`; dokumentasi Kafka menekankan stream-table duality sebagai konsep penting yang dimodelkan eksplisit lewat tiga interface ini. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/28/streams/core-concepts/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 5. KStream vs KTable vs GlobalKTable

### KStream

`KStream` adalah stream event. Setiap record adalah fakta baru.

```text
OrderCreated(order-1)
OrderPaid(order-1)
OrderShipped(order-1)
```

Cocok untuk:

| Use case | Contoh |
|---|---|
| Event notification | `OrderCreated` |
| Activity stream | `UserLoggedIn` |
| Audit trail | `CaseStatusChanged` |
| Transaction stream | `PaymentCaptured` |
| Click/event stream | `PageViewed` |

---

### KTable

`KTable` adalah view latest state per key.

```text
customer-1 → name: A
customer-1 → name: B

Current table:
customer-1 → name: B
```

Cocok untuk:

| Use case | Contoh |
|---|---|
| Current state lookup | Customer profile |
| Materialized projection | Latest order status |
| Aggregation result | Count per status |
| Changelog interpretation | CDC table stream |

---

### GlobalKTable

`GlobalKTable` direplikasi ke semua instance aplikasi. Dokumentasi Kafka menjelaskan `GlobalKTable` menyediakan kemampuan lookup current value by key melalui join operation, dan berbeda dari `KTable`, `GlobalKTable` tidak memiliki notion of time. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/41/streams/developer-guide/dsl-api/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Cocok untuk:

| Use case | Contoh |
|---|---|
| Reference data kecil | Country, currency, product category |
| Lookup table untuk enrichment | Risk score config |
| Data yang sering dibutuhkan semua instance | Tenant metadata kecil |
| Join tanpa co-partitioning ketat | KStream enrich dengan reference table |

Hindari `GlobalKTable` untuk data besar karena setiap instance menyimpan seluruh table.

---

## 6. Basic Kafka Streams Application

```java
public final class OrderStreamApp {
    public static KafkaStreams build(Properties props) {
        StreamsBuilder builder = new StreamsBuilder();

        KStream<String, String> orders =
                builder.stream("order.order.events.v1");

        orders
                .filter((key, value) -> value != null)
                .to("order.order.valid-events.v1");

        Topology topology = builder.build();

        return new KafkaStreams(topology, props);
    }
}
```

Baseline config:

```java
Properties props = new Properties();

props.put(StreamsConfig.APPLICATION_ID_CONFIG, "order-stream-service");
props.put(StreamsConfig.BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS_CONFIG, System.getenv("KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS"));

props.put(StreamsConfig.DEFAULT_KEY_SERDE_CLASS_CONFIG, Serdes.String().getClass());
props.put(StreamsConfig.DEFAULT_VALUE_SERDE_CLASS_CONFIG, Serdes.String().getClass());

props.put(StreamsConfig.PROCESSING_GUARANTEE_CONFIG, StreamsConfig.AT_LEAST_ONCE);
props.put(StreamsConfig.STATE_DIR_CONFIG, "/var/lib/order-streams/state");
```

`application.id` penting karena menjadi identitas consumer group, prefix internal topic, dan basis state management Kafka Streams.

---

## 7. Stateless Operations

| Operation | Fungsi | Contoh |
|---|---|---|
| `filter` | Buang record yang tidak memenuhi predicate | Ambil hanya event `OrderCreated` |
| `map` | Ubah key dan value | Ubah key dari `eventId` ke `orderId` |
| `mapValues` | Ubah value tanpa mengubah key | Parse JSON ke DTO |
| `flatMap` | Satu record menjadi banyak record | Split batch event |
| `selectKey` | Ganti key | Re-key by aggregate id |
| `branch` | Pecah stream ke beberapa branch | Valid vs invalid event |
| `peek` | Side-effect ringan untuk debug/log | Logging metadata |
| `to` | Tulis ke output topic | Publish derived event |

Contoh:

```java
KStream<String, OrderEvent> events =
        builder.stream("order.order.events.v1", Consumed.with(Serdes.String(), orderEventSerde));

KStream<String, OrderCreated> createdEvents =
        events
                .filter((key, event) -> event.type().equals("OrderCreated"))
                .selectKey((key, event) -> event.aggregateId())
                .mapValues(event -> toOrderCreated(event));

createdEvents.to(
        "order.order-created.events.v1",
        Produced.with(Serdes.String(), orderCreatedSerde)
);
```

Catatan: `peek` jangan dipakai untuk side effect bisnis penting. Untuk side effect seperti DB write, payment, email, atau REST call, plain consumer biasanya lebih mudah dikontrol.

---

## 8. Repartitioning

Repartition terjadi saat key berubah dan operasi downstream membutuhkan data grouped/co-partitioned berdasarkan key baru.

```java
KStream<String, OrderEvent> byOrderId =
        events.selectKey((oldKey, event) -> event.aggregateId());

KTable<String, Long> countByOrder =
        byOrderId
                .groupByKey()
                .count();
```

| Situasi | Perlu repartition? |
|---|---:|
| `selectKey` lalu `groupByKey` | Ya, biasanya |
| `map` mengubah key lalu aggregate | Ya |
| Join dua stream dengan key sama dan partition compatible | Tidak selalu |
| Join setelah key berubah | Ya |
| Stateless `filter` saja | Tidak |
| `mapValues` saja | Tidak |

Dokumentasi Kafka Streams DSL juga mengingatkan bahwa untuk stream-table join, biasanya lebih baik melakukan repartition pada `KStream`, karena repartition pada `KTable` bisa menghasilkan state store kedua. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/42/streams/developer-guide/dsl-api/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 9. Stateful Aggregation

Kafka Streams menyediakan stateful operations seperti `count`, `reduce`, dan `aggregate`. Saat operasi ini dimaterialisasi, Kafka Streams memakai state store dan changelog topic untuk recovery.

```java
KTable<String, Long> countByStatus =
        events
                .filter((key, event) -> event.type().equals("OrderStatusChanged"))
                .selectKey((key, event) -> event.payload().status())
                .groupByKey(Grouped.with(Serdes.String(), orderEventSerde))
                .count(Materialized.as("orders-count-by-status"));
```

| Operation | Cocok untuk |
|---|---|
| `count` | Hitung jumlah event/entity per key |
| `reduce` | Gabungkan value dengan tipe yang sama |
| `aggregate` | Bentuk hasil berbeda dari input |
| `groupByKey` | Group berdasarkan key saat ini |
| `groupBy` | Group dengan key/value mapping baru |
| `Materialized.as` | Memberi nama state store agar bisa di-query |

---

## 10. Windowing

Windowing membatasi aggregation berdasarkan waktu.

```text
Event stream:
  t1 OrderCreated
  t2 OrderCreated
  t3 OrderCreated

Window:
  count per 5 minutes
```

Jenis window umum:

| Window | Mental model | Use case |
|---|---|---|
| Tumbling window | Fixed, non-overlapping | Count order per 5 menit |
| Hopping window | Fixed, overlapping | Rolling count tiap 1 menit atas window 5 menit |
| Sliding window | Berdasarkan jarak waktu antar event | Korelasi aktivitas dekat waktu |
| Session window | Gap-based session | User activity session |

Contoh tumbling window:

```java
KTable<Windowed<String>, Long> ordersPerTenantPerMinute =
        events
                .selectKey((key, event) -> event.tenantId())
                .groupByKey(Grouped.with(Serdes.String(), orderEventSerde))
                .windowedBy(TimeWindows.ofSizeWithNoGrace(Duration.ofMinutes(1)))
                .count(Materialized.as("orders-per-tenant-per-minute"));
```

Hal yang perlu dipahami:

| Konsep | Penjelasan |
|---|---|
| Event time | Waktu dari record/event, bukan waktu mesin memproses |
| Grace period | Toleransi keterlambatan event |
| Late event | Event datang setelah window bergerak |
| Windowed key | Key menjadi kombinasi key asli + window |
| Retention window store | Berapa lama window result disimpan |
| Suppression | Menahan output sampai window final, jika dipakai |

---

## 11. Joins

Kafka Streams mendukung berbagai join antar stream/table. `KStream` bisa ditransformasi record-by-record, di-join dengan `KStream`, `KTable`, atau `GlobalKTable`, dan bisa di-aggregate menjadi `KTable`. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/26/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/streams/kstream/KStream.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

| Join | Mental model | Contoh |
|---|---|---|
| KStream-KStream | Join dua event stream dalam time window | OrderCreated + PaymentCaptured |
| KStream-KTable | Enrich event dengan latest table state | Order event + customer profile |
| KStream-GlobalKTable | Enrich event dengan replicated reference data | Order event + country/currency config |
| KTable-KTable | Join dua latest-state tables | Customer profile + customer risk state |

### KStream-KTable enrichment

```java
KStream<String, OrderCreated> orders =
        builder.stream("order.created.v1", Consumed.with(Serdes.String(), orderCreatedSerde));

KTable<String, CustomerProfile> customers =
        builder.table("customer.profile.v1", Consumed.with(Serdes.String(), customerSerde));

KStream<String, EnrichedOrderCreated> enriched =
        orders.join(
                customers,
                (order, customer) -> new EnrichedOrderCreated(order, customer)
        );

enriched.to("order.created.enriched.v1", Produced.with(Serdes.String(), enrichedSerde));
```

### KStream-GlobalKTable enrichment

```java
KStream<String, OrderCreated> orders =
        builder.stream("order.created.v1", Consumed.with(Serdes.String(), orderCreatedSerde));

GlobalKTable<String, ProductInfo> products =
        builder.globalTable("product.info.v1", Consumed.with(Serdes.String(), productSerde));

KStream<String, EnrichedOrderCreated> enriched =
        orders.join(
                products,
                (orderKey, order) -> order.productId(),
                (order, product) -> new EnrichedOrderCreated(order, product)
        );
```

---

## 12. State Stores

State store adalah storage lokal yang dikelola Kafka Streams untuk operasi stateful. Dokumentasi Kafka menyebut setiap task dapat memiliki satu atau lebih state store, dan store dapat berupa persistent key-value store, in-memory hashmap, atau struktur lain yang sesuai. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/streams/core-concepts/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

| Store type | Use case |
|---|---|
| Key-value store | Latest state per key |
| Window store | Aggregation by time window |
| Session store | Session-based aggregation |
| In-memory store | State kecil dan cepat, tetapi restore penuh saat restart |
| Persistent store / RocksDB-backed | State besar dan durable lokal |
| Timestamped store | State dengan timestamp metadata |
| Versioned store | Use case tertentu yang butuh historical versions |

Materialized state store:

```java
KTable<String, Long> orderCountByTenant =
        events
                .selectKey((key, event) -> event.tenantId())
                .groupByKey(Grouped.with(Serdes.String(), orderEventSerde))
                .count(Materialized.<String, Long, KeyValueStore<Bytes, byte[]>>as("order-count-by-tenant")
                        .withKeySerde(Serdes.String())
                        .withValueSerde(Serdes.Long()));
```

---

## 13. Changelog Topic & Restore

Untuk stateful operations, Kafka Streams membuat changelog topic agar state lokal bisa dipulihkan saat instance restart atau task pindah instance.

```text
Input topic
   ↓
Task processing
   ↓
Local state store
   ↓
Changelog topic
   ↓
Restore state after restart/rebalance
```

Operational implication:

| Concern | Dampak |
|---|---|
| State besar | Startup/restore lebih lama |
| Disk lokal kecil | RocksDB/state store bisa penuh |
| Rebalance sering | Task restore sering terjadi |
| Changelog retention salah | State recovery bisa bermasalah |
| Kubernetes ephemeral disk | State hilang saat pod restart, restore dari changelog |
| Standby replicas | Bisa mempercepat failover dengan biaya resource tambahan |

---

## 14. Interactive Queries

Interactive Queries memungkinkan state Kafka Streams di-query dari luar aplikasi. Dokumentasi Kafka menyatakan fitur ini memungkinkan discovery state store, dan contoh konfigurasinya memakai `StreamsConfig.APPLICATION_SERVER_CONFIG` untuk menetapkan endpoint unik tiap instance. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/streams/developer-guide/interactive-queries/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```text
Kafka Streams app instance A
  owns state for key range 1

Kafka Streams app instance B
  owns state for key range 2

Jersey endpoint receives:
  GET /tenants/{tenantId}/order-count

Endpoint:
  - find which instance owns key
  - if local: query local store
  - if remote: forward request to owner instance
```

### Local query example

```java
public final class OrderCountQueryService {
    private final KafkaStreams streams;

    public OrderCountQueryService(KafkaStreams streams) {
        this.streams = streams;
    }

    public Long getOrderCountByTenant(String tenantId) {
        ReadOnlyKeyValueStore<String, Long> store =
                streams.store(
                        StoreQueryParameters.fromNameAndType(
                                "order-count-by-tenant",
                                QueryableStoreTypes.keyValueStore()
                        )
                );

        return store.get(tenantId);
    }
}
```

### Jersey endpoint

```java
@Path("/tenants/{tenantId}/order-count")
@Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
public final class OrderCountResource {
    private final OrderCountQueryService queryService;

    @Inject
    public OrderCountResource(OrderCountQueryService queryService) {
        this.queryService = queryService;
    }

    @GET
    public Response get(@PathParam("tenantId") String tenantId) {
        Long count = queryService.getOrderCountByTenant(tenantId);

        return Response.ok(Map.of(
                "tenantId", tenantId,
                "orderCount", count == null ? 0L : count
        )).build();
    }
}
```

Important: Kafka Streams materializes one state store per stream partition, sehingga aplikasi bisa mengelola banyak underlying store; Interactive Queries API membantu query store tanpa caller harus tahu partition mana yang memegang data. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/42/streams/developer-guide/interactive-queries/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 15. Remote Interactive Query Routing

Jika key tidak dimiliki instance lokal, endpoint harus forward ke instance pemilik key.

```text
GET /tenants/tenant-a/order-count hits pod-1
  ↓
pod-1 checks metadata for key tenant-a
  ↓
metadata says pod-3 owns key
  ↓
pod-1 forwards request to pod-3
  ↓
pod-3 queries local state store
  ↓
pod-1 returns response
```

Config penting:

```java
props.put(
    StreamsConfig.APPLICATION_SERVER_CONFIG,
    System.getenv("POD_IP") + ":8080"
);
```

| Concern | Penjelasan |
|---|---|
| `application.server` | Host:port yang dipakai Kafka Streams metadata untuk discover query endpoint |
| Kubernetes service | Perlu routing antar pod, bukan hanya service load-balanced biasa |
| Security | Internal query endpoint harus protected |
| Timeout | Forwarding antar instance harus bounded |
| Readiness | Jangan query store sebelum Streams state `RUNNING` |
| Rebalance | Key ownership bisa berubah saat rebalance |

---

## 16. Processing Guarantees

Kafka Streams mendukung at-least-once dan exactly-once processing. Confluent docs menyebut default `processing.guarantee` adalah `at_least_once`, dan `exactly_once_v2` tersedia untuk broker versi 2.5 atau lebih baru. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/streams/concepts.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

| Guarantee | Makna | Cocok untuk |
|---|---|---|
| `at_least_once` | Record tidak hilang, tapi bisa diproses ulang | Banyak pipeline umum |
| `exactly_once_v2` | Kafka Streams memakai transaksi untuk memproses input/output Kafka secara exactly-once dalam boundary Kafka | Pipeline Kafka-to-Kafka yang butuh dedup kuat |
| External side effect | Tidak otomatis exactly-once | DB/API/email tetap butuh idempotency/outbox |

Config:

```java
props.put(
        StreamsConfig.PROCESSING_GUARANTEE_CONFIG,
        StreamsConfig.EXACTLY_ONCE_V2
);
```

Caveat penting: exactly-once di Kafka Streams terutama berlaku untuk **read-process-write antar Kafka topics/state internal**. Jika topology melakukan external side effect ke PostgreSQL, REST API, email, payment, atau storage eksternal, guarantee itu tidak otomatis menjadi exactly-once end-to-end.

---

## 17. Commit Interval

`commit.interval.ms` memengaruhi frekuensi commit progress. Untuk at-least-once, commit berarti menyimpan posisi offset processor; untuk exactly-once, commit berarti commit transaksi yang mencakup posisi dan output topic yang menjadi visible ke consumer `read_committed`. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/streams/developer-guide/config-streams.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

| Setting | Dampak |
|---|---|
| Commit interval kecil | Lower duplicate window, overhead lebih tinggi |
| Commit interval besar | Throughput lebih baik, recovery duplicate window lebih besar |
| Exactly-once | Commit berarti transaction commit |
| At-least-once | Commit berarti offset/progress commit |

---

## 18. DSL vs Processor API

Kafka Streams punya dua gaya utama:

| API | Karakter | Cocok untuk |
|---|---|---|
| Streams DSL | High-level, declarative | Filter, map, join, aggregate, window |
| Processor API | Low-level, kontrol penuh processor/state store | Custom state, punctuator, complex routing, advanced logic |

Dokumentasi Kafka menyebut Processor API sebagai low-level API untuk menambah dan menghubungkan processor serta berinteraksi langsung dengan state stores. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/streams/developer-guide/write-streams-app/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Rule praktis:

```text
Mulai dengan DSL.
Turun ke Processor API hanya jika:
  - butuh custom state store access
  - butuh punctuator/custom scheduling
  - butuh routing/control flow yang tidak cocok DSL
  - butuh integrasi low-level topology
```

---

## 19. Processor API Sketch

```java
public final class DeduplicationProcessor
        implements Processor<String, OrderEvent, String, OrderEvent> {

    private KeyValueStore<String, Long> seenEventStore;
    private ProcessorContext<String, OrderEvent> context;

    @Override
    public void init(ProcessorContext<String, OrderEvent> context) {
        this.context = context;
        this.seenEventStore = context.getStateStore("seen-events-store");
    }

    @Override
    public void process(Record<String, OrderEvent> record) {
        String eventId = record.value().eventId();

        if (seenEventStore.get(eventId) != null) {
            return;
        }

        seenEventStore.put(eventId, System.currentTimeMillis());
        context.forward(record);
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
    }
}
```

Gunakan Processor API dengan disiplin tinggi karena lifecycle, state, timestamp, forwarding, dan error handling lebih eksplisit.

---

## 20. Error Handling di Kafka Streams

Kafka Streams error handling berbeda dari plain consumer. Beberapa error terjadi di deserialization, processing, production, atau state restore.

| Failure point | Contoh | Strategy |
|---|---|---|
| Deserialization | Payload invalid | Configure deserialization exception handler / DLQ pattern |
| Processing | Null pointer, invalid state | Fail fast atau route invalid record |
| Production | Output topic unavailable | Retry internal / fail app |
| State store | RocksDB error, disk full | Fail instance, restore elsewhere |
| Restore | Changelog corrupt/unavailable | Platform incident |
| Rebalance | Task migration | Readiness degraded during rebalance |

Pattern praktis:

```text
Contract/data error:
  route to DLQ if possible

Code bug:
  fail app, fix, redeploy, replay

Infrastructure transient:
  allow restart/retry, alert if repeated

State store disk issue:
  fail pod, inspect disk/state.dir/changelog
```

---

## 21. DLQ di Kafka Streams

Kafka Streams tidak otomatis memberi DLQ universal untuk semua stage. DLQ biasanya dibuat secara eksplisit di topology atau lewat exception handler.

```text
input topic
  ↓
parse/validate
  ├── valid → main processing
  └── invalid → dlq topic
```

Contoh branch valid/invalid:

```java
KStream<String, RawEvent> raw =
        builder.stream("order.raw-events.v1", Consumed.with(Serdes.String(), rawEventSerde));

KStream<String, ValidatedEvent>[] branches =
        raw
                .mapValues(this::safeValidate)
                .branch(
                        (key, result) -> result.isValid(),
                        (key, result) -> !result.isValid()
                );

branches[0]
        .mapValues(ValidatedEvent::event)
        .to("order.valid-events.v1", Produced.with(Serdes.String(), validEventSerde));

branches[1]
        .mapValues(result -> result.toDlqEnvelope())
        .to("order.invalid-events.dlq.v1", Produced.with(Serdes.String(), dlqSerde));
```

Untuk deserialization error sebelum value menjadi object, perlu handler atau gunakan raw string/bytes terlebih dahulu lalu validasi manual.

---

## 22. Jersey/JAX-RS Lifecycle Integration

Kafka Streams app harus start saat application startup dan close saat shutdown.

```text
Jersey app startup
  ↓
Build topology
  ↓
Create KafkaStreams
  ↓
Register state listener / uncaught exception handler
  ↓
streams.start()
  ↓
Jersey serves HTTP + optional state queries
  ↓
Shutdown
  ↓
streams.close(Duration)
```

Sketch:

```java
public final class KafkaStreamsManager implements AutoCloseable {
    private final KafkaStreams streams;

    public KafkaStreamsManager(KafkaStreams streams) {
        this.streams = streams;
    }

    public void start() {
        streams.setStateListener((newState, oldState) ->
                log.info("Kafka Streams state changed {} -> {}", oldState, newState)
        );

        streams.setUncaughtExceptionHandler(exception -> {
            log.error("Kafka Streams uncaught exception", exception);
            return StreamsUncaughtExceptionHandler.StreamThreadExceptionResponse.SHUTDOWN_APPLICATION;
        });

        streams.start();
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        streams.close(Duration.ofSeconds(30));
    }
}
```

Kubernetes note:

| Concern | Praktik |
|---|---|
| SIGTERM | Call `streams.close(Duration)` |
| Readiness | Ready hanya jika Streams state `RUNNING` |
| Restore state | Saat `REBALANCING` / restoring, readiness bisa degraded |
| State dir | Mount volume jika ingin mengurangi full restore |
| Rolling deploy | Expect rebalance |
| Pod identity | `application.server` harus unik per pod jika Interactive Queries dipakai |

---

## 23. Health Check

Pisahkan health:

| Health | Makna | Kafka Streams behavior |
|---|---|---|
| Liveness | Process masih hidup | Jangan fail hanya karena rebalance singkat |
| Readiness | Siap serve traffic/query | Fail/degraded jika Streams belum `RUNNING` |
| Dependency | Kafka reachable, state store accessible | Diagnostics |
| Stream state | `CREATED`, `RUNNING`, `REBALANCING`, `PENDING_SHUTDOWN`, `ERROR` | Operator visibility |
| Store readiness | Query store tersedia | Penting untuk Interactive Queries |

Example response:

```json
{
  "status": "UP",
  "streams": {
    "applicationId": "order-stream-service",
    "state": "RUNNING",
    "localThreads": 2,
    "queryStores": [
      "order-count-by-tenant"
    ]
  }
}
```

## 24. Testing Kafka Streams

Kafka Streams punya testing story yang lebih baik daripada menjalankan broker penuh untuk semua unit test. Gunakan topology test untuk logic stream, lalu integration test dengan Kafka nyata untuk config/serialization/topology runtime.

| Test | Tujuan |
|---|---|
| Topology unit test | Validate transform/join/aggregate logic |
| Golden input-output test | Input event menghasilkan output event expected |
| State store test | Aggregation/materialized state benar |
| Windowing test | Event time/grace/late event behavior |
| Contract test | Serde dan schema compatibility |
| Integration test | Kafka broker + actual topics |
| Restore/rebalance test | State restore dan deployment behavior |
| Interactive query test | Query local/remote state |

Testing mental model:

```text
Input topic records
  ↓
TopologyTestDriver
  ↓
Output topic records
  ↓
Assert state store / output topic
```

---

## 25. Operational Metrics

| Metric | Kenapa penting |
|---|---|
| Input rate | Volume stream |
| Process rate | Throughput topology |
| Process latency | Bottleneck processing |
| Commit latency | Progress commit issue |
| Rebalance total | Stability |
| State restore time | Recovery speed |
| State store size | Disk/memory pressure |
| RocksDB metrics | Local store health |
| Dropped records | Data loss risk |
| Deserialization errors | Contract issue |
| Production errors | Output topic/broker issue |
| Task assignment | Parallelism visibility |
| Standby restore lag | Failover readiness |

Operational questions:

```text
Apakah app processing?
Apakah lag naik?
Apakah state restore terlalu lama?
Apakah rebalance loop?
Apakah satu task/partition hot?
Apakah output topic menerima data?
Apakah state store bisa di-query?
```

---

## 26. State Store di Kubernetes

| Issue | Risiko | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|
| Ephemeral disk | State hilang saat pod restart | Restore dari changelog; gunakan PVC jika restore mahal |
| Disk full | Streams thread error | Monitor state dir/RocksDB size |
| Pod rescheduled | State restore lambat | Standby replicas/PVC/tune retention |
| Rolling update | Rebalance dan task movement | Graceful shutdown, readiness |
| Many instances | Banyak state copies | Capacity planning |
| GlobalKTable besar | Semua pod menyimpan full table | Hindari untuk data besar |
| Changelog topic under-replicated | Restore risk | Topic config governance |

---

## 27. Common Patterns

### Pattern A - Event enrichment

```text
OrderCreated stream
  + CustomerProfile table
  → EnrichedOrderCreated stream
```

Cocok untuk menyiapkan event downstream yang tidak perlu call customer-service lagi.

---

### Pattern B - Materialized read model

```text
Order events
  → aggregate by tenant/status
  → state store
  → Jersey GET /metrics/order-status
```

Cocok untuk near-real-time dashboard internal.

---

### Pattern C - Deduplication

```text
Event stream
  → check eventId in state store
  → if unseen: forward + remember
  → if seen: drop
```

Perlu retention strategy agar dedup store tidak tumbuh tanpa batas.

---

### Pattern D - Windowed anomaly detection

```text
Payment events
  → group by account/customer
  → count/sum in 5-minute window
  → emit alert if threshold exceeded
```

Cocok untuk operational/fraud/risk signal.

---

### Pattern E - CDC projection

```text
PostgreSQL CDC topic
  → KTable current state
  → join/enrich
  → output denormalized projection topic
```

Cocok bila perusahaan memakai Debezium/Kafka Connect.

---

## 28. Anti-Patterns

| Anti-pattern | Kenapa buruk |
|---|---|
| Memakai Kafka Streams untuk side effect bisnis berat | External DB/API exactly-once tidak otomatis |
| Menganggap exactly-once berarti end-to-end ke PostgreSQL | Guarantee Kafka Streams terbatas pada Kafka/state boundary |
| GlobalKTable untuk table besar | Semua instance menyimpan seluruh data |
| State store tanpa capacity planning | Disk/memory blow-up |
| Interactive Query tanpa remote routing | Query salah instance bisa tidak menemukan key |
| Readiness selalu UP saat state restoring | Endpoint query bisa return salah/kosong |
| Mengubah key sebelum join tanpa sadar repartition | Internal topic dan overhead tak terduga |
| Join tanpa memahami co-partitioning | Result salah/tidak lengkap atau topology error |
| Windowing tanpa grace/late-event policy | Late event hilang atau output mengejutkan |
| Topology terlalu besar dalam satu service | Sulit debug, deploy, scale |
| `peek` untuk business side effect | Bisa dieksekusi ulang, tidak aman |
| Tidak memonitor restore/rebalance | Incident terlihat sebagai “service lambat” saja |

---

## 29. Production Readiness Checklist

| Area | Checklist |
|---|---|
| Topology | Topology jelas, diberi nama store/output topic eksplisit |
| Application ID | Stabil dan environment-specific |
| Keying | Key benar sebelum group/join/aggregate |
| Repartition | Internal topic dipahami dan dimonitor |
| Serde | Schema governed, contract tested |
| Processing guarantee | `at_least_once` atau `exactly_once_v2` dipilih sadar |
| State store | Disk, changelog, retention, restore plan |
| Interactive Queries | `application.server`, routing, security, readiness |
| Error handling | Deserialization/processing/production exception policy |
| DLQ | Invalid event bisa diisolasi |
| Observability | Metrics, logs, state transitions, restore status |
| Kubernetes | Graceful shutdown, readiness during restore/rebalance |
| Testing | Topology test, integration test, replay/windowing test |
| Security | Topic ACL, internal endpoint protection |

---

## 30. Practical Decision Guide

```text
Saya punya stream event dan ingin update PostgreSQL
  → Plain Consumer

Saya ingin transform event lalu tulis ke topic lain
  → Kafka Streams

Saya ingin aggregate count/sum/rate per window
  → Kafka Streams

Saya ingin join event dengan current reference data
  → Kafka Streams dengan KTable/GlobalKTable

Saya ingin SQL-based streaming transformation
  → ksqlDB

Saya ingin expose materialized stream state via REST
  → Kafka Streams + Interactive Queries + Jersey endpoint

Saya ingin melakukan payment/email/external API side effect
  → Plain Consumer + idempotency/retry/DLQ lebih aman
```

---

## 31. Ringkasan Praktis

Kafka Streams adalah pilihan kuat ketika microservice perlu menjadi **continuous processing application**, bukan sekadar event handler.

```text
Gunakan Kafka Streams untuk:
  - transformasi topic-to-topic
  - enrichment
  - aggregation
  - windowing
  - stream-table join
  - materialized read model
  - queryable local state

Hati-hati untuk:
  - external side effects
  - state store disk usage
  - repartition overhead
  - restore time
  - Interactive Query routing
  - exactly-once boundary
```

Invariant utama:

```text
Kafka Streams topology harus:
  - key-aware
  - schema-aware
  - state-aware
  - replay-safe
  - observable
  - recoverable
  - deployable under rebalance
```

# Cheatsheet - Kafka Streams Patterns dalam Java/Jersey Microservice

## 1. Core Mental Model

Kafka Streams pattern dipakai ketika service perlu menjalankan **continuous computation** di atas Kafka: transformasi event, enrichment, aggregation, join, windowing, materialized view, deduplication, atau queryable state. Kafka Streams menyediakan state store untuk operasi stateful; state store bisa dipakai untuk menyimpan dan query data yang dibutuhkan selama processing, dan Kafka Streams juga menyediakan fault-tolerance serta automatic recovery untuk local state store. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/streams/core-concepts/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```text id="i3w1km"
Kafka topic(s)
  ↓
Kafka Streams topology
  ↓
Pattern:
  ├── enrichment
  ├── deduplication
  ├── aggregation
  ├── windowing
  ├── stream-table join
  ├── materialized view
  └── interactive query
  ↓
Output:
  ├── derived Kafka topic
  ├── local state store
  ├── queryable REST endpoint
  └── downstream consumer
```

Rule besar:

```text id="b7s2vm"
Kafka Streams cocok untuk:
  stream → transform/join/aggregate/materialize → topic/state

Plain Kafka Consumer lebih cocok untuk:
  event → business side effect → DB/API/email/payment
```

---

## 2. Pattern Selection Map

| Pattern | Problem yang diselesaikan | Output utama | Stateful? | Cocok untuk |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| Event enrichment | Event kurang informasi untuk downstream | Enriched event topic | Bisa | Order + customer profile, payment + risk profile |
| Deduplication | Duplicate event akibat retry/replay/outbox | Clean event topic | Ya | Event idempotency pipeline |
| Aggregation | Hitung total/count/sum/latest per key | State store / output topic | Ya | Count order per tenant/status |
| Windowing | Hitung dalam rentang waktu | Windowed result | Ya | Rate per menit, fraud burst detection |
| Stream-table join | Gabungkan event dengan latest state | Enriched stream | Ya | Event + profile/config/current state |
| Materialized view | Buat read model dari stream | Queryable state store | Ya | Dashboard, near-real-time lookup |
| Interactive query endpoint | Expose state store via REST | JAX-RS API | Ya | `GET /tenants/{id}/metrics` |
| Routing / branching | Pisahkan event berdasarkan rule | Multiple output topics | Tidak/opsional | Valid/invalid, domain-specific routing |
| Anomaly detection | Emit alert dari pattern temporal | Alert topic | Ya | Spike, threshold, suspicious activity |

---

## 3. Pattern A - Event Enrichment

### Problem

Event input hanya punya sebagian data, sementara downstream butuh event yang lebih lengkap.

```text id="enrichment-basic"
OrderCreated
  {
    orderId,
    customerId,
    productId
  }

CustomerProfile table
  customerId → customerSegment, riskTier

Product table
  productId → productCategory

Result:
  EnrichedOrderCreated
```

### Topology

```text id="enrichment-topology"
order.created.v1          customer.profile.v1
      │                         │
      │                         └── KTable / GlobalKTable
      │
      └── KStream
             ↓
          join/enrich
             ↓
      order.created.enriched.v1
```

Kafka Streams DSL mendukung `KStream`, `KTable`, dan `GlobalKTable`; stream-table duality adalah konsep utama Kafka Streams, dan `GlobalKTable` berguna sebagai table lookup yang direplikasi ke semua instance untuk enrichment/reference data kecil. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/42/streams/core-concepts/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

### Example: KStream + GlobalKTable

```java id="enrichment-global-table"
StreamsBuilder builder = new StreamsBuilder();

KStream<String, OrderCreated> orders =
        builder.stream(
                "order.created.v1",
                Consumed.with(Serdes.String(), orderCreatedSerde)
        );

GlobalKTable<String, ProductInfo> products =
        builder.globalTable(
                "product.info.v1",
                Consumed.with(Serdes.String(), productInfoSerde)
        );

KStream<String, EnrichedOrderCreated> enriched =
        orders.join(
                products,
                (orderKey, order) -> order.productId(),
                (order, product) -> new EnrichedOrderCreated(
                        order.orderId(),
                        order.customerId(),
                        order.productId(),
                        product.category(),
                        product.name(),
                        order.occurredAt()
                )
        );

enriched.to(
        "order.created.enriched.v1",
        Produced.with(Serdes.String(), enrichedOrderSerde)
);
```

### Kapan cocok

| Cocok | Tidak cocok |
|---|---|
| Reference data kecil/sedang | Reference data sangat besar |
| Downstream butuh event self-contained | Downstream lebih baik query source of truth |
| Join logic deterministik | Join butuh external REST call |
| Data enrichment dari Kafka topic/table | Data enrichment dari DB/API transaksional langsung |

### Failure model

| Failure | Efek | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|
| Reference data belum ada | Enriched field null / event drop | Left join + default/unknown value |
| Reference table stale | Output enrichment salah waktu | Define freshness SLA |
| GlobalKTable terlalu besar | Memory/disk besar di semua instance | Pakai KTable partitioned atau external store |
| Key mismatch | Join tidak menghasilkan data | Contract test key mapping |
| Repartition tidak disadari | Internal topic dan overhead naik | Explicit keying + topology review |

---

## 4. Pattern B - Deduplication

### Problem

Event bisa muncul lebih dari sekali karena retry producer, outbox relay crash, replay, consumer restart, atau offset commit failure. Deduplication pattern memastikan output stream hanya meneruskan event baru berdasarkan `eventId`.

```text id="dedup-model"
Input event stream
  ↓
Check eventId in state store
  ├── exists    → drop duplicate
  └── not exist → remember eventId + forward
```

Kafka Streams state stores dapat diakses oleh task untuk menyimpan dan query data yang dibutuhkan processing; ini membuat deduplication stateful bisa dilakukan dalam topology. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/42/streams/core-concepts/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

### Topology

```text id="dedup-topology"
raw.events.v1
   ↓
KStream
   ↓
Processor / transformValues with state store
   ↓
deduplicated.events.v1
```

### Processor API sketch

```java id="dedup-processor"
public final class EventDeduplicationProcessor
        implements Processor<String, EventEnvelope, String, EventEnvelope> {

    private ProcessorContext<String, EventEnvelope> context;
    private KeyValueStore<String, Long> seenStore;

    @Override
    public void init(ProcessorContext<String, EventEnvelope> context) {
        this.context = context;
        this.seenStore = context.getStateStore("seen-event-ids");
    }

    @Override
    public void process(Record<String, EventEnvelope> record) {
        EventEnvelope event = record.value();

        if (event == null || event.eventId() == null) {
            return;
        }

        Long seenAt = seenStore.get(event.eventId());

        if (seenAt != null) {
            return;
        }

        seenStore.put(event.eventId(), record.timestamp());
        context.forward(record);
    }
}
```

### Store registration sketch

```java id="dedup-store"
StoreBuilder<KeyValueStore<String, Long>> seenStore =
        Stores.keyValueStoreBuilder(
                Stores.persistentKeyValueStore("seen-event-ids"),
                Serdes.String(),
                Serdes.Long()
        );

builder.addStateStore(seenStore);
```

### Kapan cocok

| Cocok | Tidak cocok |
|---|---|
| Event punya stable `eventId` | Event tidak punya unique id |
| Duplicate window terbatas | Harus dedup selamanya tanpa storage planning |
| Pipeline topic-to-topic | Side effect eksternal kompleks |
| Replay bisa menghasilkan duplicate | Semantic dedup butuh business reconciliation |

### Failure model

| Failure | Efek | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|
| State store hilang | Duplicate bisa lolos saat restore belum selesai | Changelog topic, readiness saat restore |
| Store tumbuh tanpa batas | Disk penuh | TTL/windowed dedup, compaction, retention |
| `eventId` tidak global unique | Event valid bisa ter-drop | ID contract governance |
| Exactly-once disalahpahami | External side effect tetap bisa duplicate | Batasi dedup ke Kafka pipeline |
| Reprocessing lama di luar retention dedup | Duplicate lama lolos | Tentukan dedup horizon |

---

## 5. Pattern C - Aggregation

### Problem

Butuh menghitung state akumulatif: count, sum, latest status, jumlah kasus per status, total transaksi per customer, dan sejenisnya.

```text id="aggregation-model"
OrderCreated events
  ↓
group by tenantId
  ↓
count
  ↓
State store:
  tenant-a → 1024
  tenant-b → 88
```

Kafka Streams DSL secara otomatis membuat dan mengelola state store ketika memakai stateful operator seperti `join()` atau `aggregate()`, termasuk saat windowing stream. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/31/streams/architecture/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

### Example: count order per tenant

```java id="aggregation-count"
KStream<String, OrderCreated> orders =
        builder.stream(
                "order.created.v1",
                Consumed.with(Serdes.String(), orderCreatedSerde)
        );

KTable<String, Long> orderCountByTenant =
        orders
                .selectKey((key, order) -> order.tenantId())
                .groupByKey(Grouped.with(Serdes.String(), orderCreatedSerde))
                .count(
                        Materialized.<String, Long, KeyValueStore<Bytes, byte[]>>as(
                                        "order-count-by-tenant"
                                )
                                .withKeySerde(Serdes.String())
                                .withValueSerde(Serdes.Long())
                );

orderCountByTenant
        .toStream()
        .to(
                "order.count-by-tenant.v1",
                Produced.with(Serdes.String(), Serdes.Long())
        );
```

### Example: aggregate amount per customer

```java id="aggregation-sum"
KTable<String, MoneyTotal> totalPaidByCustomer =
        payments
                .selectKey((key, payment) -> payment.customerId())
                .groupByKey(Grouped.with(Serdes.String(), paymentSerde))
                .aggregate(
                        MoneyTotal::zero,
                        (customerId, payment, aggregate) ->
                                aggregate.plus(payment.amount()),
                        Materialized.<String, MoneyTotal, KeyValueStore<Bytes, byte[]>>as(
                                        "total-paid-by-customer"
                                )
                                .withKeySerde(Serdes.String())
                                .withValueSerde(moneyTotalSerde)
                );
```

### Kapan cocok

| Cocok | Tidak cocok |
|---|---|
| Count/sum per key | Query ad-hoc kompleks lintas banyak dimensi |
| Near-real-time metric | Strongly consistent transactional report |
| Projection dari event stream | Sumber data tidak replay-safe |
| Dashboard internal | Reporting historis berat lebih cocok warehouse |

### Failure model

| Failure | Efek | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|
| Salah key sebelum group | Aggregation salah | Contract test keying |
| Event duplicate | Count/sum double | Dedup sebelum aggregate |
| Late/out-of-order event | Result berubah setelah terlihat | Window/grace policy |
| State restore lama | Readiness lambat | Standby replicas/PVC/capacity planning |
| Repartition topic besar | Cost dan latency naik | Key desain sejak producer |

---

## 6. Pattern D - Windowing

### Problem

Butuh aggregation berdasarkan waktu: order per menit, payment velocity 5 menit, failed login per user per 10 menit, case escalation rate per jam.

Windowing mengontrol bagaimana records dengan key yang sama dikelompokkan untuk stateful operation seperti aggregation dan join; windows dilacak per record key. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/streams/concepts.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```text id="windowing-model"
Events keyed by tenantId
  ↓
Window: 1 minute
  ↓
Count per tenant per minute
```

### Window types

| Window | Bentuk | Cocok untuk |
|---|---|---|
| Tumbling | Fixed, non-overlapping | Count per minute/hour/day |
| Hopping | Fixed, overlapping | Rolling 5-minute metric every 1 minute |
| Sliding | Berdasarkan jarak antar event | Temporal correlation |
| Session | Gap-based | User session/activity burst |

### Example: tumbling window

```java id="window-tumbling"
KTable<Windowed<String>, Long> orderRatePerTenant =
        orders
                .selectKey((key, order) -> order.tenantId())
                .groupByKey(Grouped.with(Serdes.String(), orderCreatedSerde))
                .windowedBy(TimeWindows.ofSizeWithNoGrace(Duration.ofMinutes(1)))
                .count(
                        Materialized.<String, Long, WindowStore<Bytes, byte[]>>as(
                                        "order-rate-per-tenant-1m"
                                )
                                .withKeySerde(Serdes.String())
                                .withValueSerde(Serdes.Long())
                );
```

### Example: hopping window

```java id="window-hopping"
KTable<Windowed<String>, Long> rollingFailedLoginCount =
        failedLogins
                .selectKey((key, event) -> event.userId())
                .groupByKey(Grouped.with(Serdes.String(), failedLoginSerde))
                .windowedBy(
                        TimeWindows
                                .ofSizeAndGrace(Duration.ofMinutes(5), Duration.ofMinutes(1))
                                .advanceBy(Duration.ofMinutes(1))
                )
                .count(Materialized.as("failed-login-rolling-5m"));
```

### Failure model

| Failure | Efek | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|
| Event timestamp salah | Window salah | Timestamp extractor + event contract |
| Late event datang setelah grace | Event tidak masuk result final | Grace period sesuai domain |
| Window retention terlalu pendek | Query/replay window gagal | Retention planning |
| Output berubah karena late event | Dashboard tampak “mundur” | Suppression/final result policy |
| High cardinality key | Banyak window state | Cardinality budget |
| Replay besar | Banyak window recomputation | Rate limit replay |

---

## 7. Pattern E - Stream-Table Join

### Problem

Event stream perlu digabung dengan latest state table.

```text id="stream-table-problem"
OrderCreated event:
  orderId, customerId, amount

CustomerProfile table:
  customerId → segment, riskTier

Output:
  EnrichedOrderCreated:
    orderId, customerId, amount, segment, riskTier
```

Kafka Streams DSL mendukung join antar stream/table, dan dokumentasi Confluent menekankan bahwa untuk stream-table join, biasanya lebih baik repartition di sisi `KStream`, karena repartition `KTable` dapat menghasilkan state store tambahan. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/streams/developer-guide/dsl-api.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

### Topology

```text id="stream-table-topology"
orders KStream
   ↓ key by customerId
customers KTable
   ↓
KStream-KTable join
   ↓
enriched orders topic
```

### Example

```java id="stream-table-join"
KStream<String, OrderCreated> orders =
        builder.stream("order.created.v1", Consumed.with(Serdes.String(), orderCreatedSerde));

KTable<String, CustomerProfile> customerProfiles =
        builder.table("customer.profile.v1", Consumed.with(Serdes.String(), customerProfileSerde));

KStream<String, EnrichedOrder> enrichedOrders =
        orders
                .selectKey((key, order) -> order.customerId())
                .leftJoin(
                        customerProfiles,
                        (order, profile) -> EnrichedOrder.from(order, profile)
                );

enrichedOrders.to(
        "order.enriched.v1",
        Produced.with(Serdes.String(), enrichedOrderSerde)
);
```

### Join semantics

| Join type | Output |
|---|---|
| Inner join | Emit hanya jika stream record punya matching table value |
| Left join | Emit stream record walau table value tidak ada |
| KStream-KTable | Join event dengan latest state table |
| KStream-GlobalKTable | Join event dengan fully replicated lookup table |
| KTable-KTable | Join latest state dengan latest state |

### Failure model

| Failure | Efek | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|
| Table belum bootstrap | Join menghasilkan null/missing enrichment | Readiness delay / left join fallback |
| Co-partitioning salah | Join tidak valid atau repartition overhead | Topic partition/key governance |
| Table update terlambat | Event join dengan stale profile | Define temporal semantics |
| Tombstone di KTable | Join result null/delete | Handle delete semantics |
| Re-key stream salah | Data join tidak ketemu | Golden topology tests |

---

## 8. Pattern F - Materialized View

### Problem

Butuh read model/query cepat dari hasil stream processing tanpa query database utama.

```text id="materialized-view-model"
Input events
  ↓
Kafka Streams aggregate/project
  ↓
Local state store
  ↓
Jersey endpoint:
    GET /tenants/{tenantId}/order-summary
```

Kafka Streams Interactive Queries memungkinkan aplikasi melakukan direct read-only query terhadap state store; semua store harus bernama, dan Interactive Queries mengekspos operasi read-only dari store tersebut. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/streams/core-concepts/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

### Example: order summary per tenant

```java id="materialized-view"
KTable<String, TenantOrderSummary> tenantSummary =
        orders
                .selectKey((key, order) -> order.tenantId())
                .groupByKey(Grouped.with(Serdes.String(), orderCreatedSerde))
                .aggregate(
                        TenantOrderSummary::empty,
                        (tenantId, order, summary) -> summary.add(order),
                        Materialized.<String, TenantOrderSummary, KeyValueStore<Bytes, byte[]>>as(
                                        "tenant-order-summary"
                                )
                                .withKeySerde(Serdes.String())
                                .withValueSerde(tenantOrderSummarySerde)
                );
```

### Query service

```java id="materialized-query-service"
public final class TenantOrderSummaryQueryService {
    private final KafkaStreams streams;

    public TenantOrderSummaryQueryService(KafkaStreams streams) {
        this.streams = streams;
    }

    public Optional<TenantOrderSummary> findByTenant(String tenantId) {
        ReadOnlyKeyValueStore<String, TenantOrderSummary> store =
                streams.store(
                        StoreQueryParameters.fromNameAndType(
                                "tenant-order-summary",
                                QueryableStoreTypes.keyValueStore()
                        )
                );

        return Optional.ofNullable(store.get(tenantId));
    }
}
```

### Jersey endpoint

```java id="materialized-query-resource"
@Path("/internal/tenants/{tenantId}/order-summary")
@Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
public final class TenantOrderSummaryResource {
    private final TenantOrderSummaryQueryService queryService;

    @Inject
    public TenantOrderSummaryResource(TenantOrderSummaryQueryService queryService) {
        this.queryService = queryService;
    }

    @GET
    public Response get(@PathParam("tenantId") String tenantId) {
        return queryService.findByTenant(tenantId)
                .map(Response::ok)
                .orElseGet(() -> Response.status(Response.Status.NOT_FOUND))
                .build();
    }
}
```

### Failure model

| Failure | Efek | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|
| Query saat state restoring | Data kosong/partial | Readiness berdasarkan Streams state |
| Key berada di instance lain | Local store tidak punya data | Remote Interactive Query routing |
| State store corrupt/disk full | Query gagal | Restart/restore dari changelog |
| Store schema berubah | Restore/deserialization gagal | Migration plan |
| Query endpoint public | Data leakage | Internal auth/network policy |

---

## 9. Pattern G - Interactive Query with Remote Routing

### Problem

State store bersifat lokal per task/partition. Jika request REST masuk ke pod yang tidak memiliki key tersebut, endpoint harus menemukan instance owner dan meneruskan request.

Interactive Queries memungkinkan aplikasi query local state; untuk discovery lintas instance, konfigurasi `application.server` dipakai sebagai endpoint unik aplikasi yang bisa digunakan untuk state store discovery dan interactive queries. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/streams/developer-guide/interactive-queries.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```text id="interactive-query-routing"
Client
  ↓
GET /tenants/tenant-a/order-summary
  ↓
Pod A receives request
  ↓
Pod A checks Streams metadata for key tenant-a
  ├── key local  → query local store
  └── key remote → forward to Pod B
```

### Config

```java id="interactive-config"
props.put(
        StreamsConfig.APPLICATION_SERVER_CONFIG,
        System.getenv("POD_IP") + ":8080"
);
```

### Routing sketch

```java id="interactive-routing-sketch"
public TenantOrderSummary getSummary(String tenantId) {
    KeyQueryMetadata metadata = streams.queryMetadataForKey(
            "tenant-order-summary",
            tenantId,
            Serdes.String().serializer()
    );

    HostInfo activeHost = metadata.activeHost();

    if (isLocal(activeHost)) {
        return localQuery(tenantId);
    }

    return remoteClient.get(
            "http://%s:%d/internal/tenants/%s/order-summary/local"
                    .formatted(activeHost.host(), activeHost.port(), tenantId)
    );
}
```

### Failure model

| Failure | Efek | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|
| Pod owner sedang rebalance | Metadata berubah/query gagal | Retry bounded + readiness |
| Remote pod unreachable | Query 503 | Fallback/stale cache jika boleh |
| `application.server` salah | Routing gagal | Pod IP/port validation |
| Load balancer biasa dipakai untuk key-specific query | Request salah pod | Direct pod routing |
| State store not queryable | Exception saat store belum ready | Check Streams state |
| Query out-of-band mutation | State corrupt risk | Interactive Queries read-only only |

---

## 10. Pattern H - Routing / Branching

### Problem

Satu input stream perlu dipisah menjadi beberapa output berdasarkan rule.

```text id="branching-model"
order.events.v1
  ↓
branch:
  ├── valid events         → order.valid-events.v1
  ├── invalid contract     → order.contract-dlq.v1
  ├── high value order     → order.high-value.v1
  └── unknown event type   → order.unknown-events.v1
```

### Example

```java id="branching-example"
KStream<String, ValidationResult> validated =
        rawEvents.mapValues(this::validateSafely);

KStream<String, ValidationResult>[] branches =
        validated.branch(
                (key, result) -> result.isValid(),
                (key, result) -> result.isContractViolation(),
                (key, result) -> true
        );

branches[0]
        .mapValues(ValidationResult::event)
        .to("order.valid-events.v1", Produced.with(Serdes.String(), eventSerde));

branches[1]
        .mapValues(ValidationResult::toDlq)
        .to("order.contract-dlq.v1", Produced.with(Serdes.String(), dlqSerde));

branches[2]
        .mapValues(ValidationResult::toUnknown)
        .to("order.unknown-events.v1", Produced.with(Serdes.String(), unknownSerde));
```

### Failure model

| Failure | Efek | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|
| Predicate overlap salah | Event masuk branch yang tidak diinginkan | Ordered predicates + tests |
| Default branch tidak ada | Event hilang | Always add catch-all branch |
| DLQ producer/output gagal | Processing failure | Production exception handler |
| Rule berubah tanpa versioning | Downstream surprise | Rule version metadata |
| Branching terlalu banyak | Topology sulit dipahami | Pisah topology/domain |

---

## 11. Pattern I - Anomaly / Threshold Detection

### Problem

Butuh mendeteksi kondisi seperti spike, threshold, velocity, atau suspicious pattern.

```text id="anomaly-model"
PaymentCaptured
  ↓
group by customerId
  ↓
sum amount over 5 minutes
  ↓
if total > threshold
  ↓
PaymentVelocityExceeded alert
```

### Example

```java id="anomaly-example"
KTable<Windowed<String>, MoneyTotal> paymentVelocity =
        payments
                .selectKey((key, payment) -> payment.customerId())
                .groupByKey(Grouped.with(Serdes.String(), paymentSerde))
                .windowedBy(
                        TimeWindows
                                .ofSizeAndGrace(Duration.ofMinutes(5), Duration.ofMinutes(1))
                                .advanceBy(Duration.ofMinutes(1))
                )
                .aggregate(
                        MoneyTotal::zero,
                        (customerId, payment, total) -> total.plus(payment.amount()),
                        Materialized.as("payment-velocity-5m")
                );

paymentVelocity
        .toStream()
        .filter((windowedCustomerId, total) -> total.isGreaterThan(Money.of("IDR", 50_000_000)))
        .map((windowedCustomerId, total) ->
                KeyValue.pair(
                        windowedCustomerId.key(),
                        PaymentVelocityExceeded.from(windowedCustomerId, total)
                )
        )
        .to("risk.payment-velocity-alerts.v1", Produced.with(Serdes.String(), alertSerde));
```

### Failure model

| Failure | Efek | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|
| Late event | Alert terlambat atau tidak keluar | Grace policy |
| Duplicate payment event | False positive | Dedup before aggregation |
| Threshold hardcoded | Sulit tuning | Config topic / GlobalKTable rule |
| Alert repeated setiap update | Alert spam | Suppression/dedup alert |
| Window semantics tidak disepakati | Business misinterpretation | Document tumbling/hopping/sliding |

---

## 12. Pattern J - CDC Projection

### Problem

Data dari PostgreSQL CDC topic perlu dibentuk menjadi projection/topic lain.

```text id="cdc-projection"
PostgreSQL table changelog
  ↓
Kafka Connect / Debezium topic
  ↓
KTable latest state
  ↓
join / transform
  ↓
projection topic / state store
```

### Kapan cocok

| Cocok | Tidak cocok |
|---|---|
| Rebuild projection dari DB changelog | Event domain lebih penting daripada row-level change |
| Need latest table state | Need semantic business transition |
| Data platform sudah punya CDC | Tidak ada CDC governance |
| Enrichment dari reference table | Complex domain command handling |

### Failure model

| Failure | Efek | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|
| Tombstone/delete event | State delete tidak tertangani | Handle null values |
| Schema CDC berubah | Deserialization gagal | Schema governance |
| Snapshot awal besar | Restore/bootstrap lama | Capacity planning |
| Row-level event bukan domain event | Downstream salah interpretasi | Map ke integration event |
| Out-of-order CDC across tables | Join sementara inconsistent | Eventual consistency design |

---

## 13. Pattern K - Latest State / KTable Projection

### Problem

Butuh current state per aggregate dari event lifecycle.

```text id="latest-state"
OrderCreated(order-1)
OrderPaid(order-1)
OrderShipped(order-1)

KTable:
order-1 → SHIPPED
```

### Example

```java id="latest-state-example"
KTable<String, OrderState> latestOrderState =
        orderEvents
                .selectKey((key, event) -> event.aggregateId())
                .groupByKey(Grouped.with(Serdes.String(), orderEventSerde))
                .aggregate(
                        OrderState::empty,
                        (orderId, event, state) -> state.apply(event),
                        Materialized.<String, OrderState, KeyValueStore<Bytes, byte[]>>as(
                                        "latest-order-state"
                                )
                                .withKeySerde(Serdes.String())
                                .withValueSerde(orderStateSerde)
                );
```

### Failure model

| Failure | Efek | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|
| Event out-of-order | State regression | Aggregate version check |
| Duplicate event | State apply ganda | Idempotent state transition |
| Missing event | State incomplete | Gap detection |
| Breaking event version | Apply gagal | Versioned handler |
| Replay with changed logic | State berbeda dari sebelumnya | Deterministic reducer + migration note |

---

## 14. Pattern L - Suppressed Final Window Result

### Problem

Windowed aggregation bisa emit update berkali-kali sebelum window final. Untuk beberapa downstream, hanya final result yang boleh dikirim.

```text id="suppress-model"
Window 10:00-10:05
  count=1 emit?
  count=2 emit?
  count=3 emit?
  window closed
  final count=3 emit
```

### Kapan cocok

| Cocok | Tidak cocok |
|---|---|
| Billing summary per window | Real-time dashboard yang ingin update cepat |
| Alert final setelah window close | Low-latency alert |
| Report periodic | Monitoring live metric |

### Failure model

| Failure | Efek | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|
| Suppression buffer besar | Memory pressure | Buffer limit/capacity planning |
| Grace terlalu panjang | Output final terlambat | SLA window final |
| Grace terlalu pendek | Late event hilang | Event lateness analysis |
| Downstream expect live update | Terlihat lambat | Contract output semantics |

---

## 15. Cross-Pattern Failure Matrix

| Pattern | Main risk | Must-have guardrail |
|---|---|---|
| Enrichment | Missing/stale lookup | Left join policy, freshness SLA |
| Deduplication | Store growth / wrong event id | TTL/window, event id governance |
| Aggregation | Duplicate/out-of-order events | Dedup + versioning |
| Windowing | Late event handling | Timestamp extractor + grace |
| Stream-table join | Key/co-partitioning mismatch | Key contract tests |
| Materialized view | Query partial state | Readiness + restore awareness |
| Interactive query | Request hits wrong instance | Metadata routing |
| Branching | Event dropped due no default branch | Catch-all branch |
| Anomaly detection | Alert spam/false positive | Dedup + threshold governance |
| CDC projection | Row-level semantics leak | Map CDC to semantic model |

---

## 16. State Store Operational Model

Stateful Kafka Streams apps require storage planning. State stores may be persistent or in-memory, and Kafka Streams can use changelog topics to restore local state after failure; standby replicas are shadow copies of local state stores that can reduce restore cost during failover. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/42/streams/core-concepts/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```text id="state-store-operational"
Stateful operation
  ↓
Local state store
  ↓
Changelog topic
  ↓
Restore on restart/rebalance
  ↓
Optional standby replica for faster failover
```

| Concern | Design question |
|---|---|
| Store size | Berapa banyak key/window disimpan? |
| Retention | Berapa lama state diperlukan? |
| Restore time | Berapa lama pod boleh belum ready? |
| Disk | Apakah ephemeral disk cukup? |
| Changelog | Apakah internal topic replication/retention benar? |
| Standby replicas | Apakah worth biaya resource tambahan? |
| Schema migration | Bagaimana update format state? |
| Rebalance | Apakah sering task pindah instance? |

---

## 17. Processing Guarantee Boundary

Kafka Streams bisa dikonfigurasi at-least-once atau exactly-once; Confluent menjelaskan default processing guarantee adalah `at_least_once`, dan `exactly_once_v2` bisa digunakan pada broker yang mendukung. Namun exactly-once hanya benar-benar end-to-end jika seluruh producer dan consumer dalam jalur tersebut juga menerapkan semantics yang sesuai. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/streams/concepts.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```text id="processing-boundary"
Kafka topic
  → Kafka Streams processing
  → Kafka topic/state store

Exactly-once v2 can help here.

Kafka Streams
  → PostgreSQL / REST API / email / payment

Not automatically exactly-once.
Need idempotency/outbox/external transaction design.
```

| Scenario | Guarantee expectation |
|---|---|
| Topic → Streams → Topic | `exactly_once_v2` bisa relevan |
| Topic → Streams state store | Covered by Kafka Streams processing model |
| Topic → Streams → PostgreSQL | Perlu idempotent write / transaction design |
| Topic → Streams → REST API | Perlu idempotency key/retry control |
| Interactive query read | Read-only state query, not transactional API |

---

## 18. Jersey/JAX-RS Integration Pattern

```text id="jersey-streams-integration"
Application startup
  ↓
Build Kafka Streams topology
  ↓
Start KafkaStreams
  ↓
Expose:
    - health endpoint
    - diagnostics endpoint
    - optional interactive query endpoint
  ↓
Shutdown:
    - close KafkaStreams gracefully
```

### Lifecycle sketch

```java id="streams-manager-patterns"
public final class StreamsRuntimeManager implements AutoCloseable {
    private final KafkaStreams streams;
    private final AtomicReference<KafkaStreams.State> state =
            new AtomicReference<>(KafkaStreams.State.CREATED);

    public StreamsRuntimeManager(KafkaStreams streams) {
        this.streams = streams;
    }

    public void start() {
        streams.setStateListener((newState, oldState) -> {
            state.set(newState);
            log.info("Kafka Streams state changed {} -> {}", oldState, newState);
        });

        streams.setUncaughtExceptionHandler(exception -> {
            log.error("Kafka Streams fatal error", exception);
            return StreamsUncaughtExceptionHandler.StreamThreadExceptionResponse.SHUTDOWN_APPLICATION;
        });

        streams.start();
    }

    public boolean isReady() {
        return state.get() == KafkaStreams.State.RUNNING;
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        streams.close(Duration.ofSeconds(30));
    }
}
```

### Health rule

| Condition | Liveness | Readiness |
|---|---:|---:|
| Process alive, Streams starting | UP | DOWN |
| Streams running | UP | UP |
| Streams rebalancing briefly | UP | DEGRADED/DOWN depending query criticality |
| Streams error | DOWN or fail app | DOWN |
| State restoring | UP | DOWN for query endpoint |
| Kafka temporary slow | UP | Maybe degraded |

---

## 19. Testing Matrix per Pattern

| Pattern | Unit/topology tests |
|---|---|
| Enrichment | Input event + lookup table → enriched output |
| Deduplication | Same `eventId` twice → one output |
| Aggregation | Multiple events per key → expected count/sum |
| Windowing | Event timestamps → expected window buckets |
| Stream-table join | Missing table value, updated table value, tombstone |
| Materialized view | Query state store after inputs |
| Interactive query | Local key vs remote key routing |
| Branching | Every branch and catch-all |
| Anomaly detection | Threshold below/equal/above, late events |
| CDC projection | Insert/update/delete/tombstone |

Test categories:

```text id="streams-test-categories"
1. Topology test
2. Golden input-output test
3. State store assertion
4. Window timestamp test
5. Repartition/key test
6. Serialization/contract test
7. Restore/replay test
8. Kubernetes lifecycle test
```

---

## 20. Production Checklist per Pattern

| Area | Checklist |
|---|---|
| Keying | Key benar sebelum group/join/aggregate |
| Serde | Schema-compatible dan tested |
| State store | Nama eksplisit, size diketahui |
| Changelog | Retention/replication sesuai recovery |
| Repartition | Internal topic dipahami |
| Window | Grace/retention/final output jelas |
| Dedup | TTL/horizon jelas |
| Join | Missing lookup policy jelas |
| Materialized view | Query readiness dan routing jelas |
| Error handling | Deserialization/processing/production failure policy |
| Metrics | Lag, process latency, restore time, store size |
| Security | Internal query endpoint protected |
| Deployment | Graceful shutdown dan state restore plan |
| Replay | Handler deterministic dan idempotent |

---

## 21. Common Anti-Patterns

| Anti-pattern | Dampak |
|---|---|
| Menggunakan Kafka Streams untuk call REST/DB per event | Exactly-once boundary rusak, backpressure sulit |
| Tidak sadar `selectKey` bisa memicu repartition | Internal topic besar, latency/cost naik |
| Dedup store tanpa retention | Disk tumbuh tanpa batas |
| Window tanpa grace policy | Late event handling tidak jelas |
| Join tanpa key contract | Enrichment kosong/salah |
| GlobalKTable untuk data besar | Semua pod menyimpan seluruh table |
| Interactive Query tanpa remote routing | Query sering 404/kosong |
| Readiness UP saat state restore | Endpoint mengembalikan data partial |
| Suppression tanpa buffer planning | Memory pressure |
| State schema berubah tanpa migration | Restore gagal |
| Topology terlalu banyak pattern | Sulit debug dan scaling |
| Event contract tidak punya timestamp jelas | Windowing tidak reliable |

---

## 22. Quick Decision Guide

```text id="quick-pattern-guide"
Butuh menambah data referensi ke event?
  → Enrichment / Stream-table join

Butuh menghapus duplicate event?
  → Deduplication with state store

Butuh count/sum/current state per key?
  → Aggregation / KTable projection

Butuh metric per periode waktu?
  → Windowing

Butuh REST read model dari hasil stream?
  → Materialized view + Interactive Query

Butuh mendeteksi spike/threshold?
  → Windowed aggregation + alert topic

Butuh valid/invalid routing?
  → Branching + DLQ topic

Butuh side effect ke DB/API?
  → Pertimbangkan plain Kafka Consumer, bukan Kafka Streams
```

---

## 23. Ringkasan Praktis

Kafka Streams pattern sebaiknya dipilih berdasarkan **bentuk state dan output**, bukan karena “semua event harus pakai Streams”.

```text id="streams-pattern-summary"
Kafka Streams strongest area:
  - topic-to-topic processing
  - stateful aggregation
  - stream-table join
  - windowed computation
  - materialized local state
  - queryable read model

Kafka Streams risky area:
  - external side effects
  - unbounded state
  - unclear event-time semantics
  - poorly governed keys
  - interactive query without routing/readiness
```

Invariant utama:

```text id="streams-pattern-invariants"
Every Kafka Streams pattern must define:
  - input topic contract
  - key semantics
  - state store ownership
  - replay behavior
  - failure behavior
  - output topic contract
  - operational metrics
  - readiness condition
```

7/13/2026, 2:00:28 AM

Kita lanjut ke **ksqlDB dalam Kafka ecosystem**. Fokusnya: mental model stream/table, persistent query, push/pull query, materialized view, join, deployment/governance, dan kapan lebih tepat memakai ksqlDB dibanding Kafka Streams atau plain Java Consumer.

# Cheatsheet - ksqlDB dalam Kafka Ecosystem untuk Java/Jersey Microservice

## 1. Core Mental Model

**ksqlDB** adalah streaming SQL database dari Confluent untuk membangun aplikasi stream processing di atas Apache Kafka menggunakan sintaks SQL. Ia cocok ketika transformasi, filtering, aggregation, join, dan materialized view bisa diekspresikan secara deklaratif, tanpa menulis Java Kafka Streams topology secara manual. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/ksqldb/overview.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```text id="ksqldb-mental-model"
Kafka topic(s)
  ↓
ksqlDB stream/table definitions
  ↓
SQL query:
  - filter
  - transform
  - join
  - aggregate
  - window
  - materialize
  ↓
Derived stream/table
  ↓
Kafka topic / materialized view
  ↓
Java/Jersey service:
  - consume output topic
  - call pull query
  - call push query
  - manage query through Java client/REST API
```

ksqlDB sebaiknya dipahami sebagai **stream processing layer**, bukan replacement total untuk Java microservice. Java/Jersey tetap cocok untuk business command handling, authorization, transactional workflow, REST API, database transaction, outbox, dan side effect kompleks. ksqlDB cocok untuk **SQL-first stream transformation**.

---
