## 3. Core Concepts

| Concept | Mental model | Praktisnya |
|---|---|---|
| Stream | Deretan event/facts yang terus bertambah | `OrderCreated`, `PaymentCaptured`, `CaseEscalated` |
| Table | Latest state per key dari changelog stream | current customer profile, current order status |
| Materialized view | Table hasil query yang terus diperbarui | count per tenant, latest risk score, summary per customer |
| Persistent query | Query server-side yang berjalan terus-menerus | `CREATE STREAM AS SELECT`, `CREATE TABLE AS SELECT`, `INSERT INTO SELECT` |
| Push query | Query yang terus mengirim perubahan hasil ke client | monitor event/result secara live |
| Pull query | Query request-response untuk membaca state saat ini | lookup materialized table by key |

Confluent mendefinisikan tiga jenis query di ksqlDB: **persistent**, **push**, dan **pull**. Persistent query berjalan di server secara terus-menerus; push query mengalirkan perubahan hasil; pull query memberikan respons point-in-time. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/ksqldb/concepts/queries.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 4. Stream vs Table

### Stream

Stream cocok untuk fakta/event yang terjadi berurutan.

```sql id="create-stream"
CREATE STREAM order_events (
  eventId VARCHAR,
  eventType VARCHAR,
  eventVersion INTEGER,
  occurredAt VARCHAR,
  aggregateId VARCHAR,
  customerId VARCHAR,
  status VARCHAR
) WITH (
  KAFKA_TOPIC = 'order.order.events.v1',
  VALUE_FORMAT = 'JSON'
);
```

Mental model:

```text id="stream-model"
order-1 OrderCreated
order-1 OrderPaid
order-2 OrderCreated
order-1 OrderShipped
```

Stream menjawab pertanyaan: **“event apa saja yang terjadi?”**

---

### Table

Table cocok untuk latest state per key.

```sql id="create-table"
CREATE TABLE customer_profile (
  customerId VARCHAR PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR,
  segment VARCHAR,
  riskTier VARCHAR
) WITH (
  KAFKA_TOPIC = 'customer.profile.v1',
  VALUE_FORMAT = 'JSON'
);
```

Mental model:

```text id="table-model"
customer-1 -> segment=REGULAR
customer-1 -> segment=PREMIUM

Current table:
customer-1 -> segment=PREMIUM
```

Table menjawab pertanyaan: **“state terakhir untuk key ini apa?”**

---

## 5. Persistent Query

Persistent query adalah query yang berjalan terus di ksqlDB server dan menghasilkan stream/table baru. ksqlDB memakai persistent query saat Anda membuat stream/table turunan dari stream/table lain. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/ksqldb/concepts/queries.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

### CREATE STREAM AS SELECT

```sql id="csas"
CREATE STREAM order_created AS
SELECT
  eventId,
  aggregateId AS orderId,
  customerId,
  occurredAt
FROM order_events
WHERE eventType = 'OrderCreated'
EMIT CHANGES;
```

Output-nya adalah stream baru dan biasanya Kafka topic baru.

---

### CREATE TABLE AS SELECT

```sql id="ctas"
CREATE TABLE order_count_by_customer AS
SELECT
  customerId,
  COUNT(*) AS orderCount
FROM order_created
GROUP BY customerId
EMIT CHANGES;
```

Output-nya adalah materialized table yang terus diperbarui.

---

### INSERT INTO SELECT

```sql id="insert-into-select"
INSERT INTO high_value_orders
SELECT *
FROM order_created
WHERE totalAmountMinorUnits >= 100000000
EMIT CHANGES;
```

`INSERT INTO ... SELECT` cocok ketika target stream/table sudah ada dan query hanya menambahkan data ke situ.

---

## 6. Push Query

Push query mengirim hasil secara streaming ke client. REST endpoint `/query` dapat mengalirkan output dari `SELECT` dengan chunked transfer encoding sampai `LIMIT` tercapai atau client menutup koneksi. Jika tidak ada `LIMIT`, respons mengalir sampai client menutup koneksi. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/ksqldb/developer-guide/ksqldb-rest-api/query-endpoint.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```sql id="push-query"
SELECT *
FROM order_created
WHERE customerId = 'customer-456'
EMIT CHANGES;
```

| Cocok untuk | Tidak cocok untuk |
|---|---|
| Live monitoring | Request-response lookup biasa |
| Debug stream | High-volume public API |
| Internal dashboard live | Business transaction API |
| Alert listener | Query dengan SLA latency ketat tanpa backpressure plan |

Di Java/Jersey, push query sebaiknya dipakai hati-hati karena koneksi bisa panjang, infinite, dan perlu timeout/cancellation/backpressure.

---

## 7. Pull Query

Pull query adalah request-response query untuk membaca state saat ini dari stream/table/materialized view. Dokumentasi ksqlDB menyebut pull query bisa dieksekusi lewat REST API dan API merespons dengan satu response; pull query menggunakan subset ketat dari ANSI SQL. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/ksqldb/developer-guide/ksqldb-reference/select-pull-query.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```sql id="pull-query"
SELECT orderCount
FROM order_count_by_customer
WHERE customerId = 'customer-456';
```

| Cocok untuk | Tidak cocok untuk |
|---|---|
| Lookup current materialized state | Scan besar tanpa key |
| REST endpoint internal | Complex OLAP query |
| Dashboard metric kecil | Transactional source of truth |
| State hasil aggregation | Data yang butuh strong consistency dengan PostgreSQL |

Pull query cocok untuk Jersey endpoint seperti:

```text id="pull-query-jersey"
GET /internal/customers/{customerId}/order-count
  ↓
Jersey service
  ↓
ksqlDB pull query
  ↓
return current materialized count
```

---

## 8. Materialized View

Materialized view di ksqlDB adalah table hasil query yang terus diperbarui agar query terhadap hasilnya efisien. Confluent menjelaskan materialized view sebagai cara ksqlDB membuat query efisien di atas event yang disimpan di Kafka. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/ksqldb/concepts/materialized-views.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```sql id="materialized-view"
CREATE TABLE tenant_order_summary AS
SELECT
  tenantId,
  COUNT(*) AS totalOrders,
  COUNT_DISTINCT(customerId) AS uniqueCustomers
FROM order_created
GROUP BY tenantId
EMIT CHANGES;
```

```sql id="query-materialized-view"
SELECT *
FROM tenant_order_summary
WHERE tenantId = 'tenant-a';
```

| Karakteristik | Penjelasan |
|---|---|
| Continuously updated | Hasil berubah seiring event baru masuk |
| Queryable | Bisa dibaca dengan pull query |
| Backed by Kafka | State dipulihkan dari changelog/topic |
| Eventually consistent | Tidak sama dengan PostgreSQL transactional read |
| Best for derived state | Count, summary, latest projection, enrichment result |

---

## 9. Windowing

Windowing dipakai untuk aggregation berbasis waktu.

```sql id="windowing"
CREATE TABLE orders_per_tenant_per_minute AS
SELECT
  tenantId,
  COUNT(*) AS orderCount
FROM order_created
WINDOW TUMBLING (SIZE 1 MINUTE)
GROUP BY tenantId
EMIT CHANGES;
```

Dokumentasi ksqlDB menjelaskan aturan timestamp untuk aggregation dan joins; untuk aggregation, timestamp dihitung dari record input yang terlibat, sedangkan untuk stream-table join output memakai timestamp dari stream record. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/ksqldb/concepts/time-and-windows-in-ksqldb-queries.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

| Window | Cocok untuk |
|---|---|
| Tumbling | Count per menit/jam/hari |
| Hopping | Rolling metric |
| Session | Aktivitas user/session dengan inactivity gap |
| Grace period | Menangani late event |

Contoh dengan hopping window:

```sql id="hopping-window"
CREATE TABLE failed_login_rolling_5m AS
SELECT
  userId,
  COUNT(*) AS failedCount
FROM failed_login_events
WINDOW HOPPING (SIZE 5 MINUTES, ADVANCE BY 1 MINUTE)
GROUP BY userId
EMIT CHANGES;
```

---

## 10. Joins

ksqlDB bisa melakukan joins untuk enrichment, correlation, dan membangun denormalized stream/table.

```text id="join-types"
Stream + Table
  → enrich event with latest state

Stream + Stream
  → correlate events within time window

Table + Table
  → combine latest states
```

### Stream-table join

```sql id="stream-table-join"
CREATE STREAM enriched_order_created AS
SELECT
  o.orderId,
  o.customerId,
  c.segment,
  c.riskTier,
  o.occurredAt
FROM order_created o
LEFT JOIN customer_profile c
  ON o.customerId = c.customerId
EMIT CHANGES;
```

### Stream-stream join

```sql id="stream-stream-join"
CREATE STREAM paid_orders AS
SELECT
  o.orderId,
  p.paymentId,
  o.customerId,
  p.amountMinorUnits
FROM order_created o
INNER JOIN payment_captured p
  WITHIN 30 MINUTES
  ON o.orderId = p.orderId
EMIT CHANGES;
```

| Join type | Kapan dipakai |
|---|---|
| Stream-table | Event enrichment dengan latest state |
| Stream-stream | Korelasi dua event dalam window |
| Table-table | Gabungkan dua latest-state views |
| Left join | Tetap emit event walau lookup missing |
| Inner join | Emit hanya jika pasangan ada |

---

## 11. Filtering & Routing

ksqlDB sangat cocok untuk routing event ke derived topic.

```sql id="filter-routing"
CREATE STREAM high_value_orders AS
SELECT *
FROM order_created
WHERE totalAmountMinorUnits >= 100000000
EMIT CHANGES;
```

```sql id="invalid-event-routing"
CREATE STREAM invalid_order_events AS
SELECT *
FROM order_events
WHERE eventId IS NULL
   OR aggregateId IS NULL
   OR eventType IS NULL
EMIT CHANGES;
```

| Use case | ksqlDB cocok? |
|---|---:|
| Split event by type | Ya |
| Filter event invalid | Ya |
| Build derived event stream | Ya |
| Complex business validation with external DB/API | Tidak ideal |
| Transactional side effect | Tidak ideal |

---

## 12. Format & Schema

ksqlDB bekerja dengan Kafka topics dan value format seperti JSON, Avro, Protobuf, dan lainnya sesuai konfigurasi/platform. Jika perusahaan memakai Schema Registry, ksqlDB bisa memanfaatkan schema-governed topics untuk stream/table definitions.

```sql id="avro-stream"
CREATE STREAM order_created_avro
WITH (
  KAFKA_TOPIC = 'order.created.avro.v1',
  VALUE_FORMAT = 'AVRO'
);
```

| Format | Cocok untuk |
|---|---|
| JSON | Debug mudah, contract sederhana |
| JSON_SR / JSON Schema | JSON + schema governance |
| Avro | Kafka-native schema governance dan compact payload |
| Protobuf | Polyglot/gRPC-friendly contract |
| Delimited | Simple demo/testing |
| Bytes | Custom parsing; jarang ideal untuk ksqlDB SQL |

Praktik production: jangan biarkan query SQL menjadi satu-satunya kontrak. Tetap butuh schema owner, compatibility policy, golden event, dan topic governance.

---

## 13. Java/Jersey Integration Options

ksqlDB menyediakan REST API untuk menjalankan commands, queries, dan mengelola cluster secara programmatic. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/ksqldb/developer-guide/ksqldb-rest-api/overview.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)) ksqlDB juga punya Java client yang dapat menerima query results satu per satu, menerima hasil batch, insert rows, membuat/mengelola streams/tables/persistent queries, list streams/tables/topics/queries, describe streams/tables, dan mengambil metadata cluster. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/ksqldb/developer-guide/java-client/java-client.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```text id="jersey-ksqldb-integration-options"
Jersey service integration
│
├── Option A: Consume output topic
│   └── Most decoupled
│
├── Option B: Pull query from REST endpoint
│   └── Query materialized state
│
├── Option C: Push query streaming
│   └── Internal live stream
│
├── Option D: Java client manages query lifecycle
│   └── Internal admin/control plane
│
└── Option E: Direct REST API calls
    └── Useful if Java client not suitable
```

---

## 14. Java Client - Conceptual Usage

### Client config

```java id="ksqldb-java-client-config"
ClientOptions options = ClientOptions.create()
        .setHost(System.getenv("KSQLDB_HOST"))
        .setPort(Integer.parseInt(System.getenv("KSQLDB_PORT")))
        .setUseTls(Boolean.parseBoolean(System.getenv("KSQLDB_USE_TLS")));

Client client = Client.create(options);
```

### Execute statement

`executeStatement()` bisa dipakai untuk membuat streams/tables, membuat persistent queries seperti `CREATE ... AS SELECT` dan `INSERT INTO ... AS SELECT`, serta pause/resume/terminate persistent queries. Dokumentasi Java client juga mencatat request sebaiknya berisi satu statement; multi-statement request akan ditolak client. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/ksqldb/developer-guide/java-client/java-client.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```java id="ksqldb-execute-statement"
String sql = """
    CREATE STREAM order_created AS
    SELECT eventId, aggregateId AS orderId, customerId
    FROM order_events
    WHERE eventType = 'OrderCreated'
    EMIT CHANGES;
    """;

client.executeStatement(sql).get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
```

### Pull query

```java id="ksqldb-pull-query"
String sql = """
    SELECT orderCount
    FROM order_count_by_customer
    WHERE customerId = 'customer-456';
    """;

BatchedQueryResult result = client.executeQuery(sql);
List<Row> rows = result.get();
```

### Push query

```java id="ksqldb-push-query"
String sql = """
    SELECT *
    FROM high_value_orders
    EMIT CHANGES;
    """;

StreamedQueryResult stream = client.streamQuery(sql).get();

while (true) {
    Row row = stream.poll();
    if (row == null) {
        break;
    }

    handle(row);
}
```

Untuk non-terminating push query, Java client documentation menyarankan `streamQuery`; untuk pull query atau push query yang terminasi seperti memakai `LIMIT`, `executeQuery` lebih cocok. ([ksqlDB Documentation](https://docs.ksqldb.io/en/latest/developer-guide/ksqldb-clients/java-client/api/io/confluent/ksql/api/client/Client.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 15. REST API Integration

ksqlDB REST API bisa dipakai langsung dari Java HTTP client jika ingin kontrol penuh atau tidak ingin membawa Java client dependency. REST API mendukung interaksi programmatic untuk commands, queries, dan cluster management. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/ksqldb/developer-guide/ksqldb-rest-api/overview.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```text id="rest-api-integration"
Jersey service
  ↓
Java HTTP Client
  ↓
ksqlDB REST API
  ├── /ksql
  ├── /query
  └── /query-stream
```

HTTP Streaming API `/query-stream` digunakan oleh ksqlDB Java client; dokumentasinya menyarankan jika memakai Java, biasanya lebih baik memakai Java client dibanding memanggil API streaming langsung. Endpoint streaming ini tersedia dengan HTTP/2. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/ksqldb/developer-guide/ksqldb-rest-api/streaming-endpoint.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

| Endpoint style | Gunakan untuk |
|---|---|
| `/ksql` | Commands/statements non-SELECT |
| `/query` | Query streaming lama/chunked result |
| `/query-stream` | HTTP/2 streaming API untuk pull/push queries dan inserts |
| Java client | Wrapper lebih ergonomis untuk Java apps |

---

## 16. ksqlDB vs Kafka Streams vs Plain Consumer

| Kebutuhan | Plain Consumer | Kafka Streams | ksqlDB |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Event → DB transaction | Sangat cocok | Kurang ideal | Tidak cocok |
| Event → REST/API side effect | Cocok dengan retry/idempotency | Risky | Tidak cocok |
| SQL transform topic-to-topic | Manual | Bisa | Sangat cocok |
| Filtering/routing stream | Bisa | Sangat cocok | Sangat cocok |
| Aggregation/windowing | Manual sulit | Sangat cocok | Sangat cocok |
| Stream-table join | Manual sulit | Sangat cocok | Sangat cocok |
| Materialized view + pull query | Manual/Kafka Streams | Cocok | Sangat cocok |
| Complex Java business logic | Sangat cocok | Cocok | Kurang cocok |
| SQL-first data/platform workflow | Tidak | Tidak | Sangat cocok |
| Fine-grained state store control | Manual | Sangat cocok | Terbatas |
| Version-controlled Java topology | Ya | Ya | Query-as-artifact perlu governance |
| Runtime query changes | Tidak mudah | Deploy app | Lebih mudah tapi harus dikontrol |

Rule praktis:

```text id="ksqldb-decision-rule"
Gunakan ksqlDB jika:
  logic bisa diekspresikan jelas dengan SQL
  output adalah derived stream/table
  tim butuh cepat membuat transform/enrichment/aggregation
  platform siap mengelola query lifecycle

Gunakan Kafka Streams jika:
  butuh Java-level control, custom state, processor API, atau testing topology kuat

Gunakan plain Consumer jika:
  butuh transaksi DB, external side effect, idempotency workflow, atau business command handling
```

---

## 17. Common ksqlDB Patterns

### Pattern A - Event Type Splitter

```sql id="pattern-event-type-splitter"
CREATE STREAM order_created AS
SELECT *
FROM order_events
WHERE eventType = 'OrderCreated'
EMIT CHANGES;

CREATE STREAM order_cancelled AS
SELECT *
FROM order_events
WHERE eventType = 'OrderCancelled'
EMIT CHANGES;
```

Cocok untuk shared topic yang berisi banyak event type.

---

### Pattern B - Enrichment

```sql id="pattern-enrichment"
CREATE STREAM enriched_order_created AS
SELECT
  o.orderId,
  o.customerId,
  c.segment,
  c.riskTier,
  o.occurredAt
FROM order_created o
LEFT JOIN customer_profile c
  ON o.customerId = c.customerId
EMIT CHANGES;
```

Cocok untuk downstream yang ingin event self-contained.

---

### Pattern C - Real-time Aggregation

```sql id="pattern-aggregation"
CREATE TABLE order_count_by_tenant AS
SELECT
  tenantId,
  COUNT(*) AS totalOrders
FROM order_created
GROUP BY tenantId
EMIT CHANGES;
```

Cocok untuk dashboard internal atau derived operational metric.

---

### Pattern D - Windowed Alert

```sql id="pattern-window-alert"
CREATE TABLE failed_login_by_user_5m AS
SELECT
  userId,
  COUNT(*) AS failedLoginCount
FROM failed_login_events
WINDOW HOPPING (SIZE 5 MINUTES, ADVANCE BY 1 MINUTE)
GROUP BY userId
EMIT CHANGES;
```

Lalu:

```sql id="pattern-window-alert-stream"
CREATE STREAM suspicious_login_activity AS
SELECT *
FROM failed_login_by_user_5m
WHERE failedLoginCount >= 5
EMIT CHANGES;
```

Cocok untuk threshold/risk signal.

---

### Pattern E - Materialized Lookup

```sql id="pattern-materialized-lookup"
CREATE TABLE latest_order_status AS
SELECT
  orderId,
  LATEST_BY_OFFSET(status) AS currentStatus
FROM order_status_events
GROUP BY orderId
EMIT CHANGES;
```

Lalu Jersey service bisa pull query:

```sql id="pattern-materialized-lookup-query"
SELECT currentStatus
FROM latest_order_status
WHERE orderId = 'order-123';
```

---

## 18. Query Lifecycle Governance

ksqlDB persistent query adalah production artifact. Ia harus diperlakukan seperti kode aplikasi.

```text id="query-lifecycle"
Query design
  ↓
SQL review
  ↓
Contract/schema review
  ↓
Test with sample topics
  ↓
Deploy query
  ↓
Monitor query
  ↓
Upgrade query safely
  ↓
Terminate old query
```

Confluent menyediakan panduan untuk meng-update persistent query yang sedang berjalan agar versi baru mulai memproses dari posisi versi lama; konsep ini disebut upgrading a query. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/ksqldb/how-to-guides/update-a-running-persistent-query.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

| Governance item | Kenapa penting |
|---|---|
| Query owner | Siapa bertanggung jawab saat gagal |
| Input topics | Contract dan SLA upstream |
| Output topics | Contract downstream |
| Query ID | Dibutuhkan untuk monitoring/terminate |
| Compatibility | Schema input/output |
| State/materialized view | Restore dan storage |
| Migration plan | Perubahan query tidak selalu trivial |
| Rollback plan | Query lama/query baru coexist? |
| Observability | Lag, error, throughput, query status |

---

## 19. Processing Guarantees

ksqlDB mendukung **at-least-once** dan **exactly-once** processing guarantees. At-least-once adalah default dengan `processing.guarantee="at_least_once"`; record tidak hilang tetapi bisa dibaca/diproses ulang saat failure. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/ksqldb/operate-and-deploy/processing-guarantees.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```text id="processing-guarantee-boundary"
Kafka topic
  → ksqlDB query
  → Kafka topic / materialized view

Processing guarantee applies here.

ksqlDB result
  → Jersey service
  → PostgreSQL / external API

Need separate idempotency/transaction design.
```

| Guarantee | Makna praktis |
|---|---|
| At-least-once | Output bisa duplicate saat recovery; downstream harus idempotent |
| Exactly-once | ksqlDB menghitung hasil benar dalam failure tertentu di boundary Kafka/ksqlDB |
| External side effect | Tidak otomatis exactly-once |
| Pull query | Membaca materialized state saat ini, bukan transaksi dengan DB aplikasi |
| Output topic consumer | Tetap perlu idempotency jika side effect eksternal |

Confluent FAQ menyatakan ksqlDB mendukung exactly-once processing dan dikonfigurasi melalui `processing.guarantee`. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/ksqldb/faq.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 20. ksqlDB dalam Jersey/JAX-RS Architecture

### Option A - Consume output topic

```text id="jersey-consume-output"
ksqlDB persistent query
  ↓
derived Kafka topic
  ↓
Java/Jersey consumer
  ↓
business handler / DB / API
```

Ini paling decoupled. Jersey service tidak perlu query ksqlDB langsung.

| Kelebihan | Kekurangan |
|---|---|
| Loose coupling | Tambah topic |
| Bisa retry/DLQ di consumer | Latency pipeline bertambah |
| ksqlDB hanya transform | Perlu consumer tambahan |

---

### Option B - Pull query from Jersey endpoint

```text id="jersey-pull-query"
HTTP GET /internal/customers/{id}/summary
  ↓
Jersey Resource
  ↓
ksqlDB pull query
  ↓
materialized view
  ↓
HTTP response
```

Cocok untuk internal read model.

| Kelebihan | Kekurangan |
|---|---|
| Cepat membuat API query | Coupling service ke ksqlDB availability |
| Tidak perlu DB read model sendiri | Query limitation |
| Cocok untuk derived metrics | Eventually consistent |

---

### Option C - Push query listener

```text id="jersey-push-listener"
Jersey background component
  ↓
ksqlDB push query
  ↓
streamed rows
  ↓
internal handler
```

Hati-hati: untuk high-volume processing, lebih aman consume Kafka output topic dibanding push query sebagai worker utama.

---

### Option D - Control-plane automation

```text id="jersey-control-plane"
Internal admin endpoint / deployment job
  ↓
Java ksqlDB client
  ↓
CREATE STREAM/TABLE/QUERY
  ↓
List/describe/terminate queries
```

Gunakan untuk internal platform tooling, bukan public API.

---

## 21. Failure Model

```text id="ksqldb-failure-model"
ksqlDB failure modes
│
├── Input contract failure
│   ├── incompatible schema
│   ├── missing field
│   └── unexpected null
│
├── Query logic failure
│   ├── wrong key
│   ├── wrong join type
│   ├── wrong window/grace
│   └── semantic bug
│
├── Runtime failure
│   ├── ksqlDB server down
│   ├── Kafka unavailable
│   ├── state restore slow
│   └── query terminated
│
├── Operational failure
│   ├── output topic missing/wrong config
│   ├── permissions/ACL issue
│   ├── schema registry unavailable
│   └── resource exhaustion
│
└── Integration failure
    ├── Jersey pull query timeout
    ├── push query connection dropped
    ├── duplicate output consumed by Java service
    └── materialized state stale
```

| Failure | Dampak | Mitigasi |
|---|---|---|
| ksqlDB down | Pull/push query gagal, persistent query berhenti/terganggu | Health check, retry, fallback, alert |
| Query semantic bug | Output topic salah | Query versioning, test data, replay |
| Wrong key | Join/aggregation salah | Key contract tests |
| Schema change upstream | Query fail atau wrong output | Schema compatibility + deployment coordination |
| State restore lama | Pull query stale/unavailable | Readiness + standby/scale planning |
| Output duplicate | Downstream side effect double | Idempotent consumer |
| Pull query timeout | REST API lambat/gagal | Timeout, circuit breaker, cache/fallback |
| Unauthorized topic access | Query tidak jalan | ACL review |

---

## 22. Operational Readiness

| Area | Checklist |
|---|---|
| Query artifact | SQL disimpan di repo, reviewable |
| Input contract | Topic/schema/key jelas |
| Output contract | Derived topic/schema owner jelas |
| Query owner | Team responsible jelas |
| Query ID | Dicatat untuk monitoring/terminate |
| Deployment | CI/CD atau platform process, bukan manual console saja |
| Migration | Plan untuk upgrade query |
| Rollback | Query lama bisa dikembalikan |
| Processing guarantee | at-least-once/exactly-once dipilih sadar |
| Materialized view | Storage, restore, query SLA jelas |
| Pull query | Timeout, auth, rate limit |
| Push query | Cancellation/backpressure |
| Security | ksqlDB auth, Kafka ACL, Schema Registry auth |
| Monitoring | Query health, lag, errors, throughput |
| DR/replay | Cara rebuild output topic/materialized view |

## 23. Monitoring Signals

| Signal | Kenapa penting |
|---|---|
| Query running/terminated | Persistent query harus aktif |
| Input rate | Apakah data masuk |
| Output rate | Apakah query menghasilkan output |
| Lag | Apakah query tertinggal |
| Processing errors | Contract/runtime issue |
| Deserialization errors | Schema/payload issue |
| State store size | Materialized view capacity |
| Pull query latency | API read SLA |
| Push query disconnects | Streaming stability |
| ksqlDB server health | Runtime availability |
| Kafka broker errors | Dependency |
| Schema Registry errors | Serialization/contract |
| Consumer downstream lag | Output dipakai atau menumpuk |

---

## 24. Security & Governance

| Concern | Praktik |
|---|---|
| ksqlDB endpoint | Jangan expose publik tanpa auth/network control |
| Kafka topic ACL | ksqlDB principal perlu read input/write output |
| Schema Registry | ksqlDB perlu akses schema jika format schema-governed |
| Pull query endpoint | Rate limit dan authorize caller |
| PII | Jangan materialize unrestricted PII |
| DLQ/error stream | Redaction dan retention |
| Query creation | Batasi siapa boleh membuat/terminate query |
| Audit | Catat perubahan query |
| Multi-tenant | Pastikan tenant isolation tidak hanya filter SQL rapuh |

ksqlDB query bisa menjadi jalur data baru. Treat sebagai **production data pipeline**, bukan query ad-hoc ringan.

---

## 25. Common Anti-Patterns

| Anti-pattern | Dampak |
|---|---|
| Membuat query manual di console tanpa version control | Tidak reproducible |
| Menganggap ksqlDB sebagai source of truth transactional | Consistency expectation salah |
| Pull query untuk traffic public high-volume tanpa capacity plan | ksqlDB overloaded |
| Push query sebagai worker utama high-throughput | Backpressure/lifecycle sulit |
| Menulis business side effect di luar ksqlDB berdasarkan push query tanpa idempotency | Duplicate side effect |
| Query `SELECT *` untuk contract publik | Output schema berubah liar |
| Mengubah query tanpa output topic versioning | Downstream rusak |
| Windowing tanpa definisi event time/grace | Late event handling tidak jelas |
| Join tanpa key governance | Enrichment salah/kosong |
| Materialized view berisi PII tanpa review | Compliance risk |
| Query lifecycle tidak dimonitor | Pipeline mati diam-diam |
| ksqlDB dijadikan escape hatch untuk semua logic | SQL layer menjadi shadow application |

## 26. Practical Decision Examples

### Case 1 - Split event topic by type

```text id="decision-split"
Problem:
  order.events.v1 berisi banyak event type.

Best fit:
  ksqlDB CREATE STREAM AS SELECT.

Why:
  SQL filter sederhana, output topic derived, tidak perlu Java service.
```

---

### Case 2 - Build dashboard count per tenant

```text id="decision-dashboard"
Problem:
  Butuh near-real-time count order per tenant.

Best fit:
  ksqlDB CTAS materialized table + pull query.

Why:
  Aggregation SQL natural, queryable materialized view.
```

---

### Case 3 - Consume event and update PostgreSQL

```text id="decision-db-side-effect"
Problem:
  Event masuk lalu update table transaksi bisnis.

Best fit:
  Plain Kafka Consumer.

Why:
  Perlu DB transaction, idempotency, retry, DLQ, offset handling.
```

---

### Case 4 - Custom state machine per case

```text id="decision-state-machine"
Problem:
  Event harus mengubah lifecycle case dengan guard, transition, audit, compensation.

Best fit:
  Java Consumer / Camunda / domain service.

Why:
  Business semantics kompleks dan perlu defensibility.
```

---

### Case 5 - Complex stream join with custom Java state logic

```text id="decision-streams"
Problem:
  Butuh custom state store, dedup TTL, special routing, topology test kuat.

Best fit:
  Kafka Streams.

Why:
  Java-level control lebih kuat daripada ksqlDB SQL.
```

## 27. ksqlDB + Jersey Reference Architecture

```text id="ksqldb-jersey-reference"
Kafka input topics
  ↓
ksqlDB persistent queries
  ├── derived streams
  ├── materialized tables
  └── output topics
        ↓
        Java/Jersey consumers
          ├── idempotent DB writes
          ├── DLQ/retry
          └── business side effects

Jersey internal REST
  ├── Pull query to ksqlDB materialized view
  ├── Admin/diagnostics endpoint
  └── Health/dependency check
```

Recommended boundary:

```text id="recommended-boundary"
ksqlDB:
  - derive
  - filter
  - enrich
  - aggregate
  - materialize

Java/Jersey:
  - command handling
  - domain validation
  - authorization
  - DB transaction
  - side effects
  - retries/DLQ
  - orchestration
```

## 28. Production Checklist

| Area | Checklist |
|---|---|
| SQL artifact | Query disimpan di repo |
| Input topic | Nama, key, format, schema jelas |
| Output topic | Nama, schema, owner, retention jelas |
| Persistent query | Query ID dan owner dicatat |
| Query type | Persistent/push/pull dipilih sadar |
| Materialized view | Pull query pattern jelas |
| Windowing | Event time, window, grace, retention jelas |
| Join | Key dan join semantics jelas |
| Processing guarantee | Config dipahami |
| Integration | Java client/REST timeout, auth, retry |
| Failure handling | Query failure, schema failure, output failure |
| Observability | Metrics, logs, alerts |
| Security | Auth, ACL, PII governance |
| Deployment | CI/CD, migration, rollback |
| Replay | Cara rebuild derived topic/table jelas |

## 29. Ringkasan Praktis

ksqlDB paling berguna ketika Anda ingin membuat stream processing dengan SQL:

```text id="ksqldb-summary"
Use ksqlDB for:
  - SQL-based filtering
  - stream routing
  - enrichment
  - aggregation
  - windowing
  - materialized views
  - pull/push query over stream state

Avoid ksqlDB for:
  - DB transaction boundary
  - external side effects
  - complex domain workflow
  - state machine with rich invariants
  - uncontrolled production query changes
```

Invariant yang harus dipegang:

```text id="ksqldb-invariants"
Every ksqlDB query must have:
  - owner
  - input contract
  - output contract
  - key semantics
  - schema policy
  - deployment path
  - monitoring
  - rollback/replay plan
```

Untuk microservice Jersey/JAX-RS, boundary paling sehat biasanya:

```text id="healthy-boundary"
ksqlDB produces clean derived streams/materialized views.
Jersey consumes or queries them with explicit timeout, auth, idempotency, and fallback.
```

## Response:
7/13/2026, 2:03:18 AM

Kita lanjut ke **EDA Patterns dalam Kafka-based microservice**. Fokusnya: memilih pattern yang benar untuk kebutuhan bisnis—bukan semua hal dibuat event-driven—dengan perhatian khusus ke consistency, auditability, replay, dan failure model.

# Cheatsheet - EDA Patterns dalam Kafka-based Java/Jersey Microservice

## 1. Core Mental Model

**Event-Driven Architecture / EDA** bukan berarti semua komunikasi harus asynchronous. EDA adalah cara memodelkan sistem sebagai rangkaian **fakta bisnis yang dipublikasikan**, lalu service lain bereaksi terhadap fakta tersebut.

Dalam microservice Kafka-based, pattern EDA biasanya dipakai untuk:

```text id="eda-core-model"
Local business action
  ↓
State change in service-owned database
  ↓
Domain / integration event published
  ↓
Other services consume event
  ↓
Derived state, side effect, workflow, projection, notification
```

Masalah utamanya bukan “cara kirim event”, tetapi:

```text id="eda-real-problems"
How to:
  - keep DB state and event publication consistent
  - avoid duplicate side effects
  - preserve ordering where needed
  - handle replay
  - model long-running business transactions
  - expose read models efficiently
  - keep event contracts stable
  - make failure auditable
```

Microservices.io menempatkan **Domain Event**, **Transactional Outbox**, **Event Sourcing**, dan **CQRS** sebagai pattern penting dalam event-driven microservices; transactional outbox dan event sourcing juga disebut sebagai cara untuk meng-update state dan publish event secara atomik. ([microservices.io](https://microservices.io/patterns/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 2. Pattern Map

```text id="eda-pattern-map"
EDA Patterns in Kafka Microservice
│
├── 1. Event Publication Patterns
│   ├── Domain event
│   ├── Integration event
│   ├── Event notification
│   ├── Event-carried state transfer
│   ├── Transactional outbox
│   └── CDC / transaction log tailing
│
├── 2. Consumption Patterns
│   ├── Idempotent consumer
│   ├── Retry topic
│   ├── DLQ / quarantine
│   ├── Replay-safe handler
│   └── Competing consumers
│
├── 3. Consistency Patterns
│   ├── Saga choreography
│   ├── Saga orchestration
│   ├── Compensation
│   ├── Process manager
│   └── Eventually consistent workflow
│
├── 4. Read Model Patterns
│   ├── CQRS
│   ├── Projection
│   ├── Materialized view
│   ├── Cache invalidation
│   └── Search indexing
│
├── 5. Persistence Patterns
│   ├── Event sourcing
│   ├── Snapshotting
│   ├── Event store
│   ├── Upcasting
│   └── Stream replay
│
├── 6. Routing & Transformation Patterns
│   ├── Event router
│   ├── Event enricher
│   ├── Event translator
│   ├── Splitter
│   ├── Aggregator
│   └── Correlator
│
└── 7. Governance Patterns
    ├── Event contract
    ├── Schema compatibility
    ├── Topic ownership
    ├── Data classification
    ├── Observability
    └── Operational runbook
```

---

## 3. Pattern Selection Table

| Pattern | Problem utama | Cocok untuk | Hindari jika |
|---|---|---|---|
| Domain Event | Service perlu merepresentasikan fakta domain internal | Internal bounded context, domain model clean | Event dipakai langsung sebagai kontrak publik tanpa mapping |
| Integration Event | Service lain perlu tahu fakta bisnis | Antar microservice | Payload bocor dari entity/table internal |
| Event Notification | Consumer hanya perlu tahu “sesuatu terjadi” | Trigger sederhana | Consumer perlu data lengkap dan tidak boleh call balik |
| Event-Carried State Transfer | Consumer butuh data cukup dari event | Projection, read model, indexing | Payload sensitif/besar tanpa governance |
| Transactional Outbox | DB commit dan event publish harus reliable | PostgreSQL + Kafka microservice | Event tidak penting atau boleh hilang |
| CDC / Log Tailing | Publish perubahan DB via transaction log | Outbox relay otomatis, data integration | Butuh semantic event kaya tapi hanya punya row-level change |
| Idempotent Consumer | Consumer harus aman terhadap duplicate | Hampir semua event bisnis | Side effect tidak bisa dibuat idempotent |
| Saga Choreography | Workflow lintas service tanpa coordinator pusat | Flow sederhana berbasis event | Alur kompleks, banyak branch, sulit observability |
| Saga Orchestration | Workflow lintas service dengan coordinator | Long-running business process, state machine | Flow sangat sederhana |
| CQRS / Projection | Read model berbeda dari write model | Dashboard, search, query cepat | Strong consistency read wajib |
| Event Sourcing | State disimpan sebagai event sequence | Audit tinggi, temporal query, replay | Tim belum siap complexity/event evolution |
| Materialized View | Query cepat atas derived state | Kafka Streams/ksqlDB projection | Data harus selalu transactionally current |
| DLQ / Quarantine | Poison message tidak boleh menahan pipeline | Production consumer | DLQ tidak dimonitor |
| Replay | Rebuild projection / recover bug | Idempotent deterministic handlers | Handler punya side effect irreversible |

---

# 4. Domain Event vs Integration Event

## Domain Event

**Domain event** adalah fakta yang terjadi di dalam domain model.

```text id="domain-event"
Order aggregate:
  command: create order
  state change: status = CREATED
  domain event: OrderCreated
```

Domain event biasanya dekat dengan business language.

```java id="domain-event-example"
public record OrderCreatedDomainEvent(
        OrderId orderId,
        CustomerId customerId,
        Instant occurredAt
) {}
```

## Integration Event

**Integration event** adalah kontrak publik yang dikirim ke Kafka agar service lain bisa consume.

```java id="integration-event-example"
public record OrderCreatedIntegrationEvent(
        String eventId,
        String eventType,
        int eventVersion,
        Instant occurredAt,
        String producer,
        String correlationId,
        String tenantId,
        String aggregateId,
        OrderCreatedPayload payload
) {}
```

| Aspek | Domain Event | Integration Event |
|---|---|---|
| Scope | Dalam bounded context | Antar service |
| Bentuk | Boleh mengikuti domain model | Harus stable contract |
| Audience | Service sendiri | Consumer lain |
| Versioning | Internal | Wajib |
| Serialization | Tidak selalu perlu | Wajib |
| Privacy review | Internal | Wajib |
| Kafka topic | Tidak langsung | Ya |

Rule praktis:

```text id="domain-vs-integration-rule"
Domain event:
  untuk menjaga domain model bersih.

Integration event:
  untuk komunikasi antar service.

Jangan publish domain object mentah langsung ke Kafka.
Map dulu ke integration event.
```

---

# 5. Event Notification Pattern

## Problem

Service lain perlu tahu bahwa sesuatu terjadi, tetapi tidak butuh semua data.

```json id="event-notification-example"
{
  "eventId": "evt-001",
  "eventType": "OrderCreated",
  "aggregateId": "order-123",
  "occurredAt": "2026-07-13T10:15:30Z",
  "payload": {
    "orderId": "order-123"
  }
}
```

## Flow

```text id="event-notification-flow"
Order Service
  ↓ publishes
OrderCreated(orderId)
  ↓ consumed by
Billing Service
  ↓ calls Order Service if more detail needed
```

## Kelebihan

| Kelebihan | Penjelasan |
|---|---|
| Payload kecil | Kafka traffic lebih ringan |
| Coupling data rendah | Producer tidak expose banyak field |
| Schema lebih sederhana | Event hanya membawa identity/reference |
| Baik untuk trigger | Cocok untuk notification, invalidation, workflow signal |

## Kekurangan

| Kekurangan | Dampak |
|---|---|
| Consumer harus call balik | Coupling runtime ke producer API |
| Latency meningkat | Event consume + HTTP call |
| Producer service jadi dependency | Jika producer down, consumer tertahan |
| Replay lebih sulit | Data historis mungkin sudah berubah |

## Cocok untuk

```text id="event-notification-fit"
Use when:
  - consumer hanya butuh trigger
  - data detail bisa diambil dari source service
  - eventual follow-up call acceptable
  - payload harus minimal
```

## Hindari untuk

```text id="event-notification-avoid"
Avoid when:
  - consumer butuh replay akurat
  - consumer harus autonomous
  - producer API tidak reliable untuk callback
  - event dipakai untuk build projection/search index
```

---

# 6. Event-Carried State Transfer Pattern

## Problem

Consumer perlu data cukup dari event agar tidak perlu call producer.

```json id="event-carried-state-example"
{
  "eventId": "evt-001",
  "eventType": "OrderCreated",
  "eventVersion": 1,
  "aggregateId": "order-123",
  "occurredAt": "2026-07-13T10:15:30Z",
  "payload": {
    "orderId": "order-123",
    "customerId": "customer-456",
    "status": "CREATED",
    "totalAmount": {
      "currency": "IDR",
      "minorUnits": 15000000
    },
    "salesChannel": "WEB"
  }
}
```

## Flow

```text id="event-carried-flow"
Order Service
  ↓ publishes self-contained OrderCreated
Search Service
  ↓ updates index without calling Order Service

Analytics Projection
  ↓ updates dashboard without calling Order Service
```

## Kelebihan

| Kelebihan | Penjelasan |
|---|---|
| Consumer autonomous | Tidak perlu callback ke producer |
| Replay lebih kuat | Event membawa data saat fakta terjadi |
| Cocok untuk projection | Search/read model bisa dibangun dari stream |
| Mengurangi runtime coupling | Producer tidak harus online saat consumer bekerja |

## Kekurangan

| Kekurangan | Dampak |
|---|---|
| Payload lebih besar | Kafka storage/network naik |
| Data privacy lebih berat | PII bisa tersebar |
| Schema evolution lebih penting | Banyak field dikontrak |
| Data bisa stale | Event merepresentasikan fakta saat itu, bukan current state |

## Cocok untuk

```text id="event-carried-fit"
Use when:
  - building read models
  - indexing search
  - analytics projection
  - replay is important
  - consumer should not call producer API
```

---

# 7. Transactional Outbox Pattern

## Problem

Service perlu mengubah database dan publish event. Jika dilakukan langsung, ada failure window:

```text id="direct-publish-failure"
DB commit success
  ↓
service crashes before Kafka publish
  ↓
event lost
```

atau:

```text id="direct-publish-failure-2"
Kafka publish success
  ↓
DB transaction rollback
  ↓
event describes state that never committed
```

**Transactional Outbox** menyimpan message/event ke table outbox dalam transaksi database yang sama dengan perubahan business entity, lalu message relay mempublish event ke broker. Pattern ini dirancang untuk menghindari kebutuhan 2PC sambil memastikan message dikirim jika transaksi database commit. ([microservices.io](https://microservices.io/patterns/data/transactional-outbox.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## Flow

```text id="transactional-outbox-flow"
HTTP command
  ↓
DB transaction:
  - update business table
  - insert outbox_event
  ↓
commit
  ↓
Outbox relay / CDC
  ↓
publish to Kafka
  ↓
mark published / rely on CDC
```

## PostgreSQL table

```sql id="outbox-table-eda"
CREATE TABLE outbox_event (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    aggregate_type  TEXT NOT NULL,
    aggregate_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_type      TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_version   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    topic           TEXT NOT NULL,
    partition_key   TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload         JSONB NOT NULL,
    headers         JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    status          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
    retry_count     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    next_attempt_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    published_at    TIMESTAMPTZ
);
```

## Application service

```java id="outbox-service-example"
public OrderId createOrder(CreateOrderCommand command, RequestContext context) {
    return transaction.inTransaction(() -> {
        Order order = Order.create(command);
        orderRepository.save(order);

        OrderCreatedIntegrationEvent event =
                orderEventMapper.toOrderCreated(order, context);

        outboxRepository.save(OutboxEvent.from(event));

        return order.id();
    });
}
```

## Relay

```text id="outbox-relay"
Outbox worker:
  SELECT pending rows FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  ↓
  publish to Kafka
  ↓
  if ack success:
      mark PUBLISHED
  else:
      retry with backoff
```

## Important invariant

```text id="outbox-invariant"
Never mark outbox event published before Kafka ack.
Never assume relay publishes exactly once.
Downstream consumer must be idempotent.
```

Microservices.io explicitly notes that a message relay may publish a message more than once, so consumers must be idempotent. ([microservices.io](https://microservices.io/patterns/data/transactional-outbox.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

# 8. CDC / Transaction Log Tailing Pattern

## Problem

Polling outbox table works, but platform may prefer publishing via database transaction log.

```text id="cdc-outbox-flow"
PostgreSQL transaction
  ↓
insert outbox_event
  ↓
WAL / transaction log
  ↓
CDC connector
  ↓
Kafka topic
```

Microservices.io lists **transaction log tailing** as one way to atomically update state and publish events in event-driven architecture. ([microservices.io](https://microservices.io/patterns/data/event-driven-architecture.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## Cocok untuk

| Cocok | Penjelasan |
|---|---|
| Platform punya Kafka Connect / Debezium | CDC bisa distandarkan |
| Outbox relay custom ingin dikurangi | Tidak perlu worker polling sendiri |
| Throughput tinggi | WAL-based capture bisa efisien |
| Audit pipeline | Semua perubahan tercatat dari log |

## Risiko

| Risiko | Penjelasan |
|---|---|
| Operasional lebih kompleks | Connector, offset, schema, DLQ CDC |
| Row-level shape bocor | Jika publish table mentah tanpa outbox event semantic |
| Debugging lintas sistem | DB → connector → Kafka |
| Connector lag | Event delayed walau DB commit sudah sukses |
| Schema table berubah | CDC output bisa berubah |

## Rule praktis

```text id="cdc-rule"
Best practice:
  DB transaction writes semantic outbox event.
  CDC publishes outbox event.
  Do not expose arbitrary table row changes as public domain events unless intentionally designed.
```

---

# 9. Idempotent Consumer Pattern

## Problem

Event dapat diproses lebih dari sekali karena retry, crash, rebalance, offset commit failure, outbox relay duplicate, atau replay.

```text id="idempotent-problem"
Consumer processes event
  ↓
DB commit success
  ↓
crashes before Kafka offset commit
  ↓
same event is consumed again
```

## Solution

Consumer menyimpan `eventId` atau business idempotency key di database.

```sql id="processed-event-table"
CREATE TABLE processed_event (
    event_id      UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    event_type    TEXT NOT NULL,
    aggregate_id  TEXT,
    processed_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
```

## Handler flow

```text id="idempotent-consumer-flow"
Consume event
  ↓
Begin DB transaction
  ↓
Try insert processed_event(eventId)
  ├── conflict → duplicate, treat as success
  └── inserted → apply business/projection mutation
  ↓
Commit DB
  ↓
Commit Kafka offset
```

## Java-ish example

```java id="idempotent-consumer-example"
public void handle(OrderCreatedEvent event) {
    transaction.inTransaction(() -> {
        boolean firstTime = processedEventRepository.tryInsert(
                event.eventId(),
                event.eventType(),
                event.aggregateId()
        );

        if (!firstTime) {
            return null;
        }

        orderProjectionRepository.upsertFrom(event);

        return null;
    });
}
```

## Invariant

```text id="idempotent-invariant"
Kafka offset commit happens after local side effect success.
Duplicate event must not produce duplicate business effect.
```

---

# 10. Saga Pattern

## Problem

Satu business transaction melibatkan banyak service dan database berbeda.

Contoh order:

```text id="saga-order-flow"
Create order
  ↓
Reserve inventory
  ↓
Authorize payment
  ↓
Confirm order
```

Tidak ada satu database transaction global yang aman dan scalable untuk semua service. AWS menjelaskan saga sebagai failure management pattern untuk menjaga consistency dalam distributed application dengan mengoordinasikan transaksi antar microservice. ([AWS Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/modernization-data-persistence/saga-pattern.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

Saga terdiri dari rangkaian **local transaction**. Setiap local transaction mengubah database service sendiri dan memicu langkah berikutnya; jika salah satu langkah gagal, sistem menjalankan **compensating transaction**. AWS juga mendeskripsikan saga sebagai sequence of local transactions yang masing-masing update database dan trigger transaksi berikutnya. ([AWS Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/cloud-design-patterns/saga.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 10.1 Saga Choreography

### Mental model

Tidak ada coordinator pusat. Tiap service publish event, service lain bereaksi.

```text id="saga-choreography"
Order Service
  → OrderCreated

Inventory Service
  consumes OrderCreated
  → InventoryReserved / InventoryRejected

Payment Service
  consumes InventoryReserved
  → PaymentAuthorized / PaymentRejected

Order Service
  consumes PaymentAuthorized
  → OrderConfirmed
```

AWS menjelaskan saga choreography sebagai pattern untuk menjaga data integrity pada distributed transaction dengan menggunakan event subscriptions. ([AWS Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/cloud-design-patterns/saga-choreography.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

### Cocok untuk

| Cocok | Penjelasan |
|---|---|
| Flow sederhana | Sedikit service dan branch |
| Loose coupling penting | Service tidak tahu coordinator |
| Event semantics jelas | Setiap event memicu langkah natural |
| Failure compensation sederhana | Tidak banyak state machine kompleks |

### Kelebihan

| Kelebihan | Penjelasan |
|---|---|
| Tidak ada central orchestrator | Lebih decentralized |
| Service autonomy tinggi | Tiap service handle event sendiri |
| Natural event-driven flow | Cocok untuk workflow sederhana |
| Mudah ditambah subscriber | Event bisa dipakai service baru |

### Kekurangan

| Kekurangan | Dampak |
|---|---|
| Flow tersebar | Sulit melihat end-to-end process |
| Debugging sulit | State workflow tersebar di banyak service |
| Coupling implisit | Event subscription menjadi dependency tersembunyi |
| Compensation rumit | Jika banyak branch, choreography membingungkan |
| Risk of event spaghetti | Tanpa governance, alur jadi tidak defensible |

---

## 10.2 Saga Orchestration

### Mental model

Ada orchestrator/coordinator yang memegang state workflow dan memberi command ke service lain.

```text id="saga-orchestration"
Order Saga Orchestrator
  ↓ command
Inventory Service: ReserveInventory
  ↓ reply event
InventoryReserved
  ↓ command
Payment Service: AuthorizePayment
  ↓ reply event
PaymentAuthorized
  ↓ command
Order Service: ConfirmOrder
```

AWS menjelaskan saga orchestration sebagai pattern yang memakai central coordinator/orchestrator untuk menjaga data integrity dalam distributed transactions yang melibatkan banyak service. ([AWS Documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/cloud-design-patterns/saga-orchestration.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

### Cocok untuk

| Cocok | Penjelasan |
|---|---|
| Workflow kompleks | Banyak branch, timeout, compensation |
| Butuh observability tinggi | Status workflow terlihat di satu tempat |
| Butuh explicit state machine | Cocok dengan Camunda/state machine |
| Regulatory defensibility | Mudah menjelaskan siapa melakukan apa, kapan |
| Long-running process | Bisa berjalan menit/jam/hari |

### Kelebihan

| Kelebihan | Penjelasan |
|---|---|
| Flow eksplisit | Mudah dilihat dan diaudit |
| State workflow terpusat | Status saga jelas |
| Compensation lebih terkendali | Orchestrator tahu langkah yang sudah sukses |
| Timeout/retry lebih mudah | Bisa dimodelkan eksplisit |
| Cocok dengan BPMN/Camunda | Workflow bisnis kompleks lebih visible |

### Kekurangan

| Kekurangan | Dampak |
|---|---|
| Coordinator dependency | Orchestrator menjadi komponen kritikal |
| Coupling ke command endpoints | Orchestrator tahu service peserta |
| Complexity pindah ke orchestrator | Harus didesain seperti state machine production |
| Risk of god workflow | Jangan masukkan semua logic domain ke orchestrator |

---

## 10.3 Choreography vs Orchestration

| Kriteria | Choreography | Orchestration |
|---|---|---|
| Control flow | Tersebar via event | Terpusat di orchestrator |
| Observability | Sulit jika tidak ada tracing kuat | Lebih mudah |
| Coupling | Event-based implicit | Command-based explicit |
| Cocok untuk | Flow sederhana | Flow kompleks |
| Failure handling | Tersebar | Terkoordinasi |
| Compensation | Tiap service bereaksi | Orchestrator mengarahkan |
| Debugging | Butuh event tracing | Saga state bisa dilihat |
| Regulatory audit | Perlu rekonstruksi event | Lebih defensible |
| Tooling | Kafka tracing/observability | Camunda/BPMN/state machine |

Rule praktis:

```text id="saga-rule"
Use choreography for simple event reactions.
Use orchestration for complex, long-running, auditable workflows.
```

---

# 11. Compensation Pattern

## Problem

Dalam distributed transaction, rollback global tidak tersedia. Jika langkah ke-3 gagal, langkah 1 dan 2 harus dikompensasi.

```text id="compensation-flow"
OrderCreated
  ↓
InventoryReserved
  ↓
PaymentAuthorizationFailed
  ↓
Compensation:
  ReleaseInventory
  CancelOrder
```

## Compensation bukan rollback teknis

| Rollback DB | Compensation |
|---|---|
| Mengembalikan transaksi lokal sebelum commit | Aksi bisnis baru setelah commit |
| Invisible ke bisnis | Visible dan diaudit |
| Instan | Bisa gagal/tertunda |
| Dilakukan oleh DB engine | Dilakukan oleh service/domain logic |
| Tidak perlu event baru | Harus publish event/command baru |

## Contoh event

```text id="compensation-events"
InventoryReserved
PaymentAuthorizationFailed
InventoryReleased
OrderCancelled
```

## Invariant

```text id="compensation-invariant"
Every compensating action must be:
  - explicit
  - idempotent
  - auditable
  - retryable
  - allowed by business rules
```

---

# 12. CQRS / Projection Pattern

## Problem

Write model yang bagus untuk transaksi domain sering tidak bagus untuk query.

```text id="cqrs-problem"
Write model:
  normalized, transactional, aggregate-centric

Read model:
  denormalized, query-optimized, dashboard/search/API-centric
```

**CQRS** memisahkan command/write model dari query/read model. Microservices.io mendeskripsikan CQRS sebagai pattern untuk mengimplementasikan query dengan mempertahankan satu atau lebih materialized views yang efisien untuk di-query. ([microservices.io](https://microservices.io/patterns/data/cqrs.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## Flow

```text id="cqrs-flow"
Command API
  ↓
Write model PostgreSQL
  ↓
Outbox event
  ↓
Kafka
  ↓
Projection consumer / Kafka Streams / ksqlDB
  ↓
Read model:
  - PostgreSQL projection table
  - Elasticsearch/OpenSearch
  - Redis
  - Kafka Streams state store
  - ksqlDB materialized table
```

## Cocok untuk

| Cocok | Contoh |
|---|---|
| Query kompleks | Dashboard, reporting operational |
| Search | Index OpenSearch |
| Denormalized API | Customer order summary |
| High read load | Cache/materialized view |
| Different consistency needs | Write strong, read eventual |

## Risiko

| Risiko | Mitigasi |
|---|---|
| Read model stale | Tampilkan freshness/lastUpdatedAt |
| Projection duplicate | Idempotent consumer |
| Projection bug | Replay-safe rebuild |
| Schema evolution | Versioned event handler |
| Query divergence | Automated reconciliation |
| Operational complexity | Monitoring lag/projection health |

## Projection handler

```java id="projection-handler"
public void handle(OrderCreatedEvent event) {
    transaction.inTransaction(() -> {
        if (!processedEventRepository.tryInsert(event.eventId())) {
            return null;
        }

        orderSummaryRepository.upsertOrderCreated(
                event.payload().customerId(),
                event.payload().orderId(),
                event.occurredAt()
        );

        return null;
    });
}
```

---

# 13. Event Sourcing Pattern

## Problem

Daripada menyimpan hanya current state, sistem menyimpan semua perubahan state sebagai sequence event.

```text id="event-sourcing-model"
Traditional persistence:
  order table current row

Event sourcing:
  OrderCreated
  OrderItemAdded
  OrderPaid
  OrderShipped
```

Microservices.io mendeskripsikan event sourcing sebagai pattern yang menyimpan aggregate sebagai sequence of events, dan mencatat beberapa manfaat seperti audit log yang reliable, temporal queries, serta kemampuan publish event saat state berubah. ([microservices.io](https://microservices.io/patterns/data/event-sourcing.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## Flow

```text id="event-sourcing-flow"
Command
  ↓
Load aggregate from event stream
  ↓
Validate command
  ↓
Append new event(s)
  ↓
Publish event(s)
  ↓
Update projections
```

## Aggregate reconstruction

```text id="aggregate-replay"
OrderCreated
  ↓ apply
OrderItemAdded
  ↓ apply
PaymentAuthorized
  ↓ apply
OrderConfirmed
  ↓ apply

Current Order state reconstructed
```

## Cocok untuk

| Cocok | Penjelasan |
|---|---|
| Auditability sangat tinggi | Semua perubahan tersimpan |
| Temporal query | Bisa lihat state pada waktu tertentu |
| Complex lifecycle | State machine kaya |
| Regulatory traceability | Alasan perubahan bisa diaudit |
| Replay projections | Read model bisa dibangun ulang |

## Hindari jika

| Hindari jika | Alasan |
|---|---|
| CRUD sederhana | Complexity tidak sepadan |
| Tim belum siap event evolution | Versi event lama harus tetap hidup |
| Query current state sederhana | Projection wajib |
| Privacy deletion kompleks | Event immutable menyulitkan data erasure |
| Domain belum stabil | Event model cepat berubah |

## Challenges

Sebuah studi empiris tentang event-sourced systems mengidentifikasi tantangan seperti evolusi event system, steep learning curve, technology availability, rebuilding projections, dan data privacy; studi itu juga menyebut solusi seperti versioned events, upcasting, in-place transformation, dan copy-and-transform. ([arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.01146?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

# 14. Snapshotting Pattern

## Problem

Jika aggregate punya ribuan event, load dari awal setiap command menjadi mahal.

```text id="snapshotting-model"
Event stream:
  e1, e2, e3, ... e10000

Snapshot at version 9000:
  current state at e9000

Load:
  snapshot e9000
  apply e9001..e10000
```

## Cocok untuk

| Cocok | Penjelasan |
|---|---|
| Long-lived aggregate | Banyak event per entity |
| Command latency penting | Load aggregate harus cepat |
| Event sourcing production | Hampir selalu butuh setelah volume naik |

## Risiko

| Risiko | Mitigasi |
|---|---|
| Snapshot schema berubah | Version snapshot |
| Snapshot corrupt | Rebuild dari event stream |
| Snapshot terlalu sering | Storage overhead |
| Snapshot terlalu jarang | Load lambat |
| Snapshot dianggap source of truth | Source of truth tetap event stream |

---

# 15. Replay-Safe Design Pattern

## Problem

Event replay diperlukan untuk rebuild projection, recovery bug, migration, atau audit. Tapi replay bisa menyebabkan side effect ganda jika handler tidak dirancang benar.

```text id="replay-risk"
Replay OrderCreated
  ↓
handler sends welcome email again
  ↓
customer receives duplicate email
```

## Replay-safe rule

```text id="replay-safe-rule"
Projection update:
  safe to replay if idempotent/deterministic.

External side effect:
  unsafe unless explicitly idempotent and guarded.
```

## Replay-safe handler

| Handler type | Replay safety |
|---|---|
| Upsert projection | Usually safe |
| Increment counter | Unsafe unless dedup/event id applied |
| Send email | Unsafe unless notification idempotency exists |
| Call payment API | Dangerous |
| Write audit append-only | Can duplicate unless event id unique |
| Rebuild search index | Usually safe if deterministic |
| Publish derived event | Needs idempotent output/event id |

## Pattern

```text id="replay-safe-flow"
Consume event
  ↓
Check processed_event(eventId, projectionName)
  ↓
Apply deterministic projection
  ↓
Record processed event
```

---

# 16. Event Router / Translator / Enricher

## 16.1 Event Router

Route event ke topic/handler berbeda.

```text id="event-router"
order.events.v1
  ↓
eventType
  ├── OrderCreated → order.created.v1
  ├── OrderPaid    → order.paid.v1
  └── unknown      → DLQ / ignored
```

## 16.2 Event Translator

Ubah event dari kontrak upstream ke kontrak downstream.

```text id="event-translator"
ExternalVendorOrderCreated
  ↓ translate
OrderCreatedIntegrationEvent
```

## 16.3 Event Enricher

Tambahkan informasi dari table/stream lain.

```text id="event-enricher"
OrderCreated + CustomerProfile
  ↓
EnrichedOrderCreated
```

| Pattern | Cocok dengan |
|---|---|
| Router | Kafka Streams, ksqlDB, plain consumer |
| Translator | Kafka Streams, plain consumer |
| Enricher | Kafka Streams, ksqlDB |
| Complex enrichment via DB/API | Plain consumer lebih aman |

---

# 17. Aggregator / Correlator Pattern

## Problem

Beberapa event perlu dikumpulkan sebelum menghasilkan output.

```text id="correlator"
OrderCreated
PaymentAuthorized
InventoryReserved
  ↓
OrderReadyForConfirmation
```

## Cocok untuk

| Cocok | Contoh |
|---|---|
| Event correlation by id | orderId |
| Windowed match | payment within 30 minutes |
| Multi-source readiness | inventory + payment + fraud check |
| Derived alert | threshold exceeded |

## Implementation options

| Option | Cocok untuk |
|---|---|
| Kafka Streams windowed join | Event correlation time-bounded |
| ksqlDB stream-stream join | SQL-first correlation |
| Saga orchestrator | Business workflow state |
| PostgreSQL process table | Strong audit + manual intervention |
| Camunda | Human/business process orchestration |

Rule:

```text id="correlator-rule"
If correlation is a business process, use saga/process manager.
If correlation is stream computation, use Kafka Streams/ksqlDB.
```

---

# 18. Event Ordering Pattern

## Problem

Kafka ordering berlaku per partition, bukan global.

```text id="ordering-model"
Topic partitions:
  partition 0: order-1 event1 → order-1 event2
  partition 1: order-2 event1 → order-2 event2

Ordering per order is safe only if key = orderId.
```

## Rule

| Requirement | Strategy |
|---|---|
| Ordering per aggregate | Kafka key = aggregateId |
| Ordering per tenant | Key = tenantId, but hot partition risk |
| High throughput | Many partitions, accept no global ordering |
| Global ordering | Single partition, but throughput limited |
| Lifecycle state machine | Aggregate version check |
| Replay subset | Preserve per-key ordering |

## Aggregate version

```json id="aggregate-version-event"
{
  "eventId": "evt-001",
  "aggregateId": "case-123",
  "aggregateVersion": 7,
  "eventType": "CaseEscalated"
}
```

Consumer invariant:

```text id="aggregate-version-rule"
Expected next version = currentVersion + 1.
If event version is duplicate: ignore.
If event version has gap: hold/retry/investigate.
If event version is older: ignore or audit.
```

---

# 19. Event Contract Governance Pattern

## Problem

Kafka membuat publish/subscribe mudah, tapi tanpa governance event akan menjadi distributed coupling.

Studi empiris 2024 tentang event management di microservice menemukan developer menghadapi tantangan seperti payload event besar, schema modelling, auditing event flows, dan ordering constraints. ([arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.00440?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## Contract checklist

| Area | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Owner | Team pemilik event/topic |
| Topic | Nama, retention, partition, cleanup policy |
| Schema | JSON Schema/Avro/Protobuf |
| Compatibility | BACKWARD/FORWARD/FULL/transitive |
| Event ID | Untuk dedup/replay |
| Event version | Untuk evolution |
| Key semantics | Aggregate/tenant/customer |
| Privacy | PII/data classification |
| Retention | Sesuai replay dan compliance |
| Consumers | Known critical consumers |
| Deprecation | Policy dan timeline |
| Observability | Metrics/log/tracing |

---

# 20. Pattern Combination: Recommended Production Stack

Untuk Java/Jersey + PostgreSQL + Kafka, kombinasi pattern yang paling sering aman:

```text id="recommended-stack"
HTTP command
  ↓
Application service
  ↓
PostgreSQL transaction
  ├── update aggregate
  └── insert outbox event
  ↓
Outbox relay / CDC
  ↓
Kafka topic
  ↓
Consumer
  ├── validate contract
  ├── idempotency check
  ├── process / project / orchestrate
  └── commit offset
  ↓
Retry / DLQ / replay tooling
```

Pattern yang dipakai:

| Layer | Pattern |
|---|---|
| Write side | Transactional outbox |
| Event contract | Integration event + schema governance |
| Kafka key | Aggregate ordering |
| Consumer | Idempotent consumer |
| Failure | Retry topic + DLQ |
| Read side | CQRS projection |
| Workflow | Saga orchestration/choreography |
| Audit-heavy domain | Event sourcing jika justified |
| Stream computation | Kafka Streams / ksqlDB |

---

# 21. Decision Matrix: Sync REST vs Async Event

| Kebutuhan | REST Sync | Kafka Event |
|---|---:|---:|
| Caller butuh jawaban langsung | Sangat cocok | Tidak cocok |
| Command validation immediate | Cocok | Tidak langsung |
| Fire-and-forget notification | Kurang ideal | Cocok |
| Banyak subscriber | Kurang ideal | Sangat cocok |
| Replay diperlukan | Tidak natural | Cocok |
| Query current state | Cocok | Via projection/materialized view |
| Long-running workflow | Bisa dengan polling | Saga/event cocok |
| Strong consistency | Cocok dalam boundary service | Tidak global |
| Loose coupling | Sedang | Tinggi, jika contract baik |
| Backpressure | Caller langsung kena | Bisa buffer di Kafka |
| Operational complexity | Lebih sederhana | Lebih kompleks |

Rule praktis:

```text id="sync-async-rule"
Use REST for asking/commanding now.
Use events for announcing facts after they happen.
```

---

# 22. Failure Model by Pattern

| Pattern | Failure utama | Guardrail |
|---|---|---|
| Event notification | Consumer callback ke producer gagal | Retry/circuit breaker/fallback |
| Event-carried state | Payload/schema breaking | Schema compatibility |
| Transactional outbox | Duplicate publish | Idempotent consumer |
| CDC | Connector lag/failure | Connector monitoring/DLQ |
| Idempotent consumer | Dedup store gagal | DB constraint + transaction |
| Saga choreography | Flow tersebar | Correlation ID + tracing |
| Saga orchestration | Orchestrator bottleneck | HA, persistence, explicit state |
| CQRS projection | Stale/incorrect read model | Lag monitoring + replay |
| Event sourcing | Event evolution/privacy | Versioning/upcasting/policy |
| Replay | Duplicate side effects | Replay-safe handler |
| DLQ | Operational debt | Alert + triage workflow |

---

EDA tanpa observability akan sulit dioperasikan.

| Signal | Kenapa penting |
|---|---|
| `eventId` | Trace satu event |
| `correlationId` | Trace business flow |
| `causationId` | Trace event chain |
| `eventType` | Grouping by semantic |
| `eventVersion` | Detect bad rollout |
| Topic/partition/offset | Kafka-level debugging |
| Producer service/version | Ownership |
| Consumer group | Processing ownership |
| Processing latency | Bottleneck |
| Consumer lag | Backlog |
| Retry count | Transient failure |
| DLQ count | Permanent failure |
| Saga instance id | Workflow tracing |
| Projection freshness | Read model correctness |

Structured log example:

  ↓

Resource layer:
  knows ApplicationService

Domain layer:
  should not know Kafka

# 25. Common Anti-Patterns

| Anti-pattern | Dampak |
|---|---|
| Semua hal dibuat event-driven | Complexity naik tanpa manfaat |
| Event dipakai sebagai command tersembunyi | Semantik membingungkan |
| Publish entity/table langsung | Coupling tinggi dan privacy risk |
| Direct publish setelah DB commit tanpa outbox | Event loss window |
| Consumer tidak idempotent | Duplicate side effect |
| Tidak punya DLQ | Poison message menahan partition |
| DLQ tidak dimonitor | Masalah tersembunyi |
| Saga choreography untuk workflow kompleks | Event spaghetti |
| Orchestrator berisi semua domain logic | God service/process |
| CQRS tanpa replay tooling | Projection sulit diperbaiki |
| Event sourcing untuk CRUD sederhana | Complexity tidak sepadan |
| Replay event yang mengirim email/payment | Side effect ganda |
| Tidak ada correlation ID | Debugging distributed flow sulit |
| Tidak ada event ownership | Data swamp |
| Breaking schema tanpa compatibility | Consumer rusak |
| Mengandalkan global ordering Kafka | Salah asumsi |

| Observability | Event ID, correlation ID, lag, DLQ, saga status |
| Security | PII minimization, ACL, retention |

# 27. Practical Decision Guide

```text id="eda-decision-guide"
Need to update DB and publish event reliably?
  → Transactional Outbox

Need to publish DB changes without custom relay?
  → Outbox + CDC

Need consumer to update DB safely?
  → Idempotent Consumer

Need long-running distributed transaction?
  → Saga

Simple event reaction across services?
  → Saga Choreography

Complex/auditable workflow?
  → Saga Orchestration / Camunda

Need fast query/read model?
  → CQRS Projection

Need full audit and temporal state?
  → Event Sourcing, only if justified

Need rebuild read model?
  → Replay-safe Projection

Need transform/enrich/aggregate stream?
  → Kafka Streams / ksqlDB

Need immediate request/response?
  → REST, not Kafka event
```

# 28. Ringkasan Praktis

Untuk onboarding sebagai senior engineer, cara berpikir paling aman:

```text id="eda-summary"
Do not start from:
  "We use Kafka, so everything is an event."

Start from:
  "What consistency, ownership, timing, audit, and failure behavior does this business flow need?"
```

Pattern baseline yang paling sering benar untuk Java/Jersey + PostgreSQL + Kafka:

```text id="baseline-patterns"
1. REST command for immediate user/API intent
2. Local DB transaction for service-owned state
3. Transactional outbox for reliable event publication
4. Kafka integration event with stable contract
5. Idempotent consumer for downstream processing
6. Retry/DLQ for failure isolation
7. CQRS projection for read-optimized views
8. Saga orchestration only when workflow complexity demands it
```

Invariant utama:

```text id="eda-invariants"
Every event-driven flow must define:
  - source of truth
  - event owner
  - event contract
  - key/order semantics
  - delivery guarantee assumption
  - duplicate handling
  - retry/DLQ behavior
  - replay behavior
  - observability model
  - operational owner
```

# Cheatsheet - Transactional Outbox + CDC dengan PostgreSQL dan Kafka di Java/Jersey

## 1. Core Mental Model

**Transactional Outbox** menyelesaikan masalah klasik: service perlu **commit state ke PostgreSQL** dan **publish event ke Kafka** secara reliable tanpa distributed transaction / 2-phase commit.

```text id="outbox-core-model"
HTTP command
  ↓
Jersey Resource
  ↓
Application Service
  ↓
PostgreSQL transaction
  ├── update business table
  └── insert outbox_event
  ↓
commit
  ↓
Message relay:
  ├── Polling publisher
  └── CDC / transaction log tailing
  ↓
Kafka topic
  ↓
Idempotent consumers
```

Pattern ini tidak menjamin “exactly-once end-to-end”. Message relay tetap bisa publish event lebih dari sekali, misalnya crash setelah publish ke broker tetapi sebelum mencatat bahwa event sudah terkirim; karena itu consumer harus idempotent. ([microservices.io](https://microservices.io/patterns/data/transactional-outbox.html))

---

## 2. Problem yang Diselesaikan

Tanpa outbox, direct publish dari service sering punya failure window.

```text id="direct-publish-failure-windows"
Case A:
  DB commit success
  ↓
  service crash before Kafka publish
  ↓
  event hilang

Case B:
  Kafka publish success
  ↓
  DB transaction rollback
  ↓
  event menyatakan fakta yang tidak pernah commit

Case C:
  REST returns 201
  ↓
  Kafka callback fails later
  ↓
  client melihat sukses, downstream tidak menerima event
```

Transactional outbox mengubah masalah menjadi:

```text id="outbox-reframing"
DB commit contains:
  - business state
  - event-to-be-published

After commit:
  relay/CDC boleh retry sampai Kafka menerima event
```

---

## 3. Dua Implementasi Utama

| Implementasi | Cara kerja | Cocok untuk | Trade-off |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Polling Publisher** | Worker aplikasi membaca `outbox_event` status `PENDING`, publish ke Kafka, lalu mark `PUBLISHED` | Simpler, tidak butuh Kafka Connect/Debezium | Butuh worker, locking, retry, cleanup |
| **CDC / Transaction Log Tailing** | Debezium membaca perubahan table outbox dari PostgreSQL WAL/logical decoding lalu menulis ke Kafka | Platform mature, throughput tinggi, lebih sedikit custom relay code | Butuh Kafka Connect, replication slot, connector ops |

Microservices.io menyebut dua cara implementasi message relay untuk transactional outbox: **transaction log tailing** dan **polling publisher**. ([microservices.io](https://microservices.io/patterns/data/transactional-outbox.html))

---

## 4. PostgreSQL Outbox Schema

### Baseline schema untuk polling relay

```sql id="outbox-schema-polling"
CREATE TABLE outbox_event (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    aggregate_type  TEXT NOT NULL,
    aggregate_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_type      TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_version   INTEGER NOT NULL,
    topic           TEXT NOT NULL,
    partition_key   TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload         JSONB NOT NULL,
    headers         JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    status          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
    retry_count     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    next_attempt_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    locked_at       TIMESTAMPTZ,
    published_at    TIMESTAMPTZ,
    last_error       TEXT
);

CREATE INDEX idx_outbox_pending
ON outbox_event (status, next_attempt_at, created_at)
WHERE status = 'PENDING';

CREATE INDEX idx_outbox_aggregate_order
ON outbox_event (aggregate_type, aggregate_id, created_at, id);

CREATE INDEX idx_outbox_cleanup
ON outbox_event (status, published_at)
WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED';
```

### Field map

| Field | Fungsi |
|---|---|
| `id` | Event id global; dipakai untuk dedup consumer |
| `aggregate_type` | Entity/domain pemilik event, misalnya `Order`, `Case`, `Payment` |
| `aggregate_id` | ID aggregate; biasanya juga Kafka key |
| `event_type` | Semantic event, misalnya `OrderCreated` |
| `event_version` | Version contract |
| `topic` | Target Kafka topic |
| `partition_key` | Kafka record key |
| `payload` | Event envelope/payload yang akan dikirim |
| `headers` | Kafka headers: correlation id, causation id, tenant id, schema info |
| `status` | `PENDING`, `PUBLISHED`, `FAILED`, `DISCARDED` |
| `retry_count` | Jumlah retry relay |
| `next_attempt_at` | Backoff scheduling |
| `published_at` | Audit publish success |
| `last_error` | Error terakhir untuk troubleshooting |

---

## 5. Schema Alternatif untuk Debezium Outbox Event Router

Debezium punya **Outbox Event Router SMT** yang membaca table outbox lalu merutekan event ke topic Kafka. Debezium mendokumentasikan bahwa SMT ini mendukung arbitrary payload format dan meneruskan nilai kolom `payload` dari outbox table tanpa modifikasi; format umum payload adalah JSON dan Avro. ([Debezium](https://debezium.io/documentation/reference/stable/transformations/outbox-event-router.html))

Schema yang lebih dekat ke convention Debezium:

```sql id="outbox-schema-debezium"
CREATE TABLE outbox_event (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    aggregatetype   TEXT NOT NULL,
    aggregateid     TEXT NOT NULL,
    type            TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload         JSONB NOT NULL,
    timestamp       TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    traceid         TEXT,
    correlationid   TEXT,
    tenantid        TEXT
);
```

| Field | Mapping praktis |
|---|---|
| `id` | Event id / Kafka header |
| `aggregatetype` | Aggregate type |
| `aggregateid` | Kafka key / aggregate id |
| `type` | Event type |
| `payload` | Kafka value |
| `timestamp` | Event timestamp |
| `traceid` | Distributed tracing |
| `correlationid` | Business/request correlation |
| `tenantid` | Multi-tenant routing/audit |

Catatan: exact column names bisa dikonfigurasi di SMT, tetapi pilih satu convention dan jadikan contract internal.

## 6. Write Path di Java/Jersey

### Flow aplikasi

```text id="outbox-write-path"
POST /orders
  ↓
OrderResource
  ↓
OrderApplicationService.createOrder()
  ↓
DB transaction:
  - insert order
  - insert outbox_event(OrderCreated)
  ↓
commit
  ↓
return 201 Created
```

### Application service

```java id="outbox-application-service"
public final class OrderApplicationService {
    private final TransactionManager transaction;
    private final OrderRepository orderRepository;
    private final OutboxRepository outboxRepository;
    private final OrderEventMapper eventMapper;

    public OrderId createOrder(CreateOrderCommand command, RequestContext context) {
        return transaction.inTransaction(() -> {
            Order order = Order.create(command);
            orderRepository.save(order);

            IntegrationEvent event =
                    eventMapper.toOrderCreated(order, context);

            outboxRepository.insert(OutboxEvent.from(event));

            return order.id();
        });
    }
}
```

### Invariant penting

```text id="write-path-invariants"
Dalam satu DB transaction:
  business state harus commit bersama outbox event.

Jangan:
  update business table lalu publish Kafka langsung
  publish Kafka lalu commit DB
  insert outbox di transaction terpisah dari business update
```

---

## 7. Outbox Event Mapper

Outbox harus menyimpan **integration event contract**, bukan entity Java mentah.

```java id="integration-event-mapper-outbox"
public final class OrderEventMapper {
    public IntegrationEvent toOrderCreated(Order order, RequestContext context) {
        return new IntegrationEvent(
                UUID.randomUUID(),
                "OrderCreated",
                1,
                Instant.now(),
                "order-service",
                context.correlationId(),
                context.causationId(),
                context.tenantId(),
                "Order",
                order.id().value(),
                new OrderCreatedPayload(
                        order.id().value(),
                        order.customerId().value(),
                        order.status().name()
                )
        );
    }
}
```

### Outbox row construction

```java id="outbox-row-construction"
public static OutboxEvent from(IntegrationEvent event) {
    return new OutboxEvent(
            event.eventId(),
            event.aggregateType(),
            event.aggregateId(),
            event.eventType(),
            event.eventVersion(),
            "order.order.events.v1",
            event.aggregateId(),
            Json.encode(event),
            Map.of(
                    "event-id", event.eventId().toString(),
                    "event-type", event.eventType(),
                    "event-version", String.valueOf(event.eventVersion()),
                    "correlation-id", event.correlationId(),
                    "causation-id", event.causationId(),
                    "tenant-id", event.tenantId(),
                    "producer", event.producer()
            )
    );
}
```
