# Cheatsheet - Kafka Rebalancing & Consumer Group Deep Dive

## 1. Core Mental Model

**Consumer group** adalah sekumpulan consumer yang bekerja sama membaca satu atau lebih topic. Kafka membagi partition topic ke member dalam group; saat member masuk, keluar, crash, deployment, atau partition berubah, Kafka melakukan **rebalance** untuk membagi ulang ownership partition. Confluent menjelaskan bahwa satu broker menjadi **group coordinator** untuk group, mengelola member dan partition assignment; coordinator dipilih dari leader partition internal topic `__consumer_offsets`. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/clients/consumer.html))

```text id="consumer-group-core"
Topic: order.order.events.v1
Partitions:
  p0 p1 p2 p3 p4 p5

Consumer group: order-projection-service
  consumer-A → p0, p1
  consumer-B → p2, p3
  consumer-C → p4, p5

If consumer-B leaves:
  rebalance
  p2,p3 reassigned to A/C
```

Rebalance bukan bug. Rebalance adalah mekanisme normal agar consumer group tetap berjalan ketika membership berubah. Yang perlu dihindari adalah **rebalance loop**, **unsafe offset commit**, dan **processing yang tidak idempotent**.

---

├── 1. Consumer Group Model
│   ├── group.id

│   └── assignment

├── 2. Partition Assignment

├── 3. Rebalance Triggers

│
├── 4. Offset Lifecycle
│   ├── position

    ├── lag diagnosis

## 3. Consumer Group Basic

| Concept | Meaning | Praktisnya |
|---|---|---|
| `group.id` | Identitas consumer group | Semua instance dengan group sama berbagi partition |
| Member | Satu consumer instance dalam group | Biasanya satu pod/thread consumer |
| Group coordinator | Broker yang mengelola group | Handle join, heartbeat, assignment, offset commit validation |
| Assignment | Mapping partition → member | Berubah saat rebalance |
| Generation / epoch | Versi membership/assignment group | Commit dari member lama bisa ditolak |
| Committed offset | Progress yang disimpan | Consumer baru lanjut dari sini |
| Position | Offset berikutnya yang akan dibaca consumer | Bisa berbeda dari committed offset |

Confluent menjelaskan bahwa saat consumer crash atau shutdown, partition-nya akan dipindahkan ke member lain, dan member baru mulai dari offset terakhir yang sudah committed; jika belum ada committed offset, consumer memakai policy `auto.offset.reset`. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/clients/consumer.html))

---

## 4. Consumer Group vs Manual Assignment

Ada dua cara membaca partition:

```text id="subscribe-vs-assign"
Dynamic assignment:
  consumer.subscribe(topics)
  → ikut consumer group
  → Kafka coordinator melakukan rebalance

Manual assignment:
  consumer.assign(partitions)
  → tidak memakai group coordination untuk assignment
  → tidak ada automatic rebalance saat consumer gagal
```

KafkaConsumer Javadoc menjelaskan bahwa manual assignment dengan `assign()` tidak memakai group coordination, sehingga consumer failure tidak menyebabkan partition otomatis di-rebalance; setiap consumer bertindak independen walaupun memakai `groupId` yang sama. Javadoc juga menegaskan tidak bisa mencampur manual partition assignment dengan dynamic assignment via `subscribe()`. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/25/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/KafkaConsumer.html))

| Mode | Use case | Risiko |
|---|---|---|
| `subscribe()` | Microservice normal dengan scaling/rebalance | Harus handle rebalance/offset |
| `assign()` | Tool replay, diagnostic, one-off partition reader | Tidak ada failover otomatis |
| Kafka Streams | Topology/stateful processing | Runtime manage assignment/task |
| ksqlDB | SQL stream processing | Managed by ksqlDB server |

Rule praktis:

```text id="subscribe-assign-rule"
Production consumer service:
  usually use subscribe()

Replay/admin tool:
  often use assign() + seek()
```

---

## 5. Rebalance Trigger

| Trigger | Contoh | Dampak |
|---|---|---|
| Consumer start | Pod baru naik | Group rebalance |
| Consumer stop clean | Rolling deploy | Partition dipindah |
| Consumer crash/OOM | Pod mati | Coordinator detect failure |
| Heartbeat timeout | Network pause / GC pause | Member dikeluarkan |
| `max.poll.interval.ms` exceeded | Handler terlalu lama | Consumer dianggap tidak progress |
| Topic partition count berubah | Partition ditambah | Assignment berubah |
| Subscription berubah | Consumer subscribe topic baru | Rebalance |
| Autoscaling | HPA/KEDA scale up/down | Group membership berubah |
| Deployment rolling | Pod old/new overlap | Rebalance selama rollout |

KafkaConsumer Javadoc menjelaskan bahwa `poll()` menjaga liveness consumer; selama consumer terus memanggil `poll()`, consumer tetap di group dan mengirim heartbeat. Kafka juga punya liveness detection dengan `max.poll.interval.ms`: jika consumer tidak memanggil `poll()` cukup sering, consumer meninggalkan group agar partition bisa diambil consumer lain. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/25/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/KafkaConsumer.html))

---

## 6. Offset Lifecycle

Offset yang sering tertukar:

```text id="offset-lifecycle"
Kafka partition:
  offset 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, ...

Consumer poll returns:
  records offset 10..19

Handler successfully processes:
  offset 10..19

Safe committed offset:
  20
```

Committed offset adalah **offset berikutnya** yang akan dibaca, bukan offset terakhir yang sudah diproses.

| Offset concept | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Record offset | Posisi record di partition |
| Current position | Offset berikutnya yang consumer akan ambil |
| Processed offset | Offset terakhir yang side effect-nya sukses |
| Committed offset | Offset berikutnya yang disimpan sebagai progress |
| Log end offset | Offset akhir partition saat ini |
| Lag | `logEndOffset - committedOffset` |

---

## 7. Auto Commit vs Manual Commit

Confluent menjelaskan bahwa consumer default-nya memakai auto-commit, tetapi manual commit memberi kontrol lebih; untuk memakai commit API langsung, `enable.auto.commit=false`. Auto-commit bisa memberi at-least-once jika semua record dari `poll()` selesai diproses sebelum `poll()` berikutnya atau sebelum close; jika processing belum selesai saat auto-commit terjadi, ada risiko progress dianggap selesai padahal side effect belum aman. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/clients/consumer.html))

| Mode | Cocok untuk | Risiko |
|---|---|---|
| Auto commit | Demo, simple read-only, low-risk | Commit bisa terjadi sebelum processing aman |
| Manual commit per batch | Business consumer umum | Duplicate jika crash sebelum commit |
| Manual commit per record | Safety lebih granular | Overhead tinggi |
| External offset store | Atomic side effect + offset di DB yang sama | Lebih kompleks |
| Kafka transaction offset commit | Kafka-to-Kafka exactly-once | Tidak otomatis untuk DB/API side effect |

### Baseline config untuk business consumer

```properties id="consumer-manual-commit-config"
enable.auto.commit=false
group.id=order-projection-service
auto.offset.reset=earliest
max.poll.records=200
max.poll.interval.ms=300000
```

---

## 8. Delivery Semantics dari Commit Timing

```text id="commit-timing"
Commit before processing
  → at-most-once
  → risk data loss

Process then commit
  → at-least-once
  → duplicate possible

Process idempotently then commit
  → effectively-once at application boundary
```

| Pattern | Result | Kapan dipakai |
|---|---|---|
| Commit before process | Data loss possible | Hampir tidak untuk event bisnis |
| Process then commit | Duplicate possible | Default aman jika idempotent |
| DB transaction + processed_event + commit | Practical reliable consumer | Business/projection handler |
| Store offset in same DB transaction | Stronger atomicity | Projection DB owned by consumer |

KafkaConsumer Javadoc menyebut aplikasi dapat menyimpan offset di external store, dan primary use case-nya adalah menyimpan hasil consumption dan offset dalam sistem yang sama secara atomik; ini bisa memberi semantic yang lebih kuat daripada at-least-once default dari Kafka offset commit. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/25/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/KafkaConsumer.html))

---

## 9. ConsumerRebalanceListener

`ConsumerRebalanceListener` memberi callback saat partition akan dicabut, diberikan, atau sudah hilang.

```java id="rebalance-listener-skeleton"
consumer.subscribe(
        List.of("order.order.events.v1"),
        new ConsumerRebalanceListener() {
            @Override
            public void onPartitionsRevoked(Collection<TopicPartition> partitions) {
                commitSafeOffsetsFor(partitions);
                cleanupPartitionState(partitions);
            }

            @Override
            public void onPartitionsAssigned(Collection<TopicPartition> partitions) {
                initializePartitionState(partitions);
            }

            @Override
            public void onPartitionsLost(Collection<TopicPartition> partitions) {
                discardUnsafeState(partitions);
            }
        }
);
```

Kafka Javadoc menyatakan `onPartitionsRevoked` dipanggil saat consumer harus melepas partition dan direkomendasikan untuk commit offset dalam callback ini agar duplicate data dapat dicegah. Dalam cooperative rebalancing, callback revoked hanya dipanggil untuk subset partition yang benar-benar dicabut jika subset tersebut tidak kosong. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/26/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/ConsumerRebalanceListener.html))

---

## 10. Revoked vs Lost vs Assigned

| Callback | Kapan | Apa yang aman dilakukan |
|---|---|---|
| `onPartitionsRevoked` | Partition akan dicabut secara normal | Commit safe offsets, cleanup state |
| `onPartitionsAssigned` | Partition baru diberikan | Init state, seek custom offset jika perlu |
| `onPartitionsLost` | Partition sudah hilang tanpa revoke normal | Jangan commit offset yang mungkin bukan milikmu; cleanup only |

Kafka Javadoc menjelaskan `onPartitionsAssigned` dipanggil setelah reassignment sukses dan sebelum consumer mulai fetch data; `onPartitionsLost` dipakai saat partition sudah direassign ke consumer lain, misalnya session timeout atau fatal error, dan default implementation memanggil `onPartitionsRevoked`, tetapi user dapat override untuk membedakan handling revoked vs lost. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/26/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/ConsumerRebalanceListener.html))

---

## 11. Safe Rebalance Listener untuk Manual Commit

```java id="safe-rebalance-listener"
public final class SafeRebalanceListener implements ConsumerRebalanceListener {
    private final KafkaConsumer<String, String> consumer;
    private final OffsetTracker offsetTracker;

    public SafeRebalanceListener(
            KafkaConsumer<String, String> consumer,
            OffsetTracker offsetTracker
    ) {
        this.consumer = consumer;
        this.offsetTracker = offsetTracker;
    }

    @Override
    public void onPartitionsRevoked(Collection<TopicPartition> partitions) {
        Map<TopicPartition, OffsetAndMetadata> offsets =
                offsetTracker.safeOffsetsFor(partitions);

        if (!offsets.isEmpty()) {
            consumer.commitSync(offsets);
        }

        offsetTracker.clear(partitions);
    }

    @Override
    public void onPartitionsAssigned(Collection<TopicPartition> partitions) {
        offsetTracker.initialize(partitions);
    }

    @Override
    public void onPartitionsLost(Collection<TopicPartition> partitions) {
        // Do not commit here unless you are absolutely sure.
        // These partitions may already be owned by another consumer.
        offsetTracker.clear(partitions);
    }
}
```

Confluent Cloud consumer docs menjelaskan bahwa rebalance punya dua fase: partition revocation dan assignment; revocation adalah kesempatan terakhir untuk commit offset sebelum partition direassign. Pattern umum adalah async commits di poll loop dan synchronous commits saat rebalance atau shutdown. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/cloud/current/client-apps/consumer.html))

---

## 12. Commit Sync vs Async

| Commit | Kelebihan | Kekurangan | Cocok |
|---|---|---|---|
| `commitSync()` | Lebih aman; tahu gagal/sukses | Blocking | Shutdown, rebalance, critical commit |
| `commitAsync()` | Lebih cepat | Failure callback harus hati-hati; order callback bisa tricky | Poll loop high-throughput |
| Async + sync on revoke | Balance | Lebih kompleks | Consumer high-throughput |

Confluent menjelaskan commit async secara umum kurang aman daripada sync; commit failure berturut-turut sebelum crash dapat meningkatkan duplicate processing. Salah satu mitigasi adalah menambahkan callback handling, occasional sync commit, atau sync commit saat rebalance/shutdown. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/cloud/current/client-apps/consumer.html))

### Practical baseline

```text id="commit-baseline"
Low/medium throughput business consumer:
  process batch
  commitSync safe offsets

High throughput projection:
  commitAsync in normal loop
  commitSync on rebalance and shutdown
```

---

## 13. OffsetTracker untuk Worker Pool

Jika processing parallel, jangan commit offset melewati gap.

```text id="offset-gap"
Partition p0:
  offset 100 done
  offset 101 still processing
  offset 102 done

Safe commit offset = 101
Not 103
```

### OffsetTracker concept

```java id="offset-tracker-concept"
public final class OffsetTracker {
    private final Map<TopicPartition, Long> highestContiguousCompleted = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<TopicPartition, NavigableSet<Long>> completedOutOfOrder = new HashMap<>();

    public void markCompleted(TopicPartition partition, long offset) {
        long current = highestContiguousCompleted.getOrDefault(partition, -1L);

        if (offset == current + 1) {
            current = offset;

            NavigableSet<Long> outOfOrder =
                    completedOutOfOrder.getOrDefault(partition, new TreeSet<>());

            while (outOfOrder.remove(current + 1)) {
                current++;
            }

            highestContiguousCompleted.put(partition, current);
        } else if (offset > current + 1) {
            completedOutOfOrder
                    .computeIfAbsent(partition, ignored -> new TreeSet<>())
                    .add(offset);
        }
    }

    public Map<TopicPartition, OffsetAndMetadata> safeOffsets() {
        return highestContiguousCompleted.entrySet().stream()
                .collect(Collectors.toMap(
                        Map.Entry::getKey,
                        e -> new OffsetAndMetadata(e.getValue() + 1)
                ));
    }
}
```

Rule:

```text id="worker-pool-offset-rule"
Parallel processing boleh.
Parallel unsafe commit tidak boleh.

Commit hanya contiguous completed offset per partition.
```

---

## 14. Partition Assignment Strategies

Kafka classic consumer punya beberapa assignor umum:

| Assignor | Behavior | Kapan berguna |
|---|---|---|
| `RangeAssignor` | Assign per topic dengan range partition | Default lama; bisa imbalance multi-topic |
| `RoundRobinAssignor` | Round-robin partition ke consumer | Distribusi lebih merata |
| `StickyAssignor` | Seimbang sambil mempertahankan assignment lama | Kurangi movement |
| `CooperativeStickyAssignor` | Sticky + incremental cooperative rebalance | Rolling deploy lebih halus |

Apache Kafka consumer configs menjelaskan `StickyAssignor` bertujuan memberi assignment yang seimbang sambil mempertahankan sebanyak mungkin assignment yang ada; config yang sama juga mencantumkan `RangeAssignor`, `RoundRobinAssignor`, dan assignment strategy lain untuk classic protocol. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/41/configuration/consumer-configs/))

### Config classic cooperative

```properties id="cooperative-sticky-config"
partition.assignment.strategy=org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.CooperativeStickyAssignor
```

---

## 15. Eager vs Cooperative Rebalance

```text id="eager-vs-cooperative"
Eager rebalance:
  revoke all partitions
  stop all consumers briefly
  assign new partitions

Cooperative rebalance:
  revoke only partitions that need to move
  keep unaffected partitions running
  incremental movement
```

Apache Kafka 4.0 GA “Next Generation Consumer Rebalance Protocol” memperkenalkan rebalance yang fully incremental dan tidak lagi bergantung pada global synchronization barrier; dokumen Kafka juga membedakan `Consumer` groups dengan protocol baru dan `Classic` groups dengan protocol lama. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/41/operations/consumer-rebalance-protocol/))

| Mode | Kelebihan | Kekurangan |
|---|---|---|
| Eager | Simple mental model | Stop-the-world, lebih disruptive |
| Cooperative | Lebih sedikit partition movement | Listener/cleanup harus siap partial revoke |
| New consumer protocol | Broker-driven, incremental | Pastikan client/platform mendukung dan config sesuai |

---

## 16. Kafka 4.x Consumer Rebalance Protocol Note

Mulai Apache Kafka 4.0, next-generation consumer rebalance protocol dari KIP-848 berstatus GA; protocol ini memindahkan lebih banyak koordinasi assignment ke broker, meningkatkan scalability consumer group, dan mengurangi rebalance time karena desain incremental. Broker mengontrol heartbeat/session timeout consumer protocol lewat config seperti `group.consumer.heartbeat.interval.ms` dan `group.consumer.session.timeout.ms`, dan server-side assignor dikontrol dengan `group.consumer.assignors`. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/41/operations/consumer-rebalance-protocol/))

```text id="kafka-4-consumer-protocol"
Classic protocol:
  client-side assignment strategy
  partition.assignment.strategy
  eager/cooperative behavior depends on assignor

Consumer protocol:
  broker-side coordination
  server-side assignor
  group.remote.assignor optional on client
```

Consumer config docs menjelaskan `group.remote.assignor` berlaku hanya jika `group.protocol=consumer`; jika tidak dispesifikkan, group coordinator memilih assignor pertama dari broker config `group.consumer.assignors`. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/41/configuration/consumer-configs/))

Praktisnya: **cek versi Kafka client, broker, dan platform policy** sebelum mengubah protocol/assignor. Di banyak enterprise, tim platform menentukan rebalance protocol standar.

---

## 17. Static Membership

Static membership memakai `group.instance.id`, yaitu identifier unik consumer instance. Jika diset, consumer diperlakukan sebagai static member; ini bisa dipakai bersama session timeout yang lebih besar untuk menghindari rebalance akibat transient unavailability seperti process restart. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/41/configuration/consumer-configs/))

```properties id="static-membership-config"
group.instance.id=${HOSTNAME}
```

Di Kubernetes, `HOSTNAME` biasanya nama pod; untuk Deployment biasa, pod name berubah saat recreate, sehingga static membership bisa terbatas manfaatnya. Untuk StatefulSet, identity pod lebih stabil.

| Workload | Static membership fit |
|---|---|
| StatefulSet consumer | Cocok |
| Kafka Streams with stable instance identity | Bisa berguna |
| Deployment ephemeral pod names | Hati-hati |
| Autoscaling frequent | Kurang cocok jika identity sering berubah |
| Long GC/restart short | Bisa mengurangi unnecessary reassignment |

### Static membership risk

| Risiko | Penjelasan |
|---|---|
| Duplicate `group.instance.id` | Hanya satu instance dengan ID itu boleh di group |
| Stale member | Partition reassignment bisa tertunda sampai session timeout |
| Kubernetes Deployment identity tidak stabil | Tidak selalu mengurangi rebalance |
| Misconfigured ID reused | Member saling fence |

---

## 18. `max.poll.interval.ms`

`max.poll.interval.ms` default 300000ms atau 5 menit. Jika consumer tidak memanggil `poll()` sebelum timeout, consumer dianggap gagal dan group melakukan rebalance; jika consumer memakai non-null `group.instance.id`, partition tidak langsung direassign pada timeout ini, consumer berhenti heartbeat, lalu partition direassign setelah session timeout. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/41/configuration/consumer-configs/))

### Sizing formula

```text id="max-poll-formula"
max.poll.records * p99_record_processing_time
  < max.poll.interval.ms * safety_factor
```

Contoh:

```text id="max-poll-example"
max.poll.records = 200
p99 processing = 500ms

batch p99 ≈ 100s

max.poll.interval.ms = 300s
→ safe-ish, but watch downstream spikes
```

Jika handler bisa 3 detik/record:

```text id="max-poll-bad-example"
200 * 3s = 600s
> 300s
→ risk: max.poll.interval exceeded
→ reduce max.poll.records or redesign processing
```

---

## 19. `session.timeout.ms` dan Heartbeat

Confluent menjelaskan tiap member group harus mengirim heartbeat ke coordinator agar tetap menjadi member; jika heartbeat tidak diterima sebelum session timeout, coordinator mengeluarkan member dan reassign partition. Menaikkan `session.timeout.ms` dapat menghindari excessive rebalancing akibat network buruk atau GC pause panjang, tetapi coordinator lebih lama mendeteksi consumer crash. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/clients/consumer.html))

| Config | Efek |
|---|---|
| `session.timeout.ms` | Deteksi member mati |
| `heartbeat.interval.ms` | Frekuensi heartbeat classic protocol |
| Terlalu kecil | False failure / rebalance sering |
| Terlalu besar | Failover lambat |
| GC pause panjang | Bisa membuat heartbeat missed |
| CPU throttling | Bisa mengganggu poll/heartbeat |

---

## 20. `auto.offset.reset`

`auto.offset.reset` dipakai saat tidak ada committed offset valid untuk partition, misalnya group baru atau offset sudah expired/out-of-range. Confluent consumer docs menyebut saat group pertama dibuat dan belum ada message dikonsumsi, posisi awal ditentukan oleh offset reset policy; biasanya mulai dari earliest atau latest. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/clients/consumer.html))

| Value | Meaning | Cocok |
|---|---|---|
| `earliest` | Mulai dari offset paling awal tersedia | Projection/replay/onboarding consumer |
| `latest` | Mulai dari record baru setelah subscribe | Real-time only, tidak butuh historical |
| `none` | Error jika tidak ada offset | Strict control |

Rule:

```text id="auto-offset-reset-rule"
auto.offset.reset is not a replay button.
It only applies when there is no valid committed offset.
```

---

## 21. Rolling Deployment Impact

```text id="rolling-rebalance"
Kubernetes rolling deploy:
  new pod starts
  → joins consumer group
  → rebalance

old pod terminates
  → leaves consumer group
  → rebalance
```

| Deployment behavior | Rebalance impact |
|---|---|
| `maxUnavailable=0` | Capacity preserved, but extra join rebalance |
| Large `maxSurge` | Many joins, more rebalance churn |
| Pod killed before close | Coordinator waits/session timeout |
| Graceful close | Faster clean group leave |
| Cooperative assignor | Less partition movement |
| Static membership | Can reduce churn for stable identities |

### Deployment guardrails

```text id="rolling-guardrails"
- readiness DOWN before shutdown
- consumer.wakeup() on SIGTERM
- commit safe offsets on revoke/shutdown
- consumer.close() cleanly
- avoid aggressive HPA during rollout
- monitor rebalance_total, lag, duplicate_event_total
```

---

## 22. Kubernetes Shutdown Pattern

```text id="consumer-shutdown-k8s"
SIGTERM
  ↓
readiness DOWN
  ↓
consumer.close requested
  ↓
consumer.wakeup breaks poll()
  ↓
finish safe processing
  ↓
commit safe offsets
  ↓
close consumer
  ↓
group coordinator sees member leave
  ↓
rebalance
```

KafkaConsumer Javadoc menyatakan `wakeup()` adalah satu-satunya method yang aman dipanggil dari thread lain untuk menginterupsi consumer; jika tidak ada thread yang blocking, `WakeupException` akan dilempar pada operasi berikutnya. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/25/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/KafkaConsumer.html))

---

## 23. Pause / Resume During Backpressure

`pause()` / `resume()` dapat digunakan untuk menghentikan fetch partition sementara tanpa keluar dari group. Ini berguna saat DB/downstream lambat, tetapi consumer tetap harus memanggil `poll()` untuk menjaga liveness.

```java id="pause-resume-example"
if (dbPool.isSaturated()) {
    consumer.pause(consumer.assignment());
}

consumer.poll(Duration.ofMillis(500)); // keep heartbeat/poll loop alive

if (dbPool.isHealthy()) {
    consumer.resume(consumer.paused());
}
```

Rule:

```text id="pause-resume-rule"
Pause is not shutdown.
Keep polling.
Resume when downstream healthy.
Monitor paused duration.
```

---

## 24. Rebalance Listener + Pause/Resume Caution

Jika partition sedang dipause lalu direvoke, state pause lokal harus dibersihkan.

```java id="pause-state-cleanup"
@Override
public void onPartitionsRevoked(Collection<TopicPartition> partitions) {
    commitSafeOffsetsFor(partitions);
    pausedPartitions.removeAll(partitions);
    offsetTracker.clear(partitions);
}
```

Dalam cooperative rebalance, hanya sebagian partition bisa direvoke; jangan clear seluruh state global jika masih ada partition yang tetap dimiliki. Kafka Javadoc menegaskan bahwa dalam cooperative rebalancing, `onPartitionsRevoked` dipanggil pada set partition yang dicabut saja jika set tersebut tidak kosong. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/26/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/ConsumerRebalanceListener.html))

---

## 25. Lag vs Rebalance

Rebalance dapat menyebabkan lag sementara karena consumer berhenti atau sebagian partition berpindah.

```text id="lag-rebalance-pattern"
Deploy starts
  ↓
consumer joins/leaves
  ↓
rebalance
  ↓
processing paused briefly
  ↓
lag rises
  ↓
assignment stabilizes
  ↓
lag drains
```

| Lag pattern | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Spike saat deploy lalu turun | Normal |
| Spike setiap beberapa menit | Rebalance loop |
| Lag satu partition tinggi | Hot key/slow partition |
| Lag semua partition tinggi | Capacity/bottleneck |
| Lag naik + DLQ naik | Processing/contract failure |
| Lag naik + rebalance naik | Group instability |
| Lag naik + DB latency naik | Downstream bottleneck |

---

## 26. Rebalance Loop Symptoms

```text id="rebalance-loop-symptoms"
Signs:
  - rebalance_total increases continuously
  - partitions assigned/revoked repeatedly in logs
  - lag sawtooth pattern
  - duplicate_event_total increases
  - commit failures increase
  - max.poll.interval exceeded logs
  - pods restart or readiness flaps
```

### Common causes

| Cause | Signal |
|---|---|
| Handler too slow | `max.poll.interval.ms` exceeded |
| DB/API hang | Processing p99 huge |
| Pod restart/OOM | Kubernetes restart count |
| CPU throttling | High throttling + poll delay |
| Liveness too aggressive | Restart storm |
| HPA flapping | Replica count oscillates |
| Bad shutdown | Session timeout wait |
| Assignment strategy mismatch | Unexpected full revokes |
| Long GC pause | Heartbeat/session miss |
| Consumer thread blocked | No poll progress |

---

## 27. Debugging Rebalance Loop Runbook

```text id="rebalance-debug-runbook"
Rebalance loop detected
  ↓
1. Check deployment/HPA timeline
  ↓
2. Check pod restarts and OOMKilled
  ↓
3. Check consumer logs:
     assigned/revoked/lost partitions
     CommitFailedException
     max.poll.interval exceeded
  ↓
4. Compare processing p99 vs max.poll.interval.ms
  ↓
5. Check DB/downstream latency
  ↓
6. Check CPU throttling / GC pauses
  ↓
7. Check assignment strategy/protocol
  ↓
8. Reduce max.poll.records or fix handler bottleneck
  ↓
9. Improve graceful shutdown / cooperative assignor / static membership if suitable
```

### Evidence to collect

```text id="rebalance-evidence"
- group.id
- client.id
- member id / group.instance.id
- pod name
- topic partitions
- assigned/revoked logs
- commit failures
- processing latency p99
- max.poll.records
- max.poll.interval.ms
- session.timeout.ms
- deployment timestamps
- pod restart reason
```

---

## 28. CommitFailedException

`CommitFailedException` often means the consumer is no longer an active owner of the partition it tries to commit. KafkaConsumer Javadoc explains that if `max.poll.interval.ms` is exceeded, `commitSync()` may throw `CommitFailedException`; this safety mechanism ensures only active group members commit offsets. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/25/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/KafkaConsumer.html))

| Cause | Meaning | Action |
|---|---|---|
| Max poll interval exceeded | Processing too slow | Reduce batch/tune handler |
| Partition revoked before commit | Rebalance occurred | Commit in revoke callback |
| Consumer fenced/lost ownership | Member no longer valid | Don’t force commit; rely on idempotency |
| Shutdown race | Commit after close/revoke | Fix shutdown ordering |
| Worker pool commits unsafe | Tracking bug | Commit contiguous offsets only |

---

## 29. Safe Consumer Poll Loop

```java id="safe-consumer-poll-loop"
public final class OrderConsumerWorker implements Runnable, AutoCloseable {
    private final KafkaConsumer<String, String> consumer;
    private final AtomicBoolean closed = new AtomicBoolean(false);
    private final OffsetTracker offsets;

    @Override
    public void run() {
        try {
            consumer.subscribe(
                    List.of("order.order.events.v1"),
                    new SafeRebalanceListener(consumer, offsets)
            );

            while (!closed.get()) {
                ConsumerRecords<String, String> records =
                        consumer.poll(Duration.ofMillis(1000));

                for (ConsumerRecord<String, String> record : records) {
                    handle(record);
                    offsets.markProcessed(record);
                }

                Map<TopicPartition, OffsetAndMetadata> safe = offsets.safeOffsets();

                if (!safe.isEmpty()) {
                    consumer.commitSync(safe);
                }
            }
        } catch (WakeupException e) {
            if (!closed.get()) {
                throw e;
            }
        } finally {
            try {
                Map<TopicPartition, OffsetAndMetadata> safe = offsets.safeOffsets();
                if (!safe.isEmpty()) {
                    consumer.commitSync(safe);
                }
            } finally {
                consumer.close(Duration.ofSeconds(10));
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        closed.set(true);
        consumer.wakeup();
    }
}
```

---

## 30. Threading Rule

`KafkaConsumer` tidak thread-safe. Pattern aman:

```text id="consumer-threading-rule"
One KafkaConsumer instance
  owned by exactly one thread.

Other threads may request shutdown via wakeup().
```

KafkaConsumer Javadoc menyatakan consumer tidak thread-safe dan akses unsynchronized akan menyebabkan `ConcurrentModificationException`; satu exception adalah `wakeup()`, yang aman dipakai dari thread eksternal untuk menginterupsi operasi aktif. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/25/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/KafkaConsumer.html))

### Safe models

| Model | Safe? | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| One consumer, one poll thread | Ya | Simpler |
| Multiple consumers, one per thread | Ya | Common scale-up |
| One consumer shared across workers | Tidak | Unsafe |
| Poll thread dispatch to worker pool | Bisa | Offset tracking complex |
| Shutdown thread calls `wakeup()` | Ya | Recommended |

---

## 31. Worker Pool Rebalance Pattern

```text id="worker-pool-rebalance"
Poll thread:
  poll records
  dispatch records to workers
  track in-flight by partition/offset

On partition revoked:
  stop dispatch for revoked partitions
  wait bounded time for in-flight records
  commit contiguous completed offsets
  cancel/retry remaining
  clear partition state
```

| Decision | Safer default |
|---|---|
| Wait forever for in-flight? | No, bounded wait |
| Commit completed out-of-order? | Only contiguous |
| Continue processing revoked partition? | Avoid side effects if ownership lost |
| Duplicate possible? | Yes, use idempotency |
| Partition lost? | Do not commit; cleanup only |

---

## 32. Rebalance-safe Idempotency

Karena rebalance bisa menyebabkan duplicate, consumer handler harus idempotent.

```sql id="processed-event-rebalance"
CREATE TABLE processed_event (
    event_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    aggregate_id TEXT,
    processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
```

```text id="rebalance-duplicate-window"
Consumer processes event
  ↓
DB commit success
  ↓
Rebalance before offset commit
  ↓
Another consumer reads same event
  ↓
Idempotency table prevents duplicate side effect
```

Rule:

```text id="rebalance-idempotency-rule"
Offset management reduces duplicates.
Idempotency makes duplicates safe.
```

---

## 33. Consumer Group Scaling Rules

```text id="consumer-scaling-rules"
Useful active consumers <= total partitions subscribed.

If consumers > partitions:
  extra consumers stay idle.

If partitions > consumers:
  each consumer owns multiple partitions.
```

| Scenario | Interpretation |
|---|---|
| 6 partitions, 3 consumers | ~2 partitions each |
| 6 partitions, 6 consumers | ~1 partition each |
| 6 partitions, 10 consumers | 4 idle |
| Multi-topic subscription | Assignment balance depends on assignor |
| Hot partition | Scaling consumers may not help |

---

## 34. Multi-topic Subscription Caveat

If one consumer group subscribes to multiple topics, assignment strategy matters.

```text id="multi-topic-assignment"
topics:
  orders: 12 partitions
  payments: 3 partitions

group:
  6 consumers
```

| Assignor | Possible concern |
|---|---|
| Range | Can imbalance by topic |
| RoundRobin | More even but more movement |
| Sticky | Balance + preserve old assignment |
| CooperativeSticky | Incremental movement |

Practical advice:

```text id="multi-topic-advice"
If workloads differ heavily:
  consider separate consumer groups/services per topic family.

If one handler processes multiple event types:
  monitor lag by topic-partition, not only total lag.
```

---

| Metric | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `rebalance_total` | Number of rebalances |
| `partition_assigned_total` | Assignment count |
| `partition_revoked_total` | Revocation count |
| `partition_lost_total` | Lost partition count |
| `rebalance_duration_ms` | Time spent rebalance |
| `last_rebalance_at` | Recent churn |
| `commit_failed_total` | Commit safety issues |
| `last_successful_poll_age_seconds` | Poll loop health |
| `consumer_lag` | Backlog |
| `duplicate_event_total` | Impact of reprocessing |

## 36. Alerting

| Alert | Condition | Action |
|---|---|---|
| Rebalance loop | Rebalance count high without deploy | Check poll interval/restarts/HPA |
| Lost partitions | `partition_lost_total > 0` | Investigate session timeout/fatal errors |
| Commit failures | Commit failures increasing | Check ownership/poll interval |
| Last poll age high | Consumer not polling | Thread dump/downstream |
| Lag + rebalance high | Group unstable | Rebalance runbook |
| Duplicate spike | Duplicate event count rises | Check commit/rebalance/outbox |
| Idle consumers | Consumers > partitions | Scale down or increase partitions |
| Hot partition lag | Max partition lag >> average | Key strategy review |

---

## 37. Kubernetes Deployment Best Practices

| Practice | Why |
|---|---|
| `terminationGracePeriodSeconds` large enough | Finish safe work |
| readiness DOWN on shutdown | Stop new traffic |
| `consumer.wakeup()` | Break poll loop |
| `consumer.close()` | Leave group cleanly |
| `maxUnavailable=0` for critical consumers | Avoid capacity drop |
| Avoid aggressive autoscaling | Prevent rebalance churn |
| Monitor pod restarts | Restart = rebalance |
| Tune CPU limits | CPU throttling can affect poll/heartbeat |
| Consider cooperative assignor | Reduce partition movement |
| Consider static membership carefully | Stable identity only |

---

## 38. Rebalance Testing Strategy

| Test | Expected |
|---|---|
| Partition revoked after processing | Safe offset committed |
| Partition revoked with in-flight gap | Commit only contiguous offset |
| Partition lost | No unsafe commit |
| Shutdown during poll | `wakeup()` exits loop |
| Duplicate after rebalance | Idempotency prevents double side effect |
| Slow handler | Test max.poll risk |
| Worker pool out-of-order | Offset tracker safe |
| Rolling deploy simulation | Lag spike drains |

### MockConsumer test idea

```java id="rebalance-test-idea"
@Test
void shouldCommitSafeOffsetsOnRevocation() {
    // Setup MockConsumer with partition assignment
    // Add records
    // Process first records
    // Trigger rebalance/revoke
    // Assert commit offset = last contiguous processed + 1
}
```

---

## 39. Common Anti-Patterns

| Anti-pattern | Dampak |
|---|---|
| Auto commit untuk DB side effect | Data loss risk |
| Commit offset sebelum processing | At-most-once, possible loss |
| Worker pool tanpa offset tracker | Commit melewati gap |
| Ignore `onPartitionsRevoked` | Duplicate lebih banyak |
| Commit in `onPartitionsLost` sembarangan | Bisa overwrite ownership |
| Handler terlalu lama tapi `max.poll.records` besar | Rebalance loop |
| Consumer shared across threads | Race/ConcurrentModification |
| Liveness restart saat Kafka transient | Rebalance storm |
| HPA flapping berdasarkan lag kecil | Rebalance churn |
| Consumers > partitions | Idle pods |
| No graceful shutdown | Session timeout + duplicates |
| No idempotency | Duplicate side effects |
| Treat lag spike during deploy as always incident | Noise |
| Increase partitions tanpa key/order review | Ordering surprise |

---

## 40. Production Readiness Checklist

| Area | Checklist |
|---|---|
| `group.id` | Unique, owned, documented |
| Assignment | Strategy/protocol known |
| Commit | `enable.auto.commit=false` for business processing |
| Offset tracker | Safe per partition |
| Rebalance listener | Revoked/assigned/lost handled |
| Idempotency | `eventId` dedup or business constraint |
| Processing time | p99 fits `max.poll.interval.ms` |
| Batch size | `max.poll.records` safe |
| Shutdown | `wakeup()`, safe commit, `close()` |
| Kubernetes | graceful period and readiness down |
| Scaling | replicas <= useful partitions |
| Static membership | only if identity stable |
| Cooperative rebalance | considered/tested |
| Observability | rebalance/lag/commit failure metrics |
| Runbook | rebalance loop documented |
| Tests | revocation/lost/shutdown/duplicate tests |

---

## 41. Quick Decision Guide

```text id="rebalance-quick-guide"
Need simple business consumer?
  → subscribe(), manual commit, idempotent handler, commitSync safe offsets.

Seeing duplicate events?
  → Check crash/rebalance window; add/verify idempotency.

Seeing data loss?
  → Check commit before processing or auto-commit misuse.

Seeing rebalance loop?
  → Check max.poll.interval, pod restarts, DB latency, CPU throttling.

Consumer pods idle?
  → replicas > partitions or assignment imbalance.

Lag after deployment?
  → Normal if temporary; incident if continues rising or rebalance loops.

Need less disruptive rollout?
  → graceful shutdown, cooperative assignor/protocol, static membership if stable.

Using worker pool?
  → commit only contiguous completed offsets per partition.
```

---

## 42. Ringkasan Praktis

Rebalancing adalah mekanisme normal Kafka untuk membagi partition ke consumer group. Yang membuatnya berbahaya adalah offset commit yang salah, handler tidak idempotent, shutdown tidak graceful, atau processing yang terlalu lama.

```text id="rebalance-summary"
Consumer group stability depends on:
  - regular poll loop
  - heartbeat/session health
  - safe offset commit
  - idempotent processing
  - correct rebalance callbacks
  - graceful deployment/shutdown
  - partition-aware scaling
```

Invariant utama:

```text id="rebalance-invariants"
1. Satu partition hanya dimiliki satu consumer dalam satu group pada satu waktu.
2. Ordering hanya dijamin dalam partition.
3. Committed offset adalah offset berikutnya yang akan dibaca.
4. Commit offset hanya setelah side effect aman.
5. Rebalance bisa menyebabkan duplicate; idempotency wajib.
6. `onPartitionsRevoked` adalah kesempatan commit sebelum partition pindah.
7. `onPartitionsLost` bukan tempat aman untuk commit sembarangan.
8. Consumer harus terus `poll()` agar tetap hidup di group.
9. Consumer tidak thread-safe; hanya `wakeup()` aman dari thread lain.
10. Scaling consumer dibatasi jumlah partition dan downstream capacity.
```

# Cheatsheet - Kafka Error Handling End-to-End dalam Java/Jersey Microservice

## 1. Core Mental Model

Kafka error handling bukan satu fitur tunggal. Error handling adalah desain **end-to-end** dari producer, broker, consumer, schema, retry, DLQ, replay, observability, dan recovery.

```text id="kafka-error-core"
Kafka Error Handling
│
├── Producer side
│   ├── serialization failure
│   ├── broker unavailable
│   ├── authorization failure
│   ├── timeout
│   ├── message too large
│   └── callback ignored
│
├── Broker / platform side
│   ├── topic missing
│   ├── ACL denied
│   ├── ISR/minISR issue
│   ├── quota throttling
│   └── retention/offset expired
│
├── Consumer side
│   ├── deserialization failure
│   ├── schema/contract failure
│   ├── business validation failure
│   ├── DB/API transient failure
│   ├── poison message
│   ├── rebalance/shutdown
│   └── duplicate processing
│
├── Recovery path
│   ├── retry inline
│   ├── retry topic
│   ├── DLQ
│   ├── quarantine table
│   ├── replay
│   └── manual intervention
│
└── Governance
    ├── failure classification
    ├── alerting
    ├── runbook
    ├── audit
    └── post-incident repair
```

Kafka producer config modern mengandalkan retry otomatis dan `delivery.timeout.ms` untuk membatasi total waktu delivery; dokumentasi Confluent menyarankan pengguna umumnya membiarkan `retries` tidak diset dan memakai `delivery.timeout.ms` untuk mengontrol retry behavior. Untuk producer idempotence, Kafka mensyaratkan konfigurasi yang kompatibel seperti `acks=all` dan retries lebih dari 0. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/installation/configuration/producer-configs.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

## 2. Error Classification

Sebelum menentukan retry/DLQ, klasifikasikan error.

| Class | Contoh | Retry? | Action |
|---|---|---:|---|
| **Serialization failure** | Object tidak bisa diubah ke JSON/Avro | Tidak | Fail fast, fix producer |
| **Deserialization failure** | Bad JSON, incompatible schema | Tidak biasanya | DLQ/quarantine |
| **Schema/contract failure** | Missing required field, unknown version | Tidak biasanya | DLQ, stop if critical |
| **Business permanent failure** | Invalid state transition | Tidak | Reject event / DLQ / audit |
| **Transient infrastructure** | DB timeout, broker timeout, HTTP 503 | Ya | Retry/backoff/retry topic |
| **Authorization/config failure** | ACL denied, topic missing | Tidak sampai config fix | Stop/fail fast/alert |
| **Capacity/backpressure** | DB pool exhausted, lag growing | Ya dengan throttle | Pause/resume, rate limit |
| **Code bug** | NPE, invariant violation | Tidak otomatis | Stop, alert, fix, replay |
| **Poison message** | Selalu gagal meski retry | Tidak setelah threshold | DLQ/quarantine |
| **Duplicate** | Same eventId reprocessed | Treat as success | Idempotency ledger |

Rule utama:

```text id="error-classification-rule"
Retry only when the same input is likely to succeed later.

Do not retry forever for:
  - bad schema
  - invalid payload
  - authorization failure
  - deterministic code bug
  - business permanent rejection
```

---

## 3. End-to-End Error Flow

```text id="end-to-end-error-flow"
Producer creates event
  ↓
Serialize
  ├── fail → producer bug / contract failure
  └── success
       ↓
Kafka send
  ├── fail retriable → producer retry / outbox retry
  ├── fail non-retriable → alert / failed outbox
  └── success
       ↓
Consumer poll
  ↓
Deserialize + validate
  ├── fail → DLQ / quarantine
  └── success
       ↓
Process business side effect
  ├── success → commit offset
  ├── duplicate → treat success → commit offset
  ├── transient fail → retry topic if published → commit original
  ├── permanent fail → DLQ if published → commit original
  └── fatal fail → stop, do not commit unsafe offset
```

Consumer offset management harus dipahami benar: auto-commit default melakukan commit periodik, sedangkan manual commit dengan `enable.auto.commit=false` memberi kontrol agar offset hanya dicommit setelah processing aman. Confluent menjelaskan dua setting utama offset management adalah `enable.auto.commit` dan `auto.offset.reset`; auto-commit default mengcommit offset secara periodik berdasarkan `auto.commit.interval.ms`. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/clients/consumer.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

# 4. Producer-Side Error Handling

## 4.1 Producer failure map

| Failure | Contoh exception / signal | Retriable? | Action |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Serialization error | JSON/Avro encode gagal | Tidak | Jangan send; fail fast |
| Broker timeout | `TimeoutException` | Ya | Retry by producer / outbox retry |
| Buffer full | `max.block.ms` exceeded | Ya/Capacity | Backpressure / outbox pending |
| Authorization denied | `TopicAuthorizationException` | Tidak | Stop/alert ACL |
| Topic missing | `UnknownTopicOrPartitionException` | Tidak biasanya | Provision topic / fail startup |
| Message too large | Record/request too large | Tidak langsung | Redesign payload |
| Invalid config | `ConfigException` | Tidak | Fail startup |
| Callback ignored | No exception handling | Operational bug | Add callback metrics/logs |
| Ack timeout | Delivery timeout | Ya, but bounded | Retry/outbox pending |

## 4.2 Async callback is mandatory

```java id="producer-callback-error-handling"
producer.send(record, (metadata, exception) -> {
    if (exception == null) {
        metrics.publishSuccess(record.topic());
        log.info("Kafka event published",
                kv("topic", metadata.topic()),
                kv("partition", metadata.partition()),
                kv("offset", metadata.offset()),
                kv("eventId", event.eventId()),
                kv("correlationId", event.correlationId()));
        return;
    }

    FailureClassification classification = producerFailureClassifier.classify(exception);

    metrics.publishFailure(record.topic(), classification.name());

    log.error("Kafka publish failed",
            kv("topic", record.topic()),
            kv("key", record.key()),
            kv("eventId", event.eventId()),
            kv("correlationId", event.correlationId()),
            kv("classification", classification.name()),
            kv("errorClass", exception.getClass().getSimpleName()),
            exception);

    if (classification.isFatal()) {
        fatalErrorHandler.handle(exception);
    }
});
```

## 4.3 Producer reliability baseline

```properties id="producer-error-baseline"
acks=all
enable.idempotence=true
delivery.timeout.ms=120000
request.timeout.ms=30000
linger.ms=5
compression.type=lz4
max.block.ms=5000
```

Producer idempotence membantu menghindari duplicate yang disebabkan oleh retry producer, tetapi tidak menyelesaikan semua duplicate end-to-end. Misalnya, transactional outbox relay tetap bisa publish duplicate jika crash setelah Kafka ack tetapi sebelum mark row `PUBLISHED`.

---

# 5. Outbox Error Handling

Untuk event bisnis penting, producer error handling sebaiknya tidak hanya bergantung pada callback request thread. Gunakan transactional outbox.

```text id="outbox-error-flow"
Business DB transaction
  ├── update business table
  └── insert outbox_event
  ↓
commit
  ↓
relay publishes to Kafka
  ├── success → mark PUBLISHED
  ├── retriable failure → retry_count + next_attempt_at
  └── non-retriable failure → FAILED + alert
```

## 5.1 Outbox failure table

| Failure | Action |
|---|---|
| Kafka timeout | Reschedule with backoff |
| Broker unavailable | Keep pending / retry |
| ACL denied | Mark failed or stop relay; alert |
| Topic missing | Mark failed / platform incident |
| Serialization bug | Mark failed; fix mapper |
| Message too large | Mark failed; redesign payload |
| Relay crash before publish | Lease expires; retry |
| Relay crash after publish before mark | Duplicate possible; consumer dedup required |
| DB markPublished fails | Retry mark; duplicate possible |

## 5.2 Reschedule query

```sql id="outbox-error-reschedule"
UPDATE outbox_event
SET retry_count = retry_count + 1,
    next_attempt_at = now() + (:backoff_seconds || ' seconds')::interval,
    locked_by = NULL,
    lock_until = NULL,
    last_error = :error_message
WHERE id = :id
  AND locked_by = :worker_id;
```

## 5.3 Mark failed

```sql id="outbox-error-mark-failed"
UPDATE outbox_event
SET status = 'FAILED',
    locked_by = NULL,
    lock_until = NULL,
    last_error = :error_message
WHERE id = :id
  AND locked_by = :worker_id;
```

## 5.4 Outbox invariant

```text id="outbox-error-invariant"
Never mark PUBLISHED before Kafka ack.
Never delete FAILED events without triage.
Always assume duplicate publication can happen.
Always require consumer idempotency.
```

---

# 6. Consumer-Side Error Handling

Consumer failure handling harus menjaga offset safety.

```text id="consumer-error-safe-flow"
poll records
  ↓
for each record:
  deserialize
  validate
  process in transaction
  classify failure
  publish retry/DLQ if needed
  commit offset only after safe outcome
```

## 6.1 Consumer failure map

| Failure | Example | Offset commit? | Action |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Success | DB/projection update success | Ya | Commit next offset |
| Duplicate event | `processed_event` conflict | Ya | Treat success |
| Bad JSON | Deserializer/parse failure | Ya only after DLQ success | DLQ/quarantine |
| Unknown schema version | Unsupported contract | Ya only after DLQ success | DLQ/stop depending policy |
| Business invalid | Permanent rule fail | Ya after rejected/DLQ audit | Rejected stream / DLQ |
| DB timeout | Transient | Ya only after retry event success | Retry topic |
| Downstream 503 | Transient | Ya only after retry event success | Retry/backoff |
| Code bug | NPE/invariant | Tidak | Stop consumer, alert |
| DLQ publish fails | Kafka issue | Tidak | Do not commit original |
| Retry publish fails | Kafka issue | Tidak | Do not commit original |

---

# 7. Deserialization & Schema Failure

## 7.1 Problem

Jika consumer tidak bisa deserialize record, handler business tidak pernah jalan. Error ini sering terjadi karena:

```text id="schema-failure-causes"
- invalid JSON
- incompatible Avro/Protobuf/JSON Schema
- missing required field
- unknown enum
- wrong content-type
- wrong schema subject
- producer emits new version too early
- consumer deploy lags producer deploy
```

## 7.2 Handling options

| Option | Cocok | Risiko |
|---|---|---|
| Fail consumer | Critical contract topic | Stops pipeline |
| DLQ raw record | Most production consumers | Need raw payload + metadata |
| Quarantine table | Need triage workflow | DB storage/security |
| Ignore | Truly optional event | Silent data loss risk |
| Route unknown version | Forward-compatible router | More code |

## 7.3 DLQ raw payload pattern

```json id="schema-dlq-payload"
{
  "failureId": "fail-001",
  "failedAt": "2026-07-13T10:15:30Z",
  "classification": "CONTRACT_FAILURE",
  "consumerGroup": "billing-order-consumer",
  "originalTopic": "order.order.events.v1",
  "originalPartition": 2,
  "originalOffset": 88123,
  "originalKey": "order-123",
  "errorClass": "SchemaValidationException",
  "errorMessage": "Missing required field customerId",
  "payloadEncoding": "utf-8",
  "rawPayload": "{...}"
}
```

Confluent’s DLQ guidance recommends using retry limits before sending to DLQ and using schema validation so messages follow the expected format. ([Confluent](https://www.confluent.io/learn/kafka-dead-letter-queue/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

# 8. Business Failure Handling

Not all business failure is “error”. Some are valid outcomes.

```text id="business-failure-example"
PaymentAuthorizationRequested
  ↓
PaymentRejected due to insufficient funds
  ↓
This is not technical failure.
It is a business result.
```

| Failure | Treat as | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Insufficient stock | Business rejection | `InventoryReservationRejected` |
| Payment rejected | Business rejection | `PaymentRejected` |
| Order already cancelled | Duplicate/stale command | Idempotent no-op / rejected |
| Invalid transition | Business rule violation | Rejected event / audit |
| Missing reference data | Depends | Retry if eventual, DLQ if invalid |

Rule:

```text id="business-error-rule"
Business rejection should be modeled as a domain event or process branch,
not retried forever as infrastructure failure.
```

---

# 9. Retry Patterns

## 9.1 Inline retry

```text id="inline-retry"
Consumer receives record
  ↓
handler fails transiently
  ↓
retry same handler 2-3 times with short backoff
  ↓
success or escalate
```

### Code

```java id="inline-retry-code"
public void handleWithInlineRetry(Event event) {
    int maxAttempts = 3;

    for (int attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {
        try {
            handler.handle(event);
            return;
        } catch (TransientFailureException e) {
            if (attempt == maxAttempts) {
                throw e;
            }

            sleep(backoff(attempt));
        }
    }
}
```

| Cocok | Hindari |
|---|---|
| Very short transient blip | Long outage |
| DB connection race | Poison message |
| Low latency recovery | Handler blocks poll too long |
| Small max attempts | Many records per poll |

## 9.2 Retry topic

```text id="retry-topic-flow"
main topic
  ↓
consumer fails transiently
  ↓
publish to retry topic with attempt header
  ↓
commit original offset
  ↓
retry consumer processes later
```

Retry topic memindahkan transient failure keluar dari main partition agar poison/transient issue tidak menahan partition utama.

## 9.3 Multi-level retry topic

```text id="multi-level-retry"
order.events.v1
  ↓ fail
order.events.retry.10s.v1
  ↓ fail
order.events.retry.1m.v1
  ↓ fail
order.events.retry.10m.v1
  ↓ exhausted
order.events.dlq.v1
```

## 9.4 Retry headers

```text id="retry-headers"
original-topic
original-partition
original-offset
original-timestamp
retry-attempt
first-failed-at
last-failed-at
next-attempt-at
error-class
error-message-hash
correlation-id
event-id
```

---

# 10. Retry Topic Commit Rule

Critical rule:

```text id="retry-commit-rule"
If processing fails transiently:
  publish retry event first.
  commit original offset only after retry publish succeeds.

If retry publish fails:
  do not commit original offset.
```

```java id="retry-topic-commit-code"
try {
    handler.handle(event);
    offsetTracker.markProcessed(record);
} catch (TransientFailureException e) {
    retryPublisher.publish(record, e, nextAttempt);

    // Only after retry publish success:
    offsetTracker.markProcessed(record);
}
```

Why?

```text id="retry-failure-window"
If you commit original offset before retry publish:
  original event is gone from main processing path
  retry event may not exist
  data loss
```

---

# 11. DLQ Pattern

DLQ adalah topic khusus untuk record yang tidak bisa diproses normal setelah classification/retry policy.

```text id="dlq-flow"
main topic
  ↓
consumer
  ↓ permanent failure / retry exhausted / poison
  ↓
DLQ topic
  ↓
operator triage / replay tool / fix-forward
```

DLQ best practice termasuk menentukan DLQ topic, routing logic, offset management, retry limit, schema validation, dan monitoring/troubleshooting. ([Confluent](https://www.confluent.io/learn/kafka-dead-letter-queue/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

## 11.1 DLQ topic naming

```text id="dlq-topic-naming"
<domain>.<source-topic-or-stream>.dlq.v<major>
```

Contoh:

```text id="dlq-topic-examples"
order.order-events.dlq.v1
billing.payment-events.dlq.v1
customer.profile-changelog.dlq.v1
camunda.message-correlation.dlq.v1
```

## 11.2 DLQ payload

```json id="dlq-payload-full"
{
  "failureId": "01JZDLQ0001",
  "failedAt": "2026-07-13T10:15:30Z",
  "service": "billing-service",
  "consumerGroup": "billing-order-consumer",
  "environment": "prod",
  "classification": "CONTRACT_FAILURE",
  "originalRecord": {
    "topic": "order.order.events.v1",
    "partition": 2,
    "offset": 88123,
    "key": "order-123",
    "timestamp": "2026-07-13T10:14:58Z"
  },
  "eventMetadata": {
    "eventId": "evt-001",
    "eventType": "OrderCreated",
    "eventVersion": 1,
    "correlationId": "corr-123",
    "tenantId": "tenant-a"
  },
  "failure": {
    "errorClass": "SchemaValidationException",
    "errorMessage": "Missing required field customerId",
    "stackTraceHash": "abc123"
  },
  "payload": {
    "raw": "{...}"
  }
}
```

## 11.3 DLQ commit rule

```text id="dlq-commit-rule"
Publish DLQ first.
Commit original offset only after DLQ publish succeeds.

If DLQ publish fails:
  do not commit original offset.
```

# 12. Quarantine Table Pattern

DLQ topic bagus, tetapi kadang butuh workflow triage dengan status.

```sql id="quarantine-table"
CREATE TABLE kafka_quarantine_event (
    id                  UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    consumer_group      TEXT NOT NULL,
    original_topic      TEXT NOT NULL,
    original_partition  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    original_offset     BIGINT NOT NULL,
    original_key        TEXT,
    event_id            UUID,
    event_type          TEXT,
    event_version       INTEGER,
    correlation_id      TEXT,
    tenant_id           TEXT,
    classification      TEXT NOT NULL,
    error_class         TEXT NOT NULL,
    error_message       TEXT,
    payload             JSONB NOT NULL,
    status              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NEW',
    created_at          TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at          TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (consumer_group, original_topic, original_partition, original_offset)
);
```

Status lifecycle:

```text id="quarantine-lifecycle"
NEW
  ↓
TRIAGED
  ↓
WAITING_FIX
  ↓
READY_TO_REPLAY
  ↓
REPLAYED / REJECTED
  ↓
CLOSED
```

| DLQ topic | Quarantine table |
|---|---|
| Good for Kafka-native replay | Good for operational workflow |
| Immutable stream style | Status/assignment/comment possible |
| Easy to produce | Easy to query/filter |
| Needs tooling | Needs DB governance |
| Great for audit trail | Great for manual triage |

---

# 13. Poison Pill Handling

Poison pill adalah record yang selalu gagal diproses dan dapat menahan partition jika tidak diisolasi.

```text id="poison-pill"
partition p0:
  offset 100 OK
  offset 101 POISON
  offset 102 OK but blocked if 101 never resolved
```

## Poison detection

| Signal | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Same topic/partition/offset fails repeatedly | Poison record |
| Same eventId retry exhausted | Deterministic failure |
| Same error class for same payload | Contract/business bug |
| Partition lag stuck at same offset | Poison blocking partition |
| Retry count exceeded | Not transient anymore |

## Handling

```text id="poison-handling"
Detect poison
  ↓
Classify:
  - contract
  - business permanent
  - code bug
  - unknown
  ↓
Publish DLQ/quarantine
  ↓
Commit original offset only after DLQ/quarantine success
  ↓
Alert if critical
```

---

# 14. Idempotency Under Error

Any error strategy can produce duplicates:

```text id="duplicates-under-error"
Producer retry
Outbox relay duplicate
Consumer crash after DB commit before offset commit
Rebalance
Retry topic
Replay
Manual recovery
```

## Idempotent consumer table

```sql id="processed-event-error"
CREATE TABLE processed_event (
    event_id      UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    event_type    TEXT NOT NULL,
    aggregate_id  TEXT,
    processed_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
```

## Handler pattern

```java id="idempotent-handler-error"
public void handle(Event event) {
    transaction.inTransaction(() -> {
        boolean first = processedEventRepository.tryInsert(
                event.eventId(),
                event.eventType(),
                event.aggregateId()
        );

        if (!first) {
            metrics.duplicateEvent(event.eventType());
            return null;
        }

        businessHandler.apply(event);
        return null;
    });
}
```

Rule:

```text id="idempotency-error-rule"
Offset correctness reduces duplicate.
Idempotency makes duplicate harmless.
```

---

# 15. Offset Error Handling

## 15.1 Unsafe commit patterns

| Pattern | Risk |
|---|---|
| Commit before processing | Data loss |
| Commit after partial batch with failure | Data loss for failed records |
| Commit after retry publish fails | Data loss |
| Commit after DLQ publish fails | Data loss |
| Commit out-of-order worker pool offset | Skip unfinished records |
| Commit in `onPartitionsLost` blindly | Wrong ownership |

## 15.2 Safe commit matrix

| Outcome | Commit original offset? |
|---|---:|
| Handler success | Yes |
| Duplicate no-op success | Yes |
| Retry topic publish success | Yes |
| Retry topic publish failure | No |
| DLQ publish success | Yes |
| DLQ publish failure | No |
| Fatal app bug | No |
| Consumer lost partition | Usually no |
| Business rejected and audit event persisted | Yes |

Kafka’s rebalance listener docs explain `onPartitionsRevoked` is the chance to commit offsets before partitions are reassigned, while `onPartitionsLost` is called when partitions may already be owned by another consumer; this matters for safe commit decisions. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/25/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/ConsumerRebalanceListener.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

---

# 16. Rebalance & Shutdown Errors

During rebalance or shutdown:

```text id="rebalance-error-window"
consumer processes record
  ↓
side effect success
  ↓
rebalance happens before offset commit
  ↓
new consumer reprocesses record
  ↓
duplicate must be safe
```

## Handling principles

| Situation | Action |
|---|---|
| `onPartitionsRevoked` | Commit safe offsets |
| `onPartitionsLost` | Cleanup state; avoid unsafe commit |
| SIGTERM | Readiness down, wakeup consumer, safe commit |
| Worker pool | Commit only contiguous completed offsets |
| CommitFailedException | Do not force; rely on idempotency and fix cause |
| Long processing | Reduce batch or increase safe timeout |

---

# 17. Replay Error Handling

Replay can fix data, but can also repeat side effects.

```text id="replay-error-handling"
Replay source:
  - original topic from earlier offset
  - DLQ topic
  - quarantine table
  - archived event store
  - outbox table
```

## Replay safety checklist

| Check | Required |
|---|---|
| Handler idempotent | Yes |
| External side effect guarded | Yes |
| Replay scope bounded | Yes |
| Replay rate limited | Yes |
| Replay audit logged | Yes |
| Consumer group chosen intentionally | Yes |
| DLQ records fixed or transformed | Yes |
| Schema compatibility checked | Yes |
| Business approval for critical replay | Yes |

## Replay modes

| Mode | Use case |
|---|---|
| New consumer group | Rebuild projection without affecting current group |
| Reset existing group offset | Reprocess with same group; risky |
| `assign()` + `seek()` tool | Targeted partition/offset replay |
| DLQ replay topic | Reinject corrected events |
| Backfill job | Deterministic rebuild |
| Manual compensation | Side effect correction |

Confluent’s `auto.offset.reset` guide distinguishes `earliest`, `latest`, and `none`, but `auto.offset.reset` only applies when no valid committed offset exists; it is not the same as an intentional replay/reset strategy. ([Confluent](https://www.confluent.io/learn/kafka-auto-reset/?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

# 18. Incident Recovery Workflow

## 18.1 DLQ spike

```text id="incident-dlq-spike"
DLQ spike
  ↓
Group by:
  - errorClass
  - eventType
  - eventVersion
  - producerVersion
  - tenant
  ↓
Check recent deploy/schema change
  ↓
Classify:
  - producer bug
  - consumer bug
  - schema break
  - bad data
  - security issue
  ↓
Stop bad producer if needed
  ↓
Patch producer/consumer/schema
  ↓
Replay or reject DLQ records
```

## 18.2 Consumer lag + retry storm

```text id="incident-retry-storm"
Lag rising + retry rising
  ↓
Identify top transient error
  ↓
Check downstream dependency health
  ↓
Pause/reduce retry consumers
  ↓
Increase backoff/jitter
  ↓
Enable circuit breaker
  ↓
Recover dependency
  ↓
Drain retry backlog gradually
```

## 18.3 Missing event downstream

```text id="incident-missing-event"
Downstream says event missing
  ↓
Find aggregateId/eventId/correlationId
  ↓
Check source DB state
  ↓
Check outbox row
  ↓
Check Kafka topic/partition/offset
  ↓
Check consumer group lag
  ↓
Check processed_event table
  ↓
Check retry/DLQ/quarantine
  ↓
Replay if safe
```

## 18.4 Duplicate side effect

```text id="incident-duplicate-side-effect"
Duplicate side effect
  ↓
Find eventId/commandId/business id
  ↓
Check outbox duplicate publish
  ↓
Check consumer idempotency table
  ↓
Check retry/replay activity
  ↓
Patch idempotency guard
  ↓
Compensate duplicate business effect
```

# 19. Error Handling Architecture in Jersey

```text id="jersey-error-architecture"
JAX-RS Resource
  ↓
Application Service
  ↓
Outbox Writer
  ↓
Outbox Relay
  ↓
Kafka Topic
  ↓
Consumer Worker
  ↓
Deserializer
  ↓
Contract Validator
  ↓
Idempotency Guard
  ↓
Business Handler
  ↓
Failure Classifier
  ├── retry publisher
  ├── DLQ publisher
  ├── quarantine repository
  └── fatal handler
```

## Component boundaries

| Component | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `EventPublisher` | Publish record + callback handling |
| `OutboxRelay` | Durable publish retry |
| `EventDeserializer` | Convert bytes to envelope |
| `EventValidator` | Schema/semantic validation |
| `FailureClassifier` | Map exception → action |
| `RetryPublisher` | Send retry record |
| `DlqPublisher` | Send DLQ record |
| `QuarantineRepository` | Store failed event workflow |
| `OffsetManager` | Commit safe offsets |
| `ReplayTool` | Controlled recovery |

---

# 20. FailureClassifier Example

```java id="failure-classifier"
public final class FailureClassifier {
    public FailureAction classify(Throwable error) {
        Throwable root = rootCause(error);

        if (root instanceof JsonProcessingException
                || root instanceof SchemaValidationException
                || root instanceof UnknownEventVersionException) {
            return FailureAction.SEND_TO_DLQ;
        }

        if (root instanceof SQLTransientException
                || root instanceof SocketTimeoutException
                || root instanceof TimeoutException) {
            return FailureAction.SEND_TO_RETRY_TOPIC;
        }

        if (root instanceof AuthorizationException
                || root instanceof TopicAuthorizationException) {
            return FailureAction.STOP_CONSUMER;
        }

        if (root instanceof BusinessPermanentRejectionException) {
            return FailureAction.PUBLISH_REJECTED_EVENT;
        }

        return FailureAction.STOP_CONSUMER;
    }

    private Throwable rootCause(Throwable error) {
        Throwable current = error;
        while (current.getCause() != null) {
            current = current.getCause();
        }
        return current;
    }
}
```

## Failure actions

```java id="failure-action-enum"
public enum FailureAction {
    RETRY_INLINE,
    SEND_TO_RETRY_TOPIC,
    SEND_TO_DLQ,
    PUBLISH_REJECTED_EVENT,
    STOP_CONSUMER
}
```

---

# 21. Consumer Processing Pseudocode

```java id="consumer-error-processing"
public void process(ConsumerRecord<String, String> record) {
    try {
        EventEnvelope event = deserializer.deserialize(record.value());
        validator.validate(event);

        idempotentHandler.handle(event);

        offsets.markProcessed(record);
    } catch (Exception error) {
        FailureAction action = classifier.classify(error);

        switch (action) {
            case SEND_TO_RETRY_TOPIC -> {
                retryPublisher.publish(record, error);
                offsets.markProcessed(record);
            }
            case SEND_TO_DLQ -> {
                dlqPublisher.publish(record, error);
                offsets.markProcessed(record);
            }
            case PUBLISH_REJECTED_EVENT -> {
                rejectedEventPublisher.publish(record, error);
                offsets.markProcessed(record);
            }
            case STOP_CONSUMER -> {
                fatalError.set(error);
                throw new FatalConsumerException(error);
            }
            case RETRY_INLINE -> {
                inlineRetryHandler.retry(record);
                offsets.markProcessed(record);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

Critical caveat:

```text id="error-processing-caveat"
offsets.markProcessed(record) after retry/DLQ/rejected publication
means publication already succeeded.

If retry/DLQ publication throws:
  do not mark processed.
```

---

# 22. Retry Backoff & Jitter

Without jitter, many consumers can retry at the same time and amplify outage.

```text id="retry-jitter"
base delay = 1 minute
attempt = 3
jitter = random 0-30 seconds

nextAttemptAt = now + exponentialBackoff + jitter
```

## Backoff table

| Attempt | Delay |
|---:|---|
| 1 | 10s |
| 2 | 1m |
| 3 | 5m |
| 4 | 15m |
| 5 | DLQ |

## Retry budget

```text id="retry-budget"
For each event:
  maxAttempts = 5

For each dependency:
  maxRetryRate = controlled

For each incident:
  pause retry consumer if dependency down
```

---

# 23. Retry Storm Prevention

| Guardrail | Why |
|---|---|
| Exponential backoff | Avoid hammering dependency |
| Jitter | Avoid thundering herd |
| Max attempts | Avoid infinite poison loop |
| Circuit breaker | Stop calling known-dead dependency |
| Pause retry consumers | Prevent overload |
| Separate retry consumer group | Isolate main flow |
| Rate limiter | Smooth replay/retry |
| DLQ after threshold | Human intervention |
| Dependency health check | Fail fast |
| Alert by error class | Faster diagnosis |

---

# 24. DLQ Security & Governance

DLQ often contains raw payload and error details, so it can be sensitive.

| Concern | Guardrail |
|---|---|
| PII in payload | Redact or restrict ACL |
| Secrets in error message | Sanitize error |
| Long retention | Review compliance |
| Replay abuse | Approval + audit |
| Multi-tenant data | Tenant-aware access |
| Unknown raw payload | Treat as sensitive |
| DLQ without owner | Assign owning team |
| DLQ without alert | Add unresolved count/age alerts |

Rule:

```text id="dlq-security-rule"
DLQ has at least the same data classification as the source topic,
often higher because it may contain raw invalid payload and stack/error context.
```

---

# 25. Monitoring & Alerts

## Producer alerts

| Alert | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Publish failure rate > threshold | Kafka/platform/producer issue |
| Outbox oldest pending age > SLA | Event publication delayed |
| Outbox failed count > 0 | Non-retriable or exhausted failure |
| Authorization error | ACL/credential broken |
| Serialization error | Producer contract bug |
| Message too large | Payload governance failure |

## Consumer alerts

| Alert | Meaning |
|---|---|
| DLQ count spike | Contract/data/consumer bug |
| Retry topic lag growing | Dependency/transient problem |
| Retry exhausted | Event cannot recover automatically |
| Consumer lag growing | Consumer capacity/handler issue |
| Last poll age high | Consumer stuck |
| Rebalance loop | Lifecycle/processing issue |
| Duplicate spike | Outbox/replay/rebalance signal |
| Schema validation errors | Contract issue |

## DLQ operational alerts

```text id="dlq-alerts"
- dlq_new_records_total > baseline
- dlq_unresolved_count > 0 for critical event
- dlq_oldest_unresolved_age > SLA
- dlq_sensitive_payload_detected > 0
- dlq_replay_failed_total > 0
```

---

# 26. Runbook: DLQ Record Triage

```text id="dlq-triage-runbook"
DLQ record appears
  ↓
Identify:
  - eventType
  - eventVersion
  - producer
  - producerVersion
  - consumerGroup
  - errorClass
  - topic/partition/offset
  ↓
Classify:
  - bad data
  - schema break
  - consumer bug
  - producer bug
  - business rejection
  - security/privacy issue
  ↓
Decide:
  - replay as-is
  - transform and replay
  - reject/close
  - compensate manually
  - patch code/schema first
```

## Replay decision

| Condition | Replay? |
|---|---:|
| Consumer bug fixed | Yes |
| Transient dependency recovered | Yes |
| Producer emitted invalid irreversible payload | Usually no; transform/fix first |
| Security/PII violation | No until compliance decision |
| Business rejection valid | No; close/reject |
| Unknown root cause | No; investigate first |

---

# 27. Runbook: Retry Topic Backlog

```text id="retry-backlog-runbook"
Retry backlog growing
  ↓
Group by errorClass/dependency
  ↓
Check downstream dependency status
  ↓
If dependency down:
      pause retry consumers
      increase backoff
      keep main consumer protected
  ↓
If dependency recovered:
      resume slowly
      rate limit replay
  ↓
If same event repeatedly fails:
      DLQ after threshold
```

---

# 28. Runbook: Producer Publish Failure

```text id="producer-failure-runbook"
Producer failure
  ↓
Classify error:
    serialization?
    authorization?
    timeout?
    topic missing?
    message too large?
  ↓
If outbox:
    check pending/failed rows
  ↓
If direct producer:
    assess lost event risk
  ↓
Fix root cause
  ↓
Replay from outbox/source of truth if possible
```

---

# 29. Runbook: Contract Break

```text id="contract-break-runbook"
Schema/contract error spike
  ↓
Identify producer version and event version
  ↓
Stop or rollback bad producer
  ↓
Patch consumer if compatibility intended
  ↓
Patch schema if incorrect
  ↓
Move bad records to DLQ/quarantine
  ↓
Transform/replay if safe
  ↓
Add CI contract test to prevent recurrence
```

---

# 30. Testing Error Handling

| Test | Expected |
|---|---|
| Serialization failure | Producer does not send invalid event |
| Producer timeout | Outbox row remains pending/rescheduled |
| Authorization failure | Fatal alert, no infinite retry |
| Bad JSON | DLQ published, original offset committed after DLQ success |
| DLQ publish failure | Original offset not committed |
| DB transient failure | Retry topic published |
| Retry exhausted | DLQ |
| Duplicate event | No duplicate side effect |
| Consumer crash after DB commit | Reprocess safe due idempotency |
| Rebalance during processing | Safe offset only |
| Replay DLQ | Idempotent and audited |
| Poison message | Does not block partition forever |

---

# 31. Common Anti-Patterns

| Anti-pattern | Dampak |
|---|---|
| Retry all exceptions | Poison loop / retry storm |
| Commit offset before retry/DLQ publish | Data loss |
| DLQ without metadata | Tidak bisa replay/debug |
| DLQ without owner | Operational debt |
| Swallow producer callback exception | Silent event loss |
| Direct publish for critical DB event | DB/Kafka inconsistency |
| Auto commit for DB side effect | Data loss risk |
| No idempotency | Duplicate side effect |
| Treat business rejection as technical error | Infinite retry |
| Treat code bug as transient | Retry storm |
| Log full payload with PII | Compliance issue |
| Replay without audit | Unsafe recovery |
| No alert on oldest retry/DLQ age | Hidden backlog |
| Retry topic same consumer capacity as main | Retry storm affects main flow |
| No schema compatibility gate | Contract break in prod |

---

# 32. Production Readiness Checklist

| Area | Checklist |
|---|---|
| Producer | Callback handles success/failure |
| Producer config | `acks=all`, idempotence, bounded timeout |
| Outbox | Critical events durable before publish |
| Failure classifier | Explicit mapping exception → action |
| Consumer commit | Manual commit after safe outcome |
| Idempotency | `eventId` / command id guard |
| Retry | Backoff, jitter, max attempts |
| DLQ | Full metadata, restricted ACL, alert |
| Quarantine | Status workflow if manual triage needed |
| Schema | Contract validation and CI gate |
| Poison pill | Does not block partition forever |
| Replay | Tooling, approval, audit, rate limit |
| Observability | Metrics/logs by eventType/errorClass |
| Runbooks | DLQ spike, retry storm, missing event, duplicate |
| Security | DLQ/retry payload classified |
| Tests | Failure injection and DLQ/retry tests |

---

## 33. Quick Decision Guide

```text id="error-quick-guide"
Producer serialization failed?
  → fail fast; fix mapper/schema.

Kafka send timeout?
  → retry/outbox; monitor pending age.

ACL/topic missing?
  → non-retryable; fix platform config.

Consumer bad payload/schema?
  → DLQ/quarantine; commit only after DLQ success.

Consumer DB/API timeout?
  → retry topic with backoff; commit original only after retry publish success.

Business rejection?
  → rejected event / saga branch / audit, not infinite retry.

Code bug?
  → stop consumer, alert, fix, replay.

Duplicate event?
  → idempotent no-op and commit.

DLQ publish failed?
  → do not commit original offset.

Retry exhausted?
  → DLQ + alert + triage.

Need recovery?
  → replay with idempotency, approval, rate limit, audit.
```

---

## 34. Ringkasan Praktis

Error handling Kafka yang aman memakai prinsip:

```text id="error-summary"
1. Classify failure first.
2. Retry only transient failures.
3. Isolate poison messages.
4. Commit offsets only after safe outcome.
5. Make consumers idempotent.
6. Treat DLQ as operational workflow, not trash bin.
7. Replay only with guardrails.
8. Observe every failure path.
```

Invariant utama:

```text id="error-invariants"
1. Producer failure must not be silent.
2. Critical DB event must use outbox or equivalent durability pattern.
3. Consumer offset commit means: this record is safely handled.
4. Retry/DLQ publication must happen before committing original offset.
5. Duplicate processing is normal; side effects must be idempotent.
6. Poison messages must not block partitions forever.
7. Business rejection is not technical failure.
8. Fatal/config/security errors should not retry forever.
9. DLQ must be monitored, owned, secured, and replayable.
10. Replay must be audited and rate-limited.
```
