# 12. SafeRebalanceListener

```java id="safe-rebalance-listener-template"
public final class SafeRebalanceListener implements ConsumerRebalanceListener {
    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(SafeRebalanceListener.class);

    private final KafkaConsumer<String, String> consumer;
    private final OffsetTracker offsetTracker;

    public SafeRebalanceListener(
            KafkaConsumer<String, String> consumer,
            OffsetTracker offsetTracker
    ) {
        this.consumer = consumer;
        this.offsetTracker = offsetTracker;
    }

    @Override
    public void onPartitionsRevoked(Collection<TopicPartition> partitions) {
        log.info("Kafka partitions revoked partitions={}", partitions);

        Map<TopicPartition, OffsetAndMetadata> offsets =
                offsetTracker.safeOffsetsFor(partitions);

        if (!offsets.isEmpty()) {
            consumer.commitSync(offsets, Duration.ofSeconds(10));
            log.info("Committed safe offsets on revoke offsets={}", offsets);
        }

        offsetTracker.clear(partitions);
    }

    @Override
    public void onPartitionsAssigned(Collection<TopicPartition> partitions) {
        log.info("Kafka partitions assigned partitions={}", partitions);
        offsetTracker.initialize(partitions);
    }

    @Override
    public void onPartitionsLost(Collection<TopicPartition> partitions) {
        log.warn("Kafka partitions lost partitions={}", partitions);

        // Jangan commit sembarangan di sini.
        // Partition mungkin sudah dimiliki member lain.
        offsetTracker.clear(partitions);
    }
}
```

`commitSync()` menyimpan offsets ke Kafka untuk digunakan pada fetch pertama setelah rebalance dan saat startup berikutnya; jika offset disimpan di sistem eksternal, pendekatannya harus berbeda. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/10/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/KafkaConsumer.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

# 13. KafkaConsumerWorker

Template worker single-threaded. `KafkaConsumer` tidak thread-safe; gunakan satu consumer untuk satu thread, dan panggil `wakeup()` dari thread lain untuk shutdown. Kafka docs menyebut `wakeup()` thread-safe dan berguna untuk membatalkan long poll. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/20/javadoc/index.html?org%2Fapache%2Fkafka%2Fclients%2Fconsumer%2FKafkaConsumer.html=&utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```java id="kafka-consumer-worker-template"
public final class KafkaConsumerWorker implements Runnable, AutoCloseable {
    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(KafkaConsumerWorker.class);

    private final KafkaConsumer<String, String> consumer;
    private final ConsumerRecordHandler handler;
    private final OffsetTracker offsetTracker;
    private final List<String> topics;
    private final AtomicBoolean closing = new AtomicBoolean(false);
    private final AtomicReference<ConsumerWorkerState> state =
            new AtomicReference<>(ConsumerWorkerState.CREATED);

    private volatile Instant startedAt;
    private volatile Instant lastPollAt;
    private volatile Instant lastSuccessfulProcessAt;
    private volatile Throwable lastError;

    public KafkaConsumerWorker(
            KafkaConsumer<String, String> consumer,
            ConsumerRecordHandler handler,
            OffsetTracker offsetTracker,
            List<String> topics
    ) {
        this.consumer = consumer;
        this.handler = handler;
        this.offsetTracker = offsetTracker;
        this.topics = List.copyOf(topics);
    }

    @Override
    public void run() {
        state.set(ConsumerWorkerState.STARTING);
        startedAt = Instant.now();

        try {
            consumer.subscribe(topics, new SafeRebalanceListener(consumer, offsetTracker));

            state.set(ConsumerWorkerState.RUNNING);

            while (!closing.get()) {
                ConsumerRecords<String, String> records =
                        consumer.poll(Duration.ofMillis(1000));

                lastPollAt = Instant.now();

                for (ConsumerRecord<String, String> record : records) {
                    processOne(record);
                }

                commitSafeOffsets();
            }
        } catch (WakeupException e) {
            if (!closing.get()) {
                state.set(ConsumerWorkerState.FAILED);
                lastError = e;
                throw e;
            }
        } catch (Throwable e) {
            state.set(ConsumerWorkerState.FAILED);
            lastError = e;
            log.error("Kafka consumer worker failed topics={}", topics, e);
            throw e;
        } finally {
            shutdownConsumer();
        }
    }

    private void processOne(ConsumerRecord<String, String> record) throws Exception {
        try {
            handler.handle(record);
            offsetTracker.markProcessed(record);
            lastSuccessfulProcessAt = Instant.now();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            lastError = e;
            throw e;
        }
    }

    private void commitSafeOffsets() {
        Map<TopicPartition, OffsetAndMetadata> offsets = offsetTracker.safeOffsets();

        if (!offsets.isEmpty()) {
            consumer.commitSync(offsets, Duration.ofSeconds(10));
        }
    }

    private void shutdownConsumer() {
        state.set(ConsumerWorkerState.STOPPING);

        try {
            commitSafeOffsets();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Failed to commit offsets during shutdown", e);
        }

        try {
            consumer.close(Duration.ofSeconds(10));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Failed to close Kafka consumer", e);
        }

        state.set(ConsumerWorkerState.STOPPED);
    }

    public ConsumerWorkerStatus status() {
        Throwable error = lastError;

        return new ConsumerWorkerStatus(
                state.get(),
                startedAt,
                lastPollAt,
                lastSuccessfulProcessAt,
                error == null ? null : error.getClass().getName(),
                error == null ? null : error.getMessage()
        );
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        if (closing.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
            consumer.wakeup();
        }
    }
}
```

# 14. Consumer Supervisor

Supervisor menjalankan worker di background thread dan menyediakan lifecycle untuk Jersey/HK2.

```java id="consumer-supervisor"
@Singleton
public final class KafkaConsumerSupervisor implements AutoCloseable {
    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(KafkaConsumerSupervisor.class);

    private final KafkaConsumerWorker worker;
    private final ExecutorService executor;
    private Future<?> future;

    @Inject
    public KafkaConsumerSupervisor(KafkaConsumerWorker worker) {
        this.worker = worker;
        this.executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(runnable -> {
            Thread thread = new Thread(runnable);
            thread.setName("kafka-consumer-worker");
            thread.setDaemon(false);
            return thread;
        });
    }

    public synchronized void start() {
        if (future != null) {
            return;
        }

        future = executor.submit(worker);
        log.info("Kafka consumer supervisor started");
    }

    public ConsumerWorkerStatus status() {
        return worker.status();
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized void close() {
        worker.close();
        executor.shutdown();

        try {
            if (!executor.awaitTermination(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
                executor.shutdownNow();
            }
        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            executor.shutdownNow();
        }

        log.info("Kafka consumer supervisor stopped");
    }
}
```

# 15. FailureAction & FailureClassifier

```java id="failure-action"
public enum FailureAction {
    RETRY_INLINE,
    SEND_TO_RETRY_TOPIC,
    SEND_TO_DLQ,
    TREAT_AS_SUCCESS,
    STOP_CONSUMER
}
```

```java id="failure-classification"
public record FailureClassification(
        FailureAction action,
        String errorClass,
        String reason,
        boolean retryable
) {
}
```

```java id="failure-classifier-template"
public final class FailureClassifier {
    public FailureClassification classify(Throwable error) {
        Throwable root = rootCause(error);

        if (root instanceof SerializationException
                || root instanceof JsonProcessingException
                || root instanceof IllegalArgumentException) {
            return new FailureClassification(
                    FailureAction.SEND_TO_DLQ,
                    root.getClass().getSimpleName(),
                    "Invalid payload or contract",
                    false
            );
        }

        if (root instanceof SQLTransientException
                || root instanceof SocketTimeoutException
                || root instanceof TimeoutException) {
            return new FailureClassification(
                    FailureAction.SEND_TO_RETRY_TOPIC,
                    root.getClass().getSimpleName(),
                    "Transient dependency failure",
                    true
            );
        }

        if (root instanceof TopicAuthorizationException
                || root instanceof GroupAuthorizationException
                || root instanceof ConfigException) {
            return new FailureClassification(
                    FailureAction.STOP_CONSUMER,
                    root.getClass().getSimpleName(),
                    "Fatal configuration or authorization failure",
                    false
            );
        }

        return new FailureClassification(
                FailureAction.STOP_CONSUMER,
                root.getClass().getSimpleName(),
                "Unknown fatal failure",
                false
        );
    }

    private Throwable rootCause(Throwable error) {
        Throwable current = error;

        while (current.getCause() != null) {
            current = current.getCause();
        }

        return current;
    }
}
```

# 16. Retry Policy

```java id="retry-policy"
public record RetryPolicy(
        int maxAttempts,
        List<Duration> delays
) {
    public Duration delayForAttempt(int attempt) {
        if (attempt <= 0) {
            return Duration.ZERO;
        }

        int index = Math.min(attempt - 1, delays.size() - 1);
        return delays.get(index);
    }

    public boolean exhausted(int attempt) {
        return attempt >= maxAttempts;
    }

    public static RetryPolicy defaultPolicy() {
        return new RetryPolicy(
                5,
                List.of(
                        Duration.ofSeconds(10),
                        Duration.ofMinutes(1),
                        Duration.ofMinutes(5),
                        Duration.ofMinutes(15),
                        Duration.ofMinutes(30)
                )
        );
    }
}
```

# 17. RetryPublisher

```java id="retry-publisher-template"
@Singleton
public final class RetryPublisher {
    private final KafkaProducerManager producerManager;
    private final RetryPolicy retryPolicy;
    private final ObjectMapper objectMapper;

    @Inject
    public RetryPublisher(
            KafkaProducerManager producerManager,
            ObjectMapper objectMapper
    ) {
        this.producerManager = producerManager;
        this.objectMapper = objectMapper;
        this.retryPolicy = RetryPolicy.defaultPolicy();
    }

    public CompletionStage<RecordMetadata> publishRetry(
            ConsumerRecord<String, String> original,
            Throwable error,
            int nextAttempt,
            String retryTopic
    ) {
        Duration delay = retryPolicy.delayForAttempt(nextAttempt);
        Instant nextAttemptAt = Instant.now().plus(delay);

        Map<String, Object> retryEnvelope = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        retryEnvelope.put("originalTopic", original.topic());
        retryEnvelope.put("originalPartition", original.partition());
        retryEnvelope.put("originalOffset", original.offset());
        retryEnvelope.put("originalKey", original.key());
        retryEnvelope.put("retryAttempt", nextAttempt);
        retryEnvelope.put("nextAttemptAt", nextAttemptAt.toString());
        retryEnvelope.put("errorClass", error.getClass().getName());
        retryEnvelope.put("errorMessage", safeMessage(error));
        retryEnvelope.put("payload", original.value());

        String payloadJson = toJson(retryEnvelope);

        PublishedEvent retryEvent = new PublishedEvent(
                retryTopic,
                original.key(),
                EventHeaders.get(original.headers(), EventHeaders.EVENT_ID).orElse(UUID.randomUUID().toString()),
                EventHeaders.get(original.headers(), EventHeaders.EVENT_TYPE).orElse("UnknownEvent"),
                parseInt(EventHeaders.get(original.headers(), EventHeaders.EVENT_VERSION).orElse("1")),
                EventHeaders.get(original.headers(), EventHeaders.CORRELATION_ID).orElse(null),
                EventHeaders.get(original.headers(), EventHeaders.CAUSATION_ID).orElse(null),
                EventHeaders.get(original.headers(), EventHeaders.TENANT_ID).orElse(null),
                "retry-publisher",
                payloadJson
        );

        return producerManager.publish(retryEvent);
    }

    private String toJson(Object value) {
        try {
            return objectMapper.writeValueAsString(value);
        } catch (JsonProcessingException e) {
            throw new SerializationException("Failed to serialize retry envelope", e);
        }
    }

    private String safeMessage(Throwable error) {
        String message = error.getMessage();
        if (message == null) {
            return "";
        }

        return message.length() > 500 ? message.substring(0, 500) : message;
    }

    private int parseInt(String value) {
        try {
            return Integer.parseInt(value);
        } catch (RuntimeException e) {
            return 1;
        }
    }
}
```

# 19. DlqPublisher

```java id="dlq-publisher-template"
@Singleton
public final class DlqPublisher {
    private final KafkaProducerManager producerManager;
    private final ObjectMapper objectMapper;
    private final String serviceName;
    private final String consumerGroup;

    @Inject
    public DlqPublisher(
            KafkaProducerManager producerManager,
            ObjectMapper objectMapper
    ) {
        this.producerManager = producerManager;
        this.objectMapper = objectMapper;
        this.serviceName = "order-service";
        this.consumerGroup = "order-projection-service";
    }

    public CompletionStage<RecordMetadata> publishDlq(
            ConsumerRecord<String, String> original,
            Throwable error,
            String dlqTopic
    ) {
        DlqRecord dlq = new DlqRecord(
                UUID.randomUUID(),
                Instant.now(),
                serviceName,
                consumerGroup,
                original.topic(),
                original.partition(),
                original.offset(),
                original.key(),
                EventHeaders.get(original.headers(), EventHeaders.EVENT_ID).orElse(null),
                EventHeaders.get(original.headers(), EventHeaders.EVENT_TYPE).orElse(null),
                EventHeaders.get(original.headers(), EventHeaders.EVENT_VERSION).orElse(null),
                EventHeaders.get(original.headers(), EventHeaders.CORRELATION_ID).orElse(null),
                EventHeaders.get(original.headers(), EventHeaders.TENANT_ID).orElse(null),
                error.getClass().getName(),
                safeMessage(error),
                original.value()
        );

        String payloadJson = toJson(dlq);

        PublishedEvent event = new PublishedEvent(
                dlqTopic,
                original.key(),
                dlq.failureId().toString(),
                "KafkaDlqRecord",
                1,
                dlq.correlationId(),
                dlq.eventId(),
                dlq.tenantId(),
                serviceName,
                payloadJson
        );

        return producerManager.publish(event);
    }

    private String toJson(Object value) {
        try {
            return objectMapper.writeValueAsString(value);
        } catch (JsonProcessingException e) {
            throw new SerializationException("Failed to serialize DLQ record", e);
        }
    }

    private String safeMessage(Throwable error) {
        String message = error.getMessage();
        if (message == null) {
            return "";
        }

        return message.length() > 500 ? message.substring(0, 500) : message;
    }
}
```

# 20. Consumer Handler with Retry/DLQ

```java id="consumer-handler-with-retry-dlq"
@Singleton
public final class ResilientConsumerRecordHandler implements ConsumerRecordHandler {
    private final FailureClassifier failureClassifier;
    private final RetryPublisher retryPublisher;
    private final DlqPublisher dlqPublisher;
    private final BusinessEventDispatcher dispatcher;

    private final String retryTopic = "order.order-events.retry.1m.v1";
    private final String dlqTopic = "order.order-events.dlq.v1";

    @Inject
    public ResilientConsumerRecordHandler(
            FailureClassifier failureClassifier,
            RetryPublisher retryPublisher,
            DlqPublisher dlqPublisher,
            BusinessEventDispatcher dispatcher
    ) {
        this.failureClassifier = failureClassifier;
        this.retryPublisher = retryPublisher;
        this.dlqPublisher = dlqPublisher;
        this.dispatcher = dispatcher;
    }

    @Override
    public void handle(ConsumerRecord<String, String> record) throws Exception {
        try {
            dispatcher.dispatch(record);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            FailureClassification classification = failureClassifier.classify(e);

            switch (classification.action()) {
                case SEND_TO_RETRY_TOPIC -> retryPublisher
                        .publishRetry(record, e, 1, retryTopic)
                        .toCompletableFuture()
                        .get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);

                case SEND_TO_DLQ -> dlqPublisher
                        .publishDlq(record, e, dlqTopic)
                        .toCompletableFuture()
                        .get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS);

                case TREAT_AS_SUCCESS -> {
                    // no-op
                }

                case STOP_CONSUMER, RETRY_INLINE -> throw e;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

Important invariant:

```text id="retry-dlq-offset-invariant"
Worker boleh mark offset processed hanya jika:
  - business handler sukses
  - duplicate dinyatakan aman
  - retry event berhasil dipublish
  - DLQ event berhasil dipublish
```

# 22. Kafka Admin Diagnostics Service

`Admin` adalah administrative client untuk operasi seperti describe topics, describe configs, consumer groups, dan offsets; javadoc merekomendasikan client code memakai interface `Admin`. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/Consumer.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```java id="admin-diagnostics-service"
@Singleton
public final class KafkaAdminDiagnosticsService implements AutoCloseable {
    private final Admin admin;

    @Inject
    public KafkaAdminDiagnosticsService(KafkaAdminConfigFactory configFactory) {
        this.admin = Admin.create(configFactory.create("admin"));
    }

    public TopicDescription describeTopic(String topic) {
        try {
            return admin.describeTopics(List.of(topic))
                    .allTopicNames()
                    .get(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                    .get(topic);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new KafkaException("Failed to describe topic: " + topic, e);
        }
    }

    public Map<TopicPartition, Long> latestOffsets(String topic) {
        TopicDescription description = describeTopic(topic);

        Map<TopicPartition, OffsetSpec> request = new HashMap<>();
        for (TopicPartitionInfo partition : description.partitions()) {
            request.put(new TopicPartition(topic, partition.partition()), OffsetSpec.latest());
        }

        try {
            return admin.listOffsets(request)
                    .all()
                    .get(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                    .entrySet()
                    .stream()
                    .collect(Collectors.toMap(
                            Map.Entry::getKey,
                            entry -> entry.getValue().offset()
                    ));
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new KafkaException("Failed to fetch latest offsets for topic: " + topic, e);
        }
    }

    public Map<TopicPartition, OffsetAndMetadata> committedOffsets(String groupId) {
        try {
            return admin.listConsumerGroupOffsets(groupId)
                    .partitionsToOffsetAndMetadata()
                    .get(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new KafkaException("Failed to fetch committed offsets for group: " + groupId, e);
        }
    }

    public KafkaLagSnapshot lag(String topic, String groupId) {
        Map<TopicPartition, Long> latest = latestOffsets(topic);
        Map<TopicPartition, OffsetAndMetadata> committed = committedOffsets(groupId);

        List<KafkaLagSnapshot.PartitionLag> partitions = latest.entrySet().stream()
                .map(entry -> {
                    TopicPartition partition = entry.getKey();
                    long logEndOffset = entry.getValue();
                    long committedOffset = Optional.ofNullable(committed.get(partition))
                            .map(OffsetAndMetadata::offset)
                            .orElse(0L);

                    return new KafkaLagSnapshot.PartitionLag(
                            partition.topic(),
                            partition.partition(),
                            committedOffset,
                            logEndOffset,
                            Math.max(0, logEndOffset - committedOffset)
                    );
                })
                .toList();

        long totalLag = partitions.stream()
                .mapToLong(KafkaLagSnapshot.PartitionLag::lag)
                .sum();

        return new KafkaLagSnapshot(topic, groupId, totalLag, partitions);
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        admin.close(Duration.ofSeconds(10));
    }
}
```

```java id="lag-snapshot"
public record KafkaLagSnapshot(
        String topic,
        String groupId,
        long totalLag,
        List<PartitionLag> partitions
) {
    public record PartitionLag(
            String topic,
            int partition,
            long committedOffset,
            long logEndOffset,
            long lag
    ) {
    }
}
```

# 23. Jersey Admin Diagnostics Resource

```java id="admin-diagnostics-resource"
@Path("/internal/kafka")
@Produces(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
@Singleton
public final class KafkaAdminDiagnosticsResource {
    private final KafkaAdminDiagnosticsService diagnosticsService;

    @Inject
    public KafkaAdminDiagnosticsResource(KafkaAdminDiagnosticsService diagnosticsService) {
        this.diagnosticsService = diagnosticsService;
    }

    @GET
    @Path("/topics/{topic}")
    public Response describeTopic(@PathParam("topic") String topic) {
        TopicDescription description = diagnosticsService.describeTopic(topic);

        Map<String, Object> response = Map.of(
                "topic", description.name(),
                "internal", description.isInternal(),
                "partitions", description.partitions().stream()
                        .map(partition -> Map.of(
                                "partition", partition.partition(),
                                "leader", partition.leader() == null ? null : partition.leader().id(),
                                "replicas", partition.replicas().stream().map(Node::id).toList(),
                                "isr", partition.isr().stream().map(Node::id).toList()
                        ))
                        .toList()
        );

        return Response.ok(response).build();
    }

    @GET
    @Path("/lag")
    public Response lag(
            @QueryParam("topic") String topic,
            @QueryParam("groupId") String groupId
    ) {
        if (topic == null || topic.isBlank() || groupId == null || groupId.isBlank()) {
            return Response.status(Response.Status.BAD_REQUEST)
                    .entity(Map.of("error", "topic and groupId are required"))
                    .build();
        }

        return Response.ok(diagnosticsService.lag(topic, groupId)).build();
    }
}
```

# 24. Streams Topology Factory

```java id="streams-topology-factory"
@FunctionalInterface
public interface StreamsTopologyFactory {
    Topology build();
}
```

```java id="order-streams-topology"
@Singleton
public final class OrderStreamsTopologyFactory implements StreamsTopologyFactory {
    private final Serde<String> stringSerde = Serdes.String();
    private final Serde<Long> longSerde = Serdes.Long();
    private final Serde<OrderEvent> orderEventSerde;

    @Inject
    public OrderStreamsTopologyFactory(Serde<OrderEvent> orderEventSerde) {
        this.orderEventSerde = orderEventSerde;
    }

    @Override
    public Topology build() {
        StreamsBuilder builder = new StreamsBuilder();

        KStream<String, OrderEvent> events =
                builder.stream(
                        "order.order.events.v1",
                        Consumed.with(stringSerde, orderEventSerde)
                );

        events
                .filter((key, event) -> "OrderCreated".equals(event.eventType()))
                .groupByKey(Grouped.with(stringSerde, orderEventSerde))
                .count(Materialized.as("order-created-count-store"))
                .toStream()
                .to(
                        "order.order-created-counts.v1",
                        Produced.with(stringSerde, longSerde)
                );

        return builder.build();
    }
}
```

```java id="streams-config-factory"
        props.put(StreamsConfig.NUM_STANDBY_REPLICAS_CONFIG, "1");
```

# 26. KafkaStreamsLifecycleManager

`KafkaStreams.start()` memulai stream threads di background dan tidak memblokir, kecuali ada global store yang perlu dipulihkan; untuk fatal exception, daftarkan uncaught exception handler sebelum `start()`. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/40/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/streams/KafkaStreams.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```java id="streams-lifecycle-manager"
@Singleton
public final class KafkaStreamsLifecycleManager implements AutoCloseable {
    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(KafkaStreamsLifecycleManager.class);

    private final KafkaStreams streams;
    private final AtomicReference<KafkaStreams.State> state =
            new AtomicReference<>(KafkaStreams.State.CREATED);

    @Inject
    public KafkaStreamsLifecycleManager(
            StreamsTopologyFactory topologyFactory,
            KafkaStreamsConfigFactory configFactory
    ) {
        Topology topology = topologyFactory.build();
        Properties props = configFactory.create("order-summary-streams");

        this.streams = new KafkaStreams(topology, props);

        this.streams.setStateListener((newState, oldState) -> {
            state.set(newState);
            log.info("Kafka Streams state changed old={} new={}", oldState, newState);
        });

        this.streams.setUncaughtExceptionHandler(exception -> {
            log.error("Kafka Streams uncaught exception", exception);
            return StreamsUncaughtExceptionHandler.StreamThreadExceptionResponse.SHUTDOWN_APPLICATION;
        });
    }

    public void start() {
        streams.start();
    }

    public boolean isReady() {
        KafkaStreams.State current = state.get();
        return current == KafkaStreams.State.RUNNING;
    }

    public KafkaStreams.State state() {
        return state.get();
    }

    public Map<MetricName, ? extends Metric> metrics() {
        return streams.metrics();
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        streams.close(Duration.ofSeconds(30));
    }
}
```

# 29. KsqlDbClientService

ksqlDB Java Client menggunakan `ClientOptions` untuk host, port, TLS, ALPN, dan basic auth; client API menyediakan `streamQuery()`, `executeQuery()`, `executeStatement()`, dan metadata/list operations. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/ksqldb/developer-guide/java-client/java-client.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```java id="ksqldb-client-service"
@Singleton
public final class KsqlDbClientService implements AutoCloseable {
    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(KsqlDbClientService.class);

    private final Client client;

    @Inject
    public KsqlDbClientService(KsqlDbConfig config) {
        ClientOptions options = ClientOptions.create()
                .setHost(config.host())
                .setPort(config.port())
                .setUseTls(config.useTls())
                .setUseAlpn(config.useAlpn());

        if (config.basicAuthUser() != null && !config.basicAuthUser().isBlank()) {
            options.setBasicAuthCredentials(config.basicAuthUser(), config.basicAuthSecret());
        }

        this.client = Client.create(options);
    }

    public CompletableFuture<ServerInfo> serverInfo() {
        return client.serverInfo()
                .thenApply(info -> {
                    log.info("Connected to ksqlDB server version={}", info.getServerVersion());
                    return info;
                });
    }

    public CompletableFuture<ExecuteStatementResult> executeStatement(String sql) {
        return client.executeStatement(sql)
                .whenComplete((result, error) -> {
                    if (error == null) {
                        log.info("ksqlDB statement executed queryId={}", result.queryId().orElse(null));
                    } else {
                        log.error("ksqlDB statement failed", error);
                    }
                });
    }

    public CompletableFuture<List<Row>> executePullQuery(String sql) {
        return client.executeQuery(sql)
                .thenCompose(BatchedQueryResult::get);
    }

    public CompletableFuture<StreamedQueryResult> streamQuery(String sql) {
        return client.streamQuery(sql);
    }

    public CompletableFuture<List<StreamInfo>> listStreams() {
        return client.listStreams();
    }

    public CompletableFuture<List<TableInfo>> listTables() {
        return client.listTables();
    }

    public CompletableFuture<List<QueryInfo>> listQueries() {
        return client.listQueries();
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        client.close();
    }
}
```

ksqlDB memiliki persistent, push, dan pull queries; persistent queries berjalan server-side secara terus-menerus, push query mengalirkan perubahan, dan pull query membaca state materialized saat itu. ([Confluent Documentation](https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/ksqldb/concepts/queries.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

# 30. ksqlDB Query Service Example

```java id="ksqldb-query-service"
@Singleton
public final class OrderKsqlQueryService {
    private final KsqlDbClientService ksql;

    @Inject
    public OrderKsqlQueryService(KsqlDbClientService ksql) {
        this.ksql = ksql;
    }

    public CompletableFuture<Void> createOrderStreamIfNeeded() {
        String sql = """
                CREATE STREAM IF NOT EXISTS ORDERS (
                    ORDER_ID STRING KEY,
                    CUSTOMER_ID STRING,
                    STATUS STRING
                ) WITH (
                    KAFKA_TOPIC='order.order.events.v1',
                    VALUE_FORMAT='JSON'
                );
                """;

        return ksql.executeStatement(sql).thenApply(ignored -> null);
    }

    public CompletableFuture<List<Row>> findOrderSummary(String orderId) {
        String sql = """
                SELECT *
                FROM ORDER_SUMMARY
                WHERE ORDER_ID = '%s';
                """.formatted(orderId.replace("'", "''"));

        return ksql.executePullQuery(sql);
    }
}
```

# 32. Lifecycle Resource for Startup/Shutdown

```java id="application-lifecycle"
@Singleton
public final class ApplicationLifecycle implements AutoCloseable {
    private final KafkaConsumerSupervisor consumerSupervisor;
    private final KafkaProducerManager producerManager;
    private final KafkaAdminDiagnosticsService adminDiagnosticsService;
    private final Optional<KafkaStreamsLifecycleManager> streamsLifecycleManager;
    private final AtomicBoolean ready = new AtomicBoolean(false);
    private final AtomicBoolean shuttingDown = new AtomicBoolean(false);

    @Inject
    public ApplicationLifecycle(
            KafkaConsumerSupervisor consumerSupervisor,
            KafkaProducerManager producerManager,
            KafkaAdminDiagnosticsService adminDiagnosticsService,
            Optional<KafkaStreamsLifecycleManager> streamsLifecycleManager
    ) {
        this.consumerSupervisor = consumerSupervisor;
        this.producerManager = producerManager;
        this.adminDiagnosticsService = adminDiagnosticsService;
        this.streamsLifecycleManager = streamsLifecycleManager;
    }

    public void start() {
        consumerSupervisor.start();
        streamsLifecycleManager.ifPresent(KafkaStreamsLifecycleManager::start);
        ready.set(true);
    }

    public boolean isReady() {
        return ready.get() && !shuttingDown.get();
    }

    public void markShuttingDown() {
        shuttingDown.set(true);
        ready.set(false);
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        markShuttingDown();

        streamsLifecycleManager.ifPresent(KafkaStreamsLifecycleManager::close);
        consumerSupervisor.close();
        producerManager.close();
        adminDiagnosticsService.close();
    }
}
```

# 35. Graceful Shutdown Hook

```java id="shutdown-hook"
public final class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        ApplicationLifecycle lifecycle = bootstrapApplication();

        lifecycle.start();

        Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                lifecycle.close();
            } catch (Exception e) {
                LoggerFactory.getLogger(Main.class).error("Graceful shutdown failed", e);
            }
        }));
    }

    private static ApplicationLifecycle bootstrapApplication() {
        // bootstrap Jersey/HK2/container
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Implement bootstrap based on your servlet/container setup");
    }
}
```

Kubernetes akan mengirim TERM/SIGTERM selama proses terminasi Pod sebelum force kill setelah grace period; karena itu consumer perlu berhenti polling, commit safe offsets, dan close producer/consumer sebelum grace period habis.

# 36. Config Factory from Environment

```java id="common-config-factory"
public final class KafkaCommonConfigFactory implements Supplier<KafkaCommonConfig> {
    @Override
    public KafkaCommonConfig get() {
        String env = env("APP_ENV", "local");

        return new KafkaCommonConfig(
                required("KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS"),
                env("KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL", "PLAINTEXT"),
                env("KAFKA_SASL_MECHANISM", ""),
                env("KAFKA_SASL_JAAS_CONFIG", ""),
                env("KAFKA_SSL_TRUSTSTORE_LOCATION", ""),
                env("KAFKA_SSL_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD", ""),
                env("SERVICE_NAME", "order-service") + "-" + env("HOSTNAME", "local"),
                env
        );
    }

    private String required(String key) {
        String value = System.getenv(key);

        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required env var: " + key);
        }

        return value;
    }

    private String env(String key, String defaultValue) {
        String value = System.getenv(key);
        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
    }
}
```

# 38. Testing Templates

## 38.1 Producer Test with MockProducer

`MockProducer` adalah mock untuk testing code producer; default-nya dapat menyelesaikan send secara sinkron sukses, atau dikonfigurasi agar test mengontrol completion/error. ([Apache Kafka](https://kafka.apache.org/43/javadoc/org/apache/kafka/clients/producer/MockProducer.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com))

```java id="mock-producer-test"
@Test
void shouldPublishRecordWithExpectedTopicKeyAndHeaders() {
    MockProducer<String, String> mockProducer =
            new MockProducer<>(true, new StringSerializer(), new StringSerializer());

    // Jika KafkaProducerManager dibuat menerima Producer interface,
    // inject mockProducer untuk test.

    ProducerRecord<String, String> record =
            new ProducerRecord<>("order.order.events.v1", "order-123", "{}");

    mockProducer.send(record);

    assertThat(mockProducer.history()).hasSize(1);
    assertThat(mockProducer.history().get(0).topic()).isEqualTo("order.order.events.v1");
    assertThat(mockProducer.history().get(0).key()).isEqualTo("order-123");
}
```

## 38.2 OffsetTracker Test

```java id="offset-tracker-test"
@Test
void shouldNotCommitPastGap() {
    OffsetTracker tracker = new OffsetTracker();

    TopicPartition partition = new TopicPartition("orders", 0);
    tracker.initialize(List.of(partition));

    tracker.markCompleted(partition, 0);
    tracker.markCompleted(partition, 2);

    Map<TopicPartition, OffsetAndMetadata> offsets = tracker.safeOffsets();

    assertThat(offsets.get(partition).offset()).isEqualTo(1L);

    tracker.markCompleted(partition, 1);

    offsets = tracker.safeOffsets();

    assertThat(offsets.get(partition).offset()).isEqualTo(3L);
}
```

## 38.3 Streams TopologyTestDriver

```java id="topology-test-driver-template"
@Test
void shouldCountOrderCreatedEvents() {
    Topology topology = topologyFactory.build();

    Properties props = new Properties();
    props.put(StreamsConfig.APPLICATION_ID_CONFIG, "test-order-summary");
    props.put(StreamsConfig.BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS_CONFIG, "dummy:9092");

    try (TopologyTestDriver driver = new TopologyTestDriver(topology, props)) {
        TestInputTopic<String, OrderEvent> input =
                driver.createInputTopic(
                        "order.order.events.v1",
                        new StringSerializer(),
                        orderEventSerde.serializer()
                );

        TestOutputTopic<String, Long> output =
                driver.createOutputTopic(
                        "order.order-created-counts.v1",
                        new StringDeserializer(),
                        new LongDeserializer()
                );

        input.pipeInput("order-123", new OrderEvent("OrderCreated", "order-123"));
        input.pipeInput("order-456", new OrderEvent("OrderCreated", "order-456"));

        assertThat(output.readKeyValuesToList()).hasSize(2);
    }
}
```

# 39. Production Readiness Checklist

| Area | Checklist |
|---|---|
| Producer | Singleton, callback handled, `flush/close` on shutdown |
| Producer config | `acks=all`, idempotence, compression, timeout |
| Consumer | Single thread per `KafkaConsumer`, manual commit |
| Consumer shutdown | `wakeup()`, safe commit, close |
| Offset | Commit only contiguous processed offsets |
| Rebalance | `onPartitionsRevoked`, `onPartitionsAssigned`, `onPartitionsLost` |
| Retry | Publish retry before marking offset processed |
| DLQ | Publish DLQ before marking offset processed |
| Admin | Diagnostics protected/internal only |
| Streams | State listener, uncaught exception handler, close timeout |
| ksqlDB | SQL versioned, no uncontrolled ad-hoc mutation |
| Config | Prod rejects PLAINTEXT/SASL_PLAINTEXT |
| Security | Secrets externalized, ACL least privilege |
| Observability | eventId, correlationId, topic, partition, offset |
| Testing | MockProducer, OffsetTracker, TopologyTestDriver, integration tests |

---

# 40. Anti-Patterns

| Anti-pattern | Dampak |
|---|---|
| `new KafkaProducer()` per HTTP request | Overhead, connection churn |
| Ignore producer callback | Event loss silent |
| `KafkaConsumer` shared across threads | Race/unsafe |
| Auto commit untuk DB side effect | Data loss |
| Commit offset sebelum retry/DLQ publish sukses | Data loss |
| No `ConsumerRebalanceListener` | Duplicate meningkat |
| No `wakeup()` on shutdown | Pod termination buruk |
| Admin diagnostics public | Security risk |
| Streams ready saat state restore | Query salah/empty |
| ksqlDB SQL ad-hoc tanpa PR | Hidden production logic |
| PLAINTEXT prod | Security incident |
| DLQ tanpa metadata | Tidak bisa replay/debug |

---
